We introduce PACT (Pressure-Applied Compliance Testing), a benchmark for rule-following under pressure in AI agents assisting employees in daily tasks across twelve regulated enterprise domains and forty-eight scenarios, each set in a realistic multi-turn conversation. Each benchmark item pairs a standing rule against a rule-violating shortcut, and applies a battery of pressures across different wordings and system-prompt modes. We construct PACT component by component under strict LLM-as-judge auditing to ensure samples are unambiguous, ungameable, and realistic enough to avoid eliciting evaluation-aware behavior. We use PACT to profile LLM compliance across six complementary metrics that create a holistic picture of an AI assistant's robustness under pressure and throughout multi-turn conversations, its transparency, and ability to correctly discern where a rule applies. We aggregate this profile into PACTScore, a reliability-weighted compliance rate over all items and modes. Our results across 22 common LLM models spanning multiple providers and sizes show substantial variability in compliance across models and metric dimensions. Even the strongest assistants mis-apply a rule on 6 to 10% of items, and ordinary user pressure raises the violation rate by 65% on average. PACT highlights compliance risks in LLM assistants, motivating guardrails and careful model selection.

摘要：隨著企業對人工智慧的採用持續增長，企業級的LLM代理正在被部署到如招聘、醫療保健和金融等敏感領域。在這些情境中，遵守代理系統上下文中規定的規則是一項首要的法律關注。目前，尚無評估框架系統性地衡量哪些LLM模型傾向於違反合規規則，特別是在持續用戶、匆忙的經理或違規方便或吸引的情況下。我們介紹了PACT（壓力應用合規測試），這是一個基準，用於評估在壓力下遵循規則的AI代理，協助員工在十二個受監管的企業領域和四十八個場景中進行日常任務，每個場景都設置在現實的多輪對話中。每個基準項目將一項現行規則與一個違規的捷徑進行配對，並在不同的措辭和系統提示模式下施加一系列壓力。我們在嚴格的LLM作為評判的審計下逐步構建PACT，以確保樣本明確、不易被操控且足夠真實，以避免引發評估意識行為。我們使用PACT來分析LLM在六個互補指標上的合規性，這些指標共同描繪了AI助手在壓力下及整個多輪對話中的穩健性、透明度以及正確辨別規則適用範圍的能力。我們將這一分析整合為PACTScore，這是一個對所有項目和模式的可靠性加權合規率。我們在22個涵蓋多個提供商和規模的常見LLM模型中的結果顯示，模型和指標維度之間的合規性存在顯著變異性。即使是最強大的助手在6%到10%的項目上也會錯誤應用規則，而普通用戶的壓力平均會使違規率提高65%。PACT突顯了LLM助手中的合規風險，促使建立防護措施和謹慎的模型選擇。

docs.title: TRIPROBE: Probing Task Separability Beyond Classification for XAI
docs.text:
2609.18525v1 by Amirhossein Sadough, Freek Hens, Aleksa Bokšan, Mohammad Mahdi Dehshibi, Mahyar Shahsavari

Modern evaluation of learning pipelines often reduces to downstream accuracy, leaving open the question of why tasks succeed or fail. TriProbe addresses this gap with a multi-level probing framework for explainable diagnosis of task separability. Rather than treating models as black boxes, TriProbe traces how separability evolves across inputs, learned features, and final classifiers. It decomposes multi-task problems into binary subtasks and applies three complementary probes: a Foundational Probe on input spaces, a Latent Probe on feature representations, and a Final Probe on classifier outputs. Using Maximum Fisher's Discriminant Ratio as a principled separability metric, TriProbe identifies bottlenecks and affected task pairs. Experiments on the Roshambo sEMG benchmark show how TriProbe reveals hidden breakdowns, guiding data collection, validation, and architecture design.

摘要：現代對學習流程的評估通常簡化為下游準確性，留下了為何任務成功或失敗的問題。TriProbe 通過一個多層次的探測框架來解決這一空白，以便對任務可分性進行可解釋的診斷。TriProbe 並不將模型視為黑箱，而是追蹤可分性如何在輸入、學習特徵和最終分類器之間演變。它將多任務問題分解為二元子任務，並應用三個互補的探測器：對輸入空間的基礎探測器、對特徵表示的潛在探測器，以及對分類器輸出的最終探測器。使用最大費舍爾判別比作為原則性的可分性度量，TriProbe 確定瓶頸和受影響的任務對。在 Roshambo sEMG 基準上的實驗顯示 TriProbe 如何揭示隱藏的故障，指導數據收集、驗證和架構設計。

docs.title: Visual Compliance via Executable Safety Rule Entailment
docs.text:
2609.18328v1 by Jisoo Kim, TaeYoon Kwack, Jinwoo Jang, Honguk Woo

Recent advances in LLMs and VLMs have enabled safety systems to reason beyond simple risk patterns toward more contextual and semantic safety concerns. However, as risk patterns continue to evolve and safety rules become more complex, existing training-based end-to-end safeguards face persistent challenges in adaptability and explainable reasoning over complex safety rules. To address these challenges, we propose GuardEn (Guarding by Safety Rule Entailment), an executable safeguard framework that decomposes safety policies into atomic propositions through Safety-Rule Compilation, modeling their composition as executable code. At test time, Scene-Grounded Execution instantiates these atomic propositions with contextual visual information derived from scene graphs, enabling rule-grounded and interpretable safety reasoning. Experiments on SafetyVisionBench demonstrate the effectiveness of programmable safeguard for complex visual safety assessment, achieving an average improvement of 9.8 F1 points over the strongest baseline.

摘要：最近在大型語言模型（LLMs）和視覺語言模型（VLMs）方面的進展，使得安全系統能夠超越簡單的風險模式，朝向更具情境性和語義性的安全關注。然而，隨著風險模式的不斷演變和安全規則的日益複雜，現有基於訓練的端到端安全防護面臨著在適應性和對複雜安全規則的可解釋推理方面的持續挑戰。為了解決這些挑戰，我們提出了GuardEn（通過安全規則推導進行保護），這是一個可執行的安全防護框架，通過安全規則編譯將安全政策分解為原子命題，並將其組合建模為可執行代碼。在測試時，場景基礎執行使用來自場景圖的上下文視覺信息實例化這些原子命題，實現基於規則的可解釋安全推理。在SafetyVisionBench上的實驗證明了可編程安全防護在複雜視覺安全評估中的有效性，平均提高了9.8個F1點，相較於最強基準。

docs.title: Knowledge-Graph Based Augmentation versus Retrieval Augmented Generation for Cultural-Related Question Answering
docs.text:
2609.18317v2 by Pablo Poulenard, Yannis Karmim, Valentin Barrière

Large language models (LLMs) suffer from a long-tail deficit: culturally specific facts, particularly those concerning underrepresented regions such as Latin America, appear too rarely in pretraining corpora to be reliably memorized. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) addresses this by grounding generation in external text, but structured alternatives such as Knowledge Graphs (KGs) offer tighter control over what enters the context, along with potential gains in explainability and updatability. We benchmark Graph-RAG against standard RAG on LatamQA, a culturally grounded multiple-choice dataset spanning eight thematic categories. The graphs are built end-to-end from Wikipedia articles with KGGen, a recent open-domain extractor, without manual curation in our main setting. G-Retriever is competitive with RAG and reduces the error of the base LLM by 72\% with a standard KG and 78\% with a benchmark-aware variant, the gap to RAG narrowing further as the graph is oriented toward task-relevant content. The trained projection transfers zero-shot to Portuguese without target-language fine-tuning, indicating multilingual reach.

摘要：大型語言模型（LLMs）面臨長尾缺失的問題：文化特定的事實，特別是那些涉及拉丁美洲等代表性不足地區的事實，在預訓練語料庫中出現得過於稀少，無法可靠地被記住。檢索增強生成（RAG）通過將生成基於外部文本來解決這一問題，但結構化的替代方案如知識圖譜（KGs）則提供了對進入上下文的內容更緊密的控制，並可能在可解釋性和可更新性方面帶來收益。我們在LatamQA上對Graph-RAG進行基準測試，這是一個涵蓋八個主題類別的文化基礎多選題數據集。這些圖是從維基百科文章中端到端構建的，使用KGGen這個最近的開放領域提取器，並且在我們的主要設置中沒有手動策劃。G-Retriever在與RAG的競爭中表現出色，並將基礎LLM的錯誤率降低了72\%（使用標準KG）和78\%（使用基準感知變體），隨著圖的內容朝向任務相關內容，與RAG的差距進一步縮小。訓練後的投影在沒有目標語言微調的情況下可以零樣本轉移到葡萄牙語，顯示出多語言的覆蓋範圍。

docs.title: A Study of the Reliability of Agentic AI-Generated Programs
docs.text:
2609.18298v2 by Ayesha Shafique, Barton P. MIller, Elisa R. Heymann

Agentic-AI based software development offers the promise of faster completion of the software, greater programmer efficiency, and more reliable code. The question is how can we verify these claims in an objective way? In this project, we attempted to answer this question based on three practices. First, we applied a typical best-practices agentic AI workflow for software development. Second, our target programs were ten well-known, release-quality human-written Linux utility programs so that we could compare the AI-generated code against a concrete ground truth. Third, we based our measure of reliability on a widely used testing technique, fuzz random testing. For this testing, we used both classic black box, generational testing and more modern coverage guided (gray box, mutational) testing using AFL++. We found that the AI-generated versions of the utility programs were typically as reliable - often more reliable - than the latest human-generated versions of these programs. While the AI-generated versions did have some failures, they were less common than the code from the standard repositories. Interestingly, the AI-generated code was less likely to have failures such as memory errors (such as buffer overflows) but more likely to have hangs such as infinite loops. In addition, we verified that generating robust and reliable software using agentic AI requires careful practice and human supervision. The quality of the code is highly dependent on the prompts and skills used, and how the human directing the process responds. We also demonstrated that using agentic AI workflow for software development (with its prompts and skills) can become a specification of the code that leads to cost-effective sustainability of the software.

摘要：代理式人工智慧（Agentic-AI）基礎的軟體開發承諾能更快完成軟體、提高程式設計師效率，並產出更可靠的程式碼。問題是，我們如何以客觀的方式驗證這些聲明？在這個專案中，我們試圖根據三個實踐來回答這個問題。首先，我們應用了典型的最佳實踐代理式人工智慧工作流程來進行軟體開發。其次，我們的目標程式是十個知名的、發布品質的人類撰寫的 Linux 工具程式，以便將 AI 生成的程式碼與具體的真實情況進行比較。第三，我們的可靠性測量基於一種廣泛使用的測試技術，即模糊隨機測試。對於這項測試，我們使用了經典的黑箱生成測試以及更現代的覆蓋引導（灰箱、變異）測試，使用 AFL++。我們發現，這些工具程式的 AI 生成版本通常與最新的人類生成版本一樣可靠——往往更可靠。雖然 AI 生成的版本確實有一些失敗，但這些失敗的頻率低於標準庫中的程式碼。有趣的是，AI 生成的程式碼不太可能出現記憶體錯誤（例如緩衝區溢出），但更可能出現無限迴圈等掛起情況。此外，我們驗證了使用代理式人工智慧生成穩健可靠的軟體需要謹慎的實踐和人類監督。程式碼的質量在很大程度上取決於所使用的提示和技能，以及指導過程的人類如何反應。我們還展示了使用代理式人工智慧工作流程進行軟體開發（連同其提示和技能）可以成為程式碼的規範，從而實現軟體的成本效益可持續性。

docs.title: Building Trust in Artificial Intelligence: A Necessity for Railway Applications
docs.text:
2609.18278v1 by Lefebvre Renard Clément, Lébé Vincent, Da Silva Ribeiro Pereira Ricardo, Sundell Johan, Jaoul Arnaud Saiah Kenza, Mijatovíc Nenad

Artificial Intelligence (AI) is currently only applied to non-safety critical applications due to the strict standards and regulations for railway industries. We propose to review the three main fields necessary to increase trust in data science and AI algorithms and reach compliance: robustness, Operational Design Domain (ODD), and explainability. Robustness is the ability of an AI system to maintain its level of performance under any circumstances (ISO24029). ODDs allow the explicit definition of operating conditions under which a system is intended to operate, according to the recently published DIN DKE SPEC 99004. Explainability is the property of an AI system to express important factors influencing the AI system results in a way that humans can understand. Those 3 domains of research are already well investigated by nonrailway actors, with algorithms and methods ready to use for railway applications. A system view is necessary to ensure all trustworthy requirements interact continuously in a safe MLOps environment thereby fostering acceptance from regulators, operators and the public. Beyond safeguarding safety-critical applications, we aim to show that fostering deep trust in AI, as now required by regulatory frameworks worldwide, will unlock its full potential and transform the pace of adoption across mission-critical domains.

摘要：人工智慧（AI）目前僅應用於非安全關鍵的應用，因為鐵路行業有嚴格的標準和法規。我們提議回顧三個主要領域，以增加對數據科學和AI算法的信任並達到合規性：穩健性、操作設計範疇（ODD）和可解釋性。穩健性是指AI系統在任何情況下保持其性能水平的能力（ISO24029）。根據最近發布的DIN DKE SPEC 99004，ODD允許明確定義系統預期運行的操作條件。可解釋性是指AI系統以人類能理解的方式表達影響AI系統結果的重要因素的特性。這三個研究領域已被非鐵路參與者充分研究，並有算法和方法可供鐵路應用使用。系統觀點是必要的，以確保所有值得信賴的要求在安全的MLOps環境中持續互動，從而促進監管機構、運營商和公眾的接受。除了保護安全關鍵應用外，我們的目標是顯示，促進對AI的深度信任，如今全球監管框架所要求的，將釋放其全部潛力並改變在任務關鍵領域的採用速度。

docs.title: A Lightweight CNN Integrated Compact Convolutional Transformer for Multi-Scale Feature Learning and reducing computational complexity for breast cancer mammography image detection and classification
docs.text:
2609.18212v1 by Md Taimur Ahad, Ainuddin Ahmed

Over the years, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have demonstrated strong capability in cancer detection and classification using medical images. However, CNN-based models often struggle to capture long-range contextual dependencies. In such scenarios, integrating Compact Convolutional Transformer (CCT) architectures after the CCT layer allows CNN-extracted features to reshape into compact patch tokens using a CCT tokenizer, followed by the addition of positional embeddings to preserve spatial structure. Using 5-fold cross-validation, the model was tested on 3 sets of breast cancer mammography. With only 250,435 parameters, the model achieved 99%-100% accuracy across 3 datasets, indicating robust generalization. Explainable AI (XAI) was integrated into the model to explain the breast cancer classification process to enhance clinical trust. The results indicate that the proposed framework is suitable for computer-aided diagnosis systems, particularly in resource-constrained clinical environments. The novelty of the proposed CNN-integrated CCT overcomes the limitation of CNN's gradient degradation in the last layers by integrating convolutional tokenization with transformer-based learning. Lighter than ViT, which is effective in capturing long-range dependencies, the model has also proven efficient in breast cancer classification by capturing long-range dependencies among breast tissue regions.

摘要：多年來，卷積神經網絡（CNN）在使用醫學影像進行癌症檢測和分類方面展現了強大的能力。然而，基於CNN的模型往往難以捕捉長距離的上下文依賴性。在這種情況下，在CCT層之後整合緊湊卷積Transformer（CCT）架構，允許CNN提取的特徵通過CCT標記器重塑為緊湊的補丁標記，隨後添加位置嵌入以保留空間結構。使用5折交叉驗證，該模型在3組乳腺癌乳房X光檢查上進行測試。僅有250,435個參數，該模型在3個數據集上達到了99%-100%的準確率，顯示出強大的泛化能力。可解釋的人工智慧（XAI）被整合進模型中，以解釋乳腺癌分類過程，增強臨床信任。結果表明，所提出的框架適合用於計算機輔助診斷系統，特別是在資源受限的臨床環境中。所提出的CNN整合CCT的新穎性克服了CNN在最後幾層中的梯度退化限制，通過將卷積標記化與基於Transformer的學習相結合。該模型比ViT更輕巧，ViT在捕捉長距離依賴性方面有效，並且在乳腺癌分類中也證明了其效率，能夠捕捉乳腺組織區域之間的長距離依賴性。

docs.title: Rethinking How We Evaluate Methodological Progress in Health AI
docs.text:
2609.18134v2 by Florent Pollet, Matthew McDermott

Methodological progress in artificial intelligence (AI) for electronic health records (EHRs) depends on our ability to determine which algorithms work better, and under which conditions. However, such progress is thought to be hindered by difficulties in reproducibility and in defining clinically meaningful evaluation tasks. We empirically study these barriers by re-implementing 12 historical and recent algorithms within a shared evaluation framework and evaluating them on two clinical datasets, MIMIC-IV and NWICU. We compare two complementary task families: expert-authored clinically meaningful tasks and generated tasks defined from randomly sampled event codes and prediction horizons. We ask whether relative algorithms comparisons transfer across task families and datasets, whether residual task heterogeneity contains useful methodological structure, and what a controlled comparison reveals about progress over the last decade. We find that aggregate pairwise comparisons transfer strongly across evaluation settings, including from randomly generated tasks to clinically meaningful tasks and across datasets. At the same time, clinically meaningful tasks exhibit greater task-method interaction, providing preliminary evidence that task properties can help explain when particular modeling choices are advantageous. Finally, newer algorithms do not consistently outperform earlier approaches: gradient-boosted trees remain highly competitive when paired with a modern, wide and sparse representation of the EHR. Together, these results suggest that useful methodological knowledge may require less task engineering than commonly assumed, while highlighting the importance of understanding the structured heterogeneity that remains across tasks and methods.

摘要：方法論在人工智慧 (AI) 於電子健康紀錄 (EHRs) 的進展取決於我們判斷哪些演算法表現更佳以及在何種條件下。然而，這樣的進展被認為受到可重複性和定義臨床上有意義的評估任務的困難所阻礙。我們透過在共享評估框架內重新實現 12 種歷史和近期的演算法，並在兩個臨床數據集 MIMIC-IV 和 NWICU 上進行評估，實證研究這些障礙。我們比較兩個互補的任務類別：專家編寫的臨床有意義任務和從隨機抽樣事件代碼和預測視野定義的生成任務。我們詢問相對的演算法比較是否能在任務類別和數據集之間轉移，殘餘任務異質性是否包含有用的方法論結構，以及受控比較對過去十年的進展揭示了什麼。我們發現，總體成對比較在評估環境之間強烈轉移，包括從隨機生成的任務到臨床有意義的任務以及跨數據集。同時，臨床有意義的任務顯示出更大的任務-方法互動，提供初步證據表明任務特性可以幫助解釋何時特定的建模選擇是有利的。最後，較新的演算法並不總是優於早期的方法：梯度提升樹在與現代的、寬且稀疏的 EHR 表示配對時仍然具有高度競爭力。綜合這些結果表明，有用的方法論知識可能需要的任務工程少於普遍假設，同時強調理解任務和方法之間仍然存在的結構性異質性的重要性。

docs.title: Measuring AI Leadership: Development and Validation of a Multidimensional Measure for AI-Native Organizations
docs.text:
2609.17965v1 by Mustafa Akben, Leslie Coyne

AI is changing what leaders must judge, explain, learn, and coordinate, yet existing measures do not capture these behaviors at the level needed to study leadership in AI-enabled work. We develop the AI Leadership Battery, which organizes 36 behaviorally specific subdimensions into 11 theory-specified content families. Following established scale-development procedures, the research used deductive item generation; content validation of definitional correspondence and definitional distinctiveness; exploratory factor analysis and item reduction; confirmatory factor analysis in independent samples; and tests of internal consistency reliability, convergent validity, discriminant validity, and criterion-related and incremental validity. Across the development and validation studies, the analyses provided evidence for the Battery's content, multidimensional structure, reliability, and distinction from selected orbiting constructs. The Battery also contributed additional information beyond orbiting constructs across organizational growth, decision speed, customer/stakeholder response capability, AI-enabled team performance, AI-enabled work experience, AI security and risk management, and AI adoption and integration. The resulting measure provides researchers with a behavioral framework for examining how leaders in AI-enabled work regulate judgment, learning, adaptation, transparency, and accountability.

摘要：AI 正在改變領導者必須判斷、解釋、學習和協調的內容，但現有的衡量標準並未捕捉到這些行為，無法在研究 AI 驅動的工作中的領導力時達到所需的水平。我們開發了 AI 領導力電池，它將 36 個行為特定的子維度組織成 11 個理論指定的內容家族。根據既定的量表開發程序，研究使用了演繹性項目生成；對定義對應性和定義區別性的內容驗證；探索性因素分析和項目縮減；在獨立樣本中的驗證性因素分析；以及內部一致性可靠性、收斂效度、區別效度和標準相關及增量效度的測試。在開發和驗證研究中，分析提供了對電池內容、多維結構、可靠性以及與選定的相關構念之間的區別的證據。該電池還提供了超越相關構念的額外信息，涵蓋組織增長、決策速度、客戶/利益相關者反應能力、AI 驅動的團隊表現、AI 驅動的工作經驗、AI 安全和風險管理，以及 AI 採用和整合。最終的測量為研究人員提供了一個行為框架，以檢視 AI 驅動工作中的領導者如何調節判斷、學習、適應、透明度和問責制。

docs.title: AI and Human Approaches to Mathematical Problem Solving
docs.text:
2609.17779v1 by Yang Ding

AI systems have begun to report solutions, disproofs, and substantive advances on long-standing mathematical problems, raising questions about whether they approach research in the same way as mathematicians. This study compares public AI research accounts with the human literature on 11 such problems. The human corpus contains 58 papers that directly addressed the same mathematical targets later reported by AI sources as resolved, disproved, or substantially advanced; 31 within-problem comparisons were constructed from these materials. Six validated text-based measures capture problem resolution, method articulation, uncertainty and boundary specification, successor-question generation, generality, and cross-disciplinary integration. AI accounts place greater emphasis on resolving the focal problem and connecting ideas across fields. Human papers devote significantly more attention to explaining methods, specifying assumptions and limitations, and identifying questions for subsequent research. No precise difference is detected in generality. The estimated directions remain unchanged when each mathematical problem is removed in turn. The findings reveal two distinct research profiles: AI accounts concentrate on closing and recombining problems, whereas mathematical papers more extensively document the procedures, limits, and research opportunities through which results become cumulative knowledge. Evaluating research AI therefore requires attention to the organization of inquiry, not only whether a target is solved.

摘要：AI 系統已開始報告解決方案、反駁和在長期存在的數學問題上取得的實質性進展，這引發了關於它們是否以與數學家相同的方式進行研究的問題。這項研究將公共 AI 研究報告與人類文獻中 11 個此類問題進行比較。人類文獻包含 58 篇直接針對 AI 來源後來報告為已解決、被反駁或實質性進展的相同數學目標的論文；這些材料構建了 31 個問題內比較。六個經驗驗證的文本基準捕捉了問題解決、方法闡述、不確定性和邊界規範、後繼問題生成、普遍性和跨學科整合。AI 報告更強調解決焦點問題和跨領域連結思想。人類論文則顯著更多地關注解釋方法、指定假設和限制，以及識別後續研究的問題。普遍性方面未檢測到明確差異。當每個數學問題依次移除時，估計的方向保持不變。研究結果揭示了兩種不同的研究輪廓：AI 報告專注於關閉和重新組合問題，而數學論文則更廣泛地記錄了通過哪些程序、限制和研究機會使結果成為累積知識。評估研究 AI 因此需要關注探究的組織，而不僅僅是目標是否被解決。

docs.title: Information Set Emulation: Causal Certificates for AI Derived EHR Features
docs.text:
2609.17777v1 by Takes Fujita, Nobutaka Hattori

AI and large language models can recover clinically meaningful features from electronic health records (EHRs), but predictive usefulness does not establish admissibility for causal inference. We introduce information set emulation: an AI typed lift attaches source evidence, clinical and recording times, decision-time availability, representation version, proposed causal roles, and unresolved ambiguity to extracted features under a locked target trial. Causal certificates record auditable evidence for those roles. Features with unresolved downstream roles are routed to compatible reporting or separate analyses. Typed evidence defines an observational fiber of causal worlds consistent with the observed law. The locked scalar estimand maps this fiber to a compatible image whose squared Chebyshev radius equals the residual minimax mean squared error when the image is nonempty and compact. This classical identity provides a target-specific measure of information ambiguity. The contribution is its integration with a joint EHR observation map and an auditable certificate architecture. Under explicit exchangeability, positivity, and nuisance-consistency conditions, we give identification and cross-fitted augmented inverse probability weighted estimation, distinguishing empirical and population targets. An EHR compression-drift identity separates the roles of frame presence, treatment assignment, and outcome observation. Artificial simulations and a common-law finite-world example illustrate estimation failures and information-radius reduction. Synthetic Phase 0 notes demonstrate audit diagnostics; a separate role-specific analysis spread illustrates routing and is not an exact fiber radius. All experiments are synthetic. The framework specifies when reconstructed information can support a point claim and when compatible reporting is required.

摘要：AI 和大型語言模型可以從電子健康記錄 (EHRs) 中恢復臨床有意義的特徵，但預測的有用性並不建立因果推斷的可接受性。 我們引入信息集模擬：一種 AI 類型的提升將來源證據、臨床和記錄時間、決策時間的可用性、表示版本、提議的因果角色和未解決的模糊性附加到鎖定目標試驗下提取的特徵。 因果證書記錄這些角色的可審計證據。 具有未解決下游角色的特徵被路由到兼容的報告或單獨分析。 類型證據定義了一種觀察性因果世界的纖維，與觀察到的法則一致。 鎖定的標量估計量將這個纖維映射到一個兼容的圖像，其平方切比雪夫半徑等於當圖像非空且緊湊時的殘差最小最大均方誤差。 這一經典身份提供了一種特定於目標的信息模糊性測量。 其貢獻在於與聯合 EHR 觀察圖和可審計證書架構的整合。 在明確的可交換性、正性和干擾一致性條件下，我們給出了識別和交叉擬合的增強逆概率加權估計，區分經驗和人口目標。 EHR 壓縮漂移身份分離了框架存在、治療分配和結果觀察的角色。 人工模擬和一個普通法有限世界的例子說明了估計失敗和信息半徑的減少。 合成的第 0 階段記錄展示了審計診斷；一個單獨的角色特定分析擴展展示了路由，並不是一個精確的纖維半徑。 所有實驗都是合成的。 該框架指定了何時重建的信息可以支持一個點聲明以及何時需要兼容的報告。

docs.title: Evolution of US Oral Political Language
docs.text:
2609.17755v1 by Jacques Savoy

The analysis of US political language is usually based on the written form (e.g. presidential addresses) or posts broadcasted on various social networks. Oral production, however, which is even more frequent, can better reveal the style and mode of thinking of the speaker. This study covers this mode of linguistic communication by considering 19 candidates from the presidential elections between 1960 to 2024. Our main research objectives are to disclose the main trends hidden in those presidential debates. Do we observe a clear simplification of the US political language over time? Does Trump have poor language compared to the other candidates? Do unusual stylistic features occur only with a single, specific president? Moreover, can we detect a pattern explaining the success or failure of some nominees? Over time, this study demonstrates a significant reduction in political language complexity, a decrease of the mean sentence length, and a noteworthy decline of complex terms. Moreover, the emotional tone increases over the decades, while logical and rational thinking tends to lessen.

摘要：美國政治語言的分析通常基於書面形式（例如總統演說）或在各種社交網絡上廣播的帖子。然而，口語表達更為頻繁，能更好地揭示講者的風格和思維模式。本研究通過考慮1960年至2024年之間的19位候選人來涵蓋這種語言交流模式。我們的主要研究目標是揭示那些總統辯論中隱藏的主要趨勢。我們是否觀察到美國政治語言隨時間的明顯簡化？特朗普的語言是否比其他候選人差？不尋常的風格特徵是否僅出現在某位特定的總統身上？此外，我們能否檢測到解釋某些提名人成功或失敗的模式？隨著時間的推移，本研究顯示政治語言的複雜性顯著降低，平均句子長度減少，複雜術語的顯著下降。此外，情感語調在幾十年中增加，而邏輯和理性思維則趨向減少。

docs.title: Det-LIME: Detector-Aware, Multi-Instance Local Interpretable Model-Agnostic Explanations for Automated Marine Mammal Detection
docs.text:
2609.17479v1 by Jiayi Zhou, David W. Johnston, Brinnae Bent

Despite the rapid uptake of black-box object detectors in marine mammal research and monitoring, explainability techniques are rarely integrated into conservation workflows. Furthermore, most classification-oriented explainability tools are ill-suited to detection tasks involving imagery of social organisms or those with colonial life histories, as they ignore multiple detections within a scene and produce single-instance outputs that blur evidence across individuals. These methods also generate low-resolution, often biologically irrelevant visuals, limiting their utility for debugging, targeted data augmentation, and refined data collection. We proposed Det-LIME, a detector-aware, multi-instance adaptation of Local Interpretable Model-Agnostic Explanations (LIME) that produced instance-specific, box-aligned explanations by combining per-detection weighting, a proximity kernel that emphasizes regions near each box, and Intersection-over-Union-based matching to track the same instance across perturbations. We evaluated Det-LIME on aerial drone imagery for harbor seal detection, with an additional seabird case study to assess generality, and compared it with vanilla LIME, Stabilized LIME, Deterministic LIME, and gradient-based attribution methods. Using the Attribution Ratio and Max Saliency Hit Rate metrics, we showed that Det-LIME consistently improved multi-instance attribution. In practice, these higher-resolution, instance-aware explanations provide insight into model outputs and support post-processing, debugging, and actionable improvements in modeling and data collection or augmentation.

摘要：儘管黑箱物體檢測器在海洋哺乳動物研究和監測中的快速應用，解釋技術卻很少融入保育工作流程中。此外，大多數以分類為導向的解釋工具不適合涉及社會生物或具有群居生活史的檢測任務，因為它們忽略了場景中的多重檢測，並產生模糊個體證據的單一實例輸出。這些方法還生成低解析度、通常生物學上無關的視覺效果，限制了它們在調試、針對性數據增強和精細數據收集中的實用性。我們提出了Det-LIME，這是一種檢測器感知的多實例適應性本地可解釋模型無關解釋（LIME），通過結合每次檢測的加權、強調每個框附近區域的接近核，以及基於交集-聯合的匹配來跟踪相同的實例，產生特定於實例的、框對齊的解釋。我們在用於港口海豹檢測的無人機航拍影像上評估了Det-LIME，並進行了額外的海鳥案例研究以評估其普遍性，並將其與原始LIME、穩定LIME、確定性LIME和基於梯度的歸因方法進行比較。使用歸因比率和最大顯著性命中率指標，我們顯示Det-LIME在多實例歸因方面持續改善。在實踐中，這些更高解析度、實例感知的解釋提供了對模型輸出的洞察，並支持後處理、調試以及在建模和數據收集或增強中的可行改進。

docs.title: CareMirror: Bringing Caregiver Wellbeing into the Dementia Care Ecosystem
docs.text:
2609.17434v1 by Jiayue Melissa Shi, Ethan Nguyen, Drishti Goel, Upasana Natarajan, Shashwat Srivatsa, Daniel S. Brown, Violeta J. Rodríguez, Dong Whi Yoo, Ravi Karkar, Koustuv Saha

Family caregivers of people living with dementia shoulder emotional and practical responsibilities, yet their own wellbeing often remains peripheral to dementia care. We built CareMirror, an envisioned caregiver wellbeing ecosystem with interconnected caregiver- and clinician-facing interfaces for longitudinal reflection, personalized support, and caregiver-controlled sharing with clinical care. We conducted semi-structured interviews with 14 caregivers, using CareMirror as a design probe to examine how they perceived this ecosystem and what expectations, concerns, and boundaries emerged around clinical connection. Caregivers valued attention to their wellbeing, longitudinal awareness, context-sensitive support, and clinical visibility when it could lead to meaningful follow-up. However, repeated reflection could become burdensome or emotionally difficult, automatic clinical sharing could inhibit candid disclosure, and participants wanted control over what information entered clinical care. They also expected AI to support reflection and communication without replacing caregiver voice or clinician judgment. We contribute design considerations for proactive, clinically connected caregiver wellbeing support.

摘要：家庭照顧者在照顧患有癡呆症的人時，承擔著情感和實際的責任，但他們自己的福祉往往在癡呆症護理中處於邊緣地位。我們建立了CareMirror，一個設想中的照顧者福祉生態系統，擁有互聯的面向照顧者和臨床醫生的界面，用於長期反思、個性化支持和照顧者控制的臨床共享。我們對14位照顧者進行了半結構化訪談，使用CareMirror作為設計探針，檢視他們對這個生態系統的看法，以及圍繞臨床聯繫出現的期望、擔憂和界限。照顧者重視對他們福祉的關注、長期的認知、情境敏感的支持，以及在能夠導致有意義的後續跟進時的臨床可見性。然而，重複的反思可能會變得繁重或情感上困難，自動的臨床共享可能會抑制坦誠的披露，參與者希望能控制進入臨床護理的信息。他們還期望人工智慧能支持反思和溝通，而不取代照顧者的聲音或臨床醫生的判斷。我們提供了主動、臨床連結的照顧者福祉支持的設計考量。

docs.title: Finding Common Mistakes In Modelling With Mathematical Formalisms Using LLMs
docs.text:
2609.17111v1 by Lilian Killich, Marko Schmellenkamp, Fabian Vehlken, Thomas Zeume

Modelling with mathematical formalisms like logical formulas, mathematical equations, or regular expressions is an important yet challenging task for students of computer science and other STEM disciplines. Identifying common mistakes occurring in this context is an important step towards helping struggling students by providing targeted high-quality feedback, e.g. in interactive learning systems. We present a tool-supported workflow that allows to (1) identify candidates for common mistakes that explain many student mistakes in large educational data sets, (2) cluster candidates according to similarities, and (3) visualize resulting clusters for instructors and CS education researchers. The visualization is designed to help researchers to identify common modelling mistakes. The candidates for common mistakes are represented by bug fixing transformations that translate incorrect formalizations into correct formalizations; they are generated by an LLM and validated algorithmically. We show that this approach works well by reproducing common mistakes in propositional logic modelling that were identified by hand in the literature; showing that, unlike other algorithmic approaches, the LLM-based approach is suitable for very large sets of data; and applying it to multiple other formalisms to showcase it generalizes beyond propositional logic.

摘要：使用數學形式主義進行建模，例如邏輯公式、數學方程或正則表達式，是計算機科學和其他STEM學科學生面臨的重要但具有挑戰性的任務。識別在這種情境中出現的常見錯誤是幫助掙扎中的學生的一個重要步驟，通過提供針對性的高質量反饋，例如在互動學習系統中。 我們提出了一個工具支持的工作流程，允許 (1) 確定解釋許多學生錯誤的常見錯誤候選者，這些候選者來自於大型教育數據集，(2) 根據相似性對候選者進行聚類，以及 (3) 為教師和計算機科學教育研究者可視化結果聚類。該可視化旨在幫助研究人員識別常見的建模錯誤。常見錯誤的候選者由錯誤修正轉換表示，這些轉換將不正確的形式化轉換為正確的形式化；它們由LLM生成並通過算法進行驗證。 我們展示了這種方法的有效性，通過重現文獻中手動識別的命題邏輯建模中的常見錯誤；顯示出與其他算法方法不同，基於LLM的方法適用於非常大的數據集；並將其應用於多種其他形式主義，以展示其超越命題邏輯的通用性。

docs.title: Sample-Conditioned Representation Selection for Audio Few-Shot Learning
docs.text:
2609.17076v1 by Fengrui Liu, Ningxin Shen, Yi Li, Yiwei Fu, Feng Liu, Jiangmeng Li

Few-shot audio classifiers may rely on foreground-background co-occurrences and fail when those correlations shift. On SpurAudio, the resulting representation shift is concentrated and class dependent: for ResNet12, the top 10 percent of channels explain 82.80 percent of the null-corrected shift contribution. We propose SAMPLESELECT, which predicts a fixed-budget feature mask independently for each input while keeping the encoder and source classifier frozen. Training uses differentiable Gumbel Top-k selection with foreground classification and cross-background contrastive losses; inference uses deterministic Top-k masks and support-only linear adaptation. Across ResNet12 and Conv64 in 5-way 1-shot and 5-shot evaluation, SAMPLESELECT gives the best OOD accuracy among the compared methods and improves the matched full-representation control by 4.90-8.38 percentage points. Ablations and representation analyses further support the learned selection mechanism. Code is available at https://github.com/Cross-Innovation-Lab/SAMPLESELECT/

摘要：少量樣本的音頻分類器可能依賴於前景與背景的共現，當這些相關性發生變化時會失效。在 SpurAudio 上，結果的表示變化是集中且依賴於類別的：對於 ResNet12，前 10% 的通道解釋了 82.80% 的無效修正變化貢獻。我們提出了 SAMPLESELECT，該方法為每個輸入獨立預測固定預算的特徵掩碼，同時保持編碼器和源分類器不變。訓練使用可微分的 Gumbel Top-k 選擇，結合前景分類和跨背景對比損失；推理使用確定性 Top-k 掩碼和僅支持的線性適應。在 5-way 1-shot 和 5-shot 評估中，SAMPLESELECT 在比較方法中提供了最佳的 OOD 準確率，並將匹配的完整表示控制提高了 4.90-8.38 個百分點。消融實驗和表示分析進一步支持了學習的選擇機制。代碼可在 https://github.com/Cross-Innovation-Lab/SAMPLESELECT/ 獲得。

docs.title: When Confidence Signals Disagree: Local and Global Confidence in Autoregressive Language Models
docs.text:
2609.16933v1 by Julio C. Amador Diaz Lopez

Modern predictive systems expose multiple quantities that are commonly interpreted as measures of confidence. However, these quantities can summarize different aspects of the predictive process. This distinction matters when confidence is used to evaluate reliability or inform downstream oversight and control. We investigate whether different confidence readouts are empirically interchangeable in an autoregressive language model by comparing local confidence, defined from the probability of the greedy-selected answer token, with global confidence, defined from modal-answer frequency under repeated sampling. Across MMLU and ARC Challenge, the two signals are weakly correlated and differ substantially in their association with correctness: global confidence is moderately associated with correctness, whereas local confidence shows little association. We further test whether question-level disagreement between the signals is associated with sampling instability. On ARC, larger local--global confidence gaps are associated with higher answer entropy, more distinct sampled answers, and lower modal-answer concentration. The gap--entropy association persists when disagreement and instability are estimated from disjoint stochastic samples, indicating that it is not explained by shared finite-sample variation. The corresponding relationship is substantially weaker on MMLU, where only 4% of questions exhibit sampling instability. These results show that confidence readouts derived from the same predictive system are not empirically interchangeable and that their disagreement can provide a diagnostic of unstable sampling behavior. Confidence should therefore be treated as an explicitly defined measurement rather than as a single intrinsic scalar property of a model, particularly when it is used to inform downstream evaluation, oversight, or control.

摘要：現代的預測系統揭示了多個量度，這些量度通常被解釋為信心的指標。然而，這些量度可以總結預測過程的不同方面。當信心被用來評估可靠性或提供下游監督和控制時，這一區別是重要的。我們通過比較本地信心（從貪婪選擇的答案標記的概率定義）和全局信心（從重複抽樣下的模式答案頻率定義）來調查不同的信心讀數在自回歸語言模型中是否可以互換。在 MMLU 和 ARC 挑戰中，這兩種信號的相關性較弱，並且在與正確性關聯方面有顯著差異：全局信心與正確性中度相關，而本地信心則幾乎沒有相關性。我們進一步測試信號之間的問題級別不一致是否與抽樣不穩定性相關。在 ARC 中，較大的本地-全局信心差距與較高的答案熵、更多不同的抽樣答案以及較低的模式答案集中度相關。當不一致性和不穩定性是從不相交的隨機樣本中估計時，差距-熵的關聯仍然存在，這表明它並不是由共享的有限樣本變異解釋的。在 MMLU 上，對應的關係顯著較弱，只有 4% 的問題顯示出抽樣不穩定性。這些結果表明，來自同一預測系統的信心讀數在實證上並不可互換，且它們的不一致性可以提供不穩定抽樣行為的診斷。因此，信心應被視為明確定義的測量，而不是模型的單一內在標量屬性，特別是當它用來通知下游評估、監督或控制時。

docs.title: Right Direction, Wrong Step: Geometric Analysis of Finite-Step Failure in Looped Transformers
docs.text:
2609.16665v1 by Zhihao Guo, Zonghan Wu, Haizhou Du, Huan Huo, Yilei Shao, Athanasios V. Vasilakos, Qingsong Wen

Looped Transformers offer a parameter-efficient route to test-time scaling by reusing shared layers for iterative latent reasoning. However, additional iterations can reduce support for a reference answer, leaving unclear whether an update's direction is locally unhelpful or its full displacement moves too far. We study this distinction by analysing reference utility, which measures this support, along the model's own update direction, varying the fraction of the proposed displacement supplied to the readout. This reveals finite-step failures in which a locally improving direction produces a harmful full update. A pathwise curvature decomposition characterises how initial progress is lost, while a local quadratic model predicts full-step gains and useful step scales. Bounds based on accumulated curvature variation characterise the approximation error of these predictions. Experiments across two model families reveal this separation on mathematical and commonsense tasks. A fixed quarter step produces positive gains in reference utility for 72.2--83.2% of selected failures across four settings. These findings identify a mismatch between update direction and step scale as a mechanism of lost progress, explaining how some harmful updates retain useful computation.

摘要：循環Transformer提供了一種參數高效的測試時間擴展方法，通過重用共享層進行迭代潛在推理。然而，額外的迭代可能會減少對參考答案的支持，讓人無法清楚地判斷更新的方向是局部無效還是其整體位移移動過遠。我們通過分析參考效用來研究這一區別，該效用衡量沿著模型自身的更新方向的支持程度，並變化提供給讀取的建議位移的比例。這揭示了有限步驟失敗的情況，其中一個局部改善的方向產生了有害的完整更新。一種路徑曲率分解特徵化了初始進展是如何喪失的，而一個局部二次模型則預測了全步驟的增益和有用的步驟尺度。基於累積曲率變化的界限特徵化了這些預測的近似誤差。在兩個模型系列中的實驗揭示了在數學和常識任務上的這一區分。在四個設置中，固定的四分之一步驟在72.2--83.2%的選定失敗中產生了參考效用的正增益。這些發現確定了更新方向和步驟尺度之間的不匹配作為進展喪失的一種機制，解釋了為什麼一些有害的更新仍然保留有用的計算。

docs.title: Abstracts
TrackEverything: Long Horizon Dense Tracking via De-Duplicating 3D Scene Representations
docs.text:
2609.30222v1 by Ayush Jain, Sreeharsha Paruchuri, Ishita Gupta, Fan Zhang, Tanner Schmidt, Jakob Engel, Katerina Fragkiadaki, Adam W. Harley

Existing point tracking models face a fundamental tradeoff: they can either track a sparse set of query points over long horizons, or track all points across only short clips. We introduce TrackEverything, a 3D point tracker that breaks this trade-off by representing videos as persistent 3D scene tracks in world coordinates. Grounded in the insight that videos are 2D projections of an underlying 3D world, TrackEverything decouples model complexity from video duration, allowing it to scale with unique physical scene geometry instead. Our approach introduces three key innovations. First, we employ a voxelization-based de-duplication mechanism at sliding-window boundaries to merge co-located tracks, preventing repeated observations of the same surface from redundantly accumulating. Second, we decompose tracking into an endpoint refiner that predicts each point's destination and static-versus-dynamic classification, followed by a lightweight trajectory refiner that decodes dense trajectories exclusively for dynamic points. Third, we propose 3D WAFT, replacing memory-prohibitive 4D correlation volumes with efficient feature sampling in the scene cloud. To the best of our knowledge, TrackEverything is the first 3D tracker capable of tracking all visible points across videos exceeding 1000 frames within 40 GB of GPU memory. On TAPVid-3D, TrackEverything outperforms all open-source all-frame dense 3D trackers by more than 20% APD on short clips, while remaining competitive with state-of-the-art sparse trackers on long sequences, despite tracking far more points.

摘要：現有的點追蹤模型面臨一個基本的權衡：它們要麼能在長時間範圍內追蹤稀疏的查詢點，要麼只能在短片段內追蹤所有點。我們介紹了 TrackEverything，一款通過將視頻表示為世界坐標中的持久 3D 場景軌跡來打破這一權衡的 3D 點追蹤器。基於視頻是潛在 3D 世界的 2D 投影的見解，TrackEverything 將模型複雜性與視頻持續時間解耦，從而使其能夠根據獨特的物理場景幾何進行擴展。我們的方法引入了三個關鍵創新。首先，我們在滑動窗口邊界採用基於體素化的去重機制來合併共址的軌跡，防止對同一表面的重複觀察冗餘累積。其次，我們將追蹤分解為一個端點細化器，該細化器預測每個點的目的地和靜態與動態分類，然後由一個輕量級的軌跡細化器專門解碼動態點的密集軌跡。第三，我們提出了 3D WAFT，通過在場景雲中進行高效的特徵採樣來替代記憶體消耗過大的 4D 相關體積。據我們所知，TrackEverything 是第一個能夠在超過 1000 幀的視頻中追蹤所有可見點且僅需 40 GB GPU 記憶體的 3D 追蹤器。在 TAPVid-3D 上，TrackEverything 在短片段中超越了所有開源的全幀密集 3D 追蹤器，APD 提高了 20% 以上，同時在長序列中與最先進的稀疏追蹤器保持競爭力，儘管追蹤的點數遠超過其他模型。

docs.title: ExplorationBench: Measuring AI Systems' Exploration in Verifiable Alien Worlds
docs.text:
2609.30199v1 by Ming Zhang, Zhenghao Xiang, Peizhong Gao, Yujiong Shen, Yuhui Wang, Zhonghan Yue, Shihan Dou, Zhangyue Yin, Junjie Ye, Shichun Liu, Weihuang Zheng, Jiahao Chen, Jiayi Chen, Hongzhang Liu, Jiaqi Shao, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang, Xuanjing Huang, Suncong Zheng, Maxm Pan

Scientific discovery begins where known problems end. There, AI systems must engage in exploration: framing hypotheses, designing experiments, and iterating on the results. However, evaluating this ability is difficult: (1) how to verify whether a genuinely new hypothesis holds, and (2) how to determine whether a system has discovered it through exploration or merely recalled related knowledge from pre-training data. To this end, we introduce ExplorationBench, which turns the wicked problem of evaluating scientific exploration into a concrete and tractable framework built on verifiable Alien Worlds: their rules are executable, so every answer can be checked exactly, and they conflict with familiar knowledge, so recall alone cannot solve the tasks. The benchmark contains two sandboxes, AlienCode (31 discovery targets, 70 tasks) and AlienLogic (24 discovery targets, 70 tasks). Each sandbox provides a flawed manual, task-specific environmental feedback, and a dedicated tool-call schema. Systems use these resources to explore the sandbox, then solve held-out tasks. We evaluate 10 AI systems and find that the strongest systems can acquire and apply unfamiliar rules, while performance varies substantially across trajectories and continued exploration can stall or reverse earlier gains. ExplorationBench represents a step towards AI systems that can acquire and apply genuinely new knowledge through exploration in unknown environments.

摘要：科學發現始於已知問題的終結。在那裡，AI 系統必須進行探索：框定假設、設計實驗並對結果進行迭代。然而，評估這種能力是困難的：(1) 如何驗證一個真正的新假設是否成立，以及 (2) 如何確定一個系統是通過探索發現它還是僅僅從預訓練數據中回憶相關知識。為此，我們引入了 ExplorationBench，將評估科學探索的棘手問題轉化為一個具體且可處理的框架，該框架建立在可驗證的 Alien Worlds 之上：它們的規則是可執行的，因此每個答案都可以準確檢查，並且它們與熟悉的知識相衝突，因此僅僅依賴回憶無法解決這些任務。該基準包含兩個沙盒，AlienCode（31 個發現目標，70 個任務）和 AlienLogic（24 個發現目標，70 個任務）。每個沙盒提供一個有缺陷的手冊、特定任務的環境反饋以及專用的工具調用架構。系統使用這些資源來探索沙盒，然後解決保留的任務。我們評估了 10 個 AI 系統，發現最強的系統能夠獲取並應用不熟悉的規則，而表現則在不同的軌跡中有顯著變化，持續探索可能會停滯或逆轉早期的增長。ExplorationBench 代表了邁向能夠通過探索在未知環境中獲取和應用真正新知識的 AI 系統的一步。

docs.title: ARGUS: Role-Aware Event Knowledge Graphs for U.S. Employment-Discrimination Complaints
docs.text:
2609.30184v1 by Sriram Kannan, Swetha Saseendran, Vishnu Vardhan Reddy Kandi, Leslie Barrett, Madhavan Seshadri, Enrico Santus

U.S. employment-discrimination complaints describe complex event sequences that are not explicitly captured by lexical or embedding-based representations alone. We present ARGUS, a source-grounded pipeline that combines a 5W1H-inspired schema, legal-domain models, and LLM-based structured generation to construct document-level Event Knowledge Graphs (EKGs) from CourtListener complaints. ARGUS extracts fact-bearing statements, builds chunk-level event graphs with participant, temporal, and causal structure, and merges them into document-level representations. We evaluate graph quality through human and multi-model assessment and test downstream utility on claim classification and legal QA. The graph-structured classifier outperforms raw and linearized baselines on the held-out set, and EKG-only retrieval improves document-scoped QA, while open-retrieval gains remain limited by low first-stage candidate recall. These results suggest that EKGs are most useful for organizing and reasoning over evidence once relevant material has been retrieved.

摘要：美國的就業歧視投訴描述了複雜的事件序列，這些序列僅靠詞彙或嵌入基礎的表示無法明確捕捉。我們提出了ARGUS，一個基於來源的流程，結合了5W1H啟發的架構、法律領域模型以及基於LLM的結構化生成，從CourtListener的投訴中構建文檔級事件知識圖（EKGs）。ARGUS提取事實性陳述，構建具有參與者、時間和因果結構的塊級事件圖，並將它們合併為文檔級表示。我們通過人工和多模型評估來評估圖的質量，並在索賠分類和法律問答上測試下游效用。圖結構分類器在保留集上超越了原始和線性基準，而僅使用EKG的檢索改善了文檔範圍的問答，儘管開放檢索的增益仍然受到低第一階段候選回憶的限制。這些結果表明，EKGs在檢索到相關材料後，對於組織和推理證據最為有用。

docs.title: A Training Criterion with Token-Level Tolerance to Transcription Ambiguity for Automatic Speech Recognition
docs.text:
2609.30160v1 by Saurabh Kumar, Diptiman Mohanta, Prasanta Kumar Ghosh

Automatic speech recognition is typically trained assuming that the reference transcript is the only valid labeling of an utterance, yet even nominally verbatim transcripts contain localized differences in pronunciation, spelling, or lexical realization that the acoustics do not uniquely determine. Omni-temporal Classification (OTC) tolerates such noise by adding wildcard paths to the connectionist temporal classification (CTC) alignment graph, but its word-level arcs are too coarse, since bypassing one unsupported token discards supervision for the whole word. We move wildcard arcs to token granularity so unsupported tokens can be bypassed while the rest of the word stays supervised, and we combine token- and word-level arcs as complementary escape paths. Across 19 languages and three corpora, token-level OTC improves over CTC on all 25 tasks. We also replace epoch-indexed relaxation of the wildcard weights with a predictive-entropy-indexed schedule, which performs comparably while reducing dependence on training length. Combining this schedule with the hybrid graph gives the lowest mean word error rate (WER) on every corpus and a 9.45% average relative WER reduction over CTC. Independent validator transcriptions show that token-level models place significantly more wildcard-bypass probability than CTC on disputed characters, indicating that token-level tolerance targets localized transcript ambiguity.

摘要：自動語音識別通常假設參考文字稿是發話的唯一有效標記，但即使是名義上逐字的文字稿也包含發音、拼寫或詞彙實現上的局部差異，而這些差異並不是聲學所獨特決定的。全時序分類（OTC）通過向連接主義時序分類（CTC）對齊圖中添加通配符路徑來容忍這種噪音，但其詞級弧線過於粗糙，因為繞過一個不支持的標記會丟棄整個單詞的監督。我們將通配符弧線移至標記粒度，以便可以繞過不支持的標記，同時保持單詞的其餘部分受到監督，並將標記級和詞級弧線結合作為互補的逃逸路徑。在19種語言和三個語料庫中，標記級OTC在所有25個任務上都優於CTC。我們還將通配符權重的時期索引放鬆替換為預測熵索引計劃，這在性能上相當，同時減少對訓練長度的依賴。將這個計劃與混合圖結合，在每個語料庫上都獲得了最低的平均單詞錯誤率（WER），並在CTC上實現了9.45%的平均相對WER減少。獨立驗證者的文字稿顯示，標記級模型在有爭議的字符上比CTC顯著地給予更多的通配符繞過概率，這表明標記級容忍針對局部文字稿模糊性。

docs.title: HEXIS: Compiling Skills into Extended Finite State Machines
docs.text:
2609.30123v1 by Minghao LI

Agent skills provide reusable knowledge and instructions, yet agents must repeatedly infer how to apply them and which operation should follow. This couples task reasoning with control decisions, allowing prescribed steps to be omitted or applied incorrectly. We introduce HEXIS, which compiles agent skills into extended finite state machines that separate knowledge from control flow. Skill knowledge is incorporated into local instructions that guide reasoning and generation within states. The machine records execution progress and intermediate results, while explicit transition conditions determine subsequent operations. Our incremental compiler first maps skill clauses and tool interfaces to state operations, local instructions, data bindings, and transitions. It then aligns development traces with existing states to identify missing operations and dependencies. These are incorporated by adding or reusing states and refining their connections. Updates are accepted only after static checks and replay of the current and all previously accepted traces. Across four benchmarks and four executors, HEXIS improves success over Skill + ReAct by 16.1 percentage points on average. Qwen3.8-27B reduces execution tokens by 38.4-88.9% across benchmarks.

摘要：代理技能提供可重用的知識和指示，但代理必須反覆推斷如何應用它們以及應該跟隨哪個操作。這將任務推理與控制決策結合在一起，允許省略或錯誤應用規定的步驟。我們介紹了 HEXIS，這是一種將代理技能編譯成擴展有限狀態機的系統，將知識與控制流程分開。技能知識被納入本地指令中，以指導狀態內的推理和生成。該機器記錄執行進度和中間結果，而明確的轉換條件決定後續操作。我們的增量編譯器首先將技能條款和工具介面映射到狀態操作、本地指令、數據綁定和轉換。然後，它將開發跟蹤與現有狀態對齊，以識別缺失的操作和依賴關係。這些通過添加或重用狀態並細化其連接來納入。只有在靜態檢查和重播當前及所有先前接受的跟蹤後，更新才會被接受。在四個基準測試和四個執行器中，HEXIS 在成功率上平均提高了 16.1 個百分點，相較於 Skill + ReAct。Qwen3.8-27B 在基準測試中減少了 38.4-88.9% 的執行標記。

docs.title: AT-SKM-Net: An Accelerated Trainable Sampling Kaczmarz-Motzkin Framework for Linear Hard-Constraint Feasibility on Dynamic Graphs
docs.text:
2609.30088v1 by Xiaochen Zhang, Haoyu Zhu, Yao Zhang, Qingchun Hou

Graph-structured optimization with linear constraints is fundamental to critical infrastructure but faces scalability limits due to massive strict hard constraints and high dimensionality. While recent projection-based methods such as Trainable Sampling Kaczmarz-Motzkin Net (T-SKM-Net) guarantee feasibility, they face high computational costs in dynamic environments by processing the entire constraint set and requiring expensive matrix factorizations. To bridge this gap, we propose the Accelerated Trainable-SKM (AT-SKM) Net framework. To concentrate computation on the active constraints and eliminate redundant calculations, we introduce a hybrid sampling strategy guided by a topology-aware heterogeneous GNN model. To efficiently handle topological shifts in graph-based constraints, we employ a Cholesky Update mechanism that theoretically reduces the equality projection complexity from O(N^3) to O(N^2) under low-rank perturbations. Experiments on random geometric graphs, N-1 Security-Constrained DC-OPF, and minimum-cost gas transport problem demonstrate that AT-SKM reduces iteration counts by up to 85% and achieves 2.95x-7.29x SKM layer speedups, while maintaining zero constraint violations.

摘要：圖結構優化與線性約束對於關鍵基礎設施至關重要，但由於龐大的嚴格硬約束和高維度，面臨可擴展性限制。雖然最近的基於投影的方法，如可訓練取樣Kaczmarz-Motzkin網絡（T-SKM-Net）保證可行性，但在動態環境中，由於處理整個約束集並需要昂貴的矩陣分解，面臨高計算成本。為了彌補這一差距，我們提出了加速可訓練-SKM（AT-SKM）網絡框架。為了將計算集中在活躍約束上並消除冗餘計算，我們引入了一種由拓撲感知的異構GNN模型引導的混合取樣策略。為了有效處理基於圖的約束中的拓撲變化，我們採用了Cholesky更新機制，理論上將等式投影的複雜度從O(N^3)降低到O(N^2)，在低秩擾動下。對隨機幾何圖、N-1安全約束DC-OPF和最小成本氣體運輸問題的實驗表明，AT-SKM將迭代次數減少了多達85%，並實現了2.95x-7.29x的SKM層加速，同時保持零約束違規。

docs.title: Reachability-Based Formal Verification of Graph Neural Networks with Node and Edge Features
docs.text:
2609.30079v1 by Anne M. Tumlin, Ben Wooding, Zhenxuan Shao, Diego Manzanas Lopez, Tyler Derr, Taylor T. Johnson

Graph neural networks (GNNs) have become a prominent approach for developing fast, topology-aware surrogates in electric power systems, supporting tasks such as power flow (PF) analysis, optimal power flow (OPF) estimation, and cascading failure analysis (CFA). Despite this growing use, formally verifying GNN-based models remains challenging, with existing methods limited in scope. We extend the neural network verification (NNV) framework to graph-structured inputs through GraphStar sets, a generalization of Star sets that captures uncertainty over both node and edge features. This extension enables the propagation of linear message-passing operations and the sound approximation of ReLU nonlinearities for GNN architectures, including graph convolutional network (GCN) and graph isomorphism network with edge features (GINE) layers. We evaluate GNNV across three power system tasks, PF, OPF, and CFA, on the IEEE-24, IEEE-39, and IEEE-118 test cases, as well as two standard graph classification benchmarks, ENZYMES and PROTEINS. Our results show that GNNV provides tighter robustness guarantees than CORA on graph classification models with ReLU-based activations and, for the first time, delivers edge-aware robustness guarantees for GINE-based PF and OPF models under joint node and edge perturbations.

摘要：圖神經網絡（GNNs）已成為電力系統中開發快速、拓撲感知替代模型的主要方法，支持如功率流（PF）分析、最佳功率流（OPF）估計和級聯故障分析（CFA）等任務。儘管這種使用日益增長，但正式驗證基於GNN的模型仍然具有挑戰性，現有方法的範圍有限。我們通過GraphStar集擴展了神經網絡驗證（NNV）框架，以適應圖結構輸入，GraphStar集是Star集的一種概括，捕捉了節點和邊特徵上的不確定性。這一擴展使得線性消息傳遞操作的傳播成為可能，並對GNN架構中的ReLU非線性進行了合理的近似，包括圖卷積網絡（GCN）和具有邊特徵的圖同構網絡（GINE）層。我們在IEEE-24、IEEE-39和IEEE-118測試案例上，以及兩個標準圖分類基準ENZYMES和PROTEINS上，對GNNV在三個電力系統任務PF、OPF和CFA進行了評估。我們的結果顯示，GNNV在具有ReLU激活的圖分類模型上提供了比CORA更緊的穩健性保證，並且首次為GINE基於PF和OPF模型在聯合節點和邊擾動下提供了邊感知的穩健性保證。

docs.title: Scoring Both Directions: LLMs realize the MRS they cannot reliably parse
docs.text:
2609.30071v1 by Soham Dan

The English Resource Grammar (ERG) is a hand-written computational grammar of English. Given a sentence, its processor, ACE, produces a formal meaning representation called Minimal Recursion Semantics (MRS): a graph of the sentence's predicates and their arguments. The grammar is bidirectional and can also turn an MRS back into an English sentence. \citet{hajdik2019} used the ERG's treebank to build a benchmark for that generation task, MRS to text, and trained sequence-to-sequence models to solve it. The parsing task, text to MRS, can be tested on the same sentences. We reconstruct their 10K-sentence test split, and score two large language models, Claude Sonnet~4.5 and Claude Opus~5, in both directions against their trained systems and against ACE, with no task-specific training. Given an MRS and three examples, Opus writes the sentence at 76.3 BLEU, ten points above their system trained on 72k pairs (66.1 BLEU), and comparable to their system trained on a million extra pairs (77.2 BLEU). Sonnet scores 65.7 BLEU, and letting it choose among ACE's own candidate sentences lifts it to 69.6, while a pooled judge that keeps Opus's own sentence among the candidates adds 0.6 points (77.0 BLEU). In the parsing direction, however, the models fall far behind ACE: asked for the MRS of the same sentences, they reach 57.2 (Sonnet) and 65.5 (Opus) F$_1$ on the graph's predicates and arguments against 91.0 for ACE, and exact-match the gold on about 1\% of sentences. We characterize the failure modes for the parsing tasks, and conclude that a generation score alone does not show that models understand formal semantic representations.

摘要：英語資源文法（ERG）是一種手寫的英語計算文法。給定一個句子，其處理器ACE生成一個稱為最小遞歸語義（MRS）的形式意義表示：一個句子的謂詞及其論元的圖。該文法是雙向的，也可以將MRS轉換回英語句子。\citet{hajdik2019}使用ERG的樹庫構建了一個基準，用於該生成任務，即MRS到文本，並訓練序列到序列模型來解決它。解析任務，即文本到MRS，可以在相同的句子上進行測試。我們重建了他們的1萬句測試拆分，並在兩個方向上對兩個大型語言模型Claude Sonnet~4.5和Claude Opus~5進行評分，與他們的訓練系統和ACE進行比較，沒有進行特定任務的訓練。給定一個MRS和三個例子，Opus以76.3 BLEU寫出句子，比他們在72k對上訓練的系統（66.1 BLEU）高出十個點，並且與他們在一百萬額外對上訓練的系統（77.2 BLEU）相當。Sonnet得分65.7 BLEU，讓它在ACE自己的候選句子中選擇將其提升至69.6，而一個將Opus自己的句子保持在候選中進行評分的評判者則增加了0.6分（77.0 BLEU）。然而，在解析方向上，這些模型遠遠落後於ACE：當要求相同句子的MRS時，他們在圖的謂詞和論元上達到57.2（Sonnet）和65.5（Opus）F$_1$，而ACE則達到91.0，並且在約1\%的句子上精確匹配金標。我們描述了解析任務的失敗模式，並得出結論：僅僅依賴生成分數並不能顯示模型理解形式語義表示。

docs.title: Self-Play Pretraining with Zero Data
docs.text:
2609.30063v1 by Aditya Cowsik, Kfir Dolev, Michael Y. Li, G. Bruno De Luca, Nourya Cohen, Noah D. Goodman, Yoav Levine

Advances in language modeling have been driven by scaling pretraining on ever more data. Yet, the training data is still largely curated on the model's behalf. A more general approach to pretraining would let the model learn to generate the data most useful for its own improvement. This would provide an effectively unbounded source of training data, limited by compute rather than human knowledge. We introduce Self-Play Pretraining with Zero Data, an initial proof-of-concept towards realizing this vision. Our procedure casts synthetic data generation as a search over the space of all computable structure, taking inspiration from Solomonoff induction. Starting from random initialization, two models learn in tandem: a generator proposes programs interpreted by a universal Turing machine, generating byte sequences, while a learner autoregressively predicts these byte sequences. The learner is trained with standard cross-entropy, while the generator is trained with reinforcement learning to produce sequences at the frontier of the learner's capabilities, yielding an adaptive curriculum. A universal Turing machine gives us a search space over all computable data-generating processes, imposing little domain-specific structure, and self-play searches over this space for useful training data. We test whether zero-shot performance on natural data improves predictably with self-play compute; this is a clean test of transfer since neither generator nor learner is trained on natural data. Across several natural datasets, zero-shot loss exhibits predictable scaling in compute. The models also exhibit in-context learning, and discover recognizable mathematical sequences during training.

摘要：語言模型的進步是由於在越來越多的數據上進行預訓練的擴展。然而，訓練數據仍然在很大程度上是為模型策劃的。更一般的預訓練方法將使模型學會生成對其自身改進最有用的數據。這將提供一個有效無界的訓練數據來源，受限於計算能力而非人類知識。我們介紹了零數據自我遊戲預訓練，這是實現這一願景的初步概念證明。我們的程序將合成數據生成視為對所有可計算結構空間的搜索，並從Solomonoff歸納中獲取靈感。從隨機初始化開始，兩個模型協同學習：一個生成器提出由通用圖靈機解釋的程序，生成字節序列，而一個學習者自回歸地預測這些字節序列。學習者使用標準交叉熵進行訓練，而生成器則使用強化學習進行訓練，以在學習者能力的邊界上生成序列，從而產生自適應課程。通用圖靈機為我們提供了一個所有可計算數據生成過程的搜索空間，幾乎不施加特定領域的結構，自我遊戲在這個空間中搜索有用的訓練數據。我們測試了自然數據上的零樣本性能是否隨著自我遊戲計算的增加而可預測地改善；這是一個清晰的轉移測試，因為生成器和學習者都沒有在自然數據上進行訓練。在幾個自然數據集上，零樣本損失顯示出計算能力的可預測擴展。這些模型還表現出上下文學習，並在訓練過程中發現可識別的數學序列。

docs.title: SciWalker: Synthesizing Scientific Coding Problems with Operator Graphs and Execution Feedback
docs.text:
2609.30054v1 by Chenxi Li, Wenxuan Zeng, Yun Luo, Fangchen Yu, Peng Ye, Yu Cheng, Jun Zhang

Improving the scientific coding capabilities of large language models (LLMs) requires high-quality training data. However, such data remain scarce because manually authoring realistic problems is costly and time-consuming, while systematically covering diverse scientific domains and algorithmic combinations remains challenging. To address this, we introduce SciWalker, a framework for synthesizing scientific coding problems through operator-chain sampling and execution feedback. The framework combines scientific library interfaces with operation modes to instantiate operators, organizes them into operator graphs, and samples operator chains as computational workflow cues. Guided by these cues, we adopt LLMs to generate scientifically grounded problem statements, reference solutions, and tests, with failed generations iteratively repaired using execution feedback. By combining structured workflow composition with verification and quality review, SciWalker enables scalable task generation while promoting scientific grounding, computational diversity, and executability. Using this framework, we construct 8,178 high-quality problems spanning 5 scientific domains and 32 subdomains. To evaluate their training utility, we conduct reinforcement learning on Qwen3.5-9B using the GSPO algorithm. This training improves SciCode subproblem accuracy by 9.9 percentage points, from 29.3% to 39.2%, with gains across scientific code generation, code repair, and reasoning benchmarks. The code for SciWalker is available at https://github.com/lichenx1/SciWalker.

摘要：改善大型語言模型（LLMs）的科學編碼能力需要高品質的訓練數據。然而，這類數據仍然稀缺，因為手動編寫現實問題既昂貴又耗時，而系統性地涵蓋多樣的科學領域和算法組合仍然具有挑戰性。為了解決這個問題，我們介紹了SciWalker，一個通過運算符鏈取樣和執行反饋合成科學編碼問題的框架。該框架結合了科學庫接口和操作模式來實例化運算符，將它們組織成運算符圖，並將運算符鏈取樣作為計算工作流提示。在這些提示的指導下，我們採用LLMs生成科學基礎的問題陳述、參考解決方案和測試，並使用執行反饋迭代修復失敗的生成。通過將結構化工作流組合與驗證和質量審查相結合，SciWalker實現了可擴展的任務生成，同時促進了科學基礎、計算多樣性和可執行性。使用這個框架，我們構建了8,178個涵蓋5個科學領域和32個子領域的高品質問題。為了評估它們的訓練效用，我們使用GSPO算法對Qwen3.5-9B進行強化學習。這次訓練將SciCode子問題的準確率提高了9.9個百分點，從29.3%提升至39.2%，在科學代碼生成、代碼修復和推理基準測試中均有增長。SciWalker的代碼可在https://github.com/lichenx1/SciWalker獲得。

docs.title: NNV3: Expanding Neural Network Verification to New Architectures and Domains
docs.text:
2609.30050v1 by Anne M. Tumlin, Samuel Sasaki, Ben Wooding, Diego Manzanas Lopez, Muhammad Usama Zubair, Navid Hashemi, Hongchao Zhang, Waseem Abbas, Ipek Oguz, Meiyi Ma, Taylor T. Johnson

We present NNV3, the latest version of the Neural Network Verification (NNV) tool, a MATLAB framework for formal verification of deep learning models and learning-enabled cyber-physical systems. Building on the set-based reachability foundation of NNV 1.0 (FFNNs, CNNs, NNCS) and NNV 2.0 (RNNs, SSNNs, neural ODEs), NNV3 introduces new members of the Star-set family: ModelStar for verifying networks under weight perturbation, VolumeStar for video and 3D volumetric inputs, and GraphStar for graph neural networks. A conformal-inference-based probabilistic reachability mode complements sound analysis for problems where deterministic verification is intractable, while FairNNV certifies counterfactual and individual fairness properties over continuous input regions. NNV3 introduces new benchmarks for malware detection, graph-based power-system models, medical imaging, variable-length time series data, and action recognition. NNV3 also incorporates tutorials and developer guides through a unified documentation site. This paper details these major updates, demonstrating NNV's maturation into a comprehensive, robust, and accessible verification tool for a diverse range of AI systems.

摘要：我們介紹 NNV3，最新版本的神經網絡驗證 (NNV) 工具，這是一個用於深度學習模型和學習驅動的網絡物理系統的正式驗證的 MATLAB 框架。基於 NNV 1.0 (FFNNs, CNNs, NNCS) 和 NNV 2.0 (RNNs, SSNNs, neural ODEs) 的集合基礎可達性，NNV3 引入了 Star-set 家族的新成員：ModelStar 用於在權重擾動下驗證網絡，VolumeStar 用於視頻和 3D 體積輸入，GraphStar 用於圖神經網絡。一種基於符合推斷的概率可達性模式補充了在確定性驗證無法處理的問題上的可靠分析，而 FairNNV 則認證了在連續輸入區域上的反事實和個體公平性屬性。NNV3 引入了新的基準，用於惡意軟件檢測、基於圖的電力系統模型、醫學影像、可變長度時間序列數據和動作識別。NNV3 還通過統一的文檔網站整合了教程和開發者指南。本文詳細介紹了這些重大更新，展示了 NNV 成為一個全面、穩健且易於訪問的驗證工具的成熟，適用於各種 AI 系統。

docs.title: VietPrism: A large-scale Vietnamese speech and deepfake corpus with diverse dialects and code-switching
docs.text:
2609.30005v1 by Minh Hoang, Thai Le

Vietnamese speech research is constrained by resources that isolate automatic speech recognition from speaker, dialect, code-switching, and deepfake analysis. We introduce VietPrism, an open, multi-domain corpus that brings these dimensions together at scale: 993.4 hours and 403,941 bona fide utterances from 1,262 verified speakers across 8,388 real-world videos. To our knowledge, it is the first large-scale Vietnamese corpus to jointly provide transcripts, consistent speaker identities, five dialect groups, and naturally occurring Vietnamese--English code-switching, which constitutes nearly half of the corpus by duration. We further create over 3.1K hours of spoof speech with four open-source and commercial synthesis systems. Every spoof is conditioned on a verified speaker reference and paired with a transcript- and speaker-matched bona fide utterance, enabling unique controlled evaluation with reduced lexical and identity confounds. Zero-shot evaluation of five pretrained multilingual detectors reveals striking brittleness: EER greatly varies across detector--generator pairings, while recent multilingual detector DFA-1B degrades from 16.3% to 33.6% as speaker similarity increases. Dialect-stratified results expose further model-dependent disparities. By unifying natural linguistic diversity with controlled spoof generation, VietPrism provides a challenging foundation for Vietnamese speech modeling and trustworthy audio-deepfake detection.

摘要：越南語語音研究受到資源的限制，使自動語音識別與說話者、方言、代碼切換和深度偽造分析隔離。我們介紹了VietPrism，一個開放的多領域語料庫，將這些維度在規模上結合在一起：來自1,262位經過驗證的說話者的993.4小時和403,941條真實語句，來自8,388個真實世界的視頻。據我們所知，它是第一個大規模的越南語語料庫，聯合提供轉錄文本、一致的說話者身份、五個方言組和自然發生的越南語-英語代碼切換，這幾乎佔據了語料庫一半的時長。我們進一步創建了超過3.1K小時的偽造語音，使用四個開源和商業合成系統。每個偽造語音都是基於經過驗證的說話者參考，並與轉錄文本和說話者匹配的真實語句配對，從而實現獨特的受控評估，減少詞彙和身份的混淆。對五個預訓練的多語言檢測器進行零樣本評估顯示出驚人的脆弱性：EER在檢測器-生成器配對之間變化很大，而最近的多語言檢測器DFA-1B在說話者相似性增加時，性能從16.3%降至33.6%。方言分層結果揭示了進一步依賴模型的差異。通過將自然語言多樣性與受控的偽造生成相結合，VietPrism為越南語語音建模和可信的音頻深度偽造檢測提供了一個具有挑戰性的基礎。

docs.title: Learning Better Reasoning for Generative Recommendation with Semantic IDs
docs.text:
2609.29973v1 by Mengdan Zhu, Yufan Zhao, Sophie Di, Yao Zhao, Tao Di, Yulan Yan, Sridhar Iyer, Liang Zhao

Generative recommendation reformulates item retrieval as sequence generation, allowing a unified model to directly generate the next item from a user's interaction history. Semantic IDs further make this paradigm effective and scalable by representing each item as discrete codes, enabling knowledge sharing among semantically related items. Recent studies introduce explicit reasoning before Semantic-ID generation, helping models summarize user interests and infer possible preference transitions. However, reasoning is not inherently beneficial: Inaccurate or uninformative reasoning may mislead subsequent item generation and ultimately degrade recommendation performance. This raises a central challenge: how can a recommender select and learn effective reasoning traces and progressively evolve toward better reasoning from its own generations? In this work, we propose Evo-Rec, a three-stage framework for learning better reasoning and further enhancing it through reinforcement learning. First, we align Semantic IDs with their textual and behavioral contexts, enabling the model to understand and generate item identifiers. Second, we sample multiple candidate reasoning traces and retain those that improve the prediction of the ground-truth item, providing a stronger reasoning initialization through supervised fine-tuning. Third, we further optimize the reasoning policy through reinforcement learning with catalog-constrained item generation and ranking-aware recommendation feedback. Experiments on three Amazon Review benchmarks show that Evo-Rec consistently outperforms discriminative, generative, and reasoning-enhanced recommenders across all evaluation metrics. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework in learning better reasoning for SID-based generative recommendation.

摘要：生成推薦將項目檢索重新定義為序列生成，允許統一模型直接從用戶的互動歷史中生成下一個項目。語義 ID 進一步使這一範式有效且可擴展，通過將每個項目表示為離散代碼，實現語義相關項目之間的知識共享。最近的研究在語義 ID 生成之前引入了明確的推理，幫助模型總結用戶興趣並推斷可能的偏好轉變。然而，推理本身並不一定有益：不準確或無信息的推理可能會誤導後續項目生成，最終降低推薦性能。這提出了一個核心挑戰：推薦系統如何選擇和學習有效的推理痕跡，並逐步從自身生成中演變為更好的推理？在這項工作中，我們提出了 Evo-Rec，一個三階段框架，用於學習更好的推理並通過強化學習進一步增強它。首先，我們將語義 ID 與其文本和行為上下文對齊，使模型能夠理解和生成項目標識符。其次，我們抽樣多個候選推理痕跡，保留那些改善真實項目預測的痕跡，通過監督微調提供更強的推理初始化。第三，我們通過強化學習進一步優化推理策略，結合目錄約束的項目生成和排名感知的推薦反饋。在三個亞馬遜評論基準上的實驗顯示，Evo-Rec 在所有評估指標上始終優於區分性、生成性和增強推理的推薦系統。這些結果證明了我們的框架在學習基於 SID 的生成推薦的更好推理方面的有效性。

docs.title: World Action Agent: Harnessing VLMs for Robot Manipulation via World Action Rehearsal
docs.text:
2609.29964v1 by Yehang Zhang, Haojian Huang, Yifan Chang, Jianchong Su, Bohan Zhou, Yingjie Xu, Wosong Chen, Tianhao Zhou, Chenxu Wang, Tianyi Zhang, Yangkai Wei, Wenqian Li, Shiyuan Deng, Yinchuan Li, Ying-Cong Chen, Zexi Li

General-purpose vision-language models (VLMs) bring broad knowledge and spatial reasoning to robot manipulation, yet existing systems either use them indirectly, to predict constraints or write programs, or give them a view of the scene rather than a world in which to act. We present World Action Agent (WAA), a multi-agent harness through which VLMs pilot robots with basic tools, making every decision within a visual action workspace. The workspace has three properties. Contact views, selected automatically from the scene geometry, present the scene around the current interaction. Action rehearsal turns each action into an editable proposal that the agent, alone or through an Imagination Agent, previews and revises against planning feedback before execution. In-view correction closes the loop between observation, rehearsal, and low-level execution, letting the agent remove residual offsets in the view where it observes them. Through the same workspace, WAA acquires embodied procedural knowledge in two ways: it evolves multimodal skills from expert videos and human teaching under evidence-based review and consults them through a Skill Agent, and its interaction traces train smaller VLMs to pilot the same harness. On LIBERO-Pro, WAA with skills evolved only from LIBERO-90 reaches a state-of-the-art 75.6% average success, outperforming end-to-end VLAs, code-as-policy agents, and a visual-harness baseline with the same backbone; the same skills remain effective on robosuite without further learning. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B on harness traces raises its out-of-domain success from 1.7% to 43.3%.

摘要：一般用途的視覺-語言模型（VLMs）為機器人操作帶來廣泛的知識和空間推理，然而現有系統要麼間接使用它們來預測約束或編寫程序，要麼僅給它們提供場景的視圖，而不是一個可以行動的世界。我們提出了世界行動代理（WAA），這是一個多代理系統，通過它，VLMs 能夠駕駛配備基本工具的機器人，在視覺行動工作空間內做出每一個決策。該工作空間具有三個特性。接觸視圖自動從場景幾何中選擇，展示當前互動周圍的場景。行動排練將每個行動轉化為可編輯的提案，代理可以單獨或通過想像代理預覽並根據規劃反饋進行修訂，然後再執行。在視圖修正則關閉了觀察、排練和低級執行之間的循環，讓代理能夠消除它觀察到的視圖中的殘餘偏移。通過相同的工作空間，WAA 以兩種方式獲得具身的程序性知識：它從專家視頻和人類教學中在基於證據的審查下發展多模態技能，並通過技能代理進行諮詢；其互動痕跡則訓練較小的 VLMs 來駕駛相同的系統。在 LIBERO-Pro 上，僅從 LIBERO-90 演變而來的技能的 WAA 達到了 75.6% 的最新平均成功率，超越了端到端的 VLA、代碼作為政策的代理和具有相同骨幹的視覺系統基線；這些相同的技能在 robosuite 上也保持有效，而無需進一步學習。對 Qwen3.5-9B 在系統痕跡上進行微調，將其域外成功率從 1.7% 提高到 43.3%。

docs.title: Augur: A Synthetic Decision Lab for Rehearsing Reactions to Product and Policy Changes
docs.text:
2609.29952v1 by Rahul Khedar, Mayank Malhotra, Avinash Karn

Before a product or policy change ships, the question that matters is how people will react to it. Augur rehearses that reaction offline: it builds a typed knowledge graph from the change documents, populates a grounded persona market, simulates the interaction, and returns an auditable decision memo recommending one of five actions. We assemble Gold-50, fifty real product and policy episodes whose real-world outcome is known, adjudicated against the public record, and score the five-way release verdict against it. Our central finding is methodological and negative: most of the measured gap between frontier cloud models and open-weight models we fine-tune and serve offline is attributable to an under-specified evaluation, not a difference in capability. We show this three ways. First, the prompt envelope alone can dominate the score: holding weights, cases and scorer fixed, one system -- a LoRA-SFT adapter on Qwen3-32B -- swings from 0% to 73%. Second, in a matched 2x2 ablation, defining the decision taxonomy in the prompt -- with no model change -- lifts every frontier model by +24 to +34pp; under the under-specified prompt, Qwen3-32B LoRA-SFT served offline beats all three frontier models (paired McNemar, Holm-corrected), and once the prompt is fair no significant difference from any of them is detected. Third, agreement with the distillation teacher rises without accuracy following, and the full pipeline amplifies a systematic "over-doom" bias rather than improving the verdict. Separately, we validate the reaction layer on its own terms: blind judges across four model families find the synthetic reaction recovers 67-90% of the concerns the public actually raised, and a pre-registered ablation locates its value -- largest where the decision is hardest, redundant near ceiling. The pipeline that regenerates every number and figure here is available from the authors.

摘要：在產品或政策變更發佈之前，重要的問題是人們會如何對其反應。Augur 在離線環境中排練這種反應：它從變更文件中構建一個類型化的知識圖譜，填充一個基於實證的人物市場，模擬互動，並返回一份可審計的決策備忘錄，建議採取五種行動中的一種。我們組建了 Gold-50，這是五十個真實的產品和政策案例，其真實世界的結果是已知的，並根據公共記錄進行裁定，並將五種釋放判決與之進行評分。 我們的主要發現是方法論上的負面結果：我們所測量的前沿雲模型與我們進行微調並離線服務的開放權重模型之間的大部分差距可歸因於評估不足，而不是能力上的差異。我們以三種方式展示了這一點。首先，僅提示範圍就可以主導分數：在權重、案例和評分者固定的情況下，一個系統——在 Qwen3-32B 上的 LoRA-SFT 轉接器——從 0% 變動到 73%。第二，在一個匹配的 2x2 消融實驗中，定義提示中的決策分類法——不改變模型——使每個前沿模型提升 +24 到 +34 個百分點；在評估不足的提示下，Qwen3-32B LoRA-SFT 離線服務超越了所有三個前沿模型（配對 McNemar，Holm 修正），一旦提示公平，則未檢測到與它們之間的任何顯著差異。第三，與蒸餾教師的協議在不跟隨準確度的情況下上升，整個管道放大了一種系統性的「過度悲觀」偏見，而不是改善判決。另一方面，我們根據其自身的標準驗證了反應層：來自四個模型家族的盲評審發現，合成反應恢復了公眾實際提出的 67-90% 的關切，並且一個預註冊的消融實驗定位了其價值——在決策最困難的地方最大，在接近上限的地方冗餘。這裡重新生成每個數字和圖形的管道可從作者處獲得。

docs.title: Neuro-symbolic AI for Industrial Configuration
docs.text:
2609.29947v1 by Danilo Valerio, Philipp Kogler, Stefan Bischof, Thomas Hubauer, Huzefa Rangwala

Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown impressive performance on a wide range of generative tasks. Yet their probabilistic nature makes them, in isolation, fundamentally unsuited for industrial product configuration, where outputs must be syntactically valid, semantically consistent with a knowledge base of hundreds of features and rules, and producible by an existing manufacturing chain. We argue that Neuro-symbolic (NeSy) AI methods lay out a promising path towards industrial-grade configurators that are reliable by design, explainable, and trustworthy. This paper describes a taxonomy of three NeSy integration strategies, namely hybrid inference, hybrid fine-tuning, and hybrid training, exploring their usage in the configuration domain. We report our effort to operationalize NeSy concepts in an industrial configuration copilot and derive a set of practical design choices for deploying trustworthy AI in engineering environments. We close with a discussion of open research challenges we consider most pressing, in particular how to scale NeSy methods from small academic demonstrators to the size of industrial configurators.

摘要：大型語言模型（LLMs）在各種生成任務上展現了令人印象深刻的表現。然而，它們的概率性質使得它們在孤立情況下，根本不適合用於工業產品配置，因為輸出必須在語法上有效，與數百個特徵和規則的知識庫在語義上保持一致，並且必須能夠由現有的製造鏈生產。我們認為神經符號（NeSy）人工智慧方法為工業級配置器鋪設了一條有前途的道路，這些配置器在設計上是可靠的、可解釋的和可信的。本文描述了三種NeSy整合策略的分類法，即混合推理、混合微調和混合訓練，並探討它們在配置領域的應用。我們報告了將NeSy概念實現於工業配置助手的努力，並推導出一系列在工程環境中部署可信人工智慧的實用設計選擇。最後，我們討論了我們認為最迫切的開放研究挑戰，特別是如何將NeSy方法從小型學術示範擴展到工業配置器的規模。

docs.title: SEEK: Skill-Routed Evaluation with Evolvable Knowledge for Industrial Search
docs.text:
2609.29803v1 by Zhongxin Huang, Songyang Li, Renzhe Zhou, Feiran Zhu, Chenglei Dai, Zhen Xiao, Xuanping Li, Jingwei Zhuo

Search quality evaluation provides essential supervision and diagnostic signals for the development and iteration of industrial search systems. Although large language models (LLMs) offer a scalable alternative to manual assessment, reliable automatic evaluation remains challenging: users experience search results at the page level, while the applicable evaluation criteria are multi-dimensional and continuously evolving. Packing all evaluation criteria into a unified prompt introduces irrelevant context and potential criterion interference, whereas internalizing them through post-training tightly couples rule updates with costly model retraining cycles. To address these issues, we propose Skill-routed Evaluation with Evolvable Knowledge (SEEK). Specifically, SEEK externalizes specific search evaluation criteria into a skill bank, dynamically routes relevant skills for each query-result list pair, and employs a task-adapted listwise evaluator to produce page-level judgments and failure mode attribution. A two-stage training pipeline teaches the evaluator to align evaluation criteria with human preferences, while a replay-gated skill bank allows recurring evaluation knowledge gaps to be incorporated without model retraining. Experiments on industrial short-video search show that SEEK improves listwise quality evaluation accuracy and achieves significant progress in attribution diagnosis. SEEK has been deployed at Kuaishou, a short-video platform with over 400 million daily active users, significantly improving the scale and quality of online search evaluation.

摘要：搜尋品質評估為工業搜尋系統的開發和迭代提供了必要的監督和診斷信號。雖然大型語言模型（LLMs）提供了一種可擴展的手動評估替代方案，但可靠的自動評估仍然具有挑戰性：用戶在頁面層面體驗搜尋結果，而適用的評估標準則是多維且持續演變的。將所有評估標準打包成統一的提示會引入不相關的上下文和潛在的標準干擾，而通過後訓練內化它們則將規則更新與昂貴的模型再訓練周期緊密耦合。為了解決這些問題，我們提出了技能導向的可演變知識評估（SEEK）。具體而言，SEEK 將特定的搜尋評估標準外部化為技能庫，動態路由每個查詢-結果列表對的相關技能，並使用適應任務的列表評估器來產生頁面級的判斷和失敗模式歸因。一個兩階段的訓練管道教導評估器將評估標準與人類偏好對齊，而重播閘控的技能庫則允許在不進行模型再訓練的情況下納入重複的評估知識差距。在工業短視頻搜尋上的實驗顯示，SEEK 提高了列表級品質評估的準確性，並在歸因診斷方面取得了顯著進展。SEEK 已在快手部署，這是一個擁有超過 4 億日活躍用戶的短視頻平台，顯著改善了在線搜尋評估的規模和品質。

docs.title: TimeBraid: Unifying Time Series and Language for Understanding and Forecasting
docs.text:
2609.29792v1 by Xinyue Wang, Jiacheng Pang, Kun Zhou, Kexin Zhang, Defu Cao, Fan Feng, Faisal, Songyao Jin, Yan Liu, Biwei Huang

We present TimeBraid, a series of unified time-series and language models that align pretrained language models and pretrained time-series foundation models through interleaved global residual attention layers. Each model inherits knowledge, instruction following, and reasoning from one side, continuous-signal perception and zero-shot forecasting from the other, and fuses the two in a shared representation space where both modalities are understood and generated. We study the design choices that make such unified modeling work: where to align the two representation spaces, how to ground language in temporal structure, how to balance understanding with generation, and how to keep joint optimization stable. The resulting recipe combines a unified prompting scheme for diverse time-series and text tasks, stabilized joint training, and supervision from 2.2M curated series--text pairs and 4.9M instruction-tuning samples. Across benchmarks spanning time-series perception, understanding, reasoning, and both context-aided and unimodal forecasting, TimeBraid remains competitive with far larger general-purpose models and task-specific counterparts.

摘要：我們提出了 TimeBraid，一系列統一的時間序列和語言模型，通過交錯的全局殘差注意層將預訓練的語言模型和預訓練的時間序列基礎模型對齊。每個模型從一方繼承知識、指令跟隨和推理，從另一方繼承連續信號感知和零樣本預測，並在共享的表示空間中融合這兩者，使得兩種模態都能被理解和生成。我們研究了使這種統一建模有效的設計選擇：在何處對齊兩個表示空間，如何將語言基於時間結構進行基礎，如何平衡理解與生成，以及如何保持聯合優化的穩定性。最終的方案結合了針對多樣時間序列和文本任務的統一提示方案、穩定的聯合訓練，以及來自 2.2M 精心挑選的系列-文本對和 4.9M 指令調整樣本的監督。在涵蓋時間序列感知、理解、推理以及上下文輔助和單模態預測的基準測試中，TimeBraid 與更大的一般用途模型和特定任務的對應模型保持競爭力。

docs.title: CodeGraph: Open-Taxonomy Knowledge Graph for Source Code with Wikidata Grounding
docs.text:
2609.29474v1 by Federico Pennino, Andrea Gurioli, Stefano Zacchiroli, Maurizio Gabbrielli, Paolo Ferragina

Public software repositories, like GitHub and Software Heritage Archive, store billions of files, yet extracting their implicit engineering knowledge ---i.e., the algorithms they implement, the paradigms they follow, the patterns they instantiate, and the application domains they serve--- remains challenging, as current tools are constrained to syntactic and token-level analysis. We present a pipeline for building an open-taxonomy semantic annotation of source code using a code-specialised Large Language Model. The extracted entities are grounded in Wikidata through a three-stage linking procedure: a deterministic SPARQL stage handles unambiguous entities, a Deep Research Agent resolves the residual long tail, and a hierarchy-rollup stage imports the parent-of closure of each resolved Wikidata identifier. The resulting annotations are materialised as a source-code-specific open-taxonomy knowledge graph. We further introduce a calibrated quality-assurance protocol that quantifies annotation precision by combining a small human gold set with an LLM-as-a-judge filter. We applied our pipeline to the 167 million files of the Stack-Edu corpus, creating the first known large-scale open-taxonomy knowledge graph for source code. Our graph, named CodeGraph, contains approximately 158 million nodes, which include around 145 million files, about 63,000 extracted concept entities (such as algorithms, paradigms, design patterns, and application domains), and roughly 19,800 grounded Wikidata entities. Furthermore, CodeGraph features approximately 1 billion typed edges that connect files to their respective concepts, link these concepts to their grounded Wikidata identifiers, and relate them to their parent categories, covering 14 programming languages.

摘要：公共軟體庫，如 GitHub 和 Software Heritage Archive，儲存了數十億個檔案，但提取其隱含的工程知識——即它們實現的演算法、遵循的範式、實例化的模式以及服務的應用領域——仍然具有挑戰性，因為目前的工具僅限於語法和標記級別的分析。我們提出了一個使用專門於程式碼的大型語言模型來構建開放分類法語義標註的流程。提取的實體通過三階段的連結程序與 Wikidata 進行對接：一個確定性的 SPARQL 階段處理明確的實體，一個深度研究代理解決剩餘的長尾，並且一個層級滾動階段導入每個已解決的 Wikidata 標識符的父閉包。最終的標註以特定於源代碼的開放分類法知識圖的形式實現。我們進一步介紹了一個經過校準的質量保證協議，通過結合一小部分人類金標集與 LLM 作為評判的過濾器來量化標註精確度。我們將這個流程應用於 1.67 億個 Stack-Edu 語料庫檔案，創建了第一個已知的大規模開放分類法知識圖，專門針對源代碼。我們的圖，名為 CodeGraph，包含大約 1.58 億個節點，其中包括約 1.45 億個檔案、約 63,000 個提取的概念實體（如演算法、範式、設計模式和應用領域）以及大約 19,800 個與 Wikidata 相關的實體。此外，CodeGraph 擁有大約 10 億條類型化邊，將檔案與其各自的概念連接，將這些概念與其對應的 Wikidata 標識符連結，並將它們與其父類別相關聯，涵蓋了 14 種程式語言。

docs.title: Direct Message Approximation (DMA): A Consistency-Based Framework for Tractable Approximate Inference on Factor Graphs
docs.text:
2609.29466v1 by Ralf Herbrich, Rainer Schlosser, Jan Lemcke, Johann Ukrow, Anna Kazachkova, Nicolas Alder, Leonhard Hennicke, Theo Bardey, Nico Grimm, Luca Kleinschmidt, Philipp Kolbe, Cezary Kujath, Johanna Schlimme, Karl Matti Schütz

Approximate message passing on factor graphs underlies two dominant families of probabilistic inference algorithms: expectation propagation (EP) and variational message passing (VMP). Both methods approximate the marginal at each factor edge, forcing an iterative round-robin schedule, risking negative-precision messages, and, for VMP, collapsing to point estimates at Dirac-delta factors. We introduce Direct Message Approximation (DMA), which approximates factor-to-variable messages directly rather than the marginal. For normalisable factors, we define a consistency condition (requiring exactness when all other incoming messages are Dirac deltas) to guide message construction. We prove a master theorem (proper messages, any graph) bounding marginal KL from message KL, with three structural corollaries: Dirac-input consistency, no EP-style inner-loop iteration, and no negative-precision messages. Further, we prove a complementary $O(1/r^2)$ guarantee for the inherently improper backward message of the product factor, whose closed-form treatment has resisted prior work. As a concrete instantiation, we derive explicit DMA messages for the product and leaky-ReLU factors and assemble a Bayesian neural network (BNN) inference algorithm with one forward/backward sweep per training example and no gradient learning-rate hyperparameter, validating that the structural guarantees translate to predictive uncertainty that widens in data-sparse regions, including under model mismatch.

摘要：近似消息傳遞在因子圖上是兩個主要的概率推斷算法家族的基礎：期望傳播（EP）和變分消息傳遞（VMP）。這兩種方法在每個因子邊緣近似邊際，強迫進行迭代的循環排程，冒著負精度消息的風險，對於VMP，則在Dirac-delta因子處崩潰為點估計。我們引入直接消息近似（DMA），它直接近似因子到變量的消息，而不是邊際。對於可規範的因子，我們定義了一個一致性條件（要求當所有其他傳入消息為Dirac delta時的精確性）來指導消息構建。我們證明了一個主定理（正確的消息，任何圖）界定了邊際KL來自消息KL的界限，並有三個結構性推論：Dirac輸入一致性、無EP風格的內部迭代，以及無負精度消息。此外，我們證明了一個互補的 $O(1/r^2)$ 保證，針對產品因子的固有不正確的反向消息，其封閉形式處理一直抵抗先前的工作。作為一個具體的實例，我們推導了產品和漏鬆ReLU因子的明確DMA消息，並組裝了一個貝葉斯神經網絡（BNN）推斷算法，對每個訓練樣本進行一次前向/反向掃描，且無梯度學習率超參數，驗證了結構性保證轉化為預測不確定性，在數據稀疏區域擴大，包括在模型不匹配的情況下。

docs.title: agentic-ger: terminology recovery in long-form speech using global context
