docs.text:
2609.29428v1 by Yanqiao Zhu, Wupeng Wang, Zhifu Gao, Xiangang Li, Xie Chen

Recent advances in speech language models have improved automatic speech recognition (ASR) for long-form audio. However, accurately and consistently transcribing domain-specific terminology remains challenging. Motivated by the world knowledge and contextual capability of large language models (LLMs), we propose Agentic-GER, an LLM-based agent for terminology correction in long-form speech. The agent uses global context from the full transcript to identify suspicious terms and resolve ambiguous hypotheses. It selectively re-transcribes the source speech to check candidate corrections, and uses accepted edits to guide subsequent decisions. Experiments with four LLMs and two ASR systems on GigaSpeechBench show consistent terminology improvements in both Chinese and English, with and without thinking. On Chinese speech, Agentic-GER achieves up to a 36.8% relative reduction in biased character error rate (B-CER) over the Whisper baseline.

摘要：最近在語音語言模型方面的進展改善了長格式音頻的自動語音識別（ASR）。然而，準確且一致地轉錄特定領域的術語仍然具有挑戰性。受到大型語言模型（LLMs）在世界知識和上下文能力方面的啟發，我們提出了Agentic-GER，一種基於LLM的術語修正代理，用於長格式語音。該代理使用完整轉錄的全球上下文來識別可疑術語並解決模糊的假設。它有選擇性地重新轉錄源語音以檢查候選修正，並使用接受的編輯來指導後續決策。在GigaSpeechBench上對四個LLM和兩個ASR系統的實驗顯示，在中文和英文中，無論是否進行思考，術語都有一致的改善。在中文語音中，Agentic-GER在偏見字符錯誤率（B-CER）上相對於Whisper基準實現了高達36.8%的減少。

docs.title: Wearable ECG Quality Assessment: A Deep Learning and Ambulatory Context-Awareness Approach
docs.text:
2609.29396v1 by Xiaopeng Mao, Marike Weisbjerg, Sadasivan Puthusserypady

This paper presents and evaluates a Deep Learning-based (DL-based) Signal Quality Assessment (SQA) model to distinguish between clean and noisy ambulatory Electrocardiograms (ECG). The model is trained on Copenhagen Center for Health Technology-Contextualized Arrhythmia Database (CACHET-CADB), which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first ambulatory ECG database with both physical and patient-reported contextual data. The model shows stable performance on different databases such as MIT-databases and the latest PyhsioNet/Cinc Challenge 2021 databases. Subsequently, the paper demonstrates how complicated ECG noise can be investigated by the SQA model and the physical contextual data.

摘要：這篇論文提出並評估了一種基於深度學習（DL-based）的信號質量評估（SQA）模型，以區分乾淨和嘈雜的動態心電圖（ECG）。該模型是在哥本哈根健康科技中心的情境性心律不整數據庫（CACHET-CADB）上訓練的，據我們所知，這是第一個同時擁有物理和患者報告的情境數據的動態心電圖數據庫。該模型在不同數據庫上顯示出穩定的性能，例如MIT數據庫和最新的PyhsioNet/Cinc Challenge 2021數據庫。隨後，論文展示了如何通過SQA模型和物理情境數據來研究複雜的ECG噪聲。

docs.title: An auditable conditional-strategy framework for open-ended decision-making in complex lung cancer
docs.text:
2609.29381v1 by Daoyun Wang, Zhicheng Huang, Huaiyuan Sun, Jiaqi Xu, Xiaowei Xu, Zhibo Zheng, Zhongxing Bing, Yuxiao Lin, Yicheng Liang, Chao Gao, Bowen Xue, Kai Zhang, Song Xu, Wanpu Yan, Hui Xia, Lin Li, Xiang Yan, Mu Hu, Qianli Ma, Zhiqiang Xue, Xiaofang Liu, Zhihai Han, Nan Zhang, Chuanhao Tang, Tongmei Zhang, Lan Song, Zhaohui Zhu, Xuan Zeng, Shafei Wu, Hui Guan, Lei Deng, Huaxia Yang, Zeliang Lian, Wubin Sun, Yongxin Wang, Xiaohui Shen, Binlin Wang, Tiantian Gu, Yu Cui, Li Zhang, Shirui Wang, Naixin Liang

Complex lung cancer decisions can involve several defensible pathways whose eligibility, sequencing and safety depend on unresolved information. Effective support must make explicit how patient conditions govern pathway eligibility, deferral and redirection. MedGPT Clinical Explorer (MCE) organizes alternatives, decision-changing unknowns, safety constraints and fallback into a conditional strategy for clinician review. To evaluate this representation in physician-authored strategies, multidisciplinary experts established case-specific references for 40 cases within a purposive 100-case corpus, and 250 physicians from 98 institutions produced 2,250 strategies under unaided, retrieval-reference and MCE-assisted conditions. MCE-assisted strategies expressed more applicable clinical requirements, measured by the Admissible Pathway Attainment Score (APAS; 0-100), than unaided strategies (adjusted difference, 12.87; 95% CI, 11.18-14.55) and retrieval-reference strategies (5.22; 3.52-6.93). With the same knowledge base available in the retrieval-reference and MCE-assisted conditions, the additional content centered on candidate pathways, decision-critical information and safety constraints. Physicians' whole-strategy acceptability judgments correlated with APAS (Spearman's rho = 0.671), while a complementary relationship audit assessed whether candidates, conditions and subsequent actions were coherently connected. Together, these findings identify two complementary dimensions of open-ended decision support: coverage of clinically relevant content and coherent links among pathways, conditions and subsequent actions. MCE provides a shared decision object that makes consequential omissions and pathway contingencies visible before action; prospective studies should evaluate its effects on clinical workflow and patient outcomes.

摘要：複雜的肺癌決策可能涉及幾條可辯護的途徑，其資格、排序和安全性取決於未解決的信息。有效的支持必須明確指出患者的狀況如何影響途徑的資格、延遲和重新指導。MedGPT Clinical Explorer (MCE) 將替代方案、改變決策的未知數、安全約束和備用方案組織成一個條件策略供臨床醫生審查。為了評估這種在醫生撰寫的策略中的表現，多學科專家為100個案例中的40個案例建立了具體參考，來自98個機構的250名醫生在無輔助、檢索參考和MCE輔助條件下產出了2250個策略。 MCE輔助策略表達了比無輔助策略（調整差異，12.87；95% CI，11.18-14.55）和檢索參考策略（5.22；3.52-6.93）更適用的臨床要求，這是通過可接受途徑達成分數 (APAS; 0-100) 來衡量的。在檢索參考和MCE輔助條件下可用的知識基礎相同的情況下，額外的內容集中於候選途徑、決策關鍵信息和安全約束。醫生對整體策略的可接受性判斷與APAS相關（Spearman's rho = 0.671），而一項補充關係審計評估了候選者、條件和隨後行動是否相互連貫地連接。 綜合這些發現，識別出開放式決策支持的兩個互補維度：涵蓋臨床相關內容和途徑、條件及隨後行動之間的連貫聯繫。MCE提供了一個共享的決策對象，使得在行動之前，重要的遺漏和途徑的應急情況變得可見；前瞻性研究應評估其對臨床工作流程和患者結果的影響。

docs.title: Beyond Simple Input-Output Assessment Tasks: Leveraging Automated Programming Assessment for Non-Trivial Courses
docs.text:
2609.29363v1 by Artur Jordao

The public visibility of Artificial Intelligence (AI) is growing rapidly, driven by the positive impact of its applications across diverse fields of knowledge. In this new chapter, courses that cover the foundations of AI and machine learning become essential for understanding their role and potential in contemporary society. Therefore, understanding fundamental concepts and elementary algorithms through the close integration of theory with practice is essential in AI courses. In this essay, we report our experience designing machine learning exercises for automated assessment tools in programming. It is worth mentioning that we are not developing a novel form of automated grading system. Instead, we propose a perspective that frames machine learning problems as input-output assessment tasks. From this perspective, each exercise admits a unique and deterministic answer and enables automated programming assessment tools (e.g., VPL for Moodle, Codeforces, and MOJ) to effectively support AI education. We believe this essay can encourage instructors to foster educational innovation by adopting more dynamic and interactive approaches to AI courses that integrate theory and practice. Importantly, this essay does not introduce an innovation in the use of AI for education; rather, it introduces an innovative approach to improving the learning of AI, particularly, machine learning.

摘要：人工智慧（AI）的公共能見度正在迅速增長，這是由於其在各個知識領域應用的正面影響。在這個新篇章中，涵蓋AI和機器學習基礎的課程對於理解它們在當代社會中的角色和潛力變得至關重要。因此，通過理論與實踐的緊密結合來理解基本概念和初步算法，在AI課程中是必不可少的。在這篇文章中，我們報告了設計自動評估工具的機器學習練習的經驗。值得一提的是，我們並不是在開發一種新型的自動評分系統。相反，我們提出了一種將機器學習問題框架化為輸入-輸出評估任務的視角。從這個角度來看，每個練習都有一個獨特且確定的答案，並使自動編程評估工具（例如，Moodle的VPL、Codeforces和MOJ）能夠有效支持AI教育。我們相信這篇文章可以鼓勵教師通過採用更具動態性和互動性的方式，來促進AI課程的教育創新，並整合理論與實踐。重要的是，這篇文章並未在教育中引入AI的創新；而是介紹了一種創新的方法來改善AI的學習，特別是機器學習。

docs.title: Reasoning Instructions Can Break Answer Decoding in Vision--Language Models
docs.text:
2609.29278v1 by Zeyan Li, Siyuan Qiu, Jianfeng Xu

Chain-of-thought (CoT) instructions can distort multiple-choice VLM evaluation when a scorer appends a reasoning cue but reads answer-label logits before the model generates any rationale. We call this CoT-prefix scoring. On ScienceQA, Qwen2.5-VL-7B drops from 80.76% to 45.48%, and across five option-content permutations 93.54% of CoT-prefix predictions select the first slot. Condition-matched linear probes recover 78.94% from the same hidden states, while free generation restores 75.24%, showing that the answer often survives the prefix and the immediate readout fails. Vocabulary and layer diagnostics explain the mismatch: probability mass moves toward continuation tokens, while answer information remains linearly accessible in late layers. The effect recurs with varying severity across datasets and models, though not universally. These results show that CoT-prefix scoring can confound model knowledge with an evaluation-interface mismatch and should be avoided unless the requested and scored output events are aligned.

摘要：Chain-of-thought (CoT) 指令在評估多選擇 VLM 時可能會扭曲結果，當評分者附加推理提示但在模型生成任何理由之前閱讀答案標籤的 logits。我們稱這種情況為 CoT-prefix 評分。在 ScienceQA 上，Qwen2.5-VL-7B 的分數從 80.76% 降至 45.48%，而在五個選項內容的排列中，93.54% 的 CoT-prefix 預測選擇了第一個槽位。條件匹配的線性探針從相同的隱藏狀態中恢復了 78.94%，而自由生成恢復了 75.24%，顯示答案通常在前綴中存活，而即時的讀取失敗。詞彙和層診斷解釋了這種不匹配：概率質量向延續標記移動，而答案信息在後期層中保持線性可訪問。這種效應在不同數據集和模型中以不同的嚴重程度重現，儘管並非普遍存在。這些結果顯示，CoT-prefix 評分可能會因評估介面不匹配而混淆模型知識，除非請求和評分的輸出事件對齊，否則應避免使用。

docs.title: ALOE: Semantically Addressed Low-Rank Operators for Knowledge Editing
docs.text:
2609.29269v1 by Zeyan Li, Hu Xu, Jianfeng Xu

Knowledge editing changes what a model knows by modifying parameters so that a requested fact updates while unrelated behavior is preserved. This is usually treated as a write problem, but editing also involves an address problem: deciding which hidden states should receive the new residual. An update that activates too narrowly memorizes one prompt, while one that activates too broadly disrupts neighboring knowledge. Parametric editors encode this scope implicitly, whereas memory-based editors make the selection explicit but keep it outside the edited model. We propose ALOE (Addressed Low-rank Operator for Editing), which learns semantic addresses from paraphrases and hard same-subject negatives, aligns them with autoregressive hidden states through rollout refinement and gate calibration, and embeds the resulting gated low-rank operator within one MLP layer, so that the deployed model runs in a single forward pass with no external retriever or auxiliary router. Evaluated on CounterFact, ZSRE, and KnowEdit across three 7--8B model families, ALOE achieves efficacy between 0.955 and 0.999 and locality between 0.981 and 1.000; mechanistic analyses confirm that the learned geometry separates competing edits and that calibration suppresses out-of-scope activation. The remaining errors concentrate in paraphrase coverage and write fitting.

摘要：知識編輯透過修改參數來改變模型所知道的內容，以便在更新請求的事實時保留不相關的行為。這通常被視為寫入問題，但編輯也涉及一個地址問題：決定哪些隱藏狀態應該接收新的殘差。過於狹隘的激活會記住一個提示，而過於廣泛的激活則會干擾相鄰的知識。參數編輯器隱式編碼這個範圍，而基於記憶的編輯器則明確選擇，但將其保持在編輯模型之外。我們提出了ALOE（針對編輯的地址低秩運算子），它從同義句和困難的相同主題負樣本中學習語義地址，通過展開細化和閘校準將其與自回歸隱藏狀態對齊，並將結果的閘低秩運算子嵌入一個MLP層中，以便部署的模型在單次前向傳遞中運行，無需外部檢索器或輔助路由器。在CounterFact、ZSRE和KnowEdit上對三個7--8B模型系列進行評估，ALOE的效能介於0.955和0.999之間，局部性介於0.981和1.000之間；機械分析確認所學幾何分離了競爭編輯，並且校準抑制了超出範圍的激活。剩餘的錯誤集中在同義句覆蓋和寫入擬合上。

docs.title: Post-Training Leaves Behavioral Shadows on Unrelated Decisions
docs.text:
2609.29233v1 by Ziyang Zhang, Yubin Jing, Yuanhao Zeng, Yuyao Li, Haofan Wang, Yichen Gong

We find that language models can transfer capabilities through task-unrelated text. Post-training typically improves language models using task-specific data. Prior work on subliminal learning shows that information about these updates can pass through unrelated generations, but has largely focused on traits or preferences using extensive teacher outputs. We introduce Active Taskless Distillation (ATD), which achieves capability transfer using only a single word from the teacher per prompt. ATD probes the behavioral shadow of post-training by selecting prompts where the teacher and student's shared public ancestor is nearly indifferent between two ordinary words. A student initialized from this ancestor learns solely from the resulting prompt-word pairs, without target-task examples, teacher logits, or teacher parameters. In the primary coding experiment with Qwen2.5-1.5B, 5,664nses yield a 5.34 pp gain on HumanEval+ over an exact nuisance-matched control thadisrupts prompt-resperiments showtransfer in scientific knowledge, commonsense reasoning, and reading comprehensins across additional model generations, sizes, and families. Functional analyses show that the learned sid composable, andthat its strength tracks the teacher's update strength.

摘要：我們發現語言模型可以通過與任務無關的文本轉移能力。後訓練通常使用特定任務數據來改善語言模型。之前的潛意識學習研究顯示，關於這些更新的信息可以通過無關的生成傳遞，但主要集中在使用大量教師輸出來研究特徵或偏好。我們介紹了主動無任務蒸餾（Active Taskless Distillation, ATD），它僅使用每個提示中的一個單詞來實現能力轉移。ATD 通過選擇教師和學生的共享公共祖先在兩個普通單詞之間幾乎無差別的提示來探測後訓練的行為影子。從這個祖先初始化的學生僅從生成的提示-單詞對中學習，沒有目標任務示例、教師 logits 或教師參數。在主要的編碼實驗中，使用 Qwen2.5-1.5B，5,664 次實驗在 HumanEval+ 上產生了 5.34 個百分點的增益，超過了一個精確的干擾匹配控制，這破壞了提示-回應實驗，顯示在科學知識、常識推理和閱讀理解方面的轉移，涵蓋了額外的模型世代、大小和家族。功能分析顯示，學到的側面是可組合的，並且其強度與教師的更新強度相關。

docs.title: ASIRF: An Agentic Framework for Context-Dependent Sensitive Information Redaction
docs.text:
2609.29191v1 by Sudha Priyadarshini, Mohamed Chahine Ghanem

Sensitive information is defined by domain and intent, not a universal category, yet redaction systems such as privacy filters and named-entity recognizers fix a taxonomy at training time, requiring retraining for each new domain. We introduce ASIRF (Agentic Sensitive Information Redaction Framework), which retrieves domain-specific definitions based on the input's domain from a flexible knowledge base at inference time, needing no retraining to adapt. Two architectures, a three-call multi-agent pipeline and a single-agent variant, are evaluated across ten small open-weight models and eight datasets, including out-of-distribution fictional domains, against the OpenAI Privacy Filter (OPF) as a trained-classifier baseline. With only a few dozen expert-authored definitions per domain and no training data, ASIRF's recall exceeds OPF's in 68 of 80 model-domain combinations (85 percent), by at least one of the two architectures, with shortfalls confined mostly to OPF's training-distribution domains.

摘要：敏感信息是由領域和意圖定義的，而不是一個普遍的類別，然而，像隱私過濾器和命名實體識別器這樣的修訂系統在訓練時固定了一個分類法，要求對每個新領域進行重新訓練。我們介紹了ASIRF（代理敏感信息修訂框架），它根據輸入的領域從靈活的知識庫中檢索特定於領域的定義，在推理時不需要重新訓練以進行適應。兩種架構，一個是三次調用的多代理管道，另一個是單代理變體，已在十個小型開放權重模型和八個數據集上進行評估，包括超出分佈的虛構領域，並以OpenAI隱私過濾器（OPF）作為訓練分類器的基準。在每個領域僅有幾十個專家撰寫的定義且沒有訓練數據的情況下，ASIRF的召回率在80個模型-領域組合中的68個（85%）超過了OPF，至少在兩種架構中的一種上達成，短缺主要限於OPF的訓練分佈領域。

docs.title: Tag-Aware Structured Text Translation: Towards a Systematic Understanding
docs.text:
2609.29131v1 by Zhanglin Wu, Hengchao Shang, Daimeng Wei, Jiaxin Guo, Zongyao Li, Tengfei Song, Ning Xie, Weidong Zhang

Internet texts are replete with format tags that carry structural, semantic, and functional meaning. Current large language model (LLM)-based translation systems struggle to balance translation fluency with tag fidelity when processing tagged text. We argue that resolving this tension requires a systematic approach at three interconnected levels: data synthesis, capability building, and multi-objective alignment. At the data level, we identify and formalize a fundamental trade-off between structural tag diversity and translation naturalness in synthetic data generation; existing methods optimize for one at the expense of the other. We propose a hybrid synthesis strategy (Hy-LST) combining LLM-based synthesis tag method and Two-Stage LLM-based synthesis tag method to produce both diverse and natural tagged data. At the capability level, we decompose tag-aware translation into four sub-tasks of increasing difficulty in a multi-task supervised fine-tuning framework, enabling targeted capability acquisition and knowledge transfer. At the alignment level, we design three complementary reward functions under a group relative policy optimization framework, each targeting a distinct objective (fluency, tag fidelity, and tag-scoped translation quality), and show that joint optimization consistently outperforms single-reward alternatives. Experiments on six language directions (en2zh, en2ja, en2de, en2fr, en2ru, de2fr) demonstrate that each level contributes measurable improvements, and the complete system significantly outperforms existing methods. Qualitative analysis reveals specific error patterns and their mitigation after training with our method.

摘要：互聯網文本充滿了承載結構、語義和功能意義的格式標籤。當處理帶標籤的文本時，當前基於大型語言模型（LLM）的翻譯系統在翻譯流暢性和標籤忠實性之間難以取得平衡。我們認為，解決這一矛盾需要在三個相互關聯的層面上採取系統性的方法：數據合成、能力建設和多目標對齊。在數據層面，我們確定並正式化了在合成數據生成中結構標籤多樣性與翻譯自然性之間的基本權衡；現有方法在優化一者的同時以犧牲另一者為代價。我們提出了一種混合合成策略（Hy-LST），結合了基於LLM的合成標籤方法和兩階段LLM基於的合成標籤方法，以生成多樣且自然的帶標籤數據。在能力層面，我們將標籤感知翻譯分解為四個逐漸增加難度的子任務，在多任務監督微調框架中，使得有針對性的能力獲取和知識轉移成為可能。在對齊層面，我們在一個群體相對政策優化框架下設計了三個互補的獎勵函數，每個函數針對一個不同的目標（流暢性、標籤忠實性和標籤範圍翻譯質量），並顯示聯合優化始終優於單一獎勵的替代方案。在六個語言方向（en2zh、en2ja、en2de、en2fr、en2ru、de2fr）上的實驗表明，每個層面都對可測量的改進有所貢獻，完整系統顯著優於現有方法。定性分析揭示了特定的錯誤模式及其在使用我們的方法訓練後的緩解情況。

docs.title: CounterRoute: Self-Routed Reasoning via Hierarchical Counterfactual Credit Assignment
docs.text:
2609.29109v1 by Ruochen Jiao, Besnik Fetahu, Zhenyu Shi, Priyanka Nigam

Reasoning-capable language models often produce long chains of thought when direct answers suffice, wasting inference compute. Many dual-mode models leave this choice to users. Automating it is challenging because routing targets evolve with the policy, initial mode preferences destabilize exploration, and sequence-level objectives entangle routing with response learning. We introduce CounterRoute, an online reinforcement-learning framework that jointly learns routing and modeconditioned responses in one shared policy directly from a native dual-mode checkpoint, without method-specific SFT warm-up. Paired current-policy counterfactual rollouts assign cross-mode credit only to the routing token, while within-mode GRPO trains response tokens. A paired-to-self-routed curriculum stabilizes early training with forced rollouts from both modes, then increases self-routed updates to improve autonomous routing. Across nine benchmarks, CounterRoute better balances accuracy and efficiency than heuristic and learned adaptive-routing methods. Relative to always-thinking checkpoints, it improves macro-average accuracy while reducing mean generated tokens by 51% for Qwen3-8B and 41% for Qwen3-14B. On instruction-following and commonsense benchmarks where direct answering is strong, think rates fall as low as 1% while response quality improves. Despite training only on math and instruction following, its routing behavior and response quality generalize to held-out coding, science, knowledge, and commonsense benchmarks.

摘要：推理能力強的語言模型經常在直接答案足夠的情況下產生冗長的思考鏈，浪費推理計算。許多雙模式模型將這一選擇留給用戶。自動化這一過程具有挑戰性，因為路由目標隨著政策而演變，初始模式偏好會使探索不穩定，且序列級目標將路由與響應學習交織在一起。我們介紹了CounterRoute，一個在線強化學習框架，能夠直接從原生雙模式檢查點中共同學習路由和模式條件響應，而無需特定方法的SFT預熱。配對當前政策的反事實回放僅將跨模式的信用分配給路由標記，而模式內的GRPO則訓練響應標記。配對自我路由的課程通過強制從兩個模式進行的回放來穩定早期訓練，然後增加自我路由的更新以改善自主路由。在九個基準測試中，CounterRoute在準確性和效率之間的平衡優於啟發式和學習的自適應路由方法。與始終思考的檢查點相比，它提高了宏觀平均準確性，同時將Qwen3-8B的平均生成標記數減少了51%，Qwen3-14B則減少了41%。在直接回答表現強勁的指令跟隨和常識基準上，思考率降至低至1%，而響應質量卻有所改善。儘管僅在數學和指令跟隨上進行訓練，其路由行為和響應質量卻能夠泛化到保留的編碼、科學、知識和常識基準。

docs.title: CRISS: A Retrieval-Augmented AI Chatbot for Assisting Cancer Registrars
docs.text:
2609.29075v1 by Vani Seth, Mohammad Beheshti, Anirudh Kambhampati, Vishwa Bhayani, Lucinda Ham, Prasad Calyam, Iris Zachary

Cancer registrars, including Oncology Data Specialists (ODSs), must interpret complex and frequently updated coding and staging standards. We developed CRISS (Cancer Registry Intelligent Support System), a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) conversational assistant that provides rapid, citation-supported access to registry guidance. This study evaluated whether CRISS could (1) support accurate and citation-supported responses, (2) improve access to and interpretation of relevant guidance, and (3) support training/helpdesk use while preserving human oversight of final abstraction decisions. We built a domain-specific knowledge base from national cancer registry standards, segmented into metadata-tagged passages and indexed as dense embeddings. Retrieved passages were used to generate citation-grounded responses through a large language model (LLM). Open-weight, proprietary, and non-RAG baseline models across Gemini and GPT families were evaluated on easy, medium, and hard registry questions using an LLM-as-a-Judge protocols. RAG configurations consistently outperformed non-RAG approaches, especially as question difficulty increased. Mean grounding scores for RAG were 0.62/0.56/0.59 across easy/medium/hard tiers versus 0.29/0.26/0.29 for non-RAG. RAG models also achieved higher semantic-similarity scores overall. Proprietary RAG models performed strongest on easy and medium questions, while local RAG models ranked highest on hard questions and proprietary models were generally more cautious. Domain-specific RAG improved evidence grounding and response quality for cancer registry questions while enabling citation-supported assistance across complexity levels. CRISS demonstrates the potential of human-centered, citation-grounded AI to support cancer registrars while preserving human oversight for final coding decisions.

摘要：癌症登記員，包括腫瘤數據專家（ODS），必須解釋複雜且經常更新的編碼和分期標準。我們開發了CRISS（癌症登記智能支持系統），這是一個檢索增強生成（RAG）對話助手，提供快速、引用支持的登記指導訪問。本研究評估了CRISS是否能夠（1）支持準確且有引用支持的回答，（2）改善對相關指導的訪問和解釋，以及（3）在保持對最終抽象決策的人類監督的同時支持培訓/幫助台的使用。我們從全國癌症登記標準建立了一個特定領域的知識庫，將其分段為帶有元數據標籤的段落並作為密集嵌入進行索引。檢索到的段落用於通過大型語言模型（LLM）生成基於引用的回答。在Gemini和GPT系列中，開放權重、專有和非RAG基準模型在簡單、中等和困難的登記問題上使用LLM作為評判者的協議進行評估。隨著問題難度的增加，RAG配置始終優於非RAG方法。RAG的平均基礎分數在簡單/中等/困難層次上分別為0.62/0.56/0.59，而非RAG則為0.29/0.26/0.29。RAG模型在整體上也達到了更高的語義相似度分數。專有RAG模型在簡單和中等問題上表現最佳，而本地RAG模型在困難問題上排名最高，專有模型通常更為謹慎。特定領域的RAG改善了癌症登記問題的證據基礎和回答質量，同時在各種複雜性水平上實現了引用支持的協助。CRISS展示了以人為中心、基於引用的人工智能支持癌症登記員的潛力，同時保留對最終編碼決策的人類監督。

docs.title: The Tokens Remember: When Tokenization Bypasses Knowledge Editing and Unlearning
docs.text:
2609.29045v1 by Manit Baser, Aditya Nawal, Dinil Mon Divakaran, Mohan Gurusamy

Open-weight LLMs give downstream users control over the inference stack, but this flexibility can undermine post-release guarantees that sensitive knowledge has been modified or removed. Model editing and machine unlearning are used to modify or remove targeted knowledge without retraining models from scratch. However, existing security evaluations of these techniques face two critical limitations. First, they typically require access to either the original pre-edit/unlearning model or auxiliary classifiers to detect modifications or reconstruct pre-edit behavior. Second, they evaluate modifications under the canonical tokenization of an input, implicitly treating tokenization as a benign preprocessing step. We show that this assumption creates a security gap: the same input string can be represented by alternative valid tokenizations that induce different computational trajectories, allowing an adversary to bypass localized modifications and recover information intended to be suppressed. We introduce Toketive, a simple yet powerful reference-free attack that exploits the tokenization-based side channel to (i) detect modified knowledge and (ii) reconstruct the corresponding pre-edit response. It operates solely on the released model and requires neither the pre-edit model, training data, shadow models, nor auxiliary classifiers. Across five LLMs, six datasets, and six editing and unlearning techniques, we find that 38.6% of alternative tokenizations bypass the modification and recover the pre-edit response. Toketive detects modified facts with an F1 score of 84.2%, a 26.2% relative gain over the strongest baseline, and reconstructs pre-edit responses with 74.5% top-5 accuracy, 21.7% higher than the best baseline. Our results show that localized modifications should not be treated as robust knowledge-control boundaries without adversarial evaluation over alternative representations.

摘要：開放權重的 LLM 使下游用戶能夠控制推理堆疊，但這種靈活性可能會削弱發布後對敏感知識已被修改或移除的保證。模型編輯和機器遺忘被用來在不從頭訓練模型的情況下修改或移除目標知識。然而，現有對這些技術的安全評估面臨兩個關鍵限制。首先，它們通常需要訪問原始的預編輯/遺忘模型或輔助分類器來檢測修改或重建預編輯行為。其次，它們在輸入的標準令牌化下評估修改，隱含地將令牌化視為一個良性的預處理步驟。我們展示了這一假設創造了一個安全漏洞：相同的輸入字符串可以通過替代有效的令牌化表示，這會引發不同的計算軌跡，使對手能夠繞過局部修改並恢復意圖被抑制的信息。 我們介紹了 Toketive，一種簡單但強大的無參考攻擊，利用基於令牌化的側信道來 (i) 檢測修改的知識和 (ii) 重建相應的預編輯響應。它僅在發布的模型上運行，並不需要預編輯模型、訓練數據、影子模型或輔助分類器。在五個 LLM、六個數據集和六種編輯及遺忘技術中，我們發現 38.6% 的替代令牌化繞過了修改並恢復了預編輯響應。Toketive 以 84.2% 的 F1 分數檢測修改的事實，相較於最強基準提高了 26.2%，並以 74.5% 的前 5 名準確率重建預編輯響應，比最佳基準高出 21.7%。我們的結果顯示，局部修改不應被視為穩健的知識控制邊界，而不進行對替代表示的對抗評估。

docs.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration of 3GPP Channel Estimators
docs.text:
2609.29044v1 by I. Zakir Ahmed, Hamid Sadjadpour

Pilot-aided channel estimation is a decisive block in orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) receivers for both 5G New Radio (5G-NR) and Long-Term Evolution (LTE). A large body of estimators exists, from simple least-squares (LS) interpolation to statistically optimal linear minimum-mean-square-error (LMMSE) variants and, more recently, deep convolutional denoisers, yet no single estimator is uniformly best: the winner depends on the propagation scenario, the numerology, the operating signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), the mobility (Doppler), and the antenna configuration. In this paper, we quantify this fact through a unified study of eight literature estimators evaluated over the 3GPP TR~38.901 Urban-Macro (UMa), Urban-Micro (UMi), and Rural-Macro (RMa) channels generated with NVIDIA Sionna, for both 5G-NR and LTE numerologies, in single-input single-output (SISO) and $8\times2$ multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) settings. We then propose a \emph{condition-adaptive multi-agent orchestrator} that treats each estimator as an independent agent and dispatches, per operating condition, to the agent that is best on a validation split without any genie knowledge. The orchestrator tracks the per-realization oracle to within $1.07$~dB and improves the normalized mean-square error (NMSE) over the best \emph{fixed} strategy by up to $3.6$~dB at high SNR, where the low-SNR champion is no longer optimal. Because the agents are independent, running them concurrently delivers this best-of-eight accuracy at essentially single-estimator latency: a data-parallel partition scales the wall-clock nearly as $1/K$ with $K$ workers (up to $6.9\times$), whereas naive by-algorithm partitioning is Amdahl-limited by the heaviest agent. The results substantiate multi-agent orchestration as a practical route to robust channel estimation across heterogeneous 5G-NR/LTE deployments.

摘要：試點輔助的通道估計是正交頻分多工（OFDM）接收器中的一個關鍵組件，適用於5G新無線（5G-NR）和長期演進（LTE）。存在大量的估計器，從簡單的最小二乘（LS）插值到統計最優的線性最小均方誤差（LMMSE）變體，以及最近的深度卷積去噪器，但沒有單一的估計器是均勻最佳的：勝者取決於傳播場景、數字設計、運行的信號噪聲比（SNR）、移動性（多普勒）和天線配置。在本文中，我們通過對八種文獻估計器的統一研究來量化這一事實，這些估計器在3GPP TR~38.901城市宏（UMa）、城市微（UMi）和農村宏（RMa）通道上進行評估，這些通道是使用NVIDIA Sionna生成的，適用於5G-NR和LTE數字設計，並在單輸入單輸出（SISO）和$8\times2$多輸入多輸出（MIMO）設置中進行。我們然後提出了一個\emph{條件自適應多代理協調器}，將每個估計器視為獨立的代理，並根據運行條件分派給在驗證拆分中表現最佳的代理，而不需要任何先驗知識。該協調器將每次實現的預言者追踪到$1.07$~dB內，並在高SNR下將標準化均方誤差（NMSE）相對於最佳\emph{固定}策略提高了最多$3.6$~dB，此時低SNR冠軍不再最優。由於這些代理是獨立的，並行運行它們在實際上以單一估計器的延遲提供了這種最佳八種準確性：數據並行分區幾乎以$1/K$的速度縮放時鐘時間，$K$工作者（最多$6.9\times$），而天真的按算法分區則受到最重代理的阿姆達爾限制。這些結果證實了多代理協調作為在異構5G-NR/LTE部署中進行穩健通道估計的實用途徑。

docs.title: Cross-Country Code-Mixing for Generative Recommendation
docs.text:
2609.28972v1 by Yuan Gao, Hao Deng, Haibo Xing, Yi Xu, Lingyu Mu, Jinxin Hu, Yu Zhang, Xiaoyi Zeng

Cross-country recommendation on modern e-commerce platforms is typically deployed with disjoint user and item ID spaces across markets, removing the shared anchors that conventional cross-domain methods rely on. Generative recommendation (GR) mitigates this by mapping items into a shared token space and training a unified model, but existing approaches keep behavior sequences strictly country-specific, so knowledge transfer occurs only at the parameter level and remains absent at the data level. Inspired by code-switching corpora in multilingual natural language processing, we propose CMRec, a cross-country GR framework that injects cross-country supervision at the data level via dual-constrained, context-aware code-mixing. CMRec first learns a shared semantic codebook from multi-modal content and behavioral co-occurrence across countries. It then uses this codebook to synthesize mixed-country sequences via token-level substitutions that satisfy both static (content) and dynamic (e.g., price, audience, popularity) constraints. Finally, it introduces a context-aware loss that reweights mixed samples according to their plausibility in the current sequence. Experiments on two real-world multi-country datasets and an online A/B test show that CMRec substantially improves recommendation quality in data-sparse countries while preserving performance in data-rich countries, achieving +1.77% advertising revenue and +2.64% orders on a large-scale e-commerce platform.

摘要：跨國推薦在現代電子商務平台上通常部署於市場之間不相交的用戶和商品 ID 空間，去除了傳統跨域方法所依賴的共享錨點。生成推薦（GR）通過將商品映射到共享的標記空間並訓練統一模型來緩解這一問題，但現有方法嚴格保持行為序列的國家特定性，因此知識轉移僅在參數層面發生，而在數據層面則缺失。受到多語言自然語言處理中的代碼切換語料庫啟發，我們提出了 CMRec，一個跨國 GR 框架，通過雙重約束的上下文感知代碼混合在數據層面注入跨國監督。CMRec 首先從跨國的多模態內容和行為共現中學習共享的語義代碼本。然後，它使用這個代碼本通過滿足靜態（內容）和動態（例如，價格、受眾、受歡迎程度）約束的標記級替換來合成混合國家的序列。最後，它引入了一種上下文感知損失，根據混合樣本在當前序列中的合理性重新加權。對於兩個現實世界的多國數據集和一個在線 A/B 測試的實驗表明，CMRec 在數據稀疏的國家顯著提高了推薦質量，同時保持了在數據豐富國家的性能，實現了 +1.77% 的廣告收入和 +2.64% 的訂單數量，在一個大型電子商務平台上。

docs.title: Back to the Definition: Estimating Step-Level Advantages via Trajectory Graphs for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
docs.text:
2609.28963v1 by Xincheng Yao, Haobo Fu, Weiming Liu, Chongyang Zhang

Group-based reinforcement learning (RL) methods, such as GRPO and its variants, have become a leading paradigm for training reasoning and agentic large language models (LLMs). While their group-normalized advantage estimation is reliable at the response level, it becomes systematically biased at the step level, since coarse-grained trajectory-level advantages are hard to accurately reflect the contribution of individual steps (i.e, failed trajectories may contain valuable steps). Revisiting the foundational RL definition, we notice that GRPO's success on single-turn tasks stems from its advantage estimation strategy, which adheres to the basic definition: the mean reward of multiple actions sampled from the same state constitutes a credible state-value estimate. Extending the faithful estimation to step-level would in principle demand sampling multiple actions from each intermediate state, which is too costly on a per-state basis. To mitigate this issue, we propose a Graph-based Faithful sTep-level credit-assignment framework (GRAFT) that grafts all rollout trajectories into a trajectory graph, recovering node state-values via Bellman iteration on the graph, and assigning credit to each edge by the node value difference. Theoretically, the estimated step-level advantage faithfully adheres to the basic advantage definition in RL. To further ensure the reliability of step-level advantage estimation, we further propose Graph GAE, which extends GAE to the trajectory graph for reducing the impact of state-value estimation bias. Experiments across a range of multi-turn agentic benchmarks show consistent gains over GRPO and superior performance compared to recent agentic RL algorithms. Code will be available at https://github.com/xcyao00/GRAFT.

摘要：群體基礎的強化學習（RL）方法，如 GRPO 及其變體，已成為訓練推理和代理大型語言模型（LLMs）的主要範式。雖然它們的群體正規化優勢估計在回應層面上是可靠的，但在步驟層面上卻系統性地存在偏差，因為粗粒度的軌跡級優勢難以準確反映個別步驟的貢獻（即失敗的軌跡可能包含有價值的步驟）。重新審視基礎的 RL 定義，我們注意到 GRPO 在單回合任務上的成功源於其優勢估計策略，該策略遵循基本定義：從同一狀態抽樣的多個動作的平均獎勵構成可信的狀態價值估計。將忠實的估計擴展到步驟層面原則上需要從每個中間狀態抽樣多個動作，這在每個狀態的基礎上成本過高。為了緩解這一問題，我們提出了一種基於圖的忠實步驟級信用分配框架（GRAFT），將所有回合軌跡 graft 進一個軌跡圖，通過在圖上進行 Bellman 迭代來恢復節點狀態值，並根據節點值差異為每條邊分配信用。理論上，估計的步驟級優勢忠實地遵循 RL 中的基本優勢定義。為了進一步確保步驟級優勢估計的可靠性，我們進一步提出了 Graph GAE，將 GAE 擴展到軌跡圖，以減少狀態價值估計偏差的影響。在一系列多回合代理基準測試中的實驗顯示，相較於 GRPO，具有一致的增益，並且與近期的代理 RL 算法相比表現優越。代碼將在 https://github.com/xcyao00/GRAFT 提供。

docs.title: Script Choice in LLMs: Evidence for Late-Layer Commitment
docs.text:
2609.28784v1 by David Kletz, Sandra Mitrović, Itay Sabato, Ljiljana Dolamić, Fabio Rinaldi

In this paper, we investigate how script knowledge is distributed across the layers of LLMs using two complementary interpretability methods: logistic regression probing and logit-lens analysis. Our probing experiments reveal a clear asymmetry: both the input script and the instructed output script are encoded in the earliest layers of the network, while, in contrast, commitment to the actual output script emerges only in the final layers, with the model's intermediate representations defaulting to Latin throughout most of the layers. This two-stage process is confirmed by logit-lens analyses, which show that script commitment consistently occurs at the very last layers of the LLMs. Together with the weaker script-following performance observed in smaller models, these results form a converging body of evidence linking script commitment to model depth, with broader implications for the design of sufficiently deep, inclusive multilingual architectures.

摘要：在本文中，我們研究了如何通過兩種互補的可解釋性方法：邏輯回歸探測和邏輯透鏡分析，來分析腳本知識在大型語言模型（LLMs）層中的分佈。我們的探測實驗揭示了一個明顯的非對稱性：輸入腳本和指令輸出的腳本都在網絡的最早層中被編碼，而與此相對，對實際輸出腳本的承諾僅在最後幾層中出現，模型的中間表示在大多數層中默認為拉丁文。這一兩階段過程得到了邏輯透鏡分析的確認，該分析顯示腳本承諾始終發生在LLMs的最後幾層中。再加上在較小模型中觀察到的較弱的腳本跟隨性能，這些結果形成了一個趨同的證據體，將腳本承諾與模型深度聯繫起來，對設計足夠深且包容的多語言架構具有更廣泛的啟示。

docs.title: Beyond Static Graph World Models: Learning Stochastic Latent Dynamics over Evolving Topologies
docs.text:
2609.28670v1 by Alex Schutz, Nick Hawes, Victor-Alexandru Darvariu

Graph-based world models have recently emerged as a means of learning transitions over relational state representations. However, existing approaches are largely limited to fixed-topology graphs or deterministic, fully observable environments. We propose the Graph Dynamics Model (GDM), a world model for graph-structured observations that is designed to handle the more general setting of evolving topologies in stochastic and partially observable environments. The GDM uses a sparse recurrent adjacency matrix to model topology updates and perform message passing, together with a recurrent state-space architecture for modelling stochastic transitions. Furthermore, we identify a gap in the evaluation of graph-based world models, as existing methods do not provide a means of comparing predicted and true distributions over the joint graph state comprising the interdependent topology, node features, and graph features. We therefore introduce the Graph Distribution Distance (GDD) metric, which uses maximum mean discrepancy with a graph kernel to comprehensively compare joint next-state distributions. We evaluate the GDM across several environments, including stochastic and partially observable settings. We demonstrate that GDM outperforms baseline models and displays zero-shot generalisation on large graphs.

摘要：圖形基礎的世界模型最近出現，作為學習關係狀態表示之間轉換的一種手段。然而，現有的方法在很大程度上僅限於固定拓撲的圖形或確定性、完全可觀察的環境。我們提出了圖形動態模型（GDM），這是一種針對圖形結構觀察的世界模型，旨在處理隨機和部分可觀察環境中不斷演變的拓撲的更一般設置。GDM使用稀疏的遞歸鄰接矩陣來建模拓撲更新並執行消息傳遞，並結合遞歸狀態空間架構來建模隨機轉換。此外，我們發現了圖形基礎世界模型評估中的一個空白，因為現有方法並未提供比較預測和真實分佈的手段，這些分佈涵蓋了相互依賴的拓撲、節點特徵和圖形特徵。因此，我們引入了圖形分佈距離（GDD）度量，該度量使用最大均值差異與圖形核來全面比較聯合下一狀態分佈。我們在多個環境中評估GDM，包括隨機和部分可觀察的設置。我們證明GDM在基準模型中表現優於並在大型圖形上顯示零樣本泛化。

docs.title: Cross-Scale Transfer Learning for Depression Severity Prediction: From PHQ-8 to HAMD-17 Across Languages and Clinical Paradigms
docs.text:
2609.28430v1 by Wenjie Feng, Sahba Zojaji, Satoshi Nakamura

This work addresses continuous depression-severity score prediction from clinical interview transcripts under data scarcity. We propose a sequential low-rank adaptation (LoRA) protocol for cross-scale transfer: a Qwen3 backbone with a bounded regression head is first fine-tuned on the English DAIC-WOZ dataset (189 avatar-mediated sessions, PHQ-8), and the adapter then initializes fine-tuning on the Chinese PDCH dataset (100 real clinical consultations, HAMD-17), where a reinitialised, scale-specific head predicts the clinician-assigned score. All configurations use patient-level stratified 5-fold, 2-repeat cross-validation. On the data-scarce HAMD-17 target, the sequential protocol attains the best point-estimate MAE , RMSE, and macro-$F_1$ on both 0.6B and 1.7B backbones, outperforming target-only training and non-LLM baselines---4.96/6.59/0.36 with Qwen3-0.6B and 4.38/5.62/0.46 with Qwen3-1.7B. Ablations suggest that correctly aligned source supervision gives the best point estimates (unsupervised exposure and shuffled-label controls also show partial gains), that native-Chinese target input outperforms machine-translated English input, and that the reversed order yields no clear gain within run-to-run variance. The study is an exploratory, single-site internal evaluation: it does not establish screening or diagnostic utility, nor separately identify the contribution of the scale, language, or paradigm shifts. To our knowledge, no prior study evaluates this specific DAIC-WOZ-to-PDCH sequential transfer setting.

摘要：這項工作針對在數據稀缺情況下從臨床訪談轉錄中預測持續的抑鬱嚴重程度分數。我們提出了一種連續低秩適應（LoRA）協議，用於跨尺度轉移：首先在英語DAIC-WOZ數據集（189次虛擬角色介導的會話，PHQ-8）上對Qwen3主幹進行微調，然後適配器在中文PDCH數據集（100次真實臨床諮詢，HAMD-17）上初始化微調，其中重新初始化的特定於尺度的頭部預測臨床醫生分配的分數。所有配置均使用患者級別的分層5折、2次重複交叉驗證。在數據稀缺的HAMD-17目標上，連續協議在0.6B和1.7B主幹上均達到最佳點估計MAE、RMSE和宏觀$F_1$，超越了僅針對目標的訓練和非LLM基準——Qwen3-0.6B的結果為4.96/6.59/0.36，Qwen3-1.7B的結果為4.38/5.62/0.46。消融實驗表明，正確對齊的源監督提供了最佳的點估計（無監督暴露和隨機標籤控制也顯示出部分增益），本地中文目標輸入優於機器翻譯的英語輸入，且反向順序在運行間變異中未顯示出明顯增益。該研究是一項探索性的單點內部評估：它並未確立篩查或診斷效用，也未單獨識別尺度、語言或範式轉變的貢獻。據我們所知，之前沒有研究評估這一特定的DAIC-WOZ到PDCH的連續轉移設置。

docs.title: Mizar: A 159M-Parameter Audio-Language Model for Audio Understanding
docs.text:
2609.28344v1 by Kaiyang Li, Shaobo Han, Yue Tian, Shihao Ji

Audio-language models (ALMs) integrate acoustic perception with the knowledge encoded in language models, enabling contextual understanding of auditory events. Making these capabilities practical on devices with limited memory and computation motivates our focus on small ALMs with fewer than 200M parameters. We introduce a recipe that brings together architecture, data, and three-stage training to build Mizar, a 159.3M-parameter ALM. Its architecture connects a compact CED-Small audio encoder to SmolLM2-135M through a frequency-merging mapper. With supervision drawn from ReasonAQA, AudioMCQ, and AVQA, the model undergoes three training stages: audio-language alignment (Stage 1), audio-dependent fine-tuning (Stage 2), and post-training (Stage 3) aimed at strengthening weak skills while retaining learned capabilities. Across five random seeds, Mizar achieves mean accuracies of 52.92% on MMAU, 42.42% on MMAR, and 36.02% on ADQA-clean, surpassing the previous best-performing ALM below 200M parameters on all three benchmarks. It also supports local inference on a single CPU: on questions from the MMAU benchmark, the mean latency from opening the audio file to generating a complete answer is 1.09 seconds. Code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/KaiyangLi1992/Mizar_159M.

摘要：音頻語言模型（ALMs）將聲音感知與語言模型中編碼的知識整合在一起，使得對聽覺事件的上下文理解成為可能。使這些能力在記憶和計算有限的設備上實用化促使我們專注於參數少於200M的小型ALMs。我們介紹了一個將架構、數據和三階段訓練結合起來的方案，以構建Mizar，這是一個擁有159.3M參數的ALM。其架構通過頻率合併映射器將緊湊的CED-Small音頻編碼器連接到SmolLM2-135M。模型在ReasonAQA、AudioMCQ和AVQA的監督下經歷了三個訓練階段：音頻語言對齊（第一階段）、音頻依賴的微調（第二階段）以及旨在加強弱技能的後訓練（第三階段），同時保留已學會的能力。在五個隨機種子下，Mizar在MMAU上達到52.92%的平均準確率，在MMAR上達到42.42%，在ADQA-clean上達到36.02%，在所有三個基準上超越了之前在200M參數以下的最佳表現ALM。它還支持在單個CPU上進行本地推理：在MMAU基準的問題上，從打開音頻文件到生成完整答案的平均延遲為1.09秒。代碼和檢查點可在https://github.com/KaiyangLi1992/Mizar_159M獲得。

docs.title: Learning to Discover Interesting Mathematics
docs.text:
2609.28603v1 by Niket Patel, Ahmad Rammal, Amaury Hayat, Remi Munos, Julia Kempe

Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have been increasingly able to solve advanced mathematical problems, including many that have been open for decades. This opens the door to expansion of mathematical knowledge at unprecedented scale. Yet, while LLMs may be able to conjecture and prove more and more theorems, it remains open whether this new mathematical knowledge is interesting or useful. We define intrinsic interestingness of a theorem as the ratio between the length of its proof and the length of its statement. We show that this correlates strongly with an extrinsic measure of the downstream utility of a theorem. We identify the difficulty of a proof conditioned on a set of premises as a useful primitive for computing these metrics, and train a 27B model that predicts proof difficulty more accurately than frontier general-purpose models. Optimizing for our metric creates a model capable of producing more interesting theorems, while also reducing substantial or full overlap with Mathlib from 91.9% to 30.6%, showcasing the creation of more out-of-distribution math. We show that our system can generate candidate theorems, select the most interesting among them, and iteratively build on a self-expanding mathematical library. These metrics provide a practical and quantifiable signal for ranking conjectures and guiding proof search within formal mathematical libraries. Our framework provides a path towards self-expanding, machine-verified mathematical libraries that can choose worthwhile statements without relying on human-supplied targets.

摘要：最近，大型語言模型（LLMs）在解決高級數學問題方面的能力日益增強，包括許多已經懸而未決數十年的問題。這為數學知識的擴展打開了前所未有的門。 然而，儘管LLMs可能能夠推測和證明越來越多的定理，但這種新的數學知識是否有趣或有用仍然是個未知數。我們將定理的內在有趣性定義為其證明的長度與其陳述的長度之比。我們展示了這與定理的外在效用的下游測量有著強烈的相關性。我們將基於一組前提的證明難度確定為計算這些指標的有用原始概念，並訓練了一個27B的模型，該模型比前沿通用模型更準確地預測證明的難度。針對我們的指標進行優化創建了一個能夠產生更有趣定理的模型，同時將與Mathlib的實質性或完全重疊從91.9%降低到30.6%，展示了創造更多分布外數學的能力。我們展示了我們的系統可以生成候選定理，從中選擇最有趣的，並迭代地構建一個自我擴展的數學庫。這些指標提供了一個實用且可量化的信號，用於對猜想進行排名並指導在正式數學庫中的證明搜索。我們的框架提供了一條通往自我擴展、機器驗證的數學庫的道路，能夠在不依賴人類提供的目標的情況下選擇有價值的陳述。

docs.title: Distillation for Efficient Multitask Manipulation Policies via Conditional Flow Matching
docs.text:
2609.28107v2 by Shreya Deshmukh, Imen Mahdi, Nick Heppert, Abhinav Valada

Advances in generative modeling have recently been extensively employed in robotics for policy learning. In particular, Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) trained with expert demonstrations has been shown to outperform existing methods on robot manipulation benchmarks. While prior work has mainly focused on single-task settings, we study the problem from a multi-task perspective, as training independent models for each task is computationally expensive. Multi-Task policy learning comes with its own set of challenges, as naively training on a concatenated dataset of demonstrations would either require increased model capacity to accommodate the added complexity or result in drops in performance. We propose to distill knowledge from single-task CFM experts into a shared multi-task policy by transferring their learned velocity fields. We combine this distillation signal with the original CFM objective to retain fidelity to the demonstrations. Experiments on RLBench show that our approach improves multi-task policy performance over naive training while maintaining a fixed model size.

摘要：在生成模型方面的進展最近被廣泛應用於機器人政策學習。特別是，使用專家示範訓練的條件流匹配（CFM）已被證明在機器人操作基準上超越現有方法。雖然之前的工作主要集中在單任務設置上，但我們從多任務的角度研究這個問題，因為為每個任務訓練獨立模型在計算上是昂貴的。多任務政策學習有其自身的一套挑戰，因為簡單地在連接的示範數據集上進行訓練要麼需要增加模型容量以適應增加的複雜性，要麼會導致性能下降。我們提出從單任務CFM專家中提煉知識，通過轉移他們學習的速度場來形成共享的多任務政策。我們將這個提煉信號與原始CFM目標結合，以保持對示範的忠實度。在RLBench上的實驗顯示，我們的方法在保持固定模型大小的同時，改善了多任務政策性能，超越了簡單訓練。

docs.title: Fed-ReMasker: Federated Tabular Imputation under Feature-Level Missingness
docs.text:
2609.28105v1 by Ioannis Papathanail, Rooholla Poursoleymani, Lubnaa Abdur Rahman, Stavroula Georgia Mougiakakou

Multi-center clinical studies and biomedical research collaborations increasingly seek to utilize data across centers to build models that generalize beyond any single center. This creates two distinct challenges: data protection regulations may restrict the sharing of raw patient data across institutions, while centers may collect only partially overlapping sets of features under different protocols. Federated learning enables collaborative model training without centralizing raw data. However, existing federated imputation methods rarely evaluate feature-level missingness, in which entire features are unobserved at some centers. To address this setting, we adapt the ReMasker masked autoencoder to federated learning (Fed-ReMasker), enabling centers to impute features never observed locally by leveraging knowledge learned across collaborating centers. We evaluate Fed-ReMasker in a benchmark spanning synthetic datasets with linear and nonlinear relationships and real-world tabular datasets, including clinical data. The benchmark varies the number of centers, the missingness ratios, and client heterogeneity. Fed-ReMasker achieves the lowest imputation error in 93.2% of value-level and 96.7% of feature-level scenarios in the homogeneous benchmark. It also remains robust to client heterogeneity using simple federated averaging, outperforming all baselines in all 36 value-level scenarios and each baseline in at least 35 of 36 feature-level scenarios, and comes within 3.0% on average of a centralized model trained on the pooled data.

摘要：多中心臨床研究和生物醫學研究合作越來越尋求利用跨中心的數據來構建能夠超越任何單一中心的模型。這帶來了兩個明顯的挑戰：數據保護法規可能限制跨機構共享原始病人數據，而各中心在不同的協議下可能僅收集部分重疊的特徵集。聯邦學習使得在不集中原始數據的情況下進行協作模型訓練成為可能。然而，現有的聯邦插補方法很少評估特徵級別的缺失情況，即某些中心的整個特徵未被觀察到。為了解決這一情況，我們將 ReMasker 掩蔽自編碼器適應於聯邦學習（Fed-ReMasker），使得各中心能夠利用跨合作中心學習到的知識來插補本地從未觀察到的特徵。我們在一個基準測試中評估 Fed-ReMasker，該基準涵蓋了具有線性和非線性關係的合成數據集以及包括臨床數據在內的真實表格數據集。該基準變化了中心的數量、缺失比例和客戶異質性。在同質基準中，Fed-ReMasker 在 93.2% 的值級別和 96.7% 的特徵級別場景中實現了最低的插補誤差。它在使用簡單的聯邦平均時對客戶異質性也保持穩健，在所有 36 個值級別場景中超越了所有基準，並在至少 35 個 36 個特徵級別場景中超越了每個基準，並且平均與在合併數據上訓練的集中模型相差僅 3.0%。

docs.title: Curriculum Learning with GNN-based Reinforcement Learning for Job Shop Scheduling
docs.text:
2609.28085v1 by Jayakrishnan K. Vasudevan, Jonathan Hoss, Noah Klarmann

The job shop scheduling problem is a challenging combinatorial optimization problem, and recent reinforcement learning approaches using graph neural networks have shown promise for learning scheduling policies directly from problem instances. However, training on large instances remains computationally expensive, and generalization across instance sizes remains challenging. This paper studies curriculum learning for graph neural network-based reinforcement learning in the job shop scheduling problem by comparing it with single-size training across three target sizes: 20 x 20, 25 x 25, and 30 x 30. In the curriculum setting, the policy is first trained on smaller instances and then progressively adapted to larger target sizes, allowing scheduling behavior learned in earlier stages to support learning on larger instances. Models are evaluated on unseen instances from 8 x 8 to 30 x 30 using the optimality gap, considering both generalization across all evaluation sizes and specialization on the target size. Results show that curriculum learning consistently reduces wall-clock training time, with larger benefits as the target size increases. The strongest advantage is observed at 30 x 30, where curriculum learning reduces the mean optimality gap across all evaluation sizes by approximately 8.1 percentage points, reduces the target-size mean optimality gap by approximately 8.6 percentage points, and saves approximately 50 hours of training time.

摘要：工作車間排程問題是一個具有挑戰性的組合優化問題，最近使用圖神經網絡的強化學習方法在直接從問題實例中學習排程策略方面顯示出潛力。然而，對於大型實例的訓練仍然計算上昂貴，並且在實例大小之間的泛化仍然具有挑戰性。本文通過將其與三個目標大小（20 x 20、25 x 25 和 30 x 30）之間的單一大小訓練進行比較，研究了基於圖神經網絡的強化學習在工作車間排程問題中的課程學習。在課程設置中，策略首先在較小的實例上進行訓練，然後逐步適應較大的目標大小，允許在早期階段學習的排程行為支持在較大實例上的學習。模型在從 8 x 8 到 30 x 30 的未見實例上進行評估，使用最優性差距，考慮到所有評估大小的泛化和在目標大小上的專門化。結果顯示，課程學習始終減少了牆鐘訓練時間，隨著目標大小的增加，效益更大。在 30 x 30 時觀察到最強的優勢，課程學習將所有評估大小的平均最優性差距減少了約 8.1 個百分點，將目標大小的平均最優性差距減少了約 8.6 個百分點，並節省了約 50 小時的訓練時間。

docs.title: SGA: Uncertainty Quantification for Multi-Step Forecasting in Time Series Foundation Models
docs.text:
2609.28582v1 by Xin-Yu Hu, Shuang Liang, Cheng Feng, Shao-Qun Zhang

The recent emergence of Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) has significantly advanced multi-step forecasting performance, enabling accurate predictions over extended future horizons. However, existing TSFMs often suffer from significantly inherent uncertainty, which typically manifests as derived forecast branches emerging at each time step and spreading to subsequent steps; different forecast branches often exhibit varying forecasting performance, thereby undermining the credibility of TSFM forecasts. In this paper, we propose the Slicing-Graphing-Alignment (SGA) method to quantify the uncertainty of multi-step TSFM forecasts. The proposed SGA first characterizes the topology of all potential forecast branches using a directed acyclic graph, such that the graph complexity bounds the uncertainty of multi-step forecasts, and then precisely measures the graph complexity by integrating both topological information and TSFM-inherent stochasticity. Experimental results conducted on 11 TSFMs and 27 datasets demonstrate that (i) SGA achieves the best performance when ranking predictive errors with uncertainty estimates; (ii) SGA works with a more extensive and more precise sampling coverage than those of existing UQ methods, deriving a quantification mechanism fundamentally different from those of established ones; and (iii) larger model scales of TSFMs correlate with lower uncertainty estimates of multi-step forecasts, suggesting another empirical scaling law for uncertainty quantification of multi-step TSFM forecasts.

摘要：最近出現的時間序列基礎模型（TSFMs）顯著提升了多步預測的表現，使得在較長的未來範圍內能夠進行準確的預測。然而，現有的TSFMs往往面臨顯著的內在不確定性，這通常表現為在每個時間步驟出現的衍生預測分支，並擴展到後續步驟；不同的預測分支往往顯示出不同的預測表現，從而削弱了TSFM預測的可信度。在本文中，我們提出了切片-圖形-對齊（SGA）方法，以量化多步TSFM預測的不確定性。所提出的SGA首先使用有向無環圖來表徵所有潛在預測分支的拓撲結構，使得圖的複雜性界定了多步預測的不確定性，然後通過整合拓撲信息和TSFM固有隨機性來精確測量圖的複雜性。在11個TSFMs和27個數據集上進行的實驗結果顯示：（i）在用不確定性估計對預測誤差進行排序時，SGA達到了最佳表現；（ii）SGA的取樣覆蓋範圍比現有的UQ方法更廣泛且更精確，推導出一種根本上不同於既有方法的量化機制；（iii）TSFMs的較大模型規模與多步預測的較低不確定性估計相關，這表明了一種針對多步TSFM預測不確定性量化的另一種經驗縮放法則。

docs.title: TWIST: A Proposed Benchmark for Intervention Quality in Conversational Memory, with a Human-Validated Draft-Alignment
docs.text:
2609.28575v1 by Subrat Panda

Long-conversation memory benchmarks increasingly test recall and prompted knowledge updates, and recent work studies evolving user beliefs and memory state. TWIST is a proposed benchmark suite for a complementary, unmeasured property: intervention quality -- whether a deployed memory system, exercised through its own ingest/recall/vet surface, acts correctly at belief change points. Four tracks cover unprompted tension detection, vetting outgoing drafts against the record, answering with current beliefs while preserving supersession history, and governing sensitive recall. The suite extends LoCoMo's corpora and harness, pairing every detect/block metric with a matched do-not-over-detect control: surface-matched hard negatives price false intervention, so no track can be gamed by flagging everything. The benchmark itself is validated first: independent, gold-blind double annotation with adjudication, judge decoy calibration, and a separability audit. On the human-validated Track B v1.0 key (161 items, post-adjudication kappa = 0.85), no tested configuration simultaneously achieves high contradiction recall, high hard-negative specificity, and high attribution: flat-RAG baselines detect 0.76-0.97 of true contradictions but falsely flag 16-43% of surface-matched safe drafts depending on backend, while a deployed coherence-oriented system almost never over-flags (0.98-1.00 specificity) yet catches 42% of true contradictions -- a trade-off no recall-only score can see. A 13-configuration baseline ladder localizes causes: every gold contradiction is detectable from its evidence alone (recall 1.000), calibrated models nearly solve the track given the full transcript -- consistent with substantial retrieval-coverage gaps -- and draft-only floors reveal model-dependent style priors. A system's TWIST profile, beside its recall score, measures whether memory knows when to intervene and when not to.

摘要：長期對話記憶基準越來越多地測試回憶和提示知識更新，而最近的研究則探討了用戶信念和記憶狀態的演變。TWIST是一個提出的基準套件，用於補充一個未被測量的屬性：介入質量——即部署的記憶系統是否在信念變更點正確運作，通過其自身的攝取/回憶/驗證界面進行操作。四個軌道涵蓋了未提示的緊張檢測、對照記錄審核發出的草稿、在保留取代歷史的同時用當前信念回答，以及管理敏感回憶。該套件擴展了LoCoMo的語料庫和工具，將每個檢測/阻止指標與匹配的不要過度檢測控制配對：表面匹配的硬負樣本對虛假介入的代價，因此沒有任何軌道可以通過標記所有內容來操縱。基準本身首先得到驗證：獨立的金盲雙重標註與裁決、評審誘餌校準和可分離性審核。在經人類驗證的Track B v1.0關鍵（161項目，裁決後kappa = 0.85）中，沒有測試配置同時實現高矛盾回憶、高硬負樣本特異性和高歸因：平坦的RAG基線檢測到0.76-0.97的真實矛盾，但根據後端錯誤標記16-43%的表面匹配安全草稿，而一個部署的以一致性為導向的系統幾乎從不過度標記（0.98-1.00特異性），卻捕捉到42%的真實矛盾——這是一種任何僅回憶分數無法看到的權衡。一個13配置的基線梯度定位原因：每個金矛盾都可以僅從其證據中檢測到（回憶1.000），經過校準的模型幾乎解決了給定完整抄本的軌道——與實質性檢索覆蓋缺口一致——而僅草稿的底線揭示了模型依賴的風格先驗。一個系統的TWIST檔案，除了其回憶分數外，還衡量記憶是否知道何時介入以及何時不介入。

docs.title: The Path Matters: Evaluating Small Language Models Beyond Answer Accuracy in KGQA
docs.text:
2609.27669v1 by Eduin E. Hernandez, Sergio A. Diaz, Luis F. Garcia, Nurassyl Askar, Stefano Rini

Small language models (SLMs) are increasingly paired with knowledge graphs (KGs), yet end-to-end KG question answering conflates graph access, search, navigation, reasoning, and answer generation. This coupling makes it difficult both to determine whether an SLM can faithfully execute the reasoning path implied by a question and to attribute failures to navigation rather than to other stages of the pipeline. We isolate this capability by employing the THESEUS navigation and traceability framework and using frozen, off-the-shelf SLMs as local action policies. At each hop, the environment exposes the legal outgoing graph actions, and the model selects one executable graph action and decides whether to stop, without task-specific parameter updates, model-controlled beam search, or free-form answer generation. This controlled setting allows us to evaluate terminal-answer accuracy with Hits@1 together with path fidelity, using Path Edit Distance (PED) as the primary trajectory metric. Across the Kinship and MQuAKE-ST KGQAs, similarly sized local models differ substantially in answer accuracy and path fidelity, with the two metrics sometimes favoring different models. This model-dependent behavior also extends to prompting, as a single demonstrated trajectory can improve or degrade navigation depending on the model. These results motivate evaluating SLM graph reasoning beyond endpoint accuracy alone.

摘要：小型語言模型（SLMs）越來越多地與知識圖譜（KGs）配對，但端到端的KG問題回答將圖譜訪問、搜索、導航、推理和答案生成混為一談。這種結合使得既難以確定SLM是否能忠實執行問題所暗示的推理路徑，也難以將失敗歸因於導航而非管道的其他階段。我們通過採用THESEUS導航和可追溯性框架，並使用冷凍的現成SLM作為局部行動策略來孤立這一能力。在每一步中，環境會顯示合法的外發圖譜行動，模型選擇一個可執行的圖譜行動並決定是否停止，而無需特定任務的參數更新、模型控制的束搜索或自由形式的答案生成。這種受控的環境使我們能夠使用Hits@1評估終端答案的準確性以及路徑的忠實度，並以路徑編輯距離（PED）作為主要的軌跡指標。在Kinship和MQuAKE-ST KGQA中，大小相似的局部模型在答案準確性和路徑忠實度上存在顯著差異，這兩個指標有時會偏向不同的模型。這種依賴模型的行為也擴展到提示，因為單一的示範軌跡可以根據模型改善或降低導航效果。這些結果促使我們在評估SLM圖譜推理時，不僅僅關注端點準確性。

docs.title: Hidden not Deleted: How Networks Suppress Entangled Features
docs.text:
2609.27593v1 by Akash Samanta, Manish Pratap Singh, Debasis Chaudhuri

Concept erasure methods that operate via linear projection assume that features occupy separable subspaces. We show this assumption fails under dense superposition: when two features are forced into an antipodal pair sharing a single subspace, state-of-the-art linear erasure destroys both, not just the target. Networks trained with gradient descent instead solve this problem non-linearly, but not uniformly: they converge to one of two distinct circuit-level solutions depending on initialization, which we call mirror and shadow solutions. We map this bifurcation as a function of feature entanglement, show it reflects a stable attractor structure rather than an artifact of our setup, and use targeted causal interventions to demonstrate that both solutions leave a substantial, measurable trace of the erased feature's representation intact, recoverable through a single scalar patch rather than requiring any further training. This mirrors a failure mode recently observed empirically in LLM unlearning, where suppression rather than deletion allows forgotten knowledge to resurface; our results offer a mechanistic, causally-validated account of why that failure mode occurs.

摘要：概念抹除方法透過線性投影運作，假設特徵佔據可分離的子空間。我們顯示這一假設在密集重疊下失效：當兩個特徵被迫進入共享單一子空間的對立對時，最先進的線性抹除會摧毀兩者，而不僅僅是目標特徵。使用梯度下降訓練的網絡則以非線性方式解決這個問題，但並不均勻：它們根據初始化收斂到兩個不同的電路級解決方案之一，我們稱之為鏡像解和影子解。我們將這一分岔映射為特徵纏結的函數，顯示它反映了一個穩定的吸引子結構，而不是我們設置的產物，並使用有針對性的因果干預來證明這兩個解決方案都留有被抹除特徵的表示的實質、可測量的痕跡，這些痕跡可以通過單一的標量補丁恢復，而不需要進一步的訓練。這與最近在LLM學習遺忘中實證觀察到的失效模式相似，在這種情況下，抑制而非刪除使得被遺忘的知識重新浮現；我們的結果提供了一個機制性、因果驗證的解釋，說明為什麼會發生這種失效模式。

docs.title: TNLearn: An Open Source Python Package for Task-based Neurons
docs.text:
2609.27564v1 by Meng Wang, Tieyun Li, Juntong Fan, Hanyu Pei, Jing-Xiao Liao, Yaodong Yang, Jianwei Ma, Fenglei Fan

The brain does not rely on a single type of neuron to perform all kinds of tasks; instead, it designs different neurons for different tasks. The concept of task-based neurons represents a paradigm shift compared to task-based architectures. It argues that solving a specific problem requires customized neurons, as task-based neurons capture useful prior knowledge from task-related data. To facilitate the use of task-based neurons in scientific research and industrial applications, we introduce TNLearn, an open-source Python package that provides automated construction of task-based neurons and networks, enabling smooth training of task-based networks. Comprehensive documentation, including technical exposition, API reference, and representative examples, is available online. TNLearn is open-sourced at https://github.com/NewT123-WM/tnlearn and has become a PyTorch ecosystem project.

摘要：大腦並不依賴單一類型的神經元來執行各種任務；相反，它為不同的任務設計不同的神經元。以任務為基礎的神經元概念代表了一種與以任務為基礎的架構相比的範式轉變。它主張解決特定問題需要定制的神經元，因為以任務為基礎的神經元能夠從與任務相關的數據中捕捉有用的先驗知識。為了促進在科學研究和工業應用中使用以任務為基礎的神經元，我們介紹了 TNLearn，一個開源的 Python 套件，提供自動構建以任務為基礎的神經元和網絡的功能，使得以任務為基礎的網絡的訓練變得順利。全面的文檔，包括技術說明、API 參考和代表性範例，均可在線獲得。TNLearn 的開源地址為 https://github.com/NewT123-WM/tnlearn，並已成為 PyTorch 生態系統的一部分。

docs.title: PhyMo: A Physical-Field Modality for Multimodal AI4Physics
docs.text:
2609.27554v1 by Henan Sun, Haitao Hu, Jin Liu, Jianfeng Zhang, Lujia Pan, Nuo Chen, Jia Li

Multimodal learning is emerging as a powerful paradigm for AI for Physics (AI4Physics), where predicting physical systems requires the joint interpretation of heterogeneous observations, measurements, and domain knowledge. However, existing approaches typically represent physical quantities and governing equations as generic numerical or textual tokens, overlooking the physical constraints that determine their spatiotemporal interactions. To address this limitation, we introduce the \textbf{physical-field modality} and propose \textbf{PhyMo}, a physics-grounded multimodal framework that organizes heterogeneous measurements through PDE-associated operators. PhyMo follows a three-stage learning procedure: the physical-field encoder is first pretrained through field reconstruction under PDE residual supervision, its representations are subsequently aligned with visual embeddings in a shared latent space, and the fused multimodal representations are finally processed by corresponding downstream prediction heads. Experiments on five datasets spanning diverse physical environments show that PhyMo achieves state-of-the-art performance, compared to the strongest baseline on each dataset, demonstrating the superiority of PhyMo on multimodal representation learning in AI4Physics.

摘要：多模態學習正逐漸成為物理學人工智慧（AI4Physics）的一種強大範式，在這裡，預測物理系統需要對異質觀察、測量和領域知識進行聯合解釋。然而，現有的方法通常將物理量和控制方程表示為通用的數值或文本標記，忽略了決定其時空互動的物理約束。為了解決這一限制，我們引入了\textbf{物理場模態}，並提出了\textbf{PhyMo}，這是一個基於物理的多模態框架，通過與PDE相關的運算子組織異質測量。PhyMo遵循三階段學習程序：物理場編碼器首先通過在PDE殘差監督下的場重建進行預訓練，然後其表示與共享潛在空間中的視覺嵌入對齊，最後融合的多模態表示由相應的下游預測頭進行處理。在五個涵蓋不同物理環境的數據集上的實驗顯示，與每個數據集上最強的基線相比，PhyMo達到了最先進的性能，展示了PhyMo在AI4Physics中的多模態表示學習的優越性。

docs.title: Pistis Technical Report
docs.text:
2609.28554v1 by Heyun Chen, Xiaohan Lan, Jiaxi Li, Zhilin Lu, Qi She, Weiwen Xu, Fei Yu, Yujie Zhong, Jinghuan Chen, Zijian Feng, Siyu Jiao, Yiheng Lin, Xinhao Wang, Sihan Yang, Jieyu You, Changbin Zhang, Hengyu Zhang, Xudong Zhang, Yunqing Zhao, Shuai Zheng

We introduce the Pistis model family, comprising 27B- and 9B-parameter multimodal large language models built on Qwen3.6 and Qwen3.5, respectively, and developed through a general and scalable post-training framework. The framework first establishes a strong foundation through large-scale multimodal supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Building on this SFT foundation, we propose Interleaved Distillation and Reinforcement Learning (IDRL), a novel post-training paradigm that tightly integrates on-policy distillation and reinforcement learning within a single training loop. By alternating between the two objectives, rather than optimizing either in isolation or combining them in a static joint loss, IDRL enables more effective knowledge transfer, greater optimization stability, and more precise credit assignment for long-horizon agentic trajectories, leading to stronger performance while mitigating common capability trade-offs. At both model scales, the framework produces two specialized variants: Pistis-Thinking, designed to strengthen deep multimodal reasoning, and Pistis-Agentic, which additionally incorporates agentic trajectory data to support long-horizon planning, iterative reasoning, and tool use. Pistis-Agentic is particularly strong in multimodal search. Both scales outperform their corresponding base models. Beyond model-parameter optimization, we further introduce Pistis-Auto-Harnessing (PAH), a system-level method that automatically improves the agent's inference harness through iterative optimization. Experiments demonstrate that PAH enhances the model performance without updating the model parameters or increasing the interaction budget.

摘要：我們介紹Pistis模型家族，包括基於Qwen3.6和Qwen3.5構建的27B和9B參數的多模態大型語言模型，並通過一個通用且可擴展的後訓練框架進行開發。該框架首先通過大規模的多模態監督微調（SFT）建立了堅實的基礎。在這一SFT基礎上，我們提出了交錯蒸餾和強化學習（IDRL），這是一種新穎的後訓練範式，將在政策內蒸餾和強化學習緊密整合在單一訓練循環中。通過在這兩個目標之間交替，而不是單獨優化其中一個或將它們靜態結合在一起，IDRL實現了更有效的知識轉移、更大的優化穩定性，以及對長期代理軌跡的更精確的信用分配，從而在減少常見能力權衡的同時提升了性能。在這兩個模型規模中，該框架產生了兩個專門的變體：Pistis-Thinking，旨在加強深度多模態推理，以及Pistis-Agentic，進一步整合了代理軌跡數據以支持長期規劃、迭代推理和工具使用。Pistis-Agentic在多模態搜索方面特別強大。這兩個規模的性能均超過其相應的基礎模型。除了模型參數優化外，我們還引入了Pistis-Auto-Harnessing（PAH），這是一種系統級方法，通過迭代優化自動改善代理的推理工具。實驗表明，PAH在不更新模型參數或增加互動預算的情況下提升了模型性能。

docs.title: SMILESGNN: Interpretable Clinical Toxicity Prediction via SMILES-Graph Cross-Attention Fusion
docs.text:
2609.28553v1 by Quang Minh Nguyen, Thuy Quynh Nguyen, Duc Minh Le, Ho Nhat Minh Nguyen, Thanh Long Dai Doan, Trong Nghia Nguyen

Drug toxicity prediction is critical for reducing late-stage attrition in drug discovery, yet remains challenging due to severe class imbalance, scaffold-based generalization, and the clinical need for interpretable predictions. Single-modality approaches-SMILES Transformers or graph neural networks capture complementary aspects of molecular structure, while sequence-only models cannot directly provide graph-attributed explanations. We present SMILESGNN, a multimodal architecture that fuses a SMILES Transformer encoder and a GATv2 graph encoder via cross-attention, and SMILESGNN-PT, a variant using a ChemBERTa-2 pretrained backbone. The design retains an explicit graph branch within the predictive pipeline, supporting GNNExplainer-based analysis of substructures associated with toxic predictions. On ClinTox, SMILESGNN achieves AUC-ROC 0.987 and F1 0.906 with only 0.4M parameters, performing competitively with a strong SMILESTransformer and a larger ChemBERTa-2/GATv2 concat-fusion baseline. On Tox21 (12 tasks), SMILESGNN-PT obtains mean AUC-ROC 0.750, comparable to ChemBERTa-2 alone and the same-backbone concat-fusion baseline. Overall, the results suggest that cross-attention is a practical fusion alternative that preserves competitive predictive performance while enabling graph-based interpretability support.

摘要：藥物毒性預測對於減少藥物發現中的晚期流失至關重要，但由於嚴重的類別不平衡、基架基於的泛化以及臨床對可解釋預測的需求，這一過程仍然具有挑戰性。單一模態方法——SMILES Transformers 或圖神經網絡捕捉了分子結構的互補方面，而僅基於序列的模型無法直接提供圖屬性解釋。我們提出了 SMILESGNN，一種通過交叉注意力融合 SMILES Transformer 編碼器和 GATv2 圖編碼器的多模態架構，以及 SMILESGNN-PT，一種使用 ChemBERTa-2 預訓練骨幹的變體。該設計在預測管道中保留了一個明確的圖分支，支持基於 GNNExplainer 的與毒性預測相關的子結構分析。在 ClinTox 上，SMILESGNN 以僅 0.4M 參數達到 AUC-ROC 0.987 和 F1 0.906，與強大的 SMILESTransformer 和更大的 ChemBERTa-2/GATv2 連接融合基準競爭表現。在 Tox21（12 個任務）上，SMILESGNN-PT 獲得平均 AUC-ROC 0.750，與 ChemBERTa-2 單獨使用及相同骨幹的連接融合基準相當。總體而言，結果表明交叉注意力是一種實用的融合替代方案，能夠保留競爭性的預測性能，同時支持基於圖的可解釋性。

docs.title: WhatWorkedBench: Benchmarking Experimental Understanding in AI Agents
docs.text:
2609.27490v1 by Jingjie Ning, Xueqi Li, Yibo Kong, Dongting Li

AI research agents need reliable knowledge of how their experiments change outcomes. We introduce WhatWorkedBench to measure experimental understanding, the accuracy of predictions about component changes after budgeted experimentation. Agents inspect code, select measurements, and submit a response surface, a table predicting scores for every configuration of component settings. Exhaustive CPU execution supplies reference effects for changing each component while holding the others fixed. These effects capture combinations of changes across 36 tasks from 30 data sources and 8 workflow types, with 1248 configuration records. Core evaluation combines 4,206 numerical-control records across all eight families and 108 agent episodes across the original six. At eight new measurements, pair-effect ridge selects an optimum on 15 of 22 sources and limits every effect error to 10% of score range on three. Fitting a Gaussian process (GP) to the same agent observations raises effect recovery, accuracy relative to true effect magnitude, from 0.632 to 0.698 in the original Flash cohort and from 0.621 to 0.720 in an additional cohort. On six completed beat-detection and graph submissions, the same-observation GP raises family-macro recovery from 0.303 to 0.455. On six workflows with six binary options at 20 new measurements, encoding code equivalences, configurations with identical behavior, raises GP recovery from 0.248 to 0.462. WhatWorkedBench supports research on experimental agents, adaptive experimental design, numerical inference, and use of program structure.

摘要：AI 研究代理需要可靠的知識來了解他們的實驗如何改變結果。我們介紹了 WhatWorkedBench 來測量實驗理解，即關於預算實驗後組件變化的預測準確性。代理檢查代碼，選擇測量，並提交響應面，一個預測每個組件設置配置的分數的表格。徹底的 CPU 執行提供了在固定其他組件的情況下改變每個組件的參考效應。這些效應捕捉了來自 30 個數據源和 8 種工作流程的 36 個任務中的變化組合，共有 1248 個配置記錄。核心評估結合了來自所有八個家族的 4,206 個數字控制記錄和來自原始六個的 108 個代理事件。在八個新測量中，配對效應脊選擇了 22 個來源中的 15 個最佳，並將每個效應誤差限制在三個的分數範圍的 10%。將高斯過程 (GP) 擬合到相同的代理觀察中，將效應恢復的準確性相對於真實效應大小，從原始 Flash 群體的 0.632 提高到 0.698，從 0.621 提高到額外群體的 0.720。在六個完成的節拍檢測和圖形提交中，相同觀察的 GP 將家族宏觀恢復從 0.303 提高到 0.455。在六個工作流程中，對 20 個新測量的六個二元選項進行編碼代碼等價，具有相同行為的配置，將 GP 恢復從 0.248 提高到 0.462。WhatWorkedBench 支持對實驗代理、適應性實驗設計、數值推斷和程序結構的研究。

docs.title: Kairos: Grounded Forecasting of Presence and Directional Flow in 4D Scene Graphs
docs.text:
2609.27467v1 by Iacopo Catalano, Julio A. Placed, Javier Civera, Jorge Peña Queralta

Long-term autonomy in human-populated environments requires anticipating whether and how people will move at times a robot has not yet observed. Existing representations of pedestrian motion face a tradeoff: they either forecast future activity, reducing each location to a scalar rate, or model the full directional distribution, holding it fixed in time. We present Kairos, a predictive directional-flow memory that extends a hierarchical 3D scene graph (3DSG) to a 4D scene graph (4DSG). Every observed voxel of the reconstructed geometry stores a directional mixture and a presence rate, and spectral predictors forecast, for any future query time, both the probability that people are present and the full directional distribution of their motion. Pairwise flow dependence between adjacent voxels supports conditional queries, and per-voxel predictive variances yield calibrated credible intervals that tighten as observations accumulate. We evaluate Kairos on three real pedestrian environments: a robot-collected campus dataset, a shopping mall, and a station concourse recorded continuously for eleven months. Its learned state remains consistent under loop-closure corrections, and its forecasts are competitive with dedicated occupancy and flow models trained on the full detection stream, although Kairos learns from only the small fraction available to a patrolling robot. Finally, we validate the representation on a downstream encounter-probability planning task, where plans computed over the Kairos forecasts encounter more people than plans computed over any time-invariant map at an equal success rate. We provide the code at https://github.com/IacopomC/kairos.

摘要：長期在有人居住的環境中自主行動需要預測人們在機器人尚未觀察到的時候是否以及如何移動。現有的行人運動表示面臨一個權衡：它們要麼預測未來活動，將每個位置簡化為一個標量速率，要麼建模完整的方向分佈，並將其固定在時間上。我們提出了Kairos，一種預測性方向流記憶，將層次化的3D場景圖（3DSG）擴展到4D場景圖（4DSG）。每個觀察到的重建幾何體的體素都存儲著一個方向混合和一個存在率，光譜預測器預測在任何未來查詢時間，人們存在的概率和他們運動的完整方向分佈。相鄰體素之間的成對流依賴支持條件查詢，而每個體素的預測方差產生經過校準的可信區間，隨著觀察的累積而收緊。我們在三個真實的行人環境中評估Kairos：一個機器人收集的校園數據集、一個購物中心，以及一個連續錄製了十一個月的車站大廳。其學習狀態在環路閉合修正下保持一致，其預測與在完整檢測流上訓練的專用佔用和流模型相當，儘管Kairos僅從巡邏機器人可用的少量數據中學習。最後，我們在一個下游的遇見概率規劃任務中驗證了該表示，在該任務中，基於Kairos預測計算的計劃遇到的人數比基於任何時間不變地圖計算的計劃在相同成功率下更多。我們提供代碼於 https://github.com/IacopomC/kairos。

docs.title: Quantization-Robust Unlearning through the Lens of Retain-Forget Loss Landscapes Interaction
docs.text:
2609.27355v1 by Jialu Wang, Jianing Deng, Shuqing Luo, Yuanzhe Li, Dongwei Wang, Jingtong Hu, Huanrui Yang, Song Wang, Tianlong Chen

Unlearning ensures LLM compliance by removing the influence of private or copyrighted training data. However, since LLM models typically undergo post-training compression, like quantization, in practical deployment, it has been observed that the unlearning effect can be substantially weakened, with the forgetting behavior degrading more severely than that of model utility. This paper proposes a quantization-robust unlearning framework that makes forgetting robust to quantization while maintaining overall model utility. We analyze this gap through the lens of loss landscape. Specifically, our analysis reveals a curvature-based criteria that pinpoints sensitive weights in the unlearned model that leads to both non-robust forgetting and reduced utility. We therefore propose sensitivity-guided noisy regularization, which is applied on the sensitive parameters to steer the model convergence towards a smoother minima of uniformly low forget and retain losses. Balancing unlearning and utility, we further propose forget-critical optimization, which updates only forget-critical layers, preserving most of the network to retain useful knowledge. Extensive experiments on the MUSE and TOFU benchmarks across multiple LLM unlearning algorithms show that our approach achieves substantially more quantization-resilient forgetting while maintaining utility.

摘要：不學習確保 LLM 的合規性，通過消除私有或受版權保護的訓練數據的影響。然而，由於 LLM 模型通常在實際部署中經歷後訓練壓縮，如量化，已觀察到不學習的效果可能會顯著減弱，遺忘行為的退化程度比模型效用更為嚴重。本文提出了一種對量化穩健的不學習框架，使得遺忘對量化具有穩健性，同時保持整體模型效用。我們通過損失景觀的視角分析這一差距。具體而言，我們的分析揭示了一種基於曲率的標準，指出了在未學習模型中敏感的權重，這導致了不穩健的遺忘和效用降低。因此，我們提出了基於敏感性的噪聲正則化，應用於敏感參數，以引導模型收斂到均勻低遺忘和保留損失的平滑最小值。平衡不學習和效用，我們進一步提出了遺忘關鍵優化，只更新遺忘關鍵層，保留大部分網絡以保留有用知識。在 MUSE 和 TOFU 基準上對多種 LLM 不學習算法進行的廣泛實驗顯示，我們的方法在保持效用的同時實現了顯著更具量化韌性的遺忘。

docs.title: Constraint-Driven Context Engineering: Designing Domain Interfaces for AI Systems
docs.text:
2609.27354v1 by Xiwei Xu, Chen Wang, Mengmeng Yang, Yipeng Zhang, Jacky Jiang, Suyu Ma, Youyang Qu, Ming Ding, Liming Zhu

Generative AI systems are increasingly deployed to address domain problems. These systems operate under technical, regulatory, institutional, and normative constraints that define acceptable AI behaviour and outcomes within their domains. We observe a recurring pattern in our industry engagement: partners often arrive with a functioning but relatively generic AI solution. The challenge is no longer to build an AI system from scratch, but to improve the quality and domain appropriateness of an AI-generated solution. In these settings, the limiting factor is often the quality, scope, and structure of the context available to the system. Yet, existing context engineering approaches primarily focus on supplying domain knowledge through retrieval, memory, and tools, with limited support for systematically identifying and operationalising the constraints that govern AI systems in their operational environments. This paper proposes Constraint-Driven Context Engineering (CDCE), a design approach for engineering domain interfaces for AI systems. Drawing on software architecture design and Domain-Driven Design (DDD), CDCE treats domain constraints as first-class design drivers. It identifies and characterises constraints, determines the required context assets, and designs representations through which these assets are made available to AI systems. We conducted a comparative multiple-case study with industry and public-sector partners across educational assessment, healthcare decision support, and financial-distress prediction. Depending on their characteristics, constraints can guide AI behaviour, enforce permissible boundaries, or support verification of AI-generated outcomes. The cases demonstrate CDCE's applicability across contrasting domains and show how constraint characteristics shape the resulting domain interfaces.

摘要：生成式人工智慧系統越來越多地被部署以解決特定領域的問題。這些系統在技術、監管、機構和規範的限制下運作，這些限制定義了在其領域內可接受的人工智慧行為和結果。我們在行業參與中觀察到一個重複出現的模式：合作夥伴通常帶來一個運行良好但相對通用的人工智慧解決方案。挑戰不再是從零開始構建一個人工智慧系統，而是改善人工智慧生成解決方案的質量和領域適應性。在這些環境中，限制因素通常是可供系統使用的上下文的質量、範圍和結構。然而，現有的上下文工程方法主要集中在通過檢索、記憶和工具提供領域知識，對於系統性識別和運作化治理人工智慧系統的限制支持有限。 本文提出了約束驅動的上下文工程（CDCE），這是一種為人工智慧系統工程領域介面的設計方法。CDCE借鑒了軟體架構設計和以領域為驅動的設計（DDD），將領域約束視為一級設計驅動因素。它識別和特徵化約束，確定所需的上下文資產，並設計通過這些資產可供人工智慧系統使用的表示方式。 我們與教育評估、醫療決策支持和財務危機預測的行業和公共部門合作夥伴進行了比較多案例研究。根據其特徵，約束可以指導人工智慧行為、強制可允許的邊界或支持對人工智慧生成結果的驗證。這些案例展示了CDCE在對比領域中的適用性，並顯示了約束特徵如何塑造最終的領域介面。

docs.title: Large Knowledge Model: From Papers to a Scientific Reasoning Landscape
docs.text:
2609.27297v1 by Yuan Huang, Sihan Hu, Hongyu Gu, Chao Ma, Jiaxing Zhang, Zhiyong Zou, Caiyu Fan, Yan Xiao, Mingjun Xu, Chenyu Xie, Mingzhen Ju, Zhehao Ma, Qi Zhang, Baozong Wang, Yu Li, Zhiyuan Yao, Ruoxue Liao, Xinyu Li, Linfeng Zhang, Kun Chen, Weinan E

Accumulated scientific knowledge advances inquiry when prior findings help researchers choose new questions, design investigations, and interpret results. Realizing this value at scale requires access to the reasoning that connects research problems, scientific procedures, conclusions, and evidence. We introduce the Large Knowledge Model (LKM), a scientific knowledge infrastructure that transforms the literature into a shared, computationally accessible reasoning resource. LKM represents papers as source-grounded reasoning graphs, couples structural traversal with semantic retrieval over the same objects, and aligns related questions, claims, and reasoning chains across papers. This representation forms a Scientific Reasoning Landscape with three connected views: a Question Landscape that organizes research problems and open directions, a Workflow Landscape that exposes reusable scientific procedures, and an Evidence Landscape that connects conclusions to their support, disagreement, and conditions. The unified substrate supports reasoning-aware scientific search, evidence-grounded question answering, comparative evidence analysis, and research planning. Researchers and agents can retrieve relevant work through its scientific intent, synthesize answers with inspectable supporting arguments, and develop research plans informed by established workflows and unresolved evidence. We describe a corpus-scale system and evaluate scientific retrieval and knowledge-intensive question answering. With the answering model fixed, LKM retrieval improves accuracy by 9.30%, 4.20%, and 14.69% on ChemBench, PubMedQA, and SciBench, respectively. By connecting knowledge access to scientific reasoning and action, LKM provides a common foundation for discovering relevant research, reusing scientific knowledge, and coordinating cumulative inquiry across researchers, agents, and research cycles.

摘要：累積的科學知識在先前的研究結果幫助研究者選擇新問題、設計調查和解釋結果時推進了探究。要在大規模上實現這一價值，需要獲得連接研究問題、科學程序、結論和證據的推理。 我們介紹了大型知識模型（LKM），這是一個將文獻轉化為共享的、可計算訪問的推理資源的科學知識基礎設施。LKM將論文表示為基於來源的推理圖，將結構遍歷與對同一對象的語義檢索相結合，並在論文之間對相關問題、主張和推理鏈進行對齊。這種表示形式形成了一個科學推理景觀，包含三個相互連接的視圖：一個組織研究問題和開放方向的問題景觀、一個揭示可重用科學程序的工作流程景觀，以及一個將結論與其支持、異議和條件連接的證據景觀。統一的基底支持以推理為中心的科學搜索、基於證據的問題回答、比較證據分析和研究規劃。研究者和代理人可以通過其科學意圖檢索相關工作，合成帶有可檢查支持論據的答案，並根據已建立的工作流程和未解決的證據制定研究計劃。我們描述了一個語料庫級系統並評估科學檢索和知識密集型問題回答。在回答模型固定的情況下，LKM檢索在ChemBench、PubMedQA和SciBench上的準確率分別提高了9.30%、4.20%和14.69%。通過將知識訪問與科學推理和行動相連接，LKM為發現相關研究、重用科學知識和協調研究者、代理人及研究循環之間的累積探究提供了共同的基礎。

docs.title: UniDataAgent: An Ontology-Grounded Agent for Enterprise Question-to-Report Automation
docs.text:
2609.27257v1 by Yutai Duan, Yahui Zhao, Zhangti Li, Yu Ma, Zhenfeng Qi, Shaoyang Yuan, Jing Fan, Jie Liu

Enterprise data agents must preserve organization specific semantics, not just translate questions into queries. We present ChinaUnicom DataAgent (UniDataAgent), an ontology grounded system for reusable question-to-report analysis that separates semantic acquisition from online execution. Ontology Acquisition and Validation stage (OAV) builds versioned enterprise ontologies from metadata, business knowledge, and supporting materials through expert authored business skills, constrained generation, question verification, and selected expert review. Question-to-Report Execution (QRE) stage retrieves semantic contracts for each question, coordinates skills and data tools, validates results, and produces evidence linked reports. Across 27 enterprise tables and roughly thousands of metric types, ontology construction took a few hours instead of about one week manually. It took just a few minutes to generate the reports, instead of several working days. Ontology grounding achieved 95.0\% strict accuracy on real business questions, versus 72.5\% for document RAG, especially on structured and compositional tasks. The system has already been deployed to generate cost savings and has the potential to be replicated in other enterprises.

摘要：企業數據代理必須保持組織特定的語義，而不僅僅是將問題翻譯成查詢。我們提出了中國聯通數據代理（UniDataAgent），這是一個基於本體的系統，用於可重用的問題到報告分析，將語義獲取與在線執行分開。本體獲取和驗證階段（OAV）通過專家撰寫的商業技能、受限生成、問題驗證和選定專家審查，從元數據、商業知識和支持材料中構建版本化的企業本體。問題到報告執行階段（QRE）為每個問題檢索語義合約，協調技能和數據工具，驗證結果，並生成與證據相關的報告。在27個企業表格和約數千種指標類型中，本體構建僅花費了幾小時，而不是手動約一周的時間。生成報告僅需幾分鐘，而不是幾個工作日。本體基礎在真實商業問題上達到了95.0\%的嚴格準確率，而文件RAG的準確率為72.5\%，特別是在結構化和組合任務上。該系統已經部署以產生成本節約，並且有潛力在其他企業中複製。

docs.title: Meet, Compare, or Abstain: LatWeave for Deterministic Multi-Hop Question Answering on Knowledge Lattices
docs.text:
2609.27225v1 by Yuze Ren, Shaoheng Fan, Tao Wang, Yabo Yan, Han Han

Probabilistic question-answering systems -- whether large language models (LLMs) themselves, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or trained multi-hop retrievers -- conflate "what is known" and "how to reason" into a single probabilistic computation: hallucination cannot be eradicated, evidence chains cannot be audited, and the system answers even when it does not know. We present LatWeave, which organizes knowledge into a multidimensional knowledge lattice and compiles multi-hop QA into three deterministic operators -- meet (constraint intersection), compare (lattice-order comparison), and abstain (structural abstention); LLMs appear only on the construction side (one-shot extraction) and the query-planning side, while the answer-generation path is zero-LLM, zero-task-training, and auditable end to end -- so that question answering over Web-published knowledge becomes reproducible item by item.
