Yet event-based evaluations of longitudinal clinical AI can treat recognition-mediated care-process signals as shortcuts and recognition-dependent endpoints as reference standards, inflating apparent performance and lead time while undermining cross-center transport. Such results may serve prognosis without establishing detection before recognition. We define an interval-censored pre-recognition transition, an independent as-of reference standard, and a prespecified recognition proxy to make the claim testable.

摘要：臨床上有用的早期檢測需要經過驗證的預認識提前時間。然而，基於事件的長期臨床人工智慧評估可以將認識介導的護理過程信號視為捷徑，並將依賴認識的終點視為參考標準，這樣會膨脹表面性能和提前時間，同時削弱跨中心的轉運。這樣的結果可能有助於預後，但並未在認識之前建立檢測。我們定義了一個區間右截斷的預認識轉變，一個獨立的即時參考標準，以及一個預先指定的認識代理，以使該主張可測試。

docs.title: A Leakage-Aware Multimodal Evaluation Framework for Early Intraoperative Acute Kidney Injury Prediction
docs.text:
2609.26848v1 by Quang Minh Nguyen, Duc Minh Le, Ho Nhat Minh Nguyen, Thuy Quynh Nguyen, Trong Nghia Nguyen

Postoperative acute kidney injury (AKI) after major non-cardiac surgery carries substantial morbidity, yet early intraoperative risk stratification remains difficult. In this retrospective cohort study, we propose SynerT, a waveform-only hybrid temporal backbone that combines a causal dilated TCN with a hierarchy of dilated recurrent layers to encode early intraoperative physiologic trajectories for AKI risk prediction. Building on SynerT, we further design two model variants that extend the backbone with structured clinical context: SynerT-MM, a late-fusion multimodal extension that integrates hemodynamic burden summaries and preoperative covariates, and SynerTStack, a leakage-safe stacked ensemble that combines cross-validated predictions from SynerT-MM with strong tabular baselines at the meta-learning stage. All models are evaluated under a strict leakage-aware framework on VitalDB, a high-fidelity perioperative database, with prediction restricted to information available within the first 60 intraoperative minutes. Among 2,413 waveform-usable cases (180 AKI-positive; 7.46% prevalence), SynerT fell well below strong structured-data baselines, demonstrating that waveform-only temporal modeling is insufficient under strict early constraints. SynerTMM recovered discrimination by incorporating hemodynamic burden summaries and preoperative covariates, and SynerT-Stack achieved the best overall performance across AUROC, AUPRC, and F1-max. Cross-fitted Platt recalibration substantially corrected calibration defects in both multimodal variants, and decision-curve analysis confirmed the recalibrated stacked model delivered the strongest net clinical benefit across low-to-intermediate thresholds.

摘要：術後急性腎損傷（AKI）在重大非心臟手術後帶來相當大的發病率，但早期的手術風險分層仍然困難。在這項回顧性隊列研究中，我們提出了SynerT，一種僅使用波形的混合時間骨幹，結合了因果膨脹的時間卷積網絡（TCN）與一系列膨脹的遞歸層，以編碼早期手術生理軌跡以預測AKI風險。在SynerT的基礎上，我們進一步設計了兩個模型變體，將結構化臨床背景擴展到骨幹中：SynerT-MM，一種晚融合的多模態擴展，整合了血流動力學負擔摘要和術前協變數，以及SynerT-Stack，一種防洩漏的堆疊集成，將SynerT-MM的交叉驗證預測與元學習階段的強表格基線結合。所有模型都在一個嚴格的防洩漏框架下在VitalDB上進行評估，這是一個高保真的圍手術數據庫，預測限制在手術前60分鐘內可用的信息。在2,413個可用波形的案例中（180個AKI陽性；7.46%的流行率），SynerT的表現遠低於強結構數據基線，顯示僅使用波形的時間建模在嚴格的早期限制下是不足夠的。SynerT-MM通過整合血流動力學負擔摘要和術前協變數恢復了區分能力，而SynerT-Stack在AUROC、AUPRC和F1-max的整體表現上達到了最佳。交叉擬合的Platt重新校準顯著修正了兩個多模態變體中的校準缺陷，決策曲線分析確認重新校準的堆疊模型在低至中等閾值下提供了最強的淨臨床效益。

docs.title: Syndrome, Synergy, and Safety: Structured Reasoning and Knowledge-Driven Alignment for TCM Prescription Generation
docs.text:
2609.25755v1 by Zheng Chen, ZhiCheng Du, Haoxuan Li, Peiwu Qin

Applying large language models to Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) prescription generation reveals three clinically critical gaps: models produce end-to-end mappings without auditable reasoning following the li-fa-fang-yao paradigm (SR Gap), treat each encounter in isolation without follow-up adjustment via sui zheng jia jian (LA Gap), and fail to enforce absolute contraindication rules such as Shi Ba Fan (SC Gap). We propose a progressive four-stage framework (SFT $\to$ PG-CoT $\to$ Dynamic $\to$ K-RL) that addresses each gap: PG-CoT constrains CoT distillation under the li-fa-fang-yao paradigm to produce auditable diagnostic chains, Dynamic SFT models patient trajectories with explicit transition reasoning, and K-RL encodes deterministic pharmacological rules as rule-based DPO preference signals. Across 12 fine-tuned models and 6 zero-shot baselines, our framework substantially improves prescription quality over zero-shot baselines---with a 7B model (Mistral-7B) surpassing zero-shot GPT-5 on all three TCM evaluation metrics.

摘要：應用大型語言模型於中醫處方生成揭示了三個臨床關鍵的缺口：模型在 li-fa-fang-yao 範式下生成端到端的映射，但缺乏可審計的推理（SR 缺口），將每次就診視為孤立事件，未能通過隨證加減進行後續調整（LA 缺口），以及未能強制執行如十八反等絕對禁忌規則（SC 缺口）。我們提出了一個逐步的四階段框架（SFT $\to$ PG-CoT $\to$ Dynamic $\to$ K-RL），以解決每個缺口：PG-CoT 在 li-fa-fang-yao 範式下約束 CoT 蒸餾，以生成可審計的診斷鏈，Dynamic SFT 模型明確過渡推理的患者軌跡，而 K-RL 將確定性的藥理規則編碼為基於規則的 DPO 偏好信號。在 12 個微調模型和 6 個零樣本基準中，我們的框架顯著提高了處方質量，超越了零樣本基準——其中一個 7B 模型（Mistral-7B）在所有三個 TCM 評估指標上均超過了零樣本 GPT-5。

docs.title: LingLan: An Advancing Traditional Chinese Medicine Diagnosis LLM with Multimodal Data
docs.text:
2609.25715v1 by Zheng Chen, Zhicheng Du, Haoxuan Li, Yingshan Liang, Peiwu Qin

Though artificial intelligence (AI) increasingly transforms modern medicine, its integration into Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) has been relatively slow, primarily due to TCM's reliance on holistic, subjective diagnostic methods---namely Inspection, Auscultation and Olfaction, Inquiry, and Palpation(I-AOI-P)---which are difficult to align with quantitative, standardized medical systems. In this work, we introduce a Unification Framework for Multimodal Data (UFMD), which automatically processes tongue and pulse images into structured, clinically standard descriptions, integrating multi-source diagnostic information into a unified digital record of I-AOI-P process. Building on this structured data, we create LingLan-14B, a TCM-specific large language model fine-tuned via supervised learning to emulate the diagnostic logic and workflow of I-AOI-P process. Experimental results show that our method significantly enhances diagnostic accuracy, achieving a relative improvement of 103.5% over the baseline (62.72% vs. 30.82%) and reaching an F1-score of up to 82%.

摘要：儘管人工智慧（AI）日益改變現代醫學，但其在傳統中醫（TCM）中的整合相對緩慢，主要是因為中醫依賴於整體的、主觀的診斷方法——即觀察、聽診與嗅診、詢問和觸診（I-AOI-P）——這些方法難以與定量、標準化的醫療系統對齊。在這項工作中，我們介紹了一個多模態數據統一框架（UFMD），該框架自動將舌頭和脈搏圖像處理成結構化的臨床標準描述，將多來源的診斷信息整合到I-AOI-P過程的統一數字記錄中。在這些結構化數據的基礎上，我們創建了LingLan-14B，這是一個針對中醫的特定大型語言模型，通過監督學習進行微調，以模擬I-AOI-P過程的診斷邏輯和工作流程。實驗結果顯示，我們的方法顯著提高了診斷準確性，相較於基準提高了103.5%（62.72% vs. 30.82%），F1-score達到82%。

docs.title: Interpretable AI plus Handheld, Portable Retinal Photographs: A Low-Cost Glaucoma Screening Solution for West Africa
docs.text:
2609.25697v1 by Charis Y. N. Chiang, Tarela Sarimiye, Adeyinka Ashaye, Martin Buist, Michael A. Hauser, Olusola Olawoye, Michaël J. A. Girard

Purpose: To develop and evaluate an interpretable artificial intelligence (AI) framework for glaucoma screening from low-cost portable, handheld retinal fundus photographs in a West African population and to compare its performance with clinical tabletop fundus imaging. Methods: We used data from a community-based study of 681 participants (1,362 eyes) in Nigeria, comprising 414 glaucoma, 478 glaucoma suspect, and 470 non-glaucoma eyes. Fundus photographs were acquired using the low-cost handheld, portable Volk Viva retinal camera and the Canon CR-2-AF tabletop camera. We fine-tuned component models separately to each device to perform vessel segmentation, cup and disc boundary segmentation, and feature extraction to detect optic nerve head features. A final classification model combined these components to classify scans as glaucoma, glaucoma suspect or non-glaucoma. Feature-weight analysis and Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping were used for interpretation. Results: The models performed well on both Volk Viva and Canon CR-2-AF images: Vessel segmentation: 0.98 Dice Coefficient (DC) (Volk) and 0.94 DC (Canon); Cup and disc segmentation: 0.95 DC (Volk) and 0.96 DC (Canon); Optic nerve head feature detection: area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUCs) of 0.83$\pm$0.03 (Volk) and 0.87$\pm$0.04 (Canon); Classification model: AUCs of 0.85$\pm$0.01 (Volk) and 0.93$\pm$0.01 (Canon). Reports for each image, present model decision confidence scores and decision-rationale visualizations to support clinical interpretation. Conclusions: Volk Viva results were reasonably comparable to Canon CR-2-AF in the component models and not far behind in classification. This shows that interpretable AI combined with low-cost, portable imaging may enhance community-level glaucoma screening, especially in settings with limited specialist access and resources.

摘要：目的：開發和評估一個可解釋的人工智慧（AI）框架，用於從低成本的便攜式手持視網膜眼底照片中進行青光眼篩查，針對西非地區的人群，並將其性能與臨床桌面眼底成像進行比較。方法：我們使用了來自尼日利亞681名參與者（1,362隻眼睛）的社區基礎研究數據，包括414隻青光眼、478隻青光眼可疑眼和470隻非青光眼眼睛。眼底照片是使用低成本的手持便攜式Volk Viva視網膜相機和Canon CR-2-AF桌面相機獲取的。我們分別對每個設備的組件模型進行微調，以執行血管分割、杯盤邊界分割和特徵提取，以檢測視神經頭特徵。最終分類模型將這些組件結合起來，將掃描結果分類為青光眼、青光眼可疑或非青光眼。特徵權重分析和梯度加權類別激活映射被用於解釋。結果：這些模型在Volk Viva和Canon CR-2-AF影像上表現良好：血管分割：0.98 Dice Coefficient (DC)（Volk）和0.94 DC（Canon）；杯盤分割：0.95 DC（Volk）和0.96 DC（Canon）；視神經頭特徵檢測：受試者工作特徵曲線下面積（AUCs）為0.83$\pm$0.03（Volk）和0.87$\pm$0.04（Canon）；分類模型：AUCs為0.85$\pm$0.01（Volk）和0.93$\pm$0.01（Canon）。每張影像的報告中，呈現模型決策信心分數和決策理由可視化，以支持臨床解釋。結論：Volk Viva的結果在組件模型中與Canon CR-2-AF相當可比，且在分類上也不遜色。這表明，可解釋的AI結合低成本的便攜式成像可能會增強社區層級的青光眼篩查，特別是在專家訪問和資源有限的環境中。

docs.title: Gaze responses to false-positive computer-aided detection prompts during colonoscopy: a paired-video and real-time eye-tracking study
docs.text:
2609.25581v1 by Te Luo, Yan Zhu, Peiyao Fu, Ruijie Yang, Xian Yang, Quanlin Li, Pinghong Zhou, Shuo Wang

False-positive computer-aided detection (CADe) prompts may divert endoscopists' attention during colonoscopy, yet the attentional impact of individual prompts remains unclear. We used event-locked eye tracking to quantify gaze attraction and attention occupation in complementary retrospective and prospective studies. In a retrospective paired-video experiment, 3 senior and 2 novice endoscopists viewed 60 colonoscopy videos with and without CADe. The prospective study recorded gaze during 42 real-time CADe-assisted colonoscopies performed by 9 senior endoscopists. Screened CADe prompts outside expert-annotated lesion windows were classified as false-positive artifact events. False-positive prompts attracted gaze in 48.6% (68/140) of retrospective observations and 65.2% (533/817) of prospective events. Among attraction events with complete recovery, median attention occupation lasted 1000 ms in the retrospective study and 1100 ms in the prospective study. Corresponding median prompt durations were 33 ms and 267 ms, with median time amplifications of 17.55-fold and 5.15-fold, respectively. In paired retrospective comparisons, visible artifact prompts drew gaze closer to the prompted region than did the same-coordinate unassisted reference. Secondary retrospective analyses showed high lesion gaze recognition without and with CADe (98.0% versus 99.0%). First gaze entry into lesion regions occurred 147.8 ms earlier with CADe. Across controlled and real-time clinical settings, false-positive CADe prompts frequently captured gaze, with attention persisting beyond prompt visibility. These findings support considering prompt-related attentional burden in CADe evaluation and design.

摘要：錯誤正確的電腦輔助檢測（CADe）提示可能會在結腸鏡檢查期間分散內視鏡醫生的注意力，但個別提示的注意力影響仍不清楚。我們使用事件鎖定眼動追蹤來量化注視吸引和注意力佔用，進行了互補的回顧性和前瞻性研究。在一項回顧性配對視頻實驗中，3名資深和2名新手內視鏡醫生觀看了60段有無CADe的結腸鏡視頻。前瞻性研究記錄了9名資深內視鏡醫生進行的42次實時CADe輔助結腸鏡檢查的注視。在專家註釋的病變窗口之外篩選出的CADe提示被歸類為錯誤正確的假象事件。在回顧性觀察中，錯誤正確的提示在48.6%（68/140）的情況下吸引了注視，而在前瞻性事件中則為65.2%（533/817）。在完全恢復的吸引事件中，回顧性研究的中位注意力佔用持續了1000毫秒，而前瞻性研究則為1100毫秒。相應的中位提示持續時間分別為33毫秒和267毫秒，注意力的中位時間放大分別為17.55倍和5.15倍。在配對的回顧性比較中，明顯的假象提示比相同坐標的無輔助參考更能吸引注視到提示區域。次要回顧性分析顯示，無論是否使用CADe，病變的注視識別率均很高（98.0%對99.0%）。首次注視進入病變區域的時間在使用CADe時提前了147.8毫秒。在受控和實時臨床環境中，錯誤正確的CADe提示經常吸引注視，且注意力持續超過提示的可見性。這些發現支持在CADe評估和設計中考慮提示相關的注意力負擔。

docs.title: Attention as a Routing Graph: Live Circuit Extraction from a Single Forward Pass
docs.text:
2609.25285v1 by Ash Manvi, Samreena Tajreen

Finding circuits in language models usually means running many careful interventions. We try something simpler: treat attention as a routing map from one forward pass, keep a small set of routes that point toward the answer, and ask whether those routes actually matter. They often do. On induction and IOI (tasks where the "right" circuit is already known), ablating our extracted edges hurts the model much more than ablating a random set of the same size. We evaluate n=100 prompts per cell on GPT-2 Small, GPT-2 Medium, and Pythia-410M, with paired gap tests and bootstrap confidence intervals. The extract step costs one forward; a head-by-head patch sweep costs about two orders of magnitude more. We are not claiming a complete circuit atlas. We are claiming a cheap sketch that carries real causal signal on known tasks, with clear failure modes when it does not. Code and evaluation artifacts are at https://github.com/Aquinf03/live-circuit-routing.

摘要：尋找語言模型中的電路通常意味著進行許多仔細的干預。我們嘗試一些更簡單的方法：將注意力視為從一次前向傳播的路由圖，保留一小組指向答案的路徑，並詢問這些路徑是否真的重要。它們通常是重要的。在歸納和IOI（已知“正確”電路的任務）中，去除我們提取的邊緣比去除隨機大小相同的邊緣對模型的傷害要大得多。我們在GPT-2 Small、GPT-2 Medium和Pythia-410M上對每個單元評估n=100個提示，並進行配對差距測試和自助信心區間。提取步驟只需一次前向傳播；逐頭修補掃描的成本大約高兩個數量級。我們並不聲稱擁有完整的電路圖集。我們聲稱擁有一個便宜的草圖，能在已知任務上傳遞真實的因果信號，並在失敗時有明確的失敗模式。代碼和評估文物位於https://github.com/Aquinf03/live-circuit-routing。

docs.title: MedGate-Fusion: Integrating First-Encounter Semantic Narratives and Physiological Biomarkers for Prospective Stroke Risk Stratification
docs.text:
2609.25272v1 by Hemn Khdr, Mohammad Noaeen, Karim Keshavjee, Aziz Guergachi, Zahra Shakeri

Prospective stroke risk stratification in primary care is challenging because early risk signals are distributed across routine biomarkers and unstructured clinical narratives. We propose MedGate-Fusion, a multi-modal gated architecture that integrates transformer-based embeddings of first-encounter narratives with ten routinely recorded risk markers. We used electronic medical record data from the Canadian Primary Care Sentinel Surveillance Network (CPCSSN). Starting from 808,921 encounter-level observations, we constructed a first-encounter cohort and retained 102,736 unique patient records with non-empty narratives and sufficient data to evaluate a five-year stroke outcome. To reduce explicit target leakage from diagnostic mentions in notes, we applied dictionary-based redaction of stroke-related terms prior to semantic encoding.

摘要：預測性中風風險分層在初級護理中具有挑戰性，因為早期風險信號分佈在常規生物標記和非結構化的臨床敘述中。我們提出了MedGate-Fusion，一種多模態閘控架構，將基於Transformer的首次接觸敘述嵌入與十個常規記錄的風險標記整合在一起。我們使用了來自加拿大初級護理哨兵監測網絡（CPCSSN）的電子病歷數據。從808,921個接觸級觀察開始，我們構建了一個首次接觸的隊列，保留了102,736個具有非空敘述和足夠數據以評估五年中風結果的獨特患者記錄。為了減少診斷提及中明確目標洩漏的情況，我們在語義編碼之前應用了基於字典的中風相關術語刪除。

docs.title: Et Tu, Brute? Economic Misalignment in Personal AI Agents
docs.text:
2609.24927v1 by Aman Priyanshu, Supriti Vijay, Brian Jabarian, Niloofar Mireshghallah

Personal AI agents make recommendations and take actions on people's behalf in high-stakes economic contexts, e.g., buying a flight, choosing health insurance, or selecting a graduate program. The agent is given access to the user's personal context, e.g., their email inbox and a structured profile of personal attributes, with the intention of making an optimal, personalized decision for the user. We show that by simply providing this personal context, the agent steers recommendations based on inferred wealth, without being explicitly instructed to do so. In a suite of 325K experiments on 13 agents across three types of economic decisions (flights, health insurance, and graduate programs), we find that 8 models systematically choose more expensive options for wealthier users when requests are identical. This steering continues even when it directly goes against the user's stated objective: when explicitly instructed to find the cheapest option, some agents still act on the wealth profile they have inferred. It also occurs when wealth is inferred from ambient data, such as emails unrelated to the task. And it persists under privacy controls that block specific attributes: blocking financial attributes largely removes the disparity, but blocking other attributes leaves it unchanged and can increase it by up to 40% for insurance, as agents rely on the remaining signals to infer wealth. Larger and more capable models are no better; Claude Opus 4.8 shows the largest effect. We term this misalignment "adversarial delegation", in which the very conditions that make a personal AI agent useful - access to personal information - enable it to act against the user's interests.

摘要：個人 AI 代理在高風險的經濟情境中代表人們做出建議和行動，例如購買航班、選擇健康保險或選擇研究生課程。該代理獲得用戶的個人背景資訊，例如他們的電子郵件收件箱和結構化的個人屬性檔案，旨在為用戶做出最佳的個性化決策。我們顯示，僅僅提供這些個人背景資訊，代理就能根據推斷出的財富來引導建議，而不需要明確指示這樣做。在對 13 個代理進行的 325K 實驗中，涵蓋三種類型的經濟決策（航班、健康保險和研究生課程），我們發現 8 個模型在請求相同的情況下，系統性地為較富裕的用戶選擇更昂貴的選項。這種引導即使在直接違反用戶明確目標的情況下仍然持續存在：當明確指示尋找最便宜的選項時，一些代理仍然根據他們推斷出的財富檔案行動。當財富是從與任務無關的環境數據（例如電子郵件）推斷時，這種情況也會發生。而且在阻止特定屬性的隱私控制下也會持續存在：阻止財務屬性在很大程度上消除了差異，但阻止其他屬性則保持不變，並且對於保險，可能會增加高達 40% 的差異，因為代理依賴剩餘的信號來推斷財富。更大且更強大的模型並沒有更好；Claude Opus 4.8 顯示出最大的影響。我們將這種不對齊稱為「對抗性委託」，在這種情況下，使個人 AI 代理有用的條件——訪問個人信息——使其能夠反對用戶的利益行動。

docs.title: From Pattern Recognizers to Personalized Companions: A Survey of Large Language Models in Mental Health
docs.text:
2609.25186v1 by He Hu, Yucheng Zhou, Qianning Wang, Yingjian Zou, Chiyuan Ma, Juzheng Si, Jianzhuang Liu, Zitong Yu, Laizhong Cui, Fei Ma, Qi Tian

The rising global prevalence of mental health conditions, together with longstanding barriers in traditional healthcare, such as limited resources, high cost, stigma, and privacy concerns, has created an urgent need for accessible and scalable support. Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as a transformative technology with strong potential to democratize mental health support through advanced natural language understanding and generation. However, the rapidly expanding, fragmented body of work in this area lacks a coherent evolutionary narrative, making it difficult to contextualize current progress and identify future directions. This survey addresses this gap by organizing and analyzing the literature around a central thesis: the role of LLMs in mental health is evolving through three distinct, increasingly sophisticated phases. We trace this trajectory from Phase I, in which LLMs act primarily as passive Information Tools and Pattern Recognizers for assessment; through Phase II, where they function as Empathetic Conversationalists for in-the-moment, stateless interactions; to the current frontier, Phase III, which seeks Longitudinal, Personalized Companions implemented as stateful cognitive agents. To support this framework, we systematically review core technologies, agent architectures (Profile, Memory, Reasoning, and Planning), and the critical infrastructure of datasets and benchmarks, highlighting how their evolution underpins this developmental path. Viewing the field through this developmental lens, we provide a comprehensive synthesis of existing work, an insightful narrative of its trajectory, and a clear roadmap for future innovation in responsible, effective, and human-centered AI for mental healthcare. A curated collection of the resources reviewed in this survey is available at our project repository: https://github.com/Emo-gml/Awesome-Mental-Health-LLMs.

摘要：全球心理健康狀況的上升流行率，加上傳統醫療中長期存在的障礙，如資源有限、高成本、污名化和隱私問題，創造了對可獲得和可擴展支持的迫切需求。大型語言模型（LLMs）已經成為一種變革性技術，具有通過先進的自然語言理解和生成來民主化心理健康支持的強大潛力。然而，這一領域快速擴展且支離破碎的研究體系缺乏一致的演變敘事，這使得難以將當前的進展置於上下文中並確定未來的方向。本調查通過圍繞一個中心論題組織和分析文獻，填補了這一空白：LLMs在心理健康中的角色正通過三個明確且日益精緻的階段演變。我們追溯這一軌跡，從第一階段，在這一階段中，LLMs主要作為被動的信息工具和模式識別器進行評估；到第二階段，它們作為同理心的對話者進行即時的無狀態互動；再到當前的前沿，第三階段，尋求作為有狀態的認知代理實現的縱向個性化伴侶。為了支持這一框架，我們系統性地回顧了核心技術、代理架構（配置、記憶、推理和規劃）以及數據集和基準的關鍵基礎設施，突顯了它們的演變如何支撐這一發展路徑。通過這一發展視角來看待該領域，我們提供了現有工作的全面綜合、其軌跡的深刻敘事，以及未來在負責任、有效和以人為中心的心理健康護理AI中的創新清晰路線圖。本調查中回顧的資源的策劃集合可在我們的項目庫中獲得：https://github.com/Emo-gml/Awesome-Mental-Health-LLMs。

docs.title: MedRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement for Medical Agents via Clinically Aligned Self-Evolution
docs.text:
2609.24838v1 by Junde Wu, Jiayuan Zhu, Minghao Hu, Fenglin Liu, Jiazhen Pan

Medical agents increasingly combine general reasoning models with specialized clinical tools, yet their capabilities remain largely fixed by what clinicians and engineers design before deployment. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a different paradigm in which agents learn from their own failures and autonomously expand their capabilities, but directly applying RSI to medicine introduces fundamental safety challenges. We introduce MedRSI, the first recursive self-improvement framework for medicine, which continuously transforms diagnostic failures into new clinical capabilities through tool composition and task-specific model training. Inspired by clinical practice, MedRSI introduces two mechanisms for clinically aligned self-evolution. Clinical-cost-aware failure prioritization directs improvement toward errors according to their potential clinical consequences rather than frequency alone. Fast discovery with slow registration separates rapid capability invention from conservative adoption, allowing new tools to enter the persistent agent only after demonstrating sustained benefit across subsequent patient cohorts. Across public glaucoma and heart disease benchmarks and two private clinical tasks, MedRSI progressively develops segmentation, measurement, prediction, multimodal reasoning, and generative capabilities, surpasses manually engineered medical agents, and autonomously discovers solutions to clinical problems not anticipated by its original designers. Our results show that medical agents need not remain constrained by capabilities specified before deployment: with clinically grounded mechanisms governing what to improve and what to retain, they can continuously construct, validate, and accumulate new capabilities from diagnostic experience. Code is available at https://github.com/ImprintLab/MedRSI.

摘要：醫療代理越來越多地將通用推理模型與專業臨床工具結合起來，但它們的能力仍然主要受到臨床醫生和工程師在部署前設計的限制。遞歸自我改進（RSI）提供了一種不同的範式，讓代理從自身的失敗中學習並自主擴展其能力，但將RSI直接應用於醫學會引入根本的安全挑戰。我們介紹了MedRSI，這是醫學領域首個遞歸自我改進框架，它通過工具組合和任務特定模型訓練，持續將診斷失敗轉化為新的臨床能力。受到臨床實踐的啟發，MedRSI引入了兩種與臨床對齊的自我演化機制。臨床成本意識的失敗優先排序根據錯誤的潛在臨床後果而非僅僅是頻率來指導改進。快速發現與緩慢登記的區分將快速能力發明與保守採用分開，允許新工具在展示對隨後患者群體持續受益後才進入持久代理。通過公共青光眼和心臟病基準以及兩個私有臨床任務，MedRSI逐步發展分割、測量、預測、多模態推理和生成能力，超越手動工程的醫療代理，並自主發現原設計者未預見的臨床問題解決方案。我們的結果顯示，醫療代理不必受限於部署前指定的能力：通過臨床基礎的機制來管理改進和保留的內容，它們可以持續構建、驗證和累積來自診斷經驗的新能力。代碼可在 https://github.com/ImprintLab/MedRSI 獲得。

docs.title: Mobile Imaging Solutions for Medical Diagnosis: Trends and Applications
docs.text:
2609.24814v2 by Syed Muhammad Ibne Zulfiker, Fariha Tabassum Islam, Md Sultanul Arifin, Khandker Aftarul Islam, Nishat Anjum Bristy, Faria Huq, Priyeta Saha, Syeda Nahida Akter, Arpita Saha, Tanzima Hashem

Advances in processing power, camera technologies, and mobile image analysis have made smartphones and other mobile devices, such as laptops, increasingly suitable for medical diagnosis and healthcare applications. Researchers have developed low-cost solutions for the early detection and monitoring of various health conditions, including eye and ENT diseases, malnutrition, heart rate variability, skin and oral conditions, and injuries, using images captured by non-medical devices such as smartphones and webcams. This survey examines existing research on mobile image-based medical diagnosis, with an emphasis on its potential to enable low-cost and accessible healthcare. We comparatively analyze state-of-the-art solutions across different healthcare application categories, examining their advantages and limitations. Based on this analysis, we identify desirable characteristics of mobile image-based diagnostic tools and highlight areas where existing approaches have made progress as well as areas requiring further research. We also discuss application-specific and common challenges and outline directions for future research. Overall, this study provides a comprehensive overview of mobile image-based healthcare solutions and their potential to support low-cost disease diagnosis and monitoring, particularly for underserved populations in remote and resource-constrained settings.

摘要：隨著處理能力、相機技術和移動影像分析的進步，智能手機和其他移動設備（如筆記型電腦）越來越適合用於醫療診斷和健康護理應用。研究人員已經開發出低成本的解決方案，用於早期檢測和監測各種健康狀況，包括眼科和耳鼻喉科疾病、營養不良、心率變異性、皮膚和口腔狀況以及受傷，這些解決方案使用的是智能手機和網絡攝像頭等非醫療設備捕捉的影像。本調查研究現有的移動影像醫療診斷研究，重點關注其促進低成本和可及性健康護理的潛力。我們對不同健康護理應用類別中的最先進解決方案進行比較分析，檢視它們的優勢和局限性。根據這一分析，我們確定了移動影像診斷工具的理想特徵，並突出了現有方法已取得進展的領域以及需要進一步研究的領域。我們還討論了特定應用和共同挑戰，並概述了未來研究的方向。總體而言，本研究提供了移動影像健康護理解決方案的全面概述，以及它們在支持低成本疾病診斷和監測方面的潛力，特別是對於在偏遠和資源有限的環境中服務不足的人群。

docs.title: When Quantization Preserves Accuracy but Not Evidence: Explanation-Aware Post-Training Quantization for Medical LLMs
docs.text:
2609.24799v1 by Yeji Kim, Mi-Young Kim, Randy Goebel

Post-training quantization (PTQ) enables efficient deployment of large language models, and PTQ methods are usually optimized and evaluated with generic reconstruction, perplexity, or answer accuracy. But in explanation-critical domains, preserving only the final answer may be insufficient, since users may also inspect generated rationales to judge whether a prediction is trustworthy. We study this issue in medical multiple-choice question answering, where rationales should provide evidence that supports the selected answer. We propose an explanation-aware objective for transformation-based PTQ. Our method builds an offline faithfulness cache from full-precision teacher rationales and uses it during optimization to preserve answer-supporting evidence tokens and evidence-conditioned answer behavior. We instantiate it on OSTQuant under W4A4KV4 quantization and evaluate four 7B--8B medical and instruction-tuned LLMs on MedExQA, MedExpQA, and ChallengeClinicalQA. While a same-calibration OSTQuant baseline preserves task accuracy, it can substantially weaken answer-supporting rationales. Our objective is to preserve the full-precision model's answer-supporting behavior rather than improve gold-label accuracy, and our method better preserves the full-precision model's answer behavior and rationale-to-answer support. These results suggest that PTQ for explanation-critical settings should evaluate preservation of answer-supporting evidence, not only answer accuracy. Code and evaluation scripts are available at https://github.com/dut0817/EAQuant.

摘要：後訓練量化（PTQ）使大型語言模型的高效部署成為可能，而PTQ方法通常是通過通用重建、困惑度或答案準確性來進行優化和評估。但在解釋至關重要的領域中，僅保留最終答案可能不夠，因為用戶可能還會檢查生成的推理，以判斷預測是否可信。我們在醫療多選題回答中研究這一問題，其中推理應提供支持所選答案的證據。我們提出了一種針對基於轉換的PTQ的解釋感知目標。我們的方法從全精度教師推理中構建一個離線忠實性緩存，並在優化過程中使用它來保留支持答案的證據標記和基於證據的答案行為。我們在W4A4KV4量化下的OSTQuant上實現了這一方法，並在MedExQA、MedExpQA和ChallengeClinicalQA上評估了四個7B--8B的醫療和指令調整的LLM。雖然相同標定的OSTQuant基線保留了任務準確性，但它可能會顯著削弱支持答案的推理。我們的目標是保留全精度模型的支持答案行為，而不是提高金標準準確性，我們的方法更好地保留了全精度模型的答案行為和推理對答案的支持。這些結果表明，對於解釋至關重要的設置，PTQ應該評估支持答案證據的保留，而不僅僅是答案準確性。代碼和評估腳本可在https://github.com/dut0817/EAQuant獲得。

docs.title: A digital-twin framework for forecasting treatment-day imaging with contour uncertainty in adaptive proton radiotherapy
docs.text:
2609.24725v1 by Yizhou Wu, Jie Ding, Justin Roper, Minglei Kang, Yuheng Li, Sibo Tian, David S. Yu, Xiaofeng Yang, Chih-Wei Chang

Head-and-neck anatomy changes over a six-to-seven-week proton course, and the anatomy of a later week cannot be imaged when the plan is made. We present a digital-twin framework that forecasts a patient's treatment-day anatomy as an ensemble of predicted CTs with propagated contours and quantifies the uncertainty of the forecast contours. The twin is a library of previously treated patients with planning and weekly quality-assurance CTs (QACTs), made patient-specific by a two-step foundation-model deformable registration: a cross-patient field carries each library patient onto the current patient, and a longitudinal field, estimated in the current patient's frame, carries that patient's planning-to-QACT change onto the current patient's own planning CT. A library of 302 observations from 88 patients yields about 300 replicates per patient, each a deformation that occurred in a treated patient. The dispersion of the propagated contours, resolved by outward normal, is six-direction contour uncertainty in millimeters. This is uncertainty in the input to the forecast, which library patient the current patient follows, rather than in model parameters, and it is unchanged when the registration engine is exchanged. On ten patients with clinician contours on two QACTs, the library alone fixes the anisotropic shape of the uncertainty (4.5 to 6.2 mm); the first QACT narrows it by a factor of 3.2 to 3.6 without a contour being drawn; an approved contour improves the center but not the width. The estimate orders directions correctly but is not Gaussian-calibrated. A clinical target volume expansion is worked out as one application.

摘要：頭頸部解剖在六到七週的質子治療過程中發生變化，而在制定計劃時無法成像後期的解剖。我們提出了一個數位雙胞胎框架，預測患者治療日的解剖結構，作為一組帶有傳播輪廓的預測CT，並量化預測輪廓的不確定性。這個雙胞胎是一個之前接受治療的患者的庫，包含計劃和每週質量保證CT（QACT），通過兩步基礎模型可變形註冊使其具備患者特異性：跨患者場將每個庫中的患者映射到當前患者，而在當前患者框架中估算的縱向場則將該患者的計劃到QACT的變化映射到當前患者自己的計劃CT。來自88名患者的302個觀察結果生成約300個每位患者的複製，每個複製都是在接受治療的患者中發生的變形。傳播輪廓的分散度由外法線解決，代表六個方向的輪廓不確定性，單位為毫米。這是預測輸入的不確定性，即當前患者跟隨的庫患者，而不是模型參數的變化，並且在交換註冊引擎時不會改變。在十名患者的兩個QACT上，臨床醫生的輪廓僅由庫修正不確定性的各向異性形狀（4.5到6.2毫米）；第一個QACT在未繪製輪廓的情況下將其縮小了3.2到3.6倍；經批准的輪廓改善了中心但未改善寬度。估計正確地排序了方向，但未經高斯校準。臨床靶體積擴展被視為一個應用。

docs.title: What Makes a Good Medical Image Tokenizer? Rethinking Reconstruction and Generation in Medical Image Tokenization
docs.text:
2609.24691v1 by Niklas Bubeck, Yundi Zhang, Vasiliki Sideri-Lampretsa, Julian McGinnis, Jiancheng Yang, Daniel Rueckert, Jiazhen Pan

Latent diffusion models now dominate medical image generation, and every such pipeline rests on a \emph{tokenizer} that compresses images into the latent codes for image generation to operate on. Thereby, the tokenizer choice bounds every downstream task from reconstruction fidelity and generation quality to the representations available for downstream analysis. Yet, medical imaging pipelines routinely utilize tokenizers from natural imaging on the hypothesis that their behavior carries over. However, this is an assumption never tested in the medical imaging regime, where datasets are orders of magnitude smaller and images exhibit far lower inter-sample variance. We present a systematic evaluation of medical image tokenizers evaluating thirty configurations across ten model families on twelve datasets at three compression factors, spanning reconstruction, generation, latent geometry, downstream classification, and memorization. We find that (1) performance on image reconstruction and generation strongly correlate, unlike prior reports on natural images; (2) modern tokenizers use nearly all of their codebook entries, but still leave most of the latent space unused; (3) training-set memorization is mild and is further suppressed by stronger latent space compression; and (4) discrete quantization can largely preserve downstream classification, with lookup-free schemes being the main exception.

摘要：潛在擴散模型現在主導醫學影像生成，每個這樣的管道都依賴於一個 \emph{tokenizer}，該工具將影像壓縮為潛在代碼，以便進行影像生成。因此，tokenizer 的選擇限制了每個下游任務的重建保真度和生成質量，以及可用於下游分析的表示。然而，醫學影像管道通常使用來自自然影像的 tokenizers，假設它們的行為可以延續下去。然而，這是一個從未在醫學影像範疇中測試過的假設，因為該領域的數據集規模小得多，且影像之間的變異性遠低於樣本間變異性。我們對醫學影像 tokenizers 進行了系統評估，評估了三十種配置，涵蓋十個模型系列，在十二個數據集上進行了三種壓縮因子的測試，涉及重建、生成、潛在幾何、下游分類和記憶化。我們發現 (1) 影像重建和生成的性能強烈相關，這與之前對自然影像的報告不同；(2) 現代 tokenizers 幾乎使用了所有的代碼本條目，但仍然留下大部分潛在空間未使用；(3) 訓練集的記憶化程度較輕，並且在更強的潛在空間壓縮下進一步抑制；以及 (4) 離散量化在很大程度上可以保留下游分類，無查找的方案是主要例外。

docs.title: Custom Named Entity Recognition and Topic Classification for Global Health Publications
docs.text:
2609.24625v1 by Genis Skura, Antoine Geissbühler, Jean-Luc Falcone

How should natural language processing models be selected and adapted for global health literature in environments where annotated data and computational resources are limited? This thesis investigates these challenges through experiments on semantic tag discovery, named entity recognition (NER), and multi-label topic classification. First, skip-gram word2vec models trained on progressively larger specialized corpora are compared with BioWordVec to assess how corpus size and domain context influence tag discovery. Vocabulary coverage and qualitative evaluation indicate that broader coverage does not necessarily yield more useful domain-specific associations. The analysis then turns to entity extraction, comparing convolutional spaCy models with a RoBERTa-based transformer on 1,000 annotated sentences. Under a lenient scoring protocol, the transformer achieves 0.80 micro-F1 versus 0.65-0.69 for convolutional models, but takes 82 seconds rather than 5-6 seconds. This trade-off motivates fine-tuning convolutional models and integrating a disease recognizer that achieves 81.33% test F1 on the NCBI Disease Corpus. Combined with PDF preprocessing, entity filtering, and MeSH enrichment, the resulting pipeline supports document-level indexing. To complement entity extraction with thematic annotation, MiniLM-based few-shot classification is compared with BART-MNLI zero-shot inference across 50 topics and 1,000 handcrafted test sentences. BART-MNLI achieves 95.2% single-label accuracy versus 59%; reported multi-label accuracies are 88% and 32% under partly manual assessment. However, its higher inference cost limits practical integration. The results show where domain specialization and lightweight adaptation offer practical value, and where transformer accuracy justifies higher inference costs, providing an empirical basis for building knowledge systems under resource constraints.

摘要：如何在標註數據和計算資源有限的環境中選擇和調整自然語言處理模型，以應對全球健康文獻？本論文通過對語義標籤發現、命名實體識別（NER）和多標籤主題分類的實驗來探討這些挑戰。首先，對逐步增大專門語料庫訓練的skip-gram word2vec模型與BioWordVec進行比較，以評估語料庫大小和領域上下文如何影響標籤發現。詞彙覆蓋率和質量評估表明，較廣的覆蓋並不一定會產生更有用的領域特定關聯。分析隨後轉向實體提取，將卷積spaCy模型與基於RoBERTa的Transformer在1,000個標註句子上進行比較。在寬鬆的評分協議下，Transformer達到0.80的微F1，而卷積模型則為0.65-0.69，但所需時間為82秒，而不是5-6秒。這種權衡促使對卷積模型進行微調，並整合一個在NCBI疾病語料庫上達到81.33%測試F1的疾病識別器。結合PDF預處理、實體過濾和MeSH豐富，最終的管道支持文檔級索引。為了用主題註釋補充實體提取，基於MiniLM的少量樣本分類與BART-MNLI零樣本推斷在50個主題和1,000個手工製作的測試句子上進行比較。BART-MNLI在單標籤準確率上達到95.2%，而基於MiniLM的準確率為59%；報告的多標籤準確率在部分手動評估下為88%和32%。然而，其較高的推斷成本限制了實際整合。結果顯示了領域專業化和輕量級調整在何處提供實際價值，以及Transformer準確性在何處證明了較高推斷成本的合理性，為在資源限制下構建知識系統提供了實證基礎。

docs.title: Ascent: An Agentic System over the Model Context Protocol for Real-World Clinical Data Analysis
docs.text:
2609.24620v1 by Angelo Ziletti, Leonardo D'Ambrosi, Melanie Tuchardt, Tim Kondziella

Answering epidemiological questions from real-world clinical data requires medical coding, schema-aware SQL, and validation of implicit choices about populations, denominators, and time. We present Ascent, an agentic system that exposes medical coding, question answering, and cohort analysis through a shared Model Context Protocol tool surface for standardized and native schemas. We introduce EpiTrap, a dataset testing whether systems avoid recognized pharmacoepidemiological errors, and compare a fixed pipeline with agents across models and orchestrators. With capable models, agents improve accuracy over the fixed pipeline by an average of 27 and 20 percentage points on native and standardized schemas, respectively. These gains require more tool calls and longer runtimes. Experience from real projects highlights the system's value for feasibility assessment, diagnostic iteration, and expert-guided analysis.

摘要：回答來自真實世界臨床數據的流行病學問題需要醫療編碼、具模式感知的 SQL 以及對於人群、分母和時間的隱性選擇的驗證。我們提出 Ascent，一個主動系統，通過共享的模型上下文協議工具界面，揭示醫療編碼、問題回答和隊列分析，以實現標準化和本地化的模式。我們介紹 EpiTrap，一個數據集，用於測試系統是否避免已知的藥物流行病學錯誤，並比較固定管道與各模型和協調者之間的代理。使用能力強大的模型，代理在本地和標準化模式上，分別提高了固定管道的準確率平均 27 和 20 個百分點。這些增益需要更多的工具調用和更長的運行時間。來自真實項目的經驗突顯了該系統在可行性評估、診斷迭代和專家指導分析中的價值。

docs.title: Fathom-Vaidya: Advancing Medical Reasoning with Rubric-Based Rewards
docs.text:
2609.24480v1 by Kalash Shah, Kunal Singh, Snehan J, Shreyas Singh

Deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) in healthcare requires robust performance across two complementary dimensions - diagnostic reasoning: the convergent, evidence-driven task of inferring a patient's condition from clinical data to produce a diagnosis, and clinical healthcare reasoning: the broader, navigational judgment required to communicate, plan, and adapt across multi-turn clinical interactions where a single correct answer may not exist. Recent benchmarks such as HealthBench and MedXpertQA reveal persistent weaknesses in both areas, exposing failures in complex diagnostic scenarios and limitations in contextual, patient-centered dialogue. We introduce a sequential training framework that targets these facets using synthetic data and rubric-based reinforcement learning. First, we improve diagnostic reasoning using MedBullets-derived questions with rule- and rubric-guided Reinforcement Learning (RL). We then shift to clinical reasoning by generating 5.3k synthetic multi-turn scenarios, each paired with multi-dimensional rubrics to comprehensively assess the response. This approach yields over 10% improvement on MedXpertQA, and our 30B model achieves 50.1% accuracy on HealthBench-Hard, surpassing proprietary baselines including GPT-5 (thinking). Our results show that targeted synthetic datasets and rubric-based training can systematically improve both diagnostic and interactive clinical reasoning in medical LLMs.

摘要：在醫療保健中部署大型語言模型（LLMs）需要在兩個互補的維度上具備穩健的性能——診斷推理：從臨床數據中推斷患者狀況以產生診斷的收斂性、以證據為驅動的任務，以及臨床醫療推理：在多輪臨床互動中所需的更廣泛的導航判斷，這些互動中可能不存在單一正確答案。最近的基準測試，如HealthBench和MedXpertQA，揭示了這兩個領域持續存在的弱點，暴露了在複雜診斷場景中的失敗以及在以患者為中心的對話中的限制。我們引入了一個針對這些方面的序列訓練框架，使用合成數據和基於評分標準的強化學習。首先，我們使用來自MedBullets的問題，通過規則和評分標準引導的強化學習（RL）來改善診斷推理。然後，我們轉向臨床推理，生成5.3k個合成的多輪場景，每個場景都配有多維評分標準，以全面評估回應。這種方法在MedXpertQA上實現了超過10%的改進，而我們的30B模型在HealthBench-Hard上達到了50.1%的準確率，超過了包括GPT-5（思考）在內的專有基準。我們的結果顯示，針對性的合成數據集和基於評分標準的訓練可以系統性地改善醫療LLMs中的診斷和互動臨床推理。

docs.title: Predicting Postprandial Glycemic Response from Meal Images, Clinical Variables, and Gut Microbiome Information
docs.text:
2609.24453v1 by Varvara Kondratyeva, Kamilia Zaripova, Nassir Navab, Azade Farshad

Predicting postprandial glycemic response (PPGR) is fundamental to personalized nutrition and type 2 diabetes management, yet existing approaches typically rely on manually reported dietary intake, limiting their scalability in free-living settings. We propose a multimodal framework that replaces manual dietary logging with image-derived macronutrient estimates and integrates them with clinical variables and gut microbiome information for personalized PPGR prediction. The framework jointly performs image-based macronutrient estimation and glucose prediction, while an attention-based prediction module models interactions between dietary and host-specific information. We evaluate the proposed approach on a real-world dataset comprising meal images, continuous glucose monitoring, clinical variables, and gut microbiome profiles. The proposed model outperforms existing PPGR baselines using image-derived nutritional inputs and approaches the performance of methods that rely on manually reported macronutrients despite using automatically estimated nutritional information. These results demonstrate that combining image-derived nutrition with complementary clinical and gut microbiome information provides a practical foundation for scalable personalized PPGR prediction.

摘要：預測餐後血糖反應（PPGR）對於個性化營養和2型糖尿病管理至關重要，然而現有的方法通常依賴手動報告的飲食攝入，限制了其在自由生活環境中的可擴展性。我們提出了一個多模態框架，將手動飲食記錄替換為基於圖像的宏量營養素估計，並將其與臨床變量和腸道微生物組信息整合，以實現個性化的PPGR預測。該框架共同執行基於圖像的宏量營養素估計和葡萄糖預測，同時基於注意力的預測模塊建模飲食和宿主特定信息之間的互動。我們在一個包含餐點圖像、連續血糖監測、臨床變量和腸道微生物組特徵的真實世界數據集上評估了所提出的方法。所提出的模型在使用基於圖像的營養輸入時超越了現有的PPGR基準，並且在性能上接近依賴手動報告的宏量營養素的方法，儘管使用的是自動估計的營養信息。這些結果表明，將基於圖像的營養與互補的臨床和腸道微生物組信息相結合，為可擴展的個性化PPGR預測提供了一個實用的基礎。

docs.title: Artificial Structure Function Search: Preserving Artificial Functional Connectivity for Structured Pruning
docs.text:
2609.24401v1 by Mindula Illeperuma, Rafael Pina, Charuka Herath, Sharmarke A. Gabayre, Varuna De Silva

Structured pruning is a model compression technique that is used to reduce the computational cost of deploying deep neural networks on resource-constrained devices. Popular methods of pruning rely on opaque heuristics or weight-based criteria that give no indication as to the structural dependencies in the network. To address these limitations we present Artificial Structure Function Search (ASF-S): a novel structured pruning framework. ASF-S utilizes Principle Gradient Importance (PGI): a novel prune-candidate selection criteria that is inspired by structure-function relationships in the brain. By ensuring the pruned structure of the model respects topographical organization of the output layer, we define Artificial Functional Connectivity (AFC) for artificial neural networks. AFC provides evidence to demonstrate that accurate smaller networks can be found using careful prune candidate selection criteria. We present results for PGI as a selection criterion and for ASF-S as a pruning framework against recent benchmarks, demonstrating that our method yields model variants with 70\% parameter reduction, that can recover baseline accuracy without re-training the pruned layers.

摘要：結構性剪枝是一種模型壓縮技術，用於減少在資源受限設備上部署深度神經網絡的計算成本。流行的剪枝方法依賴於不透明的啟發式或基於權重的標準，這些標準無法指示網絡中的結構依賴關係。為了解決這些限制，我們提出了人工結構函數搜索（ASF-S）：一種新穎的結構性剪枝框架。ASF-S利用原則梯度重要性（PGI）：一種受大腦中結構-功能關係啟發的剪枝候選選擇標準。通過確保模型的剪枝結構尊重輸出層的地形組織，我們為人工神經網絡定義了人工功能連通性（AFC）。AFC提供證據以證明，通過仔細的剪枝候選選擇標準，可以找到準確的小型網絡。我們展示了PGI作為選擇標準和ASF-S作為剪枝框架的結果，與最近的基準進行比較，顯示我們的方法產生的模型變體具有70\%的參數減少，且能在不重新訓練剪枝層的情況下恢復基線準確性。

docs.title: Brain-Token Learning: Microstate-Based Tokenization and Multi-Scale Interaction for Long-Horizon EEG Sequence Modeling
docs.text:
2609.24324v1 by Weishan Ye, Yue Pan, Li Zhang, Gan Huang, Zhen Liang

Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a non-invasive window into dynamic brain activity, yet modeling long-horizon EEG sequences remains challenging due to their high temporal complexity, substantial variability across subjects, and the lack of biologically meaningful sequence representations. Existing tokenization strategies, such as fixed-window and patch-based representations, discretize EEG signals according to artificial temporal boundaries, which may disrupt intrinsic brain-state dynamics. In this work, we propose Brain-Token Learning, a neuroscience-inspired framework that introduces Brain Tokenization for long-horizon EEG sequence modeling. Instead of partitioning EEG signals into predefined temporal segments, Brain Tokenization represents EEG as sequences of recurrent microstate-derived brain tokens, where each token corresponds to a quasi-stable large-scale brain state with variable temporal duration. Based on these biologically grounded tokens, we further develop a multi-scale token interaction module consisting of Latent State Aggregation and State Transition Modeling to jointly capture global brain-state context and local microstate transitions. We evaluate Brain-Token on five heterogeneous EEG datasets, including the newly collected long-horizon NeuroLong dataset and four affective or clinical EEG datasets (SEED, DEAP, MDD, and NSSI). Extensive experiments demonstrate that Brain-Token consistently outperforms conventional CNN/LSTM architectures, Transformer-based models, and domain adaptation methods across diverse EEG scenarios. Further analysis verifies the effectiveness of microstate-based tokenization and multi-scale interaction for learning robust and interpretable EEG representations. These results establish Brain-Token as a biologically grounded tokenization paradigm for long-horizon EEG sequence modeling.

摘要：腦電圖 (EEG) 提供了一個非侵入性的窗口來觀察動態腦活動，但由於其高時間複雜性、受試者之間的顯著變異性以及缺乏生物學上有意義的序列表示，建模長期 EEG 序列仍然具有挑戰性。現有的標記化策略，如固定窗口和基於區塊的表示，根據人工時間邊界對 EEG 信號進行離散化，這可能會破壞內在的腦狀態動態。在這項工作中，我們提出了腦標記學習，這是一個受神經科學啟發的框架，引入了腦標記化以進行長期 EEG 序列建模。腦標記化不是將 EEG 信號劃分為預定的時間段，而是將 EEG 表示為由重複微狀態衍生的腦標記序列，其中每個標記對應於一個具有可變時間持續性的準穩定大規模腦狀態。基於這些生物學上基礎的標記，我們進一步開發了一個多尺度標記互動模塊，包含潛在狀態聚合和狀態轉移建模，以共同捕捉全局腦狀態上下文和局部微狀態轉移。我們在五個異質 EEG 數據集上評估了腦標記，包括新收集的長期 NeuroLong 數據集和四個情感或臨床 EEG 數據集（SEED、DEAP、MDD 和 NSSI）。廣泛的實驗表明，腦標記在各種 EEG 場景中始終優於傳統的 CNN/LSTM 架構、基於Transformer的模型和領域適應方法。進一步的分析驗證了基於微狀態的標記化和多尺度互動在學習穩健且可解釋的 EEG 表示方面的有效性。這些結果確立了腦標記作為一種生物學上基礎的標記化範式，用於長期 EEG 序列建模。

docs.title: Unsupervised Brain Anomaly Detection as a Bayesian Inverse Problem with Diffusion Prior
docs.text:
2609.24265v1 by Hugues Roy, Reuben Dorent, Ninon Burgos

Unsupervised anomaly detection (UAD) aims to localize abnormal regions in medical scans without pixel-level annotations. A typical strategy seeks to reconstruct a pseudo-healthy image that preserves subject-specific anatomy. Recently, diffusion models have been proposed to perform UAD. However, these methods rely on heuristic noise schedules or synthetic corruptions to balance subject-specificity and anomaly removal. In this work, we propose an alternative formulation of UAD as a Bayesian inverse problem under a diffusion prior. First, we introduce a latent spatial anomaly mask that models pixel-wise consistency between a test image and its latent corresponding pseudo-healthy image. Then, we propose an approximation of the unknown generation process that links healthy anatomy, anomalies, and the observed image, enabling a well-defined likelihood within the Bayesian framework. Building on recent advances in diffusion-based inverse problem methods, we jointly infer the pseudo-healthy image and the anomaly mask via annealed posterior sampling. We evaluate our approach on FDG PET (ADNI) and FLAIR MRI (BraTS 2021), demonstrating improved anomaly localization performance compared to other diffusion-based approaches and validating the contribution of our introduced model. Our code is available at https://github.com/HuguesRoy/UAD_DAPS.

摘要：無監督異常檢測（UAD）旨在無需像素級註釋的情況下定位醫學掃描中的異常區域。一種典型策略是尋求重建一個保留受試者特定解剖結構的偽健康圖像。最近，已提出擴散模型來執行UAD。然而，這些方法依賴於啟發式噪聲計劃或合成損壞，以平衡受試者特異性和異常去除。在這項工作中，我們提出了一種將UAD作為擴散先驗下的貝葉斯逆問題的替代公式。首先，我們引入了一個潛在的空間異常掩碼，該掩碼建模測試圖像與其潛在對應的偽健康圖像之間的像素級一致性。然後，我們提出了一個未知生成過程的近似，該過程將健康解剖、異常和觀察到的圖像聯繫起來，使得在貝葉斯框架內能夠定義良好的似然性。基於最近在擴散基逆問題方法上的進展，我們通過退火後驗抽樣共同推斷偽健康圖像和異常掩碼。我們在FDG PET（ADNI）和FLAIR MRI（BraTS 2021）上評估我們的方法，顯示出相較於其他基於擴散的方法，異常定位性能有所改善，並驗證了我們所提出模型的貢獻。我們的代碼可在 https://github.com/HuguesRoy/UAD_DAPS 獲得。

docs.title: Towards Sustainable Magnetic Resonance Imaging: Insights from long-term, high-resolution energy recordings across an entire scanner fleet
docs.text:
2609.25150v1 by Florian Leonhard Raab, Fiona Mankertz, Nour Maalouf, Josephine Berger, Andreas Lingg, Reza Dehdab, Sebastian Werner, Judith Herrmann, Andreas Brendlin, Sebastian Gassenmaier, Suhas Siddaramu, Fabian Wagner, Julian Wohlers, Shreeja Varadarajan, Gurlal Singh, Jens Gühring, Rainer Schneider, Konstantin Nikolaou, Saif Afat, Thomas Küstner

Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is among the most energy-intensive diagnostic modalities in healthcare, yet its energy consumption and the factors influencing it remain insufficiently understood. This study aims to establish a comprehensive baseline of MRI energy consumption by characterizing energy demand across a scanner fleet, examining scanner utilization and operating patterns in clinical practice. Concurrently, it investigates the relationships between energy consumption and relevant operational and acquisition features. On average, a single MRI measurement consumed 0.43 kWh, while a complete examination consumed 13.50 kWh. In general, substantial differences in energy consumption were observed between MRI scanners and their corresponding operating modes (scan, idle, and eco-power mode). These variations may be related to differences in scanner operating patterns, employed examination protocols, and their resulting acquisition parameters. Idle and eco-power modes accounted for more cumulative energy consumption than active scanning. However, these energy shares should always be interpreted in relation to scanner occupancy, as utilization patterns strongly influence the distribution of energy across those operating modes. Lastly, linear regression analysis showed that energy consumption was more strongly associated with scan duration than with average power, suggesting that scan duration may be an important factor influencing MRI energy consumption. ...

摘要：磁共振成像（MRI）是醫療保健中最耗能的診斷方式之一，但其能耗及影響因素仍然未被充分理解。本研究旨在通過對掃描儀隊伍的能量需求進行特徵化，建立MRI能耗的全面基準，並檢查臨床實踐中的掃描儀利用率和操作模式。同時，它還調查了能耗與相關操作和獲取特徵之間的關係。平均而言，單次MRI測量消耗0.43 kWh，而完整檢查則消耗13.50 kWh。一般來說，MRI掃描儀之間及其相應的操作模式（掃描、空閒和生態功率模式）之間觀察到了顯著的能耗差異。這些變化可能與掃描儀的操作模式、所採用的檢查方案及其產生的獲取參數之間的差異有關。空閒和生態功率模式的累計能耗超過了主動掃描。然而，這些能量份額應始終與掃描儀的佔用率相關聯進行解釋，因為利用模式強烈影響這些操作模式之間的能量分配。最後，線性回歸分析顯示，能耗與掃描持續時間的關聯性強於與平均功率的關聯性，這表明掃描持續時間可能是影響MRI能耗的重要因素。

docs.title: LIMIT: Less Is More for Instruction Tuning in Text-to-SQL
docs.text:
2609.24186v1 by Haoyuan Ma, Hengwei Liu, Linjuan Wu, Yongliang Shen, Weiming Lu

Large language models have achieved remarkable progress on Text-to-SQL through reasoning-enhanced fine-tuning, yet existing approaches predominantly rely on massive instruction corpora under the assumption that scale drives performance. We challenge this paradigm by investigating a fundamental question: what is the minimal data requirement for effective Text-to-SQL instruction tuning? We propose LIMIT(Less Is More for Instruction Tuning in Text-to-SQL), a data-centric framework that demonstrates strong database reasoning can emerge from an extremely compact training set when examples are strategically selected. LIMIT operates through four stages: difficulty-aware filtering that identifies samples within the model's learning frontier, chain-of-thought synthesis with consistency-based selection, multi-dimensional quality scoring via LLM-as-judge, and genetic algorithm optimization that jointly maximizes schema coverage and sample quality. On the BIRD and Spider benchmark, LIMIT selects only 796 and 863 samples while achieving 100% table coverage, enabling Qwen3-8B to reach 69.1% and 88.9% execution accuracy.This result surpasses methods trained on 20 times more data and establishes a new state-of-the-art among open-source approaches. Our findings suggest that careful data curation, rather than scale, is the key to efficient Text-to-SQL learning.

摘要：大型語言模型在透過增強推理的微調上，已在文本到 SQL 的領域取得了顯著進展，然而現有的方法主要依賴於大量的指令語料庫，假設規模推動性能。我們挑戰這一範式，探討一個基本問題：有效的文本到 SQL 指令調整的最小數據需求是什麼？我們提出了 LIMIT（Less Is More for Instruction Tuning in Text-to-SQL），這是一個以數據為中心的框架，顯示出當範例被策略性選擇時，強大的數據庫推理可以從極其緊湊的訓練集中產生。LIMIT 通過四個階段運作：難度感知過濾，識別模型學習邊界內的樣本；基於一致性的思維鏈合成；通過 LLM-as-judge 的多維質量評分；以及基因算法優化，聯合最大化模式覆蓋和樣本質量。在 BIRD 和 Spider 基準上，LIMIT 僅選擇了 796 和 863 個樣本，同時實現了 100% 的表格覆蓋，使 Qwen3-8B 達到 69.1% 和 88.9% 的執行準確率。這一結果超越了在 20 倍更多數據上訓練的方法，並在開源方法中建立了新的最先進水平。我們的發現表明，謹慎的數據策劃，而非規模，是高效文本到 SQL 學習的關鍵。

docs.title: Representation-guided in-context learning for medical image interpretation with multimodal large language models
docs.text:
2609.24057v1 by Minda Zhao, Fangyu Hu, Yan Luo, Yutong Yang, Jiahui Cai, Kaichen Zhou, Manling Li, Paul Liang, Yilun Du, Lucy Q. Shen, Mengyu Wang

Medical image interpretation is central to diagnosis and care, yet adapting general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often requires resource-intensive domain-specific fine-tuning. Here we introduce representation-guided in-context learning (RG-ICL), a training-free inference framework that retrieves query-aligned demonstrations using frozen encoders, without task-specific parameter updates. Across eight datasets spanning histopathology, radiology and retinal fundoscopy, RG-ICL improved classification (mean gain 20 percentage points) and visual question answering (VQA) (mean gain 13 percentage points) over no-context and conventional ICL, approaching or exceeding training-based comparators. Which cases were retrieved mattered more than how many: 6 query-aligned cases outperformed up to 32 randomly selected ones, whereas fixed or random cases often reduced accuracy below baseline. For VQA, aligning reference cases with both image content and question intent produced further gains. These findings indicate that for medical image interpretation, curating which reference cases an MLLM sees is a practical alternative to retraining it.

摘要：醫學影像解讀對於診斷和護理至關重要，但調整通用多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）通常需要資源密集型的特定領域微調。在此，我們介紹了基於表示的上下文學習（RG-ICL），這是一種無需訓練的推理框架，通過使用凍結的編碼器檢索與查詢對齊的示例，而無需特定任務的參數更新。在涵蓋組織病理學、放射學和視網膜底照相的八個數據集上，RG-ICL在分類（平均增益20個百分點）和視覺問題回答（VQA）（平均增益13個百分點）方面優於無上下文和傳統ICL，接近或超過基於訓練的比較方法。檢索哪些案例比檢索多少案例更為重要：6個與查詢對齊的案例的表現超過了多達32個隨機選擇的案例，而固定或隨機案例往往會使準確性降至基線以下。對於VQA，將參考案例與圖像內容和問題意圖對齊可產生進一步的增益。這些發現表明，對於醫學影像解讀，策劃MLLM所見的參考案例是一種實用的替代方案，而不是重新訓練它。

docs.title: Misaligned Clinical Risk Classification and Cost Asymmetry in Open-Weight Large Language Models
docs.text:
2609.23999v1 by Star S. D. Liu, Xiyu Ding, Robert B. Barrett, Alberto Santamaria-Pang, Nic Dobbins, Harold P. Lehmann

How large language models (LLMs) integrate patient risk with clinical cost tradeoffs remains poorly understood. We investigated how four open-weight LLMs (Qwen-2.5-7B/32B and Llama-3.1-8B/70B) internally represent cost tradeoffs, how these representations relate to clinical predictions, and whether decisions shift as predicted by the specified cost direction and magnitude. Using a public diabetes dataset, we varied 11 false-negative (FN) to false-positive (FP) cost ratios across three phrasings and examined representations and behavioral outputs. Patient risk was linearly recoverable on par with conventional classifiers (AUC $\approx 0.83$), and cost direction was recoverable in every model. However, representational shifts in cost direction tracked output changes only in the two larger models, and responses to cost magnitude were predominantly direction-agnostic. Only 2 of 12 model-phrasings showed both opposing responses to increasing FN versus FP costs and cost-correct ordering. Representationally, a direction fitted on one cost side did not invert when transferred to the other, as expected under mirror-symmetric encoding. These findings suggest that LLMs encode risk and cost information but do not reliably integrate them into cost-correct decisions. Clinical evaluations should therefore include tradeoff tests, phrasing sensitivity, and default operating points alongside predictive performance.

摘要：如何大型語言模型（LLMs）將患者風險與臨床成本權衡整合仍然不甚了解。我們調查了四個開放權重的LLMs（Qwen-2.5-7B/32B和Llama-3.1-8B/70B）如何在內部表示成本權衡，這些表示如何與臨床預測相關，以及決策是否如預期那樣隨著指定的成本方向和大小而變化。使用一個公共的糖尿病數據集，我們在三種措辭中變化了11個假陰性（FN）與假陽性（FP）成本比率，並檢查了表示和行為輸出。患者風險可以線性恢復，與傳統分類器相當（AUC $\approx 0.83$），而成本方向在每個模型中均可恢復。然而，成本方向的表示變化僅在兩個較大的模型中跟踪輸出變化，對成本大小的反應主要是與方向無關的。只有12種模型措辭中的2種顯示了對增加的FN與FP成本的對立反應和成本正確排序。在表示上，適合於一側成本的方向在轉移到另一側時並未反轉，這與鏡像對稱編碼的預期相反。這些發現表明，LLMs編碼風險和成本信息，但並不可靠地將其整合為成本正確的決策。因此，臨床評估應包括權衡測試、措辭敏感性和預設操作點，並與預測性能一起考量。

docs.title: UniK: Universal Knowledge Perception for Digital and Physical AI
docs.text:
2609.23971v1 by Nirmit Desai, Kunal Sawarkar, Aditya Mahakali, Dongkon Lee, Kevin Park, Eric Song

Two transformative classes of AI systems are reshaping how organizations operate: \textit{digital AI}, which reasons over enterprise knowledge to power chatbots and agent workflows; and \textit{physical AI}, which learns to control robots and autonomous systems from video, gameplay, and sensor telemetry. Both face the same foundational bottleneck: raw knowledge at scale, spanning heterogeneous modalities, locked in private corpora that existing AI infrastructure cannot access reliably or efficiently. We propose \textit{Universal Knowledge Perception (UniK)} as a common platform for both classes, covering the full knowledge lifecycle (ingestion, enrichment, indexing, retrieval, and continuous evaluation) across modalities from rich text and video to molecular data and sensor telemetry. We present UniK, built on Polymath Retrieval (multi-index fusion over automatically enriched indices) with no task-specific fine-tuning. Across five digital AI domains (medical literature, open-domain QA, chemistry, legal video proceedings, and government open data) UniK combined with an open-source 70-billion-parameter model consistently matches or outperforms frontier proprietary LLMs that are orders of magnitude larger: 76\% RAG accuracy on government data versus 47\% for GPT-5; 77.9\% on medical QA without fine-tuning; topping all open-source chemistry pipelines. We show that the same infrastructure directly addresses the data curation, indexing, and retrieval challenges facing physical AI world model training, where the knowledge problem is harder but structurally identical.

摘要：兩種變革性的人工智慧系統正在重塑組織的運作方式：\textit{數位人工智慧}，它利用企業知識來驅動聊天機器人和代理工作流程；以及\textit{實體人工智慧}，它從視頻、遊戲和傳感器遙測中學習控制機器人和自主系統。這兩者面臨著相同的基礎瓶頸：大規模的原始知識，跨越異質的模態，鎖定在現有人工智慧基礎設施無法可靠或高效訪問的私有語料庫中。我們提出\textit{通用知識感知（UniK）}作為這兩類系統的共同平台，涵蓋整個知識生命周期（攝取、豐富、索引、檢索和持續評估），跨越從豐富文本和視頻到分子數據和傳感器遙測的模態。我們展示了UniK，基於多數據索引融合的Polymath Retrieval，且不需要特定任務的微調。在五個數位人工智慧領域（醫學文獻、開放領域問答、化學、法律視頻程序和政府開放數據）中，UniK結合一個開源的700億參數模型，始終能夠匹配或超越規模大數量級的前沿專有大型語言模型：政府數據的76\% RAG準確率對比GPT-5的47\%；在醫學問答中達到77.9\%的準確率，且無需微調；在所有開源化學管道中名列前茅。我們展示了相同的基礎設施能直接解決實體人工智慧世界模型訓練中面臨的數據策展、索引和檢索挑戰，儘管知識問題更為困難，但結構上是相同的。

docs.title: GLR-MM: Graph-Based Global-Local Reconstruction for Robust Multimodal Chest X-ray and EHR Representation Learning under Missing Modalities
docs.text:
2609.23876v1 by Surbhi Sharma, Nikhil Manali, Devesh Maheshwari

Clinical multimodal models must often predict before all chest X-ray (CXR) and electronic health record (EHR) inputs are available. Existing approaches align observed representations, model missingness, or reconstruct across modalities, but do not jointly exploit within-patient and clinically similar inter-patient evidence. We propose GLR-MM, a Graph-Based Global-Local Reconstruction framework for early ICU mortality prediction. It maps five CXR-EHR modalities to a shared space, reconstructs missing embeddings through complementary local cross-modal and global graph-attention branches, adaptively fuses their estimates, and optimizes class-balanced prediction, reconstruction, and contrastive objectives. On 9,620 MIMIC-derived ICU stays, we evaluate 10%, 30%, and 50% random modality missingness with shared deterministic masks. MUSE performs better under mild and moderate missingness, whereas GLR-MM achieves higher AUROC and AUPRC at 50% by 0.0088 and 0.0249, respectively. These results indicate that graph-guided reconstruction is most useful when inputs are severely incomplete.

摘要：臨床多模態模型往往必須在所有胸部X光（CXR）和電子健康記錄（EHR）輸入可用之前進行預測。現有的方法對觀察到的表示進行對齊，建模缺失性，或在不同模態之間重建，但未能共同利用患者內部和臨床相似的患者間證據。我們提出了GLR-MM，一個基於圖形的全局-局部重建框架，用於早期ICU死亡率預測。它將五種CXR-EHR模態映射到共享空間，通過互補的局部跨模態和全局圖形注意分支重建缺失的嵌入，自適應融合它們的估計，並優化類別平衡的預測、重建和對比目標。在9,620個MIMIC衍生的ICU住院期間，我們評估了10%、30%和50%的隨機模態缺失性，並使用共享的確定性掩碼。在輕度和中度缺失性下，MUSE的表現更佳，而GLR-MM在50%的情況下分別提高了0.0088和0.0249的AUROC和AUPRC。這些結果表明，圖形引導的重建在輸入嚴重不完整時最為有用。

docs.title: WILSON - a pathology foundation model framework for patient-level analysis and diagnostic text generation
docs.text:
2609.25123v1 by Saghir Alfasly, Wataru Uegami, Sobhan Hemati, Wenchao Han, Xiaojia Tang, Kevin Thompson, Daniel Stone, Ghazal Alabtah, Saba Yasir, Michael R. Lucas, Eric W. Klee, Cheryl L. Willman, Judy C. Boughey, Matthew P. Goetz, Krishna R. Kalari, H. R. Tizhoosh

Pathologists integrate morphology across magnifications and across the slides of a patient case, whereas pathology foundation models encode thousands of tiles from single slides and aggregate their features. Here we present WILSON, a vision--language foundation model that represents whole-slide images and multi-slide cases as single multi-magnification composite images, trained on approximately 189k slides from Mayo Clinic spanning 42 organs and 829 diagnostic entities using pathology reports as supervision. Without task-specific training, WILSON exceeded a dedicated case-level model on all internal cohorts (macro-F1 0.52 versus 0.38) and matched slide-level models up to 9.4 times larger at 272- to 2,155-fold lower compute. End-to-end fine-tuning on 508 triple-negative breast cancer cases improved histologic subtyping and stromal tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte grading by 0.16 and 0.11 macro-F1. WILSON retrieved matching diagnostic text at 75.6% recall@1 (PRISM, 58.1%) and generated captions closer to report-derived references than PRISM and PRISM2 on the internal cohort and on most external comparisons. Composite images thus offer a compact, clinically aligned computational unit for pathology.

摘要：病理學家整合不同放大倍率的形態學以及患者案例的切片，而病理基礎模型則編碼來自單一切片的數千個圖塊並聚合其特徵。這裡我們介紹WILSON，一個視覺-語言基礎模型，將全切片影像和多切片案例表示為單一的多放大倍率合成影像，訓練資料來自於大約189,000個來自梅奧診所的切片，涵蓋42個器官和829個診斷實體，並以病理報告作為監督。在沒有特定任務訓練的情況下，WILSON在所有內部隊列中超越了一個專用的案例級模型（宏觀F1 0.52對比0.38），並且在計算量降低272到2,155倍的情況下，與高達9.4倍更大的切片級模型相匹配。對508例三陰性乳腺癌案例的端到端微調改善了組織學亞型分類和基質腫瘤浸潤淋巴細胞的分級，宏觀F1分別提高了0.16和0.11。WILSON以75.6%的召回率@1檢索到匹配的診斷文本（PRISM, 58.1%），並在內部隊列及大多數外部比較中生成的標題更接近於報告衍生的參考，而非PRISM和PRISM2。因此，合成影像提供了一個緊湊且臨床對齊的計算單元，用於病理學。

docs.title: Modeling Clinical Workflow for SYNTAX Scoring from Coronary Angiography Videos
docs.text:
2609.23553v1 by Suzhong Fu, Jingqi Dong, Xuan Ding, Rui Sun, Yiming Yang, Shuguang Cui, Zhen Li

The SYNTAX score is a clinically established tool for assessing anatomical lesion complexity in coronary artery disease and guiding subsequent treatment. However, automated SYNTAX scoring is commonly formulated as a direct regression problem from coronary angiography videos to patient-level scores. In this work, we reformulate SYNTAX scoring as a vessel segment identity-preserving anatomical reasoning problem and propose a hierarchical modeling framework that explicitly aligns learning with the clinical workflow. Our approach maintains vessel segment identity across frames and views, estimates stenosis severity at the segment level, and aggregates evidence hierarchically according to coronary anatomy. Simultaneously, to address the scarcity of domain-specific data, we integrate and complete multiple public coronary angiography datasets, constructing a large-scale resource featuring completed vessel segmentation and derived structural annotations. Experiments demonstrate that vessel segment-level stenosis embedding enhances explanatory power and reduces prediction variability compared to baseline models, with the R^2 score improving by 0.201 and dev STD decreasing by 18.4%. These results highlight the necessity of structure-aligned modeling for reliable and stable automated SYNTAX scoring from multi-view coronary angiography videos. The GitHub link is https://github.com/VersaceSu7/SYNTAX_score_777.

摘要：SYNTAX 分數是一種臨床上確立的工具，用於評估冠狀動脈疾病中的解剖病變複雜性並指導後續治療。然而，自動化的 SYNTAX 計分通常被表述為從冠狀動脈造影視頻到患者級別分數的直接回歸問題。在這項工作中，我們將 SYNTAX 計分重新表述為一個保持血管段身份的解剖推理問題，並提出一個層次建模框架，明確將學習與臨床工作流程對齊。我們的方法在幀和視圖之間保持血管段身份，估計段級別的狹窄嚴重性，並根據冠狀動脈解剖學層次聚合證據。同時，為了解決領域特定數據的稀缺性，我們整合並補全多個公共冠狀動脈造影數據集，構建一個大型資源，具有完整的血管分割和衍生的結構註釋。實驗表明，血管段級別的狹窄嵌入增強了解釋能力，並減少了與基線模型相比的預測變異性，R^2 分數提高了 0.201，標準差降低了 18.4%。這些結果突顯了結構對齊建模在從多視角冠狀動脈造影視頻中進行可靠且穩定的自動化 SYNTAX 計分的必要性。GitHub 連結是 https://github.com/VersaceSu7/SYNTAX_score_777。

docs.title: Heating in human-HVAC interaction for smart homes: An interdisciplinary overview
docs.text:
2609.23508v1 by Delong Korus-Du, Gunnar Stevens, Alexander Boden, Lenneke Kuijer, Apostolos K. Vavouris, Md Shajalal, Philip Engelbutzeder, Omid Veisi, Peter Tolmie

As part of HVAC systems, residential heating provides foundational infrastructure for human habitation in cold weather. However, research on how residents interact with HVAC systems, particularly heating systems, remains fragmented across architecture, engineering, informatics, physiology, psychology, sociology, and design. Based on 541 studies from these fields, this review integrates interdisciplinary research on Heating in Human-HVAC Interaction in smart homes.The resulting synthesis is conceptualized through the Situated Interaction Dynamics of control and feedback between users and systems. User-initiated interactions involve monitoring past and present system performance and planning future operation, while system-initiated interactions rely on sensor networks to trigger automation or provide information enabling user action. These interaction dynamics connect Residents' Experience and Practices with Heating in HVAC System Mechanics. Residents' Experience and Practices include thermal comfort and energy management, where thermal comfort involves both individual physiological and psychological experiences of indoor climate and social practices shaped by norms, empathy, and negotiation among cohabitants. Heating in HVAC System Mechanics includes thermal conditions and energy performance. Thermal conditions concern the regulation of air temperature, mean radiant temperature, air velocity, and relative humidity, while energy performance concerns efficiency and environmental impact. This overview highlights four interdisciplinary tensions: sensed versus lived conditions, personalization versus negotiation, efficiency versus health, and automation versus agency. The resulting framework offers a conceptual lens to interpret heating interactions and design Human-HVAC Interaction that balances IEQ-driven healthy thermal conditions, affordability, and sustainability.

摘要：作為HVAC系統的一部分，住宅供暖為寒冷天氣中的人類居住提供了基礎設施。然而，關於居民如何與HVAC系統，特別是供暖系統互動的研究，仍然在建築、工程、資訊學、生理學、心理學、社會學和設計等領域中支離破碎。基於來自這些領域的541項研究，本綜述整合了智能家居中人類-HVAC互動中的供暖的跨學科研究。所得到的綜合通過用戶與系統之間的控制和反饋的情境互動動態進行概念化。用戶主動的互動涉及監控過去和現在的系統性能以及規劃未來的運行，而系統主動的互動則依賴於傳感器網絡來觸發自動化或提供使用戶行動的資訊。這些互動動態將居民的體驗和實踐與HVAC系統機械中的供暖聯繫起來。居民的體驗和實踐包括熱舒適和能源管理，其中熱舒適涉及個體生理和心理的室內氣候體驗，以及由規範、同理心和同居者之間的協商所塑造的社會實踐。HVAC系統機械中的供暖包括熱條件和能源性能。熱條件關注空氣溫度、平均輻射溫度、空氣速度和相對濕度的調節，而能源性能則關注效率和環境影響。本概述突出了四個跨學科的緊張關係：感知的條件與生活的條件、個性化與協商、效率與健康，以及自動化與主體性。所得到的框架提供了一個概念視角，以解釋供暖互動並設計平衡IEQ驅動的健康熱條件、可負擔性和可持續性的人類-HVAC互動。

docs.title: RPMem: Learning Long-Term Recurrent Parametric Memory Across Sessions for LLM Agents
docs.text:
2609.23466v2 by Fanyu Zhao, Ruike Cao, Liang Dong, Fugen Yao, Jian Xu, Guanjun Jiang, Han Zhang, Yifei Zhao, Yinsheng Li

Long-running LLM agents require memory that persists and evolves across sessions. Text-based memory retrieves and reconstructs past interactions at every query, making long-horizon performance increasingly dependent on retrieval quality and contextual reasoning as histories grow. Parametric memory encodes experience directly into model computation, but existing approaches provide limited support for cross-session memory evolution. Their coupling to a specific backbone further restricts memory reuse after model replacement. We introduce RPMem, a two-stage architecture that compiles each session into a model-independent latent memory through forward computation and selectively integrates it with retained memory via a task-trained recurrent gate. The consolidated memory is then mapped to backbone-specific low-rank adaptation (LoRA) parameters, allowing the encoding capability to transfer when the backbone is replaced. Evaluation across three long-term memory benchmarks and five diverse backbones demonstrates broad generalization with near-constant update cost and memory footprint. With Qwen3-8B on PERMA, RPMem reaches 85.52%, outperforming the strongest parametric and text-based baselines by 5.32 and 12.98 percentage points, respectively. Ablations validate the complementary roles of session compilation and cross-session consolidation, while dynamics analyses reveal that the gate acquires task-specific memory integration strategies. These results establish RPMem as a lifecycle-independent parametric memory framework that maintains evolving cross-session memory that remains reusable across backbone replacements. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/Quark-Medical/rpmem/tree/main.

摘要：長期運行的 LLM 代理需要持久且隨著會話演變的記憶。基於文本的記憶在每次查詢時檢索並重建過去的互動，隨著歷史的增長，長期性能越來越依賴於檢索質量和上下文推理。參數記憶將經驗直接編碼到模型計算中，但現有的方法對跨會話記憶演變的支持有限。它們與特定骨幹的耦合進一步限制了模型替換後的記憶重用。我們引入了 RPMem，一種兩階段架構，通過前向計算將每個會話編譯成模型無關的潛在記憶，並通過任務訓練的循環閘選擇性地將其與保留的記憶集成。然後，合併的記憶被映射到骨幹特定的低秩適應（LoRA）參數，允許在替換骨幹時轉移編碼能力。在三個長期記憶基準和五個不同骨幹上的評估顯示出廣泛的泛化，並且更新成本和記憶佔用幾乎保持不變。使用 Qwen3-8B 在 PERMA 上，RPMem 達到 85.52%，分別超越最強的參數和基於文本的基線 5.32 和 12.98 個百分點。消融實驗驗證了會話編譯和跨會話整合的互補角色，而動態分析顯示閘獲得了任務特定的記憶整合策略。這些結果確立了 RPMem 作為一種生命周期無關的參數記憶框架，維持隨著會話演變的可重用記憶，並在骨幹替換中保持可用。我們的實現可在 https://github.com/Quark-Medical/rpmem/tree/main 獲得。

docs.title: A Patient World Model for Early Forecasting of Digital Health Campaign Outcomes: Capabilities and Limits
docs.text:
2609.23333v1 by Yunlong Wang

Digital direct-to-consumer (DTC) health campaigns are usually measured after the fact. In-flight forecasting commonly relies on a separate classifier for every cutoff and horizon. We treat this task as a dynamic-system problem and build a compact patient world model. The architecture maintains a latent state per patient, learns exposure-conditioned state dynamics jointly with a weekly conversion hazard, and rolls forward into future conversion curves. We evaluate it on a US campaign dataset with 147{,}173 patients and 5.2 million at-risk person-weeks. In a retrospective evaluation conditioned on recorded future exposures, the model forecasts the remaining new-to-brand prescription volume through week 52 with a relative error of 2.9\% from a week-4 cutoff and 0.8--2.6\% from cutoffs at weeks 8--26. The strongest non-recurrent baseline, a pooled-hazard gradient boosting model given the same survival rollout and information, has relative errors of 13.6--33.1\%. Per-horizon classifiers perform substantially worse. A Fisher-information analysis motivates dense next-exposure supervision when conversions are rare. Removing this auxiliary objective increases prescription-volume error by approximately $2$--$14\times$, while providing no consistent disadvantage on the more common specialist-visit outcome. We also evaluate scenario simulation. Switching all future exposure off raises predicted conversion from 0.31 to 0.89, a pattern consistent with selection effects in observational exposure data. This result highlights the limits of interpreting exposure-conditioned rollouts causally.

摘要：數位直接面向消費者（DTC）健康宣傳活動通常是在事後進行測量。飛行預測通常依賴於每個截止點和預測範圍的單獨分類器。我們將這項任務視為一個動態系統問題，並建立了一個緊湊的患者世界模型。該架構為每位患者維持一個潛在狀態，並與每週轉換危險共同學習曝光條件下的狀態動態，並向未來的轉換曲線滾進。我們在一個包含147,173名患者和520萬風險人週的美國宣傳活動數據集上進行評估。在基於記錄的未來曝光的回顧性評估中，該模型預測第52週的剩餘新品牌處方量，從第4週截止點的相對誤差為2.9%，從第8至26週的截止點的相對誤差為0.8--2.6%。最強的非重複基準，即在相同生存展開和信息下的合併危險梯度提升模型，其相對誤差為13.6--33.1%。每個預測範圍的分類器表現明顯較差。費雪信息分析促使在轉換稀少時進行密集的下一次曝光監督。移除這一輔助目標會使處方量的誤差增加約$2$--$14\times$，同時對更常見的專科就診結果沒有提供一致的劣勢。我們還評估了情境模擬。關閉所有未來曝光的預測轉換從0.31提高到0.89，這一模式與觀察性曝光數據中的選擇效應一致。這一結果突顯了解釋曝光條件下的展開因果關係的限制。

docs.title: MAC-RRG: Iterative Multi-Agent Collaboration for X-ray Radiology Report Generation
docs.text:
2609.26124v1 by Futian Wang, Yuhan Qiao, Xiao Wang, Dan Xu, Yuehang Li, Zhixiang Guo, Yaowei Wang, Jin Tang

Despite the remarkable progress of LLM-based and knowledge graph-augmented Radiology Report Generation (RRG) methods, existing techniques still suffer from inherent defects. Conventional LLM-only models lack structured medical prior knowledge, resulting in frequent medical hallucinations and low diagnostic interpretability. Current knowledge graph-enhanced schemes adopt static one-round knowledge fusion with single-source knowledge, incapable of dynamic knowledge updating according to generation feedback. This paper proposes a novel Multi-Agent Collaborative iterative framework for X-ray Radiology Report Generation, termed MAC-RRG. Inspired by multi-agent technology, our framework constructs a closed-loop optimization paradigm based on task decoupling and collaborative reasoning. Specifically, the framework first generates a preliminary radiology report from input X-ray images via a vision encoder and a basic LLM. Subsequently, a multimodal knowledge graph (MM-KG) agent mines structured disease correlation and anatomical knowledge from medical knowledge graphs, while an auxiliary knowledge agent extracts unstructured domain knowledge from public medical databases. The multi-source knowledge acquired by dual agents is fused and embedded to guide the LLM in iteratively refining the initial report. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments on mainstream X-ray RRG datasets, including IU X-ray, MIMIC, and CheXpert Plus, fully verify the superiority of our proposed method. The source code and pre-trained models have been released on https://github.com/Event-AHU/Medical_Image_Analysis

摘要：儘管基於大型語言模型（LLM）和知識圖譜增強的放射學報告生成（RRG）方法取得了顯著進展，但現有技術仍然存在固有缺陷。傳統的僅基於LLM的模型缺乏結構化的醫學先驗知識，導致頻繁的醫學幻覺和低診斷可解釋性。目前的知識圖譜增強方案採用靜態的一輪知識融合，且僅依賴單一來源的知識，無法根據生成反饋進行動態知識更新。本文提出了一種新穎的多代理協作迭代框架，用於X光放射學報告生成，稱為MAC-RRG。受到多代理技術的啟發，我們的框架構建了一個基於任務解耦和協作推理的閉環優化範式。具體而言，該框架首先通過視覺編碼器和基本的LLM從輸入的X光圖像生成初步的放射學報告。隨後，多模態知識圖譜（MM-KG）代理從醫學知識圖譜中挖掘結構化的疾病相關性和解剖知識，而輔助知識代理則從公共醫學數據庫中提取非結構化的領域知識。由雙代理獲得的多來源知識被融合並嵌入，以指導LLM迭代地完善初始報告。在主流的X光 RRG數據集上進行的廣泛定量和定性實驗，包括IU X-ray、MIMIC和CheXpert Plus，充分驗證了我們提出方法的優越性。源代碼和預訓練模型已在 https://github.com/Event-AHU/Medical_Image_Analysis 上發布。

docs.title: QwenVLConnector: A Fast, Unified Medical VLM Chatbot for Fine-Grained Clinical Perception and Text Generation
docs.text:
2609.23139v1 by Le Thien Phuc Nguyen, Thien Nguyen, Thanh-Huy Nguyen, Gia Minh Hoang, Anh Mai Vu, Ulas Bagci

Most medical vision-language models (VLMs) excel at open-ended report generation and VQA but provide limited support for structured, fine-grained clinical perception within a unified interface. We present QwenVLConnector, a Qwen2.5-VL-based medical chatbot that unifies classification, multi-label classification, textualized detection, counting, regression, and free-form report generation under a single next-token objective. Our key component is a lightweight dense multi-layer Connector that aggregates low- and high-level visual features, aligns them through the pretrained vision Merger, and fuses them with the final visual representation without increasing sequence length. This design enriches visual tokens with complementary spatial and semantic cues while preserving efficiency. On FLARE-2D, QwenVLConnector improves detection F1 from 0.55 to 0.85, raises single-label classification from 0.37 to 0.51, and boosts report-generation GREEN by up to 18.3 points over the Qwen2.5-VL baseline. We further explore multimodal in-context learning for report generation, showing additional improvements without updating model parameters. Overall, QwenVLConnector offers a unified and efficient framework for combining structured medical perception with open-ended clinical text generation. Our code can be found at https://github.com/plnguyen2908/QwenConnector.

摘要：大多數醫療視覺語言模型（VLMs）在開放式報告生成和視覺問答（VQA）方面表現優異，但在統一介面中對結構化、細緻的臨床感知提供的支持有限。我們提出了 QwenVLConnector，一個基於 Qwen2.5-VL 的醫療聊天機器人，將分類、多標籤分類、文本檢測、計數、回歸和自由格式報告生成統一在單一的下一個標記目標下。我們的關鍵組件是一個輕量級的多層連接器，該連接器聚合了低層次和高層次的視覺特徵，通過預訓練的視覺合併器對齊這些特徵，並在不增加序列長度的情況下將它們與最終的視覺表示融合。這一設計使視覺標記充實了互補的空間和語義線索，同時保持了效率。在 FLARE-2D 上，QwenVLConnector 將檢測 F1 從 0.55 提高到 0.85，將單標籤分類從 0.37 提升至 0.51，並將報告生成的 GREEN 提升至比 Qwen2.5-VL 基準高出 18.3 分。我們進一步探索了報告生成的多模態上下文學習，顯示出在不更新模型參數的情況下的額外改進。總體而言，QwenVLConnector 提供了一個統一且高效的框架，用於將結構化醫療感知與開放式臨床文本生成相結合。我們的代碼可以在 https://github.com/plnguyen2908/QwenConnector 找到。

docs.title: R-GEAN: Regimen-Guided Edit Action Network for Within-Admission Medication Change Prediction
docs.text:
2609.22959v1 by Regan Mahat, Mansu Kim

The medications prescribed to a patient often change during a hospital admission as clinicians start, stop, or continue therapies. We study whether models can predict which medication classes are added or removed between 24 hours after admission and discharge. Metrics that compare the complete discharge regimen can reward models for copying medications that remain unchanged, even when they identify no actual changes. We therefore introduce a leakage-controlled benchmark that predicts net ATC3 additions and removals using only prior completed admissions and information available within the first 24 hours of the current admission. Addition candidates are classes not active at 24 hours, whereas removal candidates are classes active at that time. We also introduce R-GEAN, an asymmetric candidate-scoring network with independent addition and removal predictors. Across 240,480 admissions from 82,286 patients, R-GEAN achieves the highest predefined summary of addition, removal, changed-regimen, and action-pattern performance, termed the edit composite (0.464), compared with 0.435 for the strongest primary comparator. Reimplemented RETAIN, GAMENet, and MICRON baselines obtain 0.428, 0.420, and 0.288, respectively. R-GEAN's advantage is concentrated in correctly identifying medication classes no longer active at discharge, while rare additions and admissions with multiple medication changes remain difficult. Rankings based on micro-F1 over the reconstructed discharge regimen and the edit composite correlate weakly across the evaluated models (Spearman r = 0.20). The continuation baseline achieves the highest complete-regimen score despite predicting no additions or removals. These results show that complete-regimen and edit-level evaluation measure different aspects of medication prediction. The benchmark evaluates observed prescribing changes, not treatment appropriateness

摘要：患者在住院期間所開立的藥物常常會變化，因為臨床醫生會開始、停止或繼續治療。我們研究模型是否能預測在入院後24小時和出院之間，哪些藥物類別會被添加或移除。比較完整出院方案的指標可能會因為複製未變更的藥物而獎勵模型，即使它們未識別出任何實際變化。因此，我們引入了一個控制洩漏的基準，僅使用先前完成的住院資料和當前住院的前24小時內可用的資訊來預測淨ATC3的添加和移除。添加候選類別是指在24小時內未活躍的類別，而移除候選類別則是指在該時間內活躍的類別。我們還引入了R-GEAN，一個具有獨立添加和移除預測器的非對稱候選評分網絡。在82,286名患者的240,480次住院中，R-GEAN在預定義的添加、移除、變更方案和行動模式表現總結中達到了最高的表現，稱為編輯綜合得分（0.464），而最強的主要比較者為0.435。重新實現的RETAIN、GAMENet和MICRON基準分別獲得0.428、0.420和0.288。R-GEAN的優勢集中在正確識別出院時不再活躍的藥物類別，而稀有的添加和多藥物變更的住院仍然困難。基於重建的出院方案和編輯綜合得分的微F1排名在評估的模型之間相關性較弱（Spearman r = 0.20）。儘管預測沒有添加或移除，持續基準仍然達到了最高的完整方案得分。這些結果顯示，完整方案和編輯級別的評估衡量藥物預測的不同方面。該基準評估觀察到的處方變化，而非治療的適當性。

docs.title: An Accurate and Interpretable Hyper Graph Neural Network for GBM Survival Prediction
docs.text:
2609.25088v1 by Mushahid Intesum

Survival prediction for glioblastoma multiforme (GBM) demands models that are both accurate and interpretable, yet existing approaches treat these objectives as com- peting, where performant models sacrifice transparency, while interpretable models accept degraded predictive power. We argue that this trade-off is not inherent. Graph neural net- works offer a structural foundation for extracting interpretable, explainable representations without compromising discriminative ability. Furthermore, current methods typically rely on a single imaging modality, underutilizing the complementary information available across multi-modal MRI and clinical metadata. We propose a multi-modal framework that inte- grates three components to address both objectives simultaneously: (1) a sheaf hypergraph neural network that captures higher-order relationships among tissue patches through direc- tional, asymmetric message passing; (2) a concept bottleneck layer that compresses learned representations into clinically grounded concepts, enforcing ante-hoc interpretability; and (3) an extension sufficiency test (EST) regularizer that penalizes unfaithful explanations during training, ensuring that model explanations genuinely reflect the internal decision process. Clinical and genomic features are incorporated through gated fusion, preserving the dominant prognostic signal of molecular markers while retaining concept-level traceabil- ity. Evaluated on 593 patients from the UPenn-GBM dataset under 5-fold cross-validation, our framework achieves a concordance index of 0.643 with the lowest fold-level variance among all compared models (std = 0.015). To our knowledge, this is the first work to unify sheaf hypergraph convolution, concept bottleneck supervision, and EST regularization for interpretable survival prediction from brain MRI

摘要：生存預測對於多形性膠質母細胞瘤（GBM）需要準確且可解釋的模型，然而現有的方法將這些目標視為競爭關係，其中性能優越的模型犧牲了透明度，而可解釋的模型則接受了預測能力的下降。我們認為這種權衡並非固有的。圖神經網絡提供了一個結構基礎，可以提取可解釋、可解釋的表示，而不妨礙區分能力。此外，當前的方法通常依賴於單一的成像模式，未能充分利用多模態MRI和臨床元數據中可用的互補信息。我們提出了一個多模態框架，整合三個組件以同時解決這兩個目標：（1）一個束超圖神經網絡，通過方向性、不對稱的消息傳遞捕捉組織片段之間的高階關係；（2）一個概念瓶頸層，將學習到的表示壓縮為臨床基礎的概念，強化事前可解釋性；以及（3）一個擴展充分性測試（EST）正則化器，在訓練過程中懲罰不忠實的解釋，確保模型的解釋真實反映內部決策過程。臨床和基因組特徵通過門控融合納入，保留了分子標記的主導預後信號，同時保持概念級的可追溯性。在UPenn-GBM數據集上對593名患者進行5折交叉驗證，我們的框架達到了0.643的協調指數，並在所有比較模型中具有最低的折層變異性（標準差=0.015）。據我們所知，這是第一個將束超圖卷積、概念瓶頸監督和EST正則化統一應用於可解釋的腦MRI生存預測的工作。
