docs.title: Designing and Analysing Argument Mining Pipelines: Towards a Comprehensive Assessment
docs.text:
2609.26338v1 by Siddharth Bhargava, Sara Tonelli, Patricia Martín-Rodilla

Argument Mining (AM) transforms natural language into its underlying argument structures. This transformation is typically realized through a sequence of AM tasks that form an end-to-end AM pipeline. However, AM approaches often differ in how they conceptualize these tasks, making direct comparisons between them difficult and opaque. This calls for a more nuanced, task-level analysis of AM approaches to enable clearer comparison and assessment. This work presents a preliminary meta-study that systematically reviews several state-of-the-art end-to-end AM works and analyzes their pipelines through a triple-perspective framework---a linguistic, computational and domain perspective---to understand how the pipelines model arguments as structures, computes them, and integrates domain knowledge. We further propose a general design to the linguistic and computational perspectives, illustrating how key AM tasks are designed for modeling and computation of argument structures. Our proposed framework lays the groundwork for methodology-centered descriptions across AM approaches, facilitating deeper understanding and more systematic comparisons in future research.

摘要：論證挖掘（AM）將自然語言轉換為其基本的論證結構。這種轉換通常是通過一系列AM任務來實現，形成一個端到端的AM管道。然而，AM方法在如何概念化這些任務方面往往有所不同，這使得它們之間的直接比較變得困難且不透明。這要求對AM方法進行更細緻的任務級分析，以便能夠進行更清晰的比較和評估。本研究呈現了一項初步的元研究，系統性地回顧了幾個最先進的端到端AM工作，並通過三重視角框架進行分析——語言學、計算和領域視角——以理解這些管道如何將論證建模為結構、計算它們以及整合領域知識。我們進一步提出了一個針對語言學和計算視角的一般設計，說明了關鍵AM任務是如何為論證結構的建模和計算而設計的。我們提出的框架為AM方法之間的以方法論為中心的描述奠定了基礎，促進了未來研究中更深入的理解和更系統的比較。

docs.title: EADC: Evaluation of Advanced and Deep-level Compliance in Large Language Models
docs.text:
2609.26175v1 by Yan Zhang, Ruien Li, Yaoyao Peng, Wanxin Ren, Yijia Zhang, Wusheng Zhang, Guangwen Yang

Large Language Models (LLMs) have been used in various industries. However, ensuring their compliance with complex laws and regulatory frameworks remains a great challenge. Existing evaluation paradigms mainly rely on static benchmarks that suffer from three severe limitations: First, the compliance rules being used do not comply with the requirements of Artificial Intelligence (AI) laws and regulations; Second, they only handle apparent, explicit compliance risks, leaving implicit and covert compliance risks undetected; Third, they fail to track the systematic propagation of risks along logical dependency chains or evaluate compliance within nuanced, context-based real-world scenarios. To bridge this critical gap, we introduce EADC, a novel advanced evaluation benchmark of LLMs based on an AI compliance knowledge graph and AI compliance legal experts. By mapping abstract legal rules into structured logical multi-relational graphs, our framework enables automated, evolving agents to distill and synthesize highly sophisticated adversarial scenarios. This compliance benchmark is reviewed and corrected by human AI legal experts throughout the whole process. The resulting dataset (4,435+ QA pairs) provides an extensive, multi-dimensional taxonomy covering critical regulatory frontiers, including bias and discrimination, fairness, personal privacy protection, and values. Crucially, our compliance dataset moves beyond shallow string-matching by incorporating contextual long-horizon interactions and logic-driven hazard chains, capturing deeply embedded compliance anomalies that bypass traditional filters. Experiment evaluations demonstrate that our framework exposes critical regulatory blind spots in state-of-the-art LLMs, offering a rigorous, AI laws and regulations-aligned benchmark to safeguard high-level and deep compliance in the application of LLMs.

摘要：大型語言模型（LLMs）已被應用於各個行業。然而，確保它們遵守複雜的法律和監管框架仍然是一個重大挑戰。現有的評估範式主要依賴靜態基準，這些基準存在三個嚴重的限制：第一，所使用的合規規則不符合人工智慧（AI）法律和法規的要求；第二，它們僅處理明顯的、顯性的合規風險，留下隱性的和隱秘的合規風險未被檢測；第三，它們未能追蹤風險在邏輯依賴鏈中的系統性傳播，或在細微的、基於情境的現實場景中評估合規性。為了填補這一關鍵空白，我們介紹了EADC，一個基於AI合規知識圖譜和AI合規法律專家的新型先進LLMs評估基準。通過將抽象的法律規則映射到結構化的邏輯多關係圖中，我們的框架使自動化的、演變的代理能夠提煉和綜合高度複雜的對抗場景。這一合規基準在整個過程中由人類AI法律專家進行審查和修正。最終生成的數據集（4,435+ QA對）提供了一個廣泛的、多維的分類法，涵蓋關鍵的監管前沿，包括偏見和歧視、公平、個人隱私保護和價值觀。至關重要的是，我們的合規數據集超越了淺層的字符串匹配，通過納入情境長期互動和邏輯驅動的危害鏈，捕捉深層嵌入的合規異常，這些異常繞過了傳統的過濾器。實驗評估顯示，我們的框架揭示了最先進的LLMs中的關鍵監管盲點，提供了一個嚴謹的、與AI法律和法規對齊的基準，以保障LLMs應用中的高層次和深層合規。

docs.title: EMERGE: Resolution-Agnostic Point Cloud Generation with Equivariant Graph-Based Diffusion
docs.text:
2609.26039v1 by Ilias Mitsouras, Nikolaos Chaidos, Giorgos Stamou, Athanasios Voulodimos

Point cloud generation has emerged as a crucial task for accurately capturing and reproducing the complexity of the physical world. However, existing generative approaches, predominantly relying on Transformers and Variational Autoencoders (VAEs), frequently ignore the continuous, non-grid topologies inherent to 3D spaces. Although the integration of graph-based structures has yielded significant benefits in related discriminative vision tasks, such geometric architectures remain noticeably absent from 3D generative modeling. To address this gap, we introduce EMERGE (Equivariant Multi-scale GNN for Resolution-agnostic point cloud GEneration), the first fully $SE(3)$-equivariant graph-based diffusion backbone explicitly designed to generate point clouds while preserving continuous spatial symmetries. Our framework bypasses the rigid resolution dependencies of standard generative pipelines, enabling zero-shot inference at multiple, arbitrary spatial resolutions. Extensive empirical evaluations demonstrate that EMERGE achieves State-of-the-Art generation quality across standard metrics, while the strong inherent geometric inductive biases enable significantly faster training convergence compared to existing baseline methods.

摘要：點雲生成已成為準確捕捉和再現物理世界複雜性的關鍵任務。然而，現有的生成方法主要依賴於Transformer和變分自編碼器（VAEs），經常忽略3D空間固有的連續非網格拓撲。儘管基於圖形的結構在相關的判別視覺任務中帶來了顯著的好處，但這類幾何架構在3D生成建模中仍然明顯缺失。為了解決這一空白，我們引入了EMERGE（Equivariant Multi-scale GNN for Resolution-agnostic point cloud GEneration），這是首個完全$SE(3)$-等變圖形擴散骨幹，專門設計用於生成點雲，同時保留連續的空間對稱性。我們的框架繞過了標準生成管道的剛性解析度依賴性，使得在多個任意空間解析度下實現零樣本推斷成為可能。廣泛的實證評估表明，EMERGE在標準指標上實現了最先進的生成質量，而強大的固有幾何歸納偏見使得訓練收斂速度顯著快於現有的基準方法。

docs.title: Domain-Adaptive Pretraining Enhances Water Treatment Semantic Representation for Large-Scale Structured Literature Mining
docs.text:
2609.26034v1 by Mudi Zhai, Ruihong Qiu, Qingyun Zeng, T. David Waite, Bing-Jie Ni, Haoran Duan

Water treatment research is expanding rapidly, but much of the knowledge acquired from this research remains scattered across unstructured literature. The field still lacks a dedicated language model that can efficiently capture water treatment-specific domain semantics for large-scale literature mining. Here, we address this by developing WaterBERT, a domain-adapted encoder model designed for semantic representation and structured information extraction from water treatment texts. WaterBERT was developed by continual pretraining on a large-scale water treatment corpus comprising about 2.97 billion tokens. Three fine-tuned models based on WaterBERT were systematically evaluated on downstream tasks, achieving the best overall performance among general-purpose and domain-specific BERT models, with F1 scores of 90.12% for multiclass treatment process classification, 79.50% for named entity recognition, and 74.04% for relation extraction. Beyond these benchmark tasks, we further demonstrated WaterBERT's advantages for large-scale literature processing. Applied to 5,144 Environmental Science & Technology articles, WaterBERT-BERTopic identified coherent, diverse, and domain-specific research topics without predefined categories. Building on WaterBERT, we processed 693,211 abstracts at substantially lower cost than commercial LLMs while retaining competitive extraction performance to construct a structured water treatment knowledge graph. The knowledge graph was then integrated with lexical and dense retrieval to develop a Water Knowledge-Enhanced Retrieval System (WaterKERS), which achieved a relevance score of 77.7, substantially outperforming text-based retrieval baselines (54.7-64.5). Through WaterBERT, this study provides a compact and scalable semantic foundation for large-scale information processing and evidence mapping in water treatment research.

摘要：水處理研究正在迅速擴展，但從這項研究中獲得的許多知識仍然分散在非結構化文獻中。該領域仍然缺乏一個專門的語言模型，能夠有效捕捉水處理特定領域的語義，以進行大規模文獻挖掘。在此，我們通過開發WaterBERT來解決這一問題，這是一個針對水處理文本的語義表示和結構化信息提取而設計的領域適應編碼器模型。WaterBERT是通過在一個包含約29.7億個標記的大規模水處理語料庫上進行持續預訓練而開發的。基於WaterBERT的三個微調模型在下游任務上進行了系統評估，在通用和領域特定的BERT模型中實現了最佳的整體性能，其中多類處理過程分類的F1得分為90.12%，命名實體識別的F1得分為79.50%，關係提取的F1得分為74.04%。除了這些基準任務，我們進一步展示了WaterBERT在大規模文獻處理中的優勢。應用於5,144篇環境科學與技術文章，WaterBERT-BERTopic識別了連貫、多樣且特定於領域的研究主題，而無需預先定義的類別。在WaterBERT的基礎上，我們以顯著低於商業LLM的成本處理了693,211篇摘要，同時保持競爭力的提取性能，以構建結構化的水處理知識圖譜。然後，該知識圖譜與詞彙和密集檢索相結合，開發出一個水知識增強檢索系統（WaterKERS），其相關性得分達到77.7，顯著超越了基於文本的檢索基準（54.7-64.5）。通過WaterBERT，本研究為水處理研究中的大規模信息處理和證據映射提供了一個緊湊且可擴展的語義基礎。

docs.title: Reciprocal Collaboration: how lessons from convergence in GLAMs can enhance interdisciplinary AI research
docs.text:
2609.26023v1 by Amber L. Cushing, Suzanne Little, Giulia Osti

The need for collaboration between diverse fields of research is increasingly recognised as important by research funding agencies. A significant driver of this need is the current revolution in artificial intelligence (AI) and related technologies. There is a growing interest in the potential impact of AI in different fields including the methodologies they use and the resulting advances in new knowledge, new access and enhanced productivity. However, there is also a corresponding increase in concern about the fundamentals of AI technologies and the way in which trans and/or interdisciplinary research is approached. The resulting collaboration too often ends up as a one-way street where the domain partner acts only as an information provider. For example, the contribution of the AHSS partner might be limited to providing insight about ethics and/or the technology partner may only provide a service to build applied AI-based solutions. In response to this problem, we propose a reciprocal approach to collaboration where both partners seek to understand, cooperate and identify jointly significant impacts. In this paper we explore this relationship between cultural heritage institutions (GLAMs), Arts, Humanities & Social Sciences (AHSS) research and technology-led AI research, especially the impact of current technological advances in AI. Drawing from the history of convergence in GLAM studies, we propose five key practices to form a framework for greater understanding across this divide.

摘要：研究資助機構越來越認識到不同研究領域之間合作的重要性。這一需求的主要驅動力是當前人工智慧（AI）及相關技術的革命。對於AI在不同領域潛在影響的興趣日益增長，包括它們所使用的方法論以及由此產生的新知識、新途徑和提升的生產力。然而，對於AI技術的基本原理以及跨學科和/或跨領域研究的方式的擔憂也隨之增加。由此產生的合作往往變成單向的街道，領域夥伴僅充當信息提供者。例如，AHSS夥伴的貢獻可能僅限於提供有關倫理的見解，或技術夥伴可能僅提供構建基於應用AI解決方案的服務。針對這一問題，我們提出一種互惠的合作方式，雙方夥伴共同尋求理解、合作並識別共同的重要影響。在本文中，我們探討文化遺產機構（GLAMs）、藝術、人文與社會科學（AHSS）研究以及以技術為主導的AI研究之間的關係，特別是當前AI技術進步的影響。根據GLAM研究中的融合歷史，我們提出五個關鍵實踐，以形成一個促進跨越這一鴻溝的更大理解的框架。

docs.title: BAS-OPD: Budget-Aware Selective On-Policy Self-Distillation for Fine-Grained Multimodal Perception
docs.text:
2609.25891v1 by Zihan Chen, Hengguang Zhou, Yuan Kang, Yiming Zhang, Wenhui Fang, Zenghui Ding, Yining Sun, Cho-Jui Hsieh

Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often struggle with fine-grained visual perception when processing complete images, as critical evidence may only appear in local regions. On-policy self-distillation (OPD) enables transferring privileged visual knowledge from informative views to full-image policies, but querying the teacher for every rollout introduces substantial supervision costs. In this work, we propose BAS-OPD, a budget-aware selective OPD framework that allocates teacher supervision under limited query budgets. Instead of querying all rollouts, BAS-OPD selects informative samples while maintaining full-batch student generation. We explore random, uncertainty-based, and learned utility-based selection strategies, where the learned selector estimates query value from detached rollout statistics and online utility signals derived from student--teacher agreement and teacher confidence without additional student forward passes. BAS-OPD only changes training-time supervision allocation and preserves single-pass full-image inference. Experiments on fine-grained multimodal perception benchmarks demonstrate that BAS-OPD achieves strong performance while substantially reducing teacher supervision costs, highlighting the effectiveness of selective OPD under constrained budgets.

摘要：多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）在處理完整圖像時，往往在細緻的視覺感知上面臨挑戰，因為關鍵證據可能僅出現在局部區域。政策內自我蒸餾（OPD）使得從信息豐富的視圖向全圖政策轉移特權視覺知識成為可能，但對每次展開查詢教師會引入相當大的監督成本。在這項工作中，我們提出了BAS-OPD，一種預算意識的選擇性OPD框架，該框架在有限的查詢預算下分配教師監督。BAS-OPD不會查詢所有展開，而是選擇信息豐富的樣本，同時保持全批次學生生成。我們探索了隨機、基於不確定性和基於學習效用的選擇策略，其中學習選擇器從脫離的展開統計和源自學生與教師一致性及教師信心的在線效用信號中估計查詢價值，而無需額外的學生前向傳遞。BAS-OPD僅改變訓練時的監督分配，並保留單次全圖推斷。對於細緻的多模態感知基準的實驗表明，BAS-OPD在顯著降低教師監督成本的同時實現了強大的性能，突顯了在預算受限下選擇性OPD的有效性。

docs.title: AgenticSizing: A Large Language Model-based Multi-Agent Framework for Analog Circuit Sizing
docs.text:
2609.25873v1 by Yijia Hao, Pratibha Verma, Dongxu Guo, Cristian Sestito, Michael O'Boyle, Christos-Savvas Bouganis, Themis Prodromakis

Analog circuit sizing remains a challenging and time-consuming task due to the large design space, strong performance trade-offs, and increasing circuit complexity in scaled technologies. Although recent large language model (LLM)-based methods show promise in improving sample efficiency and interpretability, existing approaches often lack explicit circuit-topology understanding and are mainly evaluated on relatively simple analog building blocks. This paper presents a multi-agent LLM-based framework for complex analog circuit sizing. The proposed framework first analyzes the circuit topology and decomposes the netlist into functional blocks and substructures. It also extracts lightweight design knowledge for reuse. Based on the extracted topology and knowledge, a planner coordinates multiple role-specialized sizing agents to update design variables and achieve global performance specifications. This workflow mimics the collaborative process of an expert analog design team and provides a structured, interpretable, and simulation-driven optimization procedure. The framework was validated on eight circuits, with the largest design containing up to 55 transistors and 60 sizing variables. Notably, for the LDO benchmark, the proposed method achieved a 60\% success rate with an average of 83 iterations, where classical optimizers failed to find feasible solutions. Further, ablation studies demonstrate that topology understanding, design-knowledge infusion, and agent specialization provide complementary benefits. The source code is available to support reproducibility.

摘要：類比電路的尺寸調整仍然是一項具有挑戰性且耗時的任務，這是由於設計空間廣泛、性能權衡強烈以及在縮放技術中電路複雜性不斷增加所致。雖然最近基於大型語言模型（LLM）的方法在提高樣本效率和可解釋性方面顯示出潛力，但現有的方法往往缺乏明確的電路拓撲理解，並且主要在相對簡單的類比構建塊上進行評估。本文提出了一種基於多代理的LLM框架，用於複雜的類比電路尺寸調整。所提出的框架首先分析電路拓撲，並將網表分解為功能塊和子結構。它還提取輕量級的設計知識以供重用。基於提取的拓撲和知識，規劃者協調多個角色專門化的尺寸調整代理，以更新設計變數並實現全球性能規範。這個工作流程模擬了專家類比設計團隊的協作過程，並提供了一個結構化、可解釋且以模擬驅動的優化程序。該框架在八個電路上進行了驗證，最大的設計包含多達55個晶體管和60個尺寸變數。值得注意的是，對於LDO基準，所提出的方法在平均83次迭代中達到了60%的成功率，而傳統優化器未能找到可行解。此外，消融研究表明，拓撲理解、設計知識注入和代理專業化提供了互補的好處。源代碼可用於支持可重現性。

docs.title: BELXTR: Biomedical Entity Linking via Contextualized Token Retrieval
docs.text:
2609.25859v1 by Samuele Garda, Ulf Leser

Biomedical Entity Linking disambiguates mentions to entities in a knowledge base (KB), making it the cornerstone of information extraction pipelines. While embedding-based models are a popular approach for the task, they suffer from a key limitation. They compress mentions (and entities) into a single vector, forcing the model to average away crucial fine-grained differences. We present BELXTR, a novel embedding model based on the multi-vector (a.k.a. late interaction) architecture, which allows to leverage token-level matching information. BELXTR extends the original XTR model to biomedical entity linking by integrating an existing task-specific training objective and exploring active query expansion. Experiments across ten corpora and five KBs show that BELXTR improves upon current state-of-the-art in half of the corpora with an average improvement of 5pp recall@1. The largest gains are reported on the challenging cross-species gene disambiguation subtask, where BELXTR outperforms an LLM-powered retrieve-and-rerank pipeline and closely approaches a specialized rule-based system. Our results highlight multi-vector models as a practical alternative to hard-to-maintain rule-based systems or in scenarios where LLM-based reranking is too costly as in PubMed-scale mining. The code to reproduce our experiments can be found at: https://github.com/sg-wbi/belxtr.

摘要：生物醫學實體連結對知識庫 (KB) 中的實體進行消歧義，使其成為信息提取管道的基石。雖然基於嵌入的模型是該任務的一種流行方法，但它們存在一個主要的限制。它們將提及（和實體）壓縮成單一向量，迫使模型平均掉關鍵的細微差異。我們提出了 BELXTR，一種基於多向量（即晚期互動）架構的新型嵌入模型，這使得能夠利用令牌級匹配信息。BELXTR 通過整合現有的任務特定訓練目標並探索主動查詢擴展，將原始 XTR 模型擴展到生物醫學實體連結。跨越十個語料庫和五個知識庫的實驗顯示，BELXTR 在一半的語料庫中改善了當前的最先進技術，平均提高了 5 個百分點的 recall@1。最大的增益報告在具有挑戰性的跨物種基因消歧義子任務中，BELXTR 超越了一個基於 LLM 的檢索和重排序管道，並接近一個專門的基於規則的系統。我們的結果突顯了多向量模型作為難以維護的基於規則系統或在 LLM 基於重排序成本過高的情況下（如 PubMed 規模的挖掘）的一種實用替代方案。我們的實驗代碼可以在以下網址找到：https://github.com/sg-wbi/belxtr。

docs.title: CogenPVG: Cognitive-Enhanced Reflective Multi-Agent Framework for Persuasive Video Generation
docs.text:
2609.25821v1 by Yuntian Xiao, Shoulong Zhang, Wenfeng Song, Yan Wang, Yi Chen, Shuai Li

Persuasive video generation (PVG) is a valuable yet under-explored research topic. Despite the significant advances in multimodal content generation, AI-empowered automated creation of human-made-like videos with substantial persuasiveness remains a formidable challenge. In this paper, we propose CogenPVG, a novel Cognitive-Enhanced reflective multi-agent framework tailored for Persuasive Video Generation task. Given the topic and stance from the user, we decouple the sophisticated generation process into four sequential stages: argument reasoning, storyboard planning, asset creation, and post-editing, imitating the workflow of human video producers. To ensure high persuasiveness, each stage is equipped with a pair of generator and critic agents, following a reflective refinement scheme grounded in a solid psychological theory of persuasion, the Elaboration Likelihood Model (ELM). In the argument reasoning stage, we generate highly logical and credible reasoning thoughts under the guidance of critical thinking theory, enabling cognitive enhancement via the central route of the ELM. For the other three stages, we generate and optimize multimodal assets, assembling them into a persuasive video guided by theories of heuristics, as the peripheral route of the ELM. To the best of our knowledge, CogenPVG is the first work focused on general persuasive topics, without being confined to commercial purposes. Extensive experiments and comprehensive analysis demonstrate that our framework achieves the best persuasion performance, thereby proving the effectiveness of our proposed multi-agent framework for the PVG task.

摘要：說服性視頻生成（PVG）是一個有價值但尚未深入探索的研究主題。儘管在多模態內容生成方面取得了顯著進展，但利用人工智慧自動創建類似人類製作的視頻並具備實質說服力仍然是一項艱巨的挑戰。在本文中，我們提出了CogenPVG，一個新穎的認知增強反思多代理框架，專為說服性視頻生成任務量身定制。根據用戶的主題和立場，我們將複雜的生成過程解耦為四個連續階段：論證推理、故事板規劃、資產創建和後期編輯，模仿人類視頻製作人的工作流程。為了確保高說服力，每個階段都配備了一對生成器和評論者代理，遵循基於堅實心理學說服理論的反思精煉方案，即精緻可能性模型（ELM）。在論證推理階段，我們在批判性思維理論的指導下生成高度邏輯和可信的推理思考，通過ELM的中心路徑實現認知增強。對於其他三個階段，我們生成並優化多模態資產，並根據啟發式理論將其組裝成一個說服性視頻，作為ELM的外圍路徑。據我們所知，CogenPVG是首個專注於一般說服主題的工作，而不僅限於商業目的。廣泛的實驗和全面的分析表明，我們的框架實現了最佳的說服性能，從而證明了我們提出的多代理框架在PVG任務中的有效性。

docs.title: MorphoSHAP: Rethinking the Unit of Attribution in Explanation for Deep Visual Models
docs.text:
2609.25815v1 by Anirudh Prabhakaran, Alexandre Rocchi, Gianni Franchi

Visual attribution methods typically explain predictions using pixels, superpixels, or regular patches. These representations can localize important regions, but provide limited information about their structure. We introduce MorphoSHAP, a model-agnostic post-hoc method that instead uses morphological shapes as the players of a Shapley attribution game. Using the Tree of Shapes, each shape is described by its scale, geometry, and signed contribution, providing explanations of where the evidence lies, what type of structure carries it, and how strongly it affects the prediction. This shared morphological vocabulary enables spatial, textual, and global class-level explanations beyond image-specific heatmaps. To the best of our knowledge, MorphoSHAP is the first SHAP-based image attribution framework to combine these different forms of explanation. Across five diverse datasets and three architectures, MorphoSHAP achieves strong insertion/deletion performance and outperforms competing attribution methods on several benchmarks. Finally, a user study shows that MorphoSHAP provides explanations that are easy to use and are preferred over standard attribution baselines.

摘要：視覺歸因方法通常使用像素、超像素或常規區塊來解釋預測。這些表示可以定位重要區域，但對其結構提供的資訊有限。我們介紹了 MorphoSHAP，一種與模型無關的事後方法，該方法使用形態學形狀作為 Shapley 歸因遊戲的參與者。利用形狀樹，每個形狀都由其尺度、幾何形狀和簽名貢獻來描述，提供了證據所在的位置、承載它的結構類型以及它對預測影響的強度的解釋。這種共享的形態學詞彙使得超越圖像特定熱圖的空間、文本和全局類別級解釋成為可能。據我們所知，MorphoSHAP 是第一個基於 SHAP 的圖像歸因框架，結合了這些不同形式的解釋。在五個多樣的數據集和三種架構中，MorphoSHAP 實現了強大的插入/刪除性能，並在幾個基準測試中超越了競爭的歸因方法。最後，一項用戶研究顯示，MorphoSHAP 提供的解釋易於使用，並且比標準歸因基準更受偏愛。

docs.title: You Only Need 2/3 of the Chosen Experts: An Empirical Study of Dynamic Expert Pruning in Fine-Grained MoE LLMs
docs.text:
2609.25809v1 by Yuanteng Chen, Qiwei Lai, Chen Tianqi, Peisong Wang, Yuantian Shao, Nanxin Zeng, Zhilei Liu, Chuangyi Li, Jing Liu, Jian Cheng

Fine-grained mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures have become a mainstream design for open-weight LLMs, with hundreds of experts and increasingly many selected per token. This shift makes dynamic expert pruning an attractive route to cheaper inference. Yet existing evidence comes largely from coarser architectures and likelihood-scored multiple-choice benchmarks, leaving three central questions open in the fine-grained regime: how redundant per-token expert selection is, how effectively existing pruning methods exploit that redundancy, and what governs a model's sensitivity to pruning. We fill this gap with a systematic empirical study of twelve fine-grained MoE checkpoints spanning nine architecture families, with a core suite of eleven benchmarks covering knowledge QA, mathematics, code generation, and general reasoning. We find that expert selection is far more redundant than the field's operating points assume: uniformly retaining about two thirds of the selected experts preserves 98.8% of unpruned performance on average, requiring only a one-integer change and delivering 1.2-1.7x measured speedup across two serving backends. This simple baseline leaves little room for dynamic allocation at conservative budgets: even the best published rules differ from it by under 1% at matched expert budgets. Their value emerges under aggressive pruning, where the best rules recover up to 3.0% over uniform truncation, with gains concentrated in the generative tasks that suffer the sharpest degradation. Sensitivity to aggressive pruning also depends on the model: larger and thinking models are more resilient, whereas multimodal models are more vulnerable. Together, these findings reveal how much expert computation fine-grained MoEs can dispense with, and establish when dynamic allocation earns its complexity, informing both practical deployment and future pruning methods.

摘要：細粒度的專家混合（MoE）架構已成為開放權重 LLM 的主流設計，擁有數百個專家，並且每個標記選擇的專家數量也在不斷增加。這一轉變使得動態專家修剪成為降低推理成本的有吸引力的途徑。然而，現有的證據主要來自較粗糙的架構和基於可能性的多選基準，留下了三個核心問題在細粒度範疇中尚未解決：每個標記的專家選擇有多冗餘、現有的修剪方法在多大程度上利用了這種冗餘，以及什麼因素決定模型對修剪的敏感性。我們通過對十二個細粒度 MoE 檢查點的系統實證研究填補了這一空白，這些檢查點涵蓋了九個架構系列，並且有一組核心的十一個基準，涵蓋知識問答、數學、代碼生成和一般推理。我們發現專家選擇的冗餘程度遠高於該領域的運作點假設：均勻保留約三分之二的選定專家平均能保留 98.8% 的未修剪性能，只需改變一個整數，並在兩個服務後端上實現 1.2-1.7 倍的測量加速。這一簡單的基準在保守預算下幾乎沒有動態分配的空間：即使是最好的已發表規則在匹配專家預算時也僅與其相差不到 1%。它們的價值在於激進修剪的情況下出現，最佳規則在均勻截斷上恢復了最多 3.0% 的性能，增益集中在遭受最劇烈降級的生成任務上。對激進修剪的敏感性也取決於模型：較大和思維能力較強的模型更具彈性，而多模態模型則更脆弱。綜合這些發現揭示了細粒度 MoE 可以省去多少專家計算，並確定了動態分配何時值得其複雜性，為實際部署和未來的修剪方法提供了指導。

docs.title: TCMaster: Confidence-Aware Querying and Workload-Guided Physical Design for Multi-Source Traditional Chinese Medicine Knowledge Graphs
docs.text:
2609.25712v1 by Zheng Chen, Yuzhu Li, Haoxuan Li, Zhongde Zhang, Lianshun Jin, Peiwu Qin

Multi-source knowledge graphs (KGs) need query mechanisms that expose reliability and exploit domain structure. This paper presents TCMaster, a property-graph query substrate for confidence-aware traversal and workload-guided physical design over Traditional Chinese Medicine KGs. TCMaster integrates pharmacopoeias, prescriptions, molecular databases, and LLM-extracted micro-semantics into a KG with approximately 221K entities and 723K base edges. It annotates edges with provenance-level confidence, rewrites Cypher queries with confidence predicates, ranks multi-hop paths under PRODUCT, MIN, or weighted-average policies, and uses ontology skew through direction selection, herb-attribute bitmaps, and materialized shortcut edges. On Neo4j, direction selection improves attribute lookup by a factor of 1.47, shortcuts accelerate high-fanout target counting by a factor of 4.42, confidence filtering removes 39.3 percent of low-quality heterogeneous paths, and KG retrieval improves TCMbench QA accuracy by 20.0 percentage points.

摘要：多來源知識圖譜 (KGs) 需要能夠揭示可靠性並利用領域結構的查詢機制。本文提出了 TCMaster，一個針對傳統中醫知識圖譜的信心感知遍歷和工作負載導向物理設計的屬性圖查詢基礎設施。TCMaster 將藥典、處方、分子數據庫和 LLM 提取的微語義整合成一個擁有約 221K 實體和 723K 基本邊的知識圖譜。它用來源級別的信心標註邊，使用信心謂詞重寫 Cypher 查詢，根據 PRODUCT、MIN 或加權平均策略對多跳路徑進行排名，並通過方向選擇、草藥屬性位圖和具體化快捷邊來利用本體偏斜。在 Neo4j 上，方向選擇將屬性查找的效率提高了 1.47 倍，快捷方式使高分支目標計數的效率提高了 4.42 倍，信心過濾去除了 39.3% 的低質量異質路徑，而 KG 檢索使 TCMbench QA 的準確率提高了 20.0 個百分點。

docs.title: Ladders of Thought: A Self-Evolving Curriculum of Progressively Simplified Reasoning Traces
docs.text:
2609.25643v1 by Minghui Liu, Thomas Magelinski, Dehao Yuan, Qi Yu, Furong Huang

Large language models (LLMs) excel at reasoning when scaled to hundreds of billions of parameters, but small- and mid-scale models remain brittle reasoners even with knowledge distillation (KD). We present Ladders-of-Thought (LoT), a framework that improves reasoning by combining progressive question rewrites with a self-evolving curriculum. LoT automatically generates semantically faithful but easier variants of reasoning problems, organizes them into difficulty buckets using step-based measures, and employs a self-evolving bandit scheduler to allocate training adaptively. Evaluated on two reasoning domains, math and multi-hop reasoning, across 1-8B models from different families, LoT consistently improves over KD. It delivers large gains on arithmetic tasks (e.g., +32 percentage points on AddSub, +25pp on SVAMP), +2-8pp improvements on in-domain test splits, and strong though dataset-dependent benefits on multi-hop reasoning (e.g., +16pp on QASC, +25pp on StrategyQA). LoT also converges faster than staged curricula, highlighting the value of adaptive progression. These results show that progressive rewrites coupled with adaptive curricula provide a simple yet effective recipe for strengthening reasoning in smaller LLMs.

摘要：大型語言模型（LLMs）在擴展到數百億參數時在推理方面表現優異，但即使在知識蒸餾（KD）下，小型和中型模型仍然是脆弱的推理者。我們提出了思維階梯（LoT），這是一個通過結合漸進式問題重寫和自我演變課程來改善推理的框架。LoT自動生成語義上忠實但更簡單的推理問題變體，使用基於步驟的度量將其組織成難度桶，並利用自我演變的賭徒調度器自適應地分配訓練。在數學和多跳推理的兩個推理領域中，對來自不同家族的1-8B模型進行評估，LoT在KD上始終表現出改善。它在算術任務上提供了巨大的增益（例如，在AddSub上提高32個百分點，在SVAMP上提高25個百分點），在領域內測試分割上提高2-8個百分點，並在多跳推理上提供強大的但依賴於數據集的好處（例如，在QASC上提高16個百分點，在StrategyQA上提高25個百分點）。LoT的收斂速度也快於分階段課程，突顯了自適應進展的價值。這些結果顯示，漸進式重寫結合自適應課程為加強小型LLMs中的推理提供了一個簡單而有效的方案。

docs.title: Reasoning-Preserving Fine-Tuning of Post-RL LLMs with Null-Basis LoRA
docs.text:
2609.25618v1 by Wenzhi Fang, Nicholas Tzou, Lazar Valkov, Srinivas Chappidi

Reinforcement learning (RL)-based post-training has become an effective approach for eliciting reasoning capabilities in large language models (LLMs). However, adapting post-RL models to new knowledge domains or behaviors through subsequent supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can severely overwrite these capabilities. Existing approaches mitigate such forgetting through experience replay, specialized initialization, or constrained optimization using gradient projection, but either provide limited preservation or incur substantial training overhead. Our analysis shows that reasoning activations concentrate in low-dimensional subspaces, leaving substantial null-space capacity for adaptation, and that the corresponding approximate null spaces can be reliably estimated from a modest number of examples. Motivated by these observations, we propose Null-Basis Low-Rank Adaptation (NB-LoRA), a parameter-efficient method for adapting post-RL LLMs while preserving their acquired reasoning ability. We formulate reasoning retention as a layer-wise hidden-state preservation constraint and construct a fixed approximate null basis from reasoning activations. LoRA updates are then reparameterized through this basis, enforcing the preservation constraint throughout fine-tuning. Extensive experiments across multiple RL-trained LLMs and diverse downstream tasks show that NB-LoRA matches standard LoRA in adaptation performance, maintains reasoning accuracy near pre-fine-tuning levels, and generalizes this preservation to held-out reasoning benchmarks.

摘要：強化學習 (RL) 基礎的後訓練已成為引發大型語言模型 (LLMs) 推理能力的有效方法。然而，通過後續的監督微調 (SFT) 將後 RL 模型適應於新的知識領域或行為，可能會嚴重覆蓋這些能力。現有的方法通過經驗重播、專門初始化或使用梯度投影的約束優化來減輕這種遺忘，但要麼提供有限的保留，要麼產生大量的訓練開銷。我們的分析顯示，推理激活集中在低維子空間中，留下了相當大的零空間容量以供適應，並且相應的近似零空間可以從少量範例中可靠地估計。受這些觀察的啟發，我們提出了零基低秩適應 (NB-LoRA)，這是一種在保留後 RL LLMs 獲得的推理能力的同時進行適應的參數高效方法。我們將推理保留公式化為逐層隱藏狀態保留約束，並從推理激活構建一個固定的近似零基。然後，LoRA 更新通過這個基重新參數化，在微調過程中強制執行保留約束。在多個 RL 訓練的 LLMs 和多樣的下游任務上進行的廣泛實驗顯示，NB-LoRA 在適應性能上與標準 LoRA 相匹配，保持推理準確度接近微調前的水平，並將這種保留推廣到保留的推理基準上。

docs.title: ArticleMiner: Ontology-Guided Knowledge Graph Construction from Scientific Publications
docs.text:
2609.25607v1 by Md Abrar Jahin, Craig A. Knoblock, Jay Pujara

Scientific papers keep much of their quantitative content in tables and supplementary files, where a number means something only through its header, caption, unit, analytical method, and the conventions of its field. Recovering the rows and columns of a table is therefore not the same as recovering the scientific fact it reports. Most semantic table-interpretation methods assume that a clean table is already available and subsequently map its cells or columns to ontology terms, whereas most publication-level extraction systems are designed for a single domain. We study a middle path: a shared process that reads a paper and its supplementary files, gathers evidence from several parsers and a language model, and reconciles that evidence, while a bounded human-authored task module for each task supplies the domain meaning. The module lists the canonical names the graph may use, the surface forms that map to them, a small set of derivation rules and validity constraints, an identity key, and the bindings used to write RDF. It defines what a task is allowed to emit; it does not try to list every convention of a field. We build four such modules (for drug-discovery chemistry, materials science, machine learning, and mineral geochemistry) in the ArticleMiner framework, and evaluate them on 163 papers, including a new geochemistry benchmark with expert-curated ground truth. In comparisons against a same-LLM few-shot baseline, the point estimates favor ArticleMiner on all four tasks, with uncertainty on the two smaller benchmarks. The geochemistry comparison also includes access to supplementary files, so its improvement cannot be attributed to domain guidance alone.

摘要：科學論文將其定量內容大部分保留在表格和補充檔案中，其中數字的意義僅通過其標題、說明、單位、分析方法及其領域的慣例來理解。恢復表格的行和列因此並不等同於恢復其報告的科學事實。大多數語義表格解釋方法假設已經有一個乾淨的表格可用，然後將其單元格或列映射到本體術語，而大多數出版級提取系統則是針對單一領域設計的。我們研究了一條中間道路：一個共享過程，該過程閱讀論文及其補充檔案，從幾個解析器和語言模型中收集證據，並調和這些證據，同時每個任務的有界人類編寫任務模塊提供領域意義。該模塊列出了圖形可以使用的標準名稱、映射到它們的表面形式、一小組推導規則和有效性約束、一個身份鍵，以及用於編寫RDF的綁定。它定義了任務被允許發出的內容；它不試圖列出一個領域的每個慣例。我們在ArticleMiner框架中構建了四個這樣的模塊（針對藥物發現化學、材料科學、機器學習和礦物地球化學），並在163篇論文上進行評估，包括一個由專家策劃的地球化學基準的新基準。在與同一LLM的少量樣本基線進行比較時，所有四個任務的點估計均偏向ArticleMiner，對於兩個較小的基準則存在不確定性。地球化學的比較還包括對補充檔案的訪問，因此其改進不能僅歸因於領域指導。

docs.title: AkasicMEM: Governed Enterprise Memory for Agents
docs.text:
2609.25563v1 by Jeongmin Bae, Yongjae Kim, Kyoung Hur, Donghyoung Han, Min-Soo Kim

Agent memory enables enterprise agents to retain knowledge acquired during work and reuse it across tasks and agents, turning execution experience into persistent organizational knowledge. Realizing this potential requires both source--memory integration, through which enterprise sources and accumulated memory can be utilized together, and memory governance, through which shared memory remains subject to organizational policies throughout its lifecycle. These requirements interact when information from enterprise sources persists in memory. As this information is repeatedly derived and reused under changing principals and policies, source restrictions may be bypassed, resulting in information leakage. Preventing such leakage requires authorization continuity, under which source restrictions remain effective throughout source-to-memory and memory-to-memory derivation and reuse. Existing approaches address these concerns individually, but do not treat source--memory integration, memory governance, and authorization continuity as combined core design targets across the memory lifecycle. We define Governed Enterprise Memory as agent memory designed around this combined scope and present AkasicMEM as its realization. AkasicMEM realizes authorization continuity through transitive lineage, policy composition during memory formation, and policy re-evaluation during retrieval. It is built on GraphAI's AkasicDB, a unified vector--graph--relational database whose storage and execution substrate enables the underlying operations of these mechanisms to be jointly optimized and executed.

摘要：代理記憶使企業代理能夠保留在工作中獲得的知識，並在任務和代理之間重複使用，將執行經驗轉化為持久的組織知識。實現這一潛力需要源--記憶整合，通過它企業來源和累積的記憶可以一起使用，以及記憶治理，通過它共享記憶在其生命周期內仍然受組織政策的約束。當來自企業來源的信息在記憶中持久存在時，這些要求相互作用。隨著這些信息在變化的原則和政策下被反覆推導和重用，源限制可能會被繞過，導致信息洩漏。防止此類洩漏需要授權持續性，在此情況下，源限制在源到記憶和記憶到記憶的推導和重用過程中保持有效。現有的方法分別解決這些問題，但並未將源--記憶整合、記憶治理和授權持續性作為記憶生命周期中的結合核心設計目標。我們定義了受管控的企業記憶，作為圍繞這一綜合範疇設計的代理記憶，並提出了AkasicMEM作為其實現。AkasicMEM通過傳遞性血統、記憶形成過程中的政策組合以及檢索過程中的政策重新評估來實現授權持續性。它建立在GraphAI的AkasicDB之上，這是一個統一的向量--圖--關係數據庫，其存儲和執行基礎使這些機制的底層操作能夠共同優化和執行。

docs.title: DefaultGNN: A Dual-Perspective GNN Framework for Predicting Corporate Default from Buyer-Seller Transaction Networks
docs.text:
2609.25542v1 by Junghoon Kim, Hyunsung Kim, Seungyoon Choi, KyoungYong Park, Jihun Lee, YongGu Ji, Chanyoung Park

Corporate default prediction is a core problem in financial risk management, yet traditional credit models rely heavily on financial statements that are often sparse or unavailable for many firms. Corporate transaction networks offer a complementary view of real economic activity, but how risk propagates through buyer-seller relationships remains underexplored. We conduct a large-scale empirical study using real-world electronic tax-invoice data spanning six years that links transaction histories with default events, revealing that transaction-driven risk is both role-dependent (buyer or seller) and scale-dependent. Based on these findings, we construct multiplex buyer-view and seller-view transaction networks and propose DefaultGNN, a dual-perspective graph neural network-based framework for corporate default prediction. DefaultGNN integrates both views to model how risk flows through transactional relationships, achieving strong improvements over both attribute-based and graph-based baselines, especially for firms with limited intrinsic risk signals. We further provide interpretable network-based explanations by visualizing how distressed trading partners contribute to default risk. In collaboration with a licensed credit rating agency, we validate that DefaultGNN's predictions complement existing credit scoring models, improving approval rates by 7-11%p without increasing default risk among approved firms. The source code can be found at https://github.com/jhkim611/DefaultGNN

摘要：企業違約預測是金融風險管理中的核心問題，但傳統的信用模型在很大程度上依賴於往往稀疏或無法獲得的財務報表。企業交易網絡提供了對實際經濟活動的補充視角，但風險如何通過買賣關係傳播仍然未被充分探索。我們進行了一項大規模的實證研究，使用涵蓋六年的真實電子稅務發票數據，將交易歷史與違約事件聯繫起來，揭示了基於交易的風險既依賴於角色（買方或賣方），也依賴於規模。根據這些發現，我們構建了多重買方視角和賣方視角的交易網絡，並提出了DefaultGNN，一種基於雙視角圖神經網絡的企業違約預測框架。DefaultGNN整合了這兩個視角，以建模風險如何在交易關係中流動，並在基於屬性和基於圖形的基準上實現了顯著的改進，特別是對於內在風險信號有限的企業。我們還通過可視化困境交易夥伴如何對違約風險作出貢獻，提供了可解釋的基於網絡的解釋。與一家持牌信用評級機構合作，我們驗證了DefaultGNN的預測補充了現有的信用評分模型，提高了7-11%的批准率，而不增加已批准企業的違約風險。源代碼可以在 https://github.com/jhkim611/DefaultGNN 找到。

docs.title: Hill Sampling for Test-Time Scaling: A Simple and Better Alternative to Repeated Sampling, Evolution, and Training
docs.text:
2609.25510v1 by Jacob Beck, Philip V. Ogren, Ari Kobren

Large language models (LLMs) can improve solutions to verifiable scientific and algorithmic problems by spending additional computation at test time. Recent systems achieve strong results with increasingly elaborate evolutionary search harnesses or by updating model parameters during test-time training. We ask how much of this machinery is necessary. We introduce Hill Sampling, a simple procedure that repeatedly samples candidate program edits from a frozen LLM, retains the best program found so far, and conditions all subsequent samples on that program. We evaluate the method on circle packing, sums/differences of sets, and Erdos' minimum-overlap problem using three open-weight models. Hill Sampling sets a new state of the art on circle packing among published methods, improves over the AlphaEvolve reference on Erdos' minimum-overlap problem, and achieves strong results on sums and differences of finite sets. The circle-packing and Erdos results require only hours of wall-clock time on eight NVIDIA H100 GPUs. To our knowledge, we also conduct, the largest study, by parameter count, of evolution strategies (ES) applied directly to LLM weights at test time. Surprisingly, learning the weights is worse than setting the ES learning rate to zero: at zero learning rate, the method is still searching in weight space through fixed random perturbations. Those perturbations can help exploration, but randomness from token sampling is stronger still, and repeated sampling remains substantially weaker than Hill Sampling. These results suggest a simple test-time compute allocation strategy: repeatedly sample edits to the best verified solution found so far, before introducing additional complexity such as adding archives, diversity mechanisms, evolutionary scaffolds, or test-time parameter learning.

摘要：大型語言模型（LLMs）可以透過在測試時花費額外的計算來改善可驗證的科學和算法問題的解決方案。最近的系統通過越來越複雜的進化搜索工具或在測試時訓練期間更新模型參數來取得強勁的結果。我們詢問這些機制中有多少是必要的。我們引入了丘陵取樣（Hill Sampling），這是一個簡單的程序，反覆從凍結的LLM中取樣候選程序編輯，保留迄今為止找到的最佳程序，並將所有後續樣本條件化於該程序。我們在圓形打包、集合的和/差以及Erdos的最小重疊問題上使用三個開放權重模型來評估該方法。丘陵取樣在已發表的方法中為圓形打包設立了新的技術標準，並在Erdos的最小重疊問題上超越了AlphaEvolve參考，對有限集合的和與差也取得了強勁的結果。圓形打包和Erdos的結果僅需在八個NVIDIA H100 GPU上花費幾小時的實時計算時間。據我們所知，我們還進行了最大的研究，按參數數量計算，直接將進化策略（ES）應用於測試時的LLM權重。令人驚訝的是，學習權重的效果不如將ES學習率設置為零：在零學習率下，該方法仍然通過固定的隨機擾動在權重空間中進行搜索。這些擾動可以幫助探索，但來自標記取樣的隨機性更強，且重複取樣仍然顯著弱於丘陵取樣。這些結果暗示了一種簡單的測試時計算分配策略：在引入額外的複雜性（例如添加檔案、豐富機制、進化支架或測試時參數學習）之前，反覆取樣迄今為止找到的最佳驗證解的編輯。

docs.title: SMTB: Fast Structure-Mapping with Tight Bounds
docs.text:
2609.25508v1 by Daniel Weitekamp, Christopher MacLellan

Structure-mapping forms analogies by aligning systems of relationally connected elements based on shared structure instead of surface features. We introduce a new structure-mapping algorithm: Structure-Mapping with Tight Bounds (SMTB) that is 5--15x faster than the structure-mapping engine (SME) and about 50\% better at finding mappings in large nested domains. SMTB is part of the broader Cognitive Rule Engine (CRE) project, a flexible multi-language-compatible framework with an accessible Python interface to state-of-the-art C++ implementations of core algorithms commonly used in cognitive systems such as pattern matching, planning, and structure-mapping. CRE and SMTB are designed to work with a wide range of representation choices. Unlike SME, which biases higher-order correspondences in tree-like predicate logic, SMTB maximizes relational connectivity without privileging higher-order relations. This allows SMTB to work just as well over arbitrary relational graphs as it does in tree-like domains of nested predicate logic. We discuss situations where privileging "higher-orderness" in structure-mapping can cause issues, and illustrate how SMTB avoids failure modes that SME would encounter in these situations. We also provide an evaluation comparing SMTB to SME v4 over 5845 domain pairs from the SME corpus.

摘要：結構映射通過基於共享結構而非表面特徵對關聯元素系統進行對齊來形成類比。我們介紹了一種新的結構映射算法：緊界結構映射（SMTB），其速度比結構映射引擎（SME）快5到15倍，並且在大型嵌套領域中找到映射的效果約好50%。SMTB是更廣泛的認知規則引擎（CRE）項目的一部分，這是一個靈活的多語言兼容框架，具有可訪問的Python介面，連接到最先進的C++實現的核心算法，這些算法通常用於認知系統，如模式匹配、規劃和結構映射。CRE和SMTB旨在與廣泛的表示選擇一起工作。與偏向於樹狀謂詞邏輯中高階對應的SME不同，SMTB在不特權高階關係的情況下最大化關聯連接性。這使得SMTB在任意關聯圖上工作的效果與在嵌套謂詞邏輯的樹狀領域中一樣好。我們討論了在結構映射中特權「高階性」可能引發問題的情況，並說明了SMTB如何避免SME在這些情況下會遇到的失敗模式。我們還提供了一個評估，將SMTB與SME v4在SME語料庫中的5845個領域對進行比較。

docs.title: Towards participatory speech dataset curation: A queer case study and conceptual framework
docs.text:
2609.25496v1 by Brooklyn Sheppard, Anaelia Ovalle, Adina Williams, Levent Sagun

In this paper, we motivate the need for a participatory speech dataset creation framework through a case study of the LGBTQIA+, or queer, community - a community with documented concerns about AI and reported harms, including attempts to develop 'gaydar' technologies that purportedly identify individuals as queer. We review common speech data collection practices, why these methods may be unsuitable for engaging with queer speakers, and discuss previous efforts in participatory AI with queer community engagement, as well as participatory endeavours specific to speech data collection for other marginalized communities. From this review, we develop a conceptual framework for participatory speech data curation by, for, and with marginalized communities drawing on insights from co-design and knowledge sharing. We propose a framework comprising overlapping and two-way processes of defining a community, project formulation, modes of participation, and personal autonomy.

摘要：在本文中，我們通過對LGBTQIA+或酷兒社群的案例研究，激發了對參與式語音數據集創建框架的需求——這是一個對人工智慧有記錄關注和報告傷害的社群，包括試圖開發所謂的“gaydar”技術，該技術聲稱能夠識別個體為酷兒。我們回顧了常見的語音數據收集實踐，這些方法為何可能不適合與酷兒講者互動，並討論了先前在參與式人工智慧中與酷兒社群互動的努力，以及針對其他邊緣化社群的語音數據收集的參與性努力。根據這些回顧，我們制定了一個針對邊緣化社群的參與式語音數據策展的概念框架，借鑒了共同設計和知識共享的見解。我們提出了一個框架，包括定義社群、項目制定、參與模式和個人自主權的重疊和雙向過程。

docs.title: RAG-NAROK: Retrieval-Aware Knowledge Corpus Poisoning in RAG with Source-specific Refutation
docs.text:
2609.25469v1 by Abdullahil Kafi, Alvi Ataur Khalil

Retrieval augmented generation (RAG) systems have emerged as the dominant architecture for grounding large language model (LLM) outputs in verifiable external knowledge, yet their structural reliance on a dynamic retrieval pipeline introduces a largely unexplored class of adversarial vulnerability. Existing knowledge-base poisoning attacks are fundamentally static. Adversarial documents are pre-computed and injected without any awareness of what the victim system will actually retrieve for a given query, leaving the attack blind to the competitive documentary landscape that surrounds its payload in the generator's context window. Unlike traditional static poisoning attacks that are blind to the retrieved context, we introduce RAG-NAROK (Retrieval-Anchored Generation Negation And Response Quality Collapse), a RAG attack framework that adapts to the query text. RAG-NAROK exploits the transparency inherent in RAG pipeline to first extract the legitimate source identities, then generate Anchor-Specific Refutation documents that explicitly name and devalue retrieved sources while leveraging recency and authority biases to steer the text generation toward a target answer. Our results demonstrate that RAG-NAROK significantly outperforms static baselines across diverse domains, revealing a fundamental tension between RAG transparency and AI security.

摘要：檢索增強生成（RAG）系統已成為將大型語言模型（LLM）輸出與可驗證的外部知識相結合的主導架構，但它們對動態檢索管道的結構依賴引入了一種在很大程度上未被探索的對抗性脆弱性。現有的知識庫中毒攻擊基本上是靜態的。對抗性文檔是預先計算並注入的，並未考慮到受害系統在特定查詢下實際會檢索到的內容，這使得攻擊對生成器上下文窗口中其有效載荷周圍的競爭文檔環境視而不見。與對檢索上下文視而不見的傳統靜態中毒攻擊不同，我們提出了RAG-NAROK（檢索錨定生成否定與回應質量崩潰），這是一個適應查詢文本的RAG攻擊框架。RAG-NAROK利用RAG管道固有的透明性，首先提取合法的來源身份，然後生成明確命名和貶低檢索來源的錨定特定反駁文檔，同時利用近期性和權威性偏見將文本生成引導至目標答案。我們的結果表明，RAG-NAROK在多個領域顯著超越靜態基準，揭示了RAG透明性與人工智慧安全之間的根本緊張關係。

docs.title: Mining Legal Arguments in U.S. Corporate Case Law
docs.text:
2609.25441v1 by Luis Brena, William Jurayj, Gregory Deyesu, Zaid Al-Huneidi, Andrew Blair-Stanek, Benjamin Van Durme

Legal argument mining supports passage classification, retrieval, and argument completion. This work introduces an expert-annotated dataset of 42 U.S. federal tax opinions on corporate reorganizations under I.R.C. §368. To our knowledge, it is the first expert-annotated, tree-structured argument corpus for this domain. Explicit spans receive one of five functional labels: Rule, Analysis, Conclusion, Background Facts, and Procedural History. Rule, Analysis, and Conclusion spans can be linked into directed support trees, while Background Facts and Procedural History serve a contextual function. The corpus provides span-based, sentence-based, flat, and tree-structured representations. Agreement analysis shows that functional node labels are more reliable than directed support edges and implicit intermediate conclusions. Directed-path agreement is stronger than direct-edge agreement, which indicates that broad reachability is more stable than exact local decomposition. Classification experiments show that functional labels are learnable under case-disjoint evaluation. Retrieval experiments show that supervised fine-tuning improves within-case retrieval. However, cross-case generalization remains weak. The dataset supports legal passage classification and provides a conservative benchmark for structured argument mining in U.S. federal tax case law.

摘要：法律論點挖掘支持段落分類、檢索和論點補全。這項工作介紹了一個專家標註的數據集，包含42個美國聯邦稅收意見，涉及根據I.R.C. §368的公司重組。據我們所知，這是該領域第一個專家標註的樹狀結構論點語料庫。明確的範圍接收五個功能標籤之一：規則、分析、結論、背景事實和程序歷史。規則、分析和結論範圍可以鏈接成有向支持樹，而背景事實和程序歷史則起到上下文功能。該語料庫提供基於範圍、基於句子、扁平和樹狀結構的表示。協議分析顯示，功能節點標籤比有向支持邊和隱式中間結論更可靠。有向路徑的協議比直接邊的協議更強，這表明廣泛可達性比精確的局部分解更穩定。分類實驗顯示，功能標籤在案例不重疊的評估下是可學習的。檢索實驗顯示，監督微調改善了案例內的檢索。然而，跨案例的泛化仍然較弱。該數據集支持法律段落分類，並為美國聯邦稅法中的結構化論點挖掘提供了一個保守的基準。

docs.title: Robust Failure, Conservative Repair: Textual Knowledge Distillation from Cross-Model Failures
docs.text:
2609.25400v1 by Andrew Ren, Haokun Liu, Chenhao Tan

Failure-based textual knowledge distillation aims to discover gaps in a model's knowledge by examining its task errors. The distilled knowledge can be useful for the reasoning of both this model ("source model") and other models. However, this transfer of knowledge may not be stable. We define a rule atom to be a standalone rule injected into a model's textual input at inference time. A rule atom can encode transferable task knowledge or model-specific reasoning patches that can confuse other models. Also, the injected rule atoms can be misapplied to unrelated cases, causing the model to incorrectly flip its answer based on irrelevant information. Building on a pipeline that distills training examples into task-specific cheat sheets that aid model reasoning, we examine when failure-derived rules can improve these cheat sheets. Our early experiment shows rule distillation from a single model's failures underperforms the baseline cheat sheet on non-source model families. This motivates Robust Failure, Conservative Repair (RFCR), a textual distillation procedure that derives rules from failures shared across models, sharpens their application boundaries using boundary cases, and abstains when no useful rule is found. On a 400-item BIG-Bench Hard task set, RFCR improves the baseline cheat sheets from 68.50% to 71.25% (+2.75 pp; 95% CI [+1.25,+4.50]) without performance degradation on previously correct cases. Ablations and cross-model diagnostics support that accuracy gains come from both new knowledge injection and strict rule-application control.

摘要：失敗基礎的文本知識蒸餾旨在通過檢查模型的任務錯誤來發現模型知識中的空白。蒸餾的知識對於這個模型（“源模型”）和其他模型的推理都是有用的。然而，這種知識的轉移可能並不穩定。我們定義規則原子為在推理時注入到模型文本輸入中的獨立規則。規則原子可以編碼可轉移的任務知識或特定於模型的推理補丁，這些補丁可能會混淆其他模型。此外，注入的規則原子可能會被錯誤地應用到不相關的案例上，導致模型根據無關信息錯誤地改變其答案。基於將訓練範例蒸餾成有助於模型推理的任務特定備忘單的流程，我們檢查何時失敗衍生的規則可以改善這些備忘單。我們的早期實驗顯示，從單一模型的失敗中進行的規則蒸餾在非源模型系列上表現不如基線備忘單。這促使了穩健失敗、保守修復（RFCR），這是一種文本蒸餾程序，從跨模型共享的失敗中衍生規則，利用邊界案例來明確其應用邊界，並在未找到有用規則時保持靜默。在400項BIG-Bench Hard任務集上，RFCR將基線備忘單的準確率從68.50%提高到71.25%（+2.75 pp；95% CI [+1.25,+4.50]），而不會對之前正確的案例造成性能下降。消融實驗和跨模型診斷支持準確率的提升來自於新知識的注入和嚴格的規則應用控制。

docs.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning on Item-Compatibility Graphs for One-Dimensional Bin Packing
docs.text:
2609.25397v1 by M. Aslı Aydın

The one-dimensional bin packing problem (1D-BPP) is a classical NP-hard combinatorial optimization problem with applications ranging from logistics and manufacturing to cloud resource management. Although deep reinforcement learning (DRL) has become a competitive paradigm for data-driven optimization, most learned packing methods target 2D and 3D variants, and intelligent learned solvers for 1D-BPP remain scarce. In this paper, we present a novel end-to-end, size-agnostic graph reinforcement learning framework for 1D-BPP. We formulate the packing process as a Markov decision process on an item-compatibility graph, serving as a structural knowledge representation in which every action merges two partial bins that fit together. A graph neural network actor-critic policy extracts relational features from this representation and is trained through reinforcement learning and decoded by stochastic beam search, enabling a single trained model to generalize zero-shot to instances of any size. We conduct a systematic empirical study across graph encoders, DRL algorithms, reward functions, training distributions, and hyperparameters. Evaluated zero-shot on the full BPPLIB benchmark against a constructive heuristic, a grouping genetic algorithm, and recent learned methods, our data-driven policy lowers the mean optimality gap of the constructive heuristic from 2.66\% to 2.31\%, with the largest gains on structured instances. Against learned baselines evaluated on the same benchmark, it attains a lower gap on most of the nine families and is far more stable across instance distributions. On the hardest benchmark family, it outperforms a state-of-the-art learned solver that relies on column generation and integer programming, while using no solver at all. A grouping genetic algorithm remains ahead overall, and we analyze where and why the residual gap arises.

摘要：一維裝箱問題（1D-BPP）是一個經典的 NP-hard 組合優化問題，應用範圍從物流和製造到雲資源管理。雖然深度強化學習（DRL）已成為數據驅動優化的競爭性範式，但大多數學習的裝箱方法針對的是 2D 和 3D 變體，而針對 1D-BPP 的智能學習解算器仍然稀缺。在本文中，我們提出了一種新穎的端到端、大小無關的圖形強化學習框架，用於 1D-BPP。我們將裝箱過程表述為一個項目兼容性圖上的馬爾可夫決策過程，作為一種結構知識表示，其中每個行動合併兩個相容的部分箱。圖神經網絡的演員-評論者策略從這一表示中提取關係特徵，並通過強化學習進行訓練，通過隨機束搜索進行解碼，使得單個訓練模型能夠對任何大小的實例進行零樣本泛化。我們對圖編碼器、DRL 算法、獎勵函數、訓練分佈和超參數進行了系統的實證研究。在對完整的 BPPLIB 基準進行零樣本評估時，與一個建構性啟發式、一個分組遺傳算法和最近的學習方法相比，我們的數據驅動策略將建構性啟發式的平均最優性差距從 2.66\% 降低到 2.31\%，在結構化實例上獲得了最大的增益。在與在同一基準上評估的學習基準相比時，它在大多數九個家族中達到了更低的差距，並且在實例分佈上更加穩定。在最困難的基準家族中，它的表現超過了一個依賴於列生成和整數規劃的最先進學習解算器，而完全不使用任何解算器。分組遺傳算法在整體上仍然領先，我們分析了殘差差距出現的原因和位置。

docs.title: Abstracts
LLM Agents Can Easily Tamper With Their Own Traces
docs.text:
2609.30266v1 by Jeremy Qin, David Schmotz, Derck Prinzhorn, Luca Beurer-Kellner, Ameya Prabhu, Maksym Andriushchenko

Asynchronous monitoring, incident investigations, and compliance audits primarily rely on agent traces to reconstruct what happened. These analyses assume that LLM agents cannot tamper with their own execution traces. We show that local LLM agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Open Code and Grok Build fail to enforce this boundary. All tested harnesses, except Muse Code, allowed agents to delete their traces when asked, without triggering monitor guardrails. We also validate that external attackers can exploit this gap to induce trace deletion. Finally, we show that trace tampering behavior emerges naturally in frontier models, when agents try to improve their rewards. We advise practitioners to ensure trace logging happens through an independent interception mechanism outside of the agent's control, preserving trace integrity even in cases of full host compromise. Overall, our findings identify a concrete failure of trace integrity in agent infrastructure which can be used to conceal misaligned behaviors like scheming or sabotage.

摘要：非同步監控、事件調查和合規審核主要依賴代理追蹤來重建發生了什麼。這些分析假設 LLM 代理無法篡改自己的執行追蹤。我們顯示出像 Claude Code、Codex、Antigravity、Open Code 和 Grok Build 這樣的本地 LLM 代理未能強制執行這一邊界。所有測試的工具，除了 Muse Code，均允許代理在要求時刪除其追蹤，而不觸發監控防護措施。我們還驗證了外部攻擊者可以利用這一漏洞來誘導追蹤刪除。最後，我們顯示出在前沿模型中，當代理試圖改善其獎勵時，追蹤篡改行為自然會出現。我們建議實踐者確保追蹤日誌的記錄通過一個獨立的攔截機制進行，該機制不受代理控制，以保持追蹤的完整性，即使在完全主機被攻破的情況下。總體而言，我們的發現識別了代理基礎設施中追蹤完整性的具體失敗，這可以用來掩蓋不當行為，如陰謀或破壞。

docs.title: AD-WM: Action-Discriminative World Models for Counterfactual Model Predictive Control
docs.text:
2609.30264v1 by Jiabin Qiu, Zixuan Chen, Hongye Cao, Jieqi Shi, Jing Huo, Yang Gao

Latent world models are typically trained to predict factual transitions, whereas model predictive control (MPC) must compare alternative actions from the same state. A model can therefore achieve low factual prediction error yet poorly distinguish candidate actions. We introduce AD-WM, an action-discriminative joint-embedding world model for counterfactual MPC. AD-WM combines residual latent dynamics with predictor-level action-recovery regularization, using inverse dynamics and a normalized recovery objective motivated by conditional mutual information. Both objectives encourage planning transitions to preserve action information; their auxiliary heads are discarded at test time, leaving MPC unchanged. On OGBench-Cube, AD-WM improves hard-start success from 3.7% to 52.0% over a matched LeWM baseline and improves mean success over the reproduced baseline in four of five simulation environments. Planning diagnostics show that factual prediction error and whole-bank action ranking do not follow the closed-loop success ordering, whereas CEM-aligned elite regret tracks success more closely. With a frozen V-JEPA 2 encoder and matched DROID post-training, AD-WM also improves zero-shot transfer to our Franka setup, increasing basic pick-and-place success from 42.2% to 71.1% without lab-specific adaptation. These results suggest that world models for planning should preserve action-dependent differences needed for counterfactual selection, rather than optimize factual prediction accuracy alone. More videos and code are available at https://ad-wm.github.io/.

摘要：潛在世界模型通常被訓練以預測事實轉換，而模型預測控制（MPC）必須比較來自同一狀態的替代行動。因此，一個模型可以實現低的事實預測誤差，但卻無法良好區分候選行動。我們介紹了AD-WM，一種針對反事實MPC的行動區分聯合嵌入世界模型。AD-WM結合了殘差潛在動力學與預測者級別的行動恢復正則化，使用逆動力學和由條件互信息驅動的標準化恢復目標。這兩個目標都鼓勵規劃轉換以保留行動信息；它們的輔助頭在測試時被丟棄，使MPC保持不變。在OGBench-Cube上，AD-WM將硬啟動成功率從3.7%提高到52.0%，超過了匹配的LeWM基線，並在五個模擬環境中的四個中改善了平均成功率。規劃診斷顯示，事實預測誤差和整體銀行行動排名並不遵循閉環成功排序，而CEM對齊的精英後悔則更密切地追蹤成功。使用凍結的V-JEPA 2編碼器和匹配的DROID後訓練，AD-WM還改善了對我們的Franka設置的零樣本轉移，將基本的拾取和放置成功率從42.2%提高到71.1%，而無需實驗室特定的適應。這些結果表明，規劃的世界模型應該保留反事實選擇所需的行動依賴差異，而不僅僅是優化事實預測準確性。更多視頻和代碼可在 https://ad-wm.github.io/ 獲得。

docs.title: Agentic Detection of Online Conspiracies
docs.text:
2609.30250v1 by Lior Biton, Oren Tsur

Conspiratorial discourse on social media is not always expressed through explicit claims or stable lexical markers. The same surface content may express endorsement, legitimate concerns, criticism, satire, or mockery. The main challenge is therefore not only recognizing conspiracy-related claims, but inferring the speaker's intent -- the utterance's illocutionary force. We argue that this can be achieved through the use of relevant social contexts and propose an agentic framework, equipped with a set of tools supporting social queries. We demonstrate the benefits of our approach on a unique dataset of Hebrew tweets, covering 80\%--90\% of the public Hebrew tweets published over a four-year span (late 2018-- early 2023), encompassing several election cycles as well as the COVID pandemic years and related vaccination campaigns. This extensive coverage can be used in recovering different social contexts. Evaluating our framework on a manually-annotated adversarial dataset, we find that context-aware workflows consistently outperform text-only classification and that the agentic framework performs significantly better than other frameworks and settings, including a non-agentic model exposed to the same contexts available to the agent. We further provide an analysis of the results, the errors and efficiency (token economy) tradeoffs. These findings support viewing the task of conspiracy detection as a socially embedded interpretation task, in which effective classification depends not only on access to contexts, but also on adaptive reasoning in which the agent uses tools on a per-case basis, asking only for evidence relevant to its current reasoning step.

摘要：社交媒體上的陰謀論話語並不總是通過明確的聲明或穩定的詞彙標記來表達。相同的表面內容可能表達支持、合理的擔憂、批評、諷刺或嘲諷。因此，主要挑戰不僅在於識別與陰謀相關的聲明，還在於推斷說話者的意圖——話語的言外之意。我們認為這可以通過使用相關的社會背景來實現，並提出一個具備一套支持社會查詢的工具的代理框架。 我們在一個獨特的希伯來語推文數據集上展示了我們方法的好處，該數據集涵蓋了2018年底至2023年初四年期間發佈的80\%--90\%的公共希伯來語推文，涵蓋了幾個選舉周期以及COVID疫情年和相關的疫苗接種運動。這種廣泛的覆蓋可以用於恢復不同的社會背景。在一個手動標註的對抗性數據集上評估我們的框架，我們發現考慮上下文的工作流程始終優於僅基於文本的分類，並且代理框架的表現顯著優於其他框架和設置，包括暴露於相同上下文的非代理模型。我們還提供了結果、錯誤和效率（令牌經濟）權衡的分析。 這些發現支持將陰謀檢測的任務視為一個社會嵌入的解釋任務，其中有效的分類不僅依賴於訪問上下文，還依賴於適應性推理，其中代理根據具體情況使用工具，僅要求與其當前推理步驟相關的證據。

docs.title: Rolling-WAM: World Action Models with Rolling Imagination
docs.text:
2609.30247v1 by Yinghua Zhou, Junjie Ye, Yiqi Zhao, Hao Dong, Celina Shiyu Wang, Ruohai Ge, Tingyi Yang, Basile Van Hoorick, Gaurav Sukhatme, Vitor Guizilini, Yue Wang

World Action Models (WAMs) couple action generation with future visual prediction for robotic manipulation. However, completing the joint video-action denoising process at each replanning cycle incurs substantial latency, delaying action updates and limiting closed-loop responsiveness. We present Rolling-WAM, a formulation that distributes joint denoising across successive replanning cycles. Our method maintains a sliding window of video-action chunks at staggered noise levels. At each step, a rolling noise schedule fully denoises the imminent action chunk for execution, while partially refining farther-future chunks. As the window advances with new camera observations, the retained future chunks continue their denoising process. This distributes the computational cost over time while carrying an evolving visual-action context across chunk boundaries. Evaluations on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and a real-world Unitree G1 humanoid show that Rolling-WAM achieves competitive manipulation performance. By removing the need to denoise the entire prediction horizon from scratch, it delivers a 4.5x steady-state replanning speedup over standard joint WAMs.

摘要：世界行動模型（WAMs）將行動生成與未來視覺預測結合，用於機器人操作。然而，在每次重新規劃週期中完成聯合視頻-行動去噪過程會產生相當大的延遲，從而延遲行動更新並限制閉環響應能力。我們提出了Rolling-WAM，一種在連續重新規劃週期中分配聯合去噪的公式。 我們的方法保持一個在錯開噪聲水平下的視頻-行動片段的滑動窗口。在每一步中，滾動噪聲計劃完全去噪即將執行的行動片段，同時部分精煉更遠未來的片段。隨著窗口隨著新的相機觀察而前進，保留的未來片段繼續其去噪過程。這在時間上分配了計算成本，同時在片段邊界之間攜帶不斷演變的視覺-行動上下文。在LIBERO、RoboTwin和一個真實的Unitree G1人形機器人上的評估顯示，Rolling-WAM實現了具有競爭力的操作性能。通過消除從頭開始去噪整個預測範圍的需求，它在穩態重新規劃速度上比標準聯合WAMs提高了4.5倍。

docs.title: JevOut: Natural Context Can Flip Decision Models
docs.text:
2609.30243v1 by Zixiang Xu

Dedicated decision models such as Jev map unstructured language to probability distributions over finite choices, allowing their outputs to directly route requests, select tools, and trigger actions. Yet real-world inputs rarely arrive in isolation: they come with background details and surrounding context. We find that short additions that fit naturally into this context can nevertheless redirect an otherwise correct decision, even when the correct answer remains unchanged. To study this behavior, we fix a wrong target option for each initially correct item and use the model's option probabilities to refine fluent context additions while preserving the source, question, choices, and gold answer. Within 64 accepted target evaluations, the optimizer identifies contexts that redirect Jev on 312 of 508 initially correct decisions (61.4%); in 229 cases, Jev assigns at least 0.7 probability to the fixed wrong option. Across seven datasets, three additional decision systems show targeted flip rates of 64.9%-73.2% on decisions they initially answer correctly. Taken together, these results expose a pronounced fragility in current decision models: short, ordinary-looking context can shift a correct choice to a high-confidence wrong one. Because these models turn language directly into downstream choices, this sensitivity raises concerns about treating their probability outputs as reliable decision interfaces.

摘要：專門的決策模型如Jev將非結構化語言映射到有限選擇上的概率分佈，使其輸出能夠直接路由請求、選擇工具和觸發行動。然實際世界中的輸入很少是孤立到達的：它們伴隨著背景細節和周圍的上下文。我們發現，適合自然融入這種上下文的短小補充，仍然可以重新引導一個原本正確的決策，即使正確答案保持不變。為了研究這種行為，我們為每個最初正確的項目固定一個錯誤的目標選項，並利用模型的選項概率來精煉流暢的上下文補充，同時保留來源、問題、選擇和正確答案。在64個接受的目標評估中，優化器識別出能夠重新引導Jev的上下文，涉及508個最初正確的決策中的312個（61.4%）；在229個案例中，Jev對固定的錯誤選項賦予至少0.7的概率。在七個數據集上，另外三個決策系統在最初正確回答的決策上顯示出64.9%-73.2%的目標翻轉率。綜合這些結果，揭示了當前決策模型中明顯的脆弱性：短小、看似普通的上下文可以將正確選擇轉變為高置信度的錯誤選擇。由於這些模型將語言直接轉化為下游選擇，這種敏感性引發了將其概率輸出視為可靠決策界面的擔憂。

docs.title: SemMSA: Latent Semantic-Aided Robust Multimodal Sentiment Analysis with Incomplete Data
docs.text:
2609.30238v1 by Wenhao Li, Zhibin Wu, Chong Xiao, Qiangchang Wang

Recent research on Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) has focused on learning from language, visual, and acoustic modalities with incomplete data to infer human sentiment. Most studies typically compensate for missing information by reconstructing modality features or designing complicated fusion mechanisms. However, these methods still suffer from spurious generation and noisy guidance due to the lack of high-level semantic grounding in partially observed multimodal evidence. To address these issues, we propose SemMSA, a latent semantic-aided framework that constructs rich sentiment-relevant semantics with LLMs, fully integrating with all modalities via anchor-free spectral alignment. It mainly consists of Cross-modal Semantic Refinement (CSR) and Cross-modal Spectral Alignment (CSA). Specifically, CSR first adaptively extracts visual and acoustic representations by corresponding adapters to form a unified multimodal prefix with language in the frozen LLM embedding space. It then iteratively produces continuous discriminative semantic states through a token-efficient latent refinement process without decoding explicit text. Next, CSA simultaneously aligns the refined semantics with all modalities by enhancing the dominant spectral component of their kernel Gram matrix. This captures global nonlinear dependencies among all representations without relying on a predefined anchor modality. In addition, an instance-level spectral separation constraint preserves cross-sample discriminability and mitigates representation collapse. Extensive experiments on SIMS, MOSI, and MOSEI benchmarks demonstrate that SemMSA achieves state-of-the-art performance.

摘要：最近對多模態情感分析（MSA）的研究專注於從語言、視覺和聲學模態中學習不完整數據，以推斷人類情感。大多數研究通常通過重建模態特徵或設計複雜的融合機制來補償缺失的信息。然而，由於在部分觀察的多模態證據中缺乏高級語義基礎，這些方法仍然面臨虛假生成和噪聲指導的問題。為了解決這些問題，我們提出了SemMSA，一個潛在語義輔助框架，通過無錨光譜對齊，構建豐富的情感相關語義，並與所有模態完全整合。它主要由跨模態語義精煉（CSR）和跨模態光譜對齊（CSA）組成。具體而言，CSR首先通過相應的適配器自適應地提取視覺和聲學表示，形成與凍結的LLM嵌入空間中的語言統一的多模態前綴。然後，它通過一個令牌高效的潛在精煉過程，迭代生成連續的區分語義狀態，而無需解碼明確的文本。接下來，CSA通過增強它們的核Gram矩陣的主導光譜成分，同時將精煉的語義與所有模態對齊。這捕捉了所有表示之間的全局非線性依賴，而不依賴於預定義的錨模態。此外，實例級光譜分離約束保留了跨樣本的可區分性並減輕了表示崩潰。在SIMS、MOSI和MOSEI基準上的廣泛實驗表明，SemMSA達到了最先進的性能。

docs.title: Coding Agents for Generalized Task and Motion Planning Problems
docs.text:
2609.30233v1 by Matteo Merler, Bowen Li, Josh Roy, Yichao Liang, Qianwei Wang, Yixuan Huang, Tom Silver

Task and motion planning (TAMP) problems remain difficult even with full observability and object-centric states because discrete decisions are tightly coupled to geometric, kinematic, and dynamic constraints. Generalized TAMP addresses this difficulty by exploiting regularities across problem instances to reduce planning effort on new instances. However, existing methods require substantial TAMP-specific engineering. We investigate whether coding agents can automate this process by synthesizing programs that generalize across instances. Given a task description and simulator access, each agent chooses how to interact with the environment while developing a program within a fixed synthesis budget. The program is then frozen and evaluated on unseen instances. We evaluate Claude Code (Opus 5) and Codex (GPT-5.6 Sol and GPT-6 Astra) on 28 simulated environments from KinDER and PDDLStream, with object counts beyond those evaluated in the original benchmark. Across all program synthesis methods, we evaluate 980 generated programs on 100 held-out instances each, 98,000 evaluation episodes in total. Overall, we find that coding agents are surprisingly effective at generalized TAMP: all three agent configurations outperform hand-engineered planners, one-shot generation, and an LLM-based generalized planning baseline in mean success (56% to 95% versus 47% for the planners, on the 16 environments where a planner is available). As object counts grow, the agents' programs maintain higher success than the planner, using an order of magnitude less computation per instance on average. Logs show agents using interaction to calibrate physical models, test edge cases, and refine strategies. We release all code, including the full prompts given to the agents. These findings suggest that coding agents are a strong baseline for generalized TAMP.

摘要：任務與運動規劃（TAMP）問題即使在完全可觀察和以物體為中心的狀態下仍然困難，因為離散決策與幾何、運動學和動力學約束緊密相連。一般化的 TAMP 通過利用問題實例之間的規律來解決這一困難，以減少對新實例的規劃工作。然而，現有的方法需要大量特定於 TAMP 的工程。 我們研究編碼代理是否可以通過合成跨實例的一般化程序來自動化此過程。給定任務描述和模擬器訪問，每個代理選擇如何與環境互動，同時在固定的合成預算內開發程序。然後該程序被凍結並在未見過的實例上進行評估。我們在來自 KinDER 和 PDDLStream 的 28 個模擬環境中評估 Claude Code（Opus 5）和 Codex（GPT-5.6 Sol 和 GPT-6 Astra），物體數量超過原始基準中評估的數量。在所有程序合成方法中，我們在每個 100 個保留實例上評估 980 個生成的程序，總共 98,000 次評估回合。總體而言，我們發現編碼代理在一般化 TAMP 上出奇地有效：所有三種代理配置在平均成功率上超過了手工設計的規劃者、一鍵生成和基於 LLM 的一般化規劃基線（在 16 個有規劃者的環境中，成功率為 56% 至 95% 對比 47%）。隨著物體數量的增加，代理的程序在平均每個實例使用的計算量上保持比規劃者更高的成功率，並且計算量少一個數量級。日誌顯示代理使用互動來校準物理模型、測試邊界情況和完善策略。我們釋放所有代碼，包括提供給代理的完整提示。這些發現表明，編碼代理是一般化 TAMP 的強基準。

docs.title: To Trust or Not to Trust: Retrieval-Augmented Fact Checking in Speech
docs.text:
2609.30227v1 by Debajyoti Mazumder, Mamta, Abhirama Subramanyam Penamakuri

Online misinformation increasingly appears in spoken formats such as news clips, podcasts, interviews, political speeches, and social media videos, creating a need for fact-checking systems that can verify claims directly from speech. We introduce VeriSpeak, a probe benchmark for studying speech-based fact verification in Large Audio Language Models (LALMs). VeriSpeak contains 3,879 spoken claims spanning temporal, geographical, and relational facts, with balanced true and false labels. The benchmark is designed to examine whether factual verification ability transfers from text to speech, and whether retrieval-augmented LALMs can use textual evidence to correctly support or refute spoken claims. Our experiments reveal a consistent text-speech modality gap: LALMs that verify written claims reliably often fail on the same claims when spoken. Moreover, retrieval alone provides limited gains because models frequently conflate retrieved evidence with the spoken claim. In contrast, retrieval combined with explicit reasoning improves claim-evidence comparison, with a thinking-tuned LALM reaching 86.1% accuracy. VeriSpeak highlights that effective speech misinformation detection requires not only speech understanding, but also grounded reasoning over retrieved evidence. The dataset is publicly available via Hugging Face at https://huggingface.co/datasets/abhiram4572/VeriSpeak.

摘要：在線上錯誤資訊越來越多地以口語形式出現，例如新聞片段、播客、訪談、政治演講和社交媒體視頻，這創造了對能夠直接從語音中驗證主張的事實檢查系統的需求。我們介紹了 VeriSpeak，一個用於研究基於語音的事實驗證的探測基準，適用於大型音頻語言模型（LALMs）。VeriSpeak 包含 3,879 條口語主張，涵蓋時間、地理和關係事實，並且具有平衡的真實和虛假標籤。該基準旨在檢查事實驗證能力是否能從文本轉移到語音，以及檢索增強的 LALMs 是否能夠利用文本證據正確支持或反駁口語主張。我們的實驗顯示出一個持續存在的文本-語音模式差距：能夠可靠驗證書面主張的 LALMs 在口語表達相同主張時往往失敗。此外，僅僅依賴檢索提供的增益有限，因為模型經常將檢索到的證據與口語主張混淆。相對而言，將檢索與明確推理結合起來可以改善主張-證據比較，經過思考調整的 LALM 達到了 86.1% 的準確率。VeriSpeak 強調，有效的語音錯誤資訊檢測不僅需要語音理解，還需要對檢索到的證據進行基於事實的推理。該數據集可通過 Hugging Face 公開獲得，網址為 https://huggingface.co/datasets/abhiram4572/VeriSpeak。

docs.title: PoEM: Predicting RL Outcomes from Existing Policies
docs.text:
2609.30226v1 by Kimia Hamidieh, Giannis Daras, Antonio Torralba

Foundation models are post-trained with reinforcement learning (RL) to maximize specific rewards, such as human alignment, correctness, or instruction following. This post-training process is computationally intensive, sometimes unstable, and has to be run from scratch every time the reward model changes or when we want to combine multiple rewards. We hence ask: given a new reward function, is it possible to predict the RL outcomes without actually running RL on it? We answer this in the affirmative by introducing PoEM, a framework to predict the outputs of RL on a new reward function using a set of models already post-trained on other rewards. First, we show that if the new reward function can be written as a linear combination of existing ones, then the new policy in log-space can be written as a linear combination of the existing log-policies. Surprisingly, even in cases where the rewards are not linearly connected, we observe that often log-policies from RL training span an approximately low-rank subspace across rewards. To our benefit, the weighting coefficients for this combination can be estimated using only the reward or basis policy outputs on the samples. We turn these observations into an algorithm that takes post-trained models and a new reward function, and approximates the target RL policy without actually running any additional RL training. We experimentally validate our approach across synthetic and real rewards, spanning both text and image modalities.

摘要：基礎模型經過強化學習（RL）的後訓練，以最大化特定的獎勵，例如人類對齊、正確性或遵循指令。這一後訓練過程計算密集，有時不穩定，並且每當獎勵模型變更或我們想要結合多個獎勵時，都必須從頭開始運行。因此，我們提出問題：給定一個新的獎勵函數，是否可以在不實際運行 RL 的情況下預測 RL 的結果？我們的回答是肯定的，通過引入 PoEM，一個框架來預測在新獎勵函數上 RL 的輸出，使用一組已經在其他獎勵上進行後訓練的模型。首先，我們展示如果新的獎勵函數可以寫成現有獎勵的線性組合，那麼新的政策在對數空間中可以寫成現有對數政策的線性組合。令人驚訝的是，即使在獎勵並非線性連接的情況下，我們也觀察到，RL 訓練中的對數政策通常跨獎勵範圍內展現出大約低秩的子空間。對我們有利的是，這一組合的加權係數可以僅通過樣本上的獎勵或基礎政策輸出來估計。我們將這些觀察轉化為一個算法，該算法接受後訓練模型和一個新的獎勵函數，並在不實際運行任何額外的 RL 訓練的情況下，近似目標 RL 政策。我們在合成和真實獎勵上實驗性地驗證了我們的方法，涵蓋文本和圖像模態。

docs.title: TrackEverything: Long Horizon Dense Tracking via De-Duplicating 3D Scene Representations
docs.text:
2609.30222v1 by Ayush Jain, Sreeharsha Paruchuri, Ishita Gupta, Fan Zhang, Tanner Schmidt, Jakob Engel, Katerina Fragkiadaki, Adam W. Harley

Existing point tracking models face a fundamental tradeoff: they can either track a sparse set of query points over long horizons, or track all points across only short clips. We introduce TrackEverything, a 3D point tracker that breaks this trade-off by representing videos as persistent 3D scene tracks in world coordinates. Grounded in the insight that videos are 2D projections of an underlying 3D world, TrackEverything decouples model complexity from video duration, allowing it to scale with unique physical scene geometry instead. Our approach introduces three key innovations. First, we employ a voxelization-based de-duplication mechanism at sliding-window boundaries to merge co-located tracks, preventing repeated observations of the same surface from redundantly accumulating. Second, we decompose tracking into an endpoint refiner that predicts each point's destination and static-versus-dynamic classification, followed by a lightweight trajectory refiner that decodes dense trajectories exclusively for dynamic points. Third, we propose 3D WAFT, replacing memory-prohibitive 4D correlation volumes with efficient feature sampling in the scene cloud. To the best of our knowledge, TrackEverything is the first 3D tracker capable of tracking all visible points across videos exceeding 1000 frames within 40 GB of GPU memory. On TAPVid-3D, TrackEverything outperforms all open-source all-frame dense 3D trackers by more than 20% APD on short clips, while remaining competitive with state-of-the-art sparse trackers on long sequences, despite tracking far more points.

摘要：現有的點追蹤模型面臨一個基本的權衡：它們要麼能在長時間範圍內追蹤稀疏的查詢點，要麼只能在短片段內追蹤所有點。我們介紹了 TrackEverything，一款通過將視頻表示為世界坐標中的持久 3D 場景軌跡來打破這一權衡的 3D 點追蹤器。基於視頻是潛在 3D 世界的 2D 投影的見解，TrackEverything 將模型複雜性與視頻持續時間解耦，從而使其能夠根據獨特的物理場景幾何進行擴展。我們的方法引入了三個關鍵創新。首先，我們在滑動窗口邊界採用基於體素化的去重機制來合併共址的軌跡，防止對同一表面的重複觀察冗餘累積。其次，我們將追蹤分解為一個端點細化器，該細化器預測每個點的目的地和靜態與動態分類，然後由一個輕量級的軌跡細化器專門解碼動態點的密集軌跡。第三，我們提出了 3D WAFT，通過在場景雲中進行高效的特徵採樣來替代記憶體消耗過大的 4D 相關體積。據我們所知，TrackEverything 是第一個能夠在超過 1000 幀的視頻中追蹤所有可見點且僅需 40 GB GPU 記憶體的 3D 追蹤器。在 TAPVid-3D 上，TrackEverything 在短片段中超越了所有開源的全幀密集 3D 追蹤器，APD 提高了 20% 以上，同時在長序列中與最先進的稀疏追蹤器保持競爭力，儘管追蹤的點數遠超過其他模型。

docs.title: Requirement-Bound Verified Commissioning: A Frozen Four-Billion-Parameter Local Model as a Candidate Generator under an External Acceptance Layer with Verification and Release Authority
docs.text:
2609.30219v1 by Mehmet Iscan

An acceptance protocol is developed for sensor-coordinate and polarity binding in mechatronic commissioning. Candidate generation is separated from release authority. Requirements unsupported by a deterministic parser are routed to a frozen local language model with four billion parameters. Plans are released only when both facts can be derived by an external gate under a sealed grammar. One canonical answer is requested from a gold-standard user when eligible. The protocol was evaluated once under a criterion fixed before benchmark construction, on 144 tasks written by isolated agent contexts without access to the gate, grammar, or experimental plan. Three contributions are established. First, candidate generation and release decisions were measured separately. Fabricated ready plans were committed on 21 of 22 routed unanswerable tasks, and all were rejected. The same 83 releases were reproduced without model calls. Second, no false release was observed among 83 releases. A one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound of 0.0354 was obtained as a diagnostic under an independent-and-identically-distributed assumption, below the sealed 5% threshold. However, one false release was subsequently recorded among 146 releases outside the benchmark at seed 0. Third, protection against incorrect user answers was characterized. Both facts were bound from the original text on 13 of 96 answerable tasks. Incorrect answers were released in 169 of 431 pairings on the remaining tasks, including failures involving coordinate exclusion. A deployable questioning policy was not tested because eligibility was determined from the answer key. Gate sensitivity and real user behavior were not measured.

摘要：一個接受協議被開發用於機電調試中的傳感器坐標和極性綁定。候選生成與發布權限分開。對於不被確定性解析器支持的要求，則路由到一個擁有四十億參數的凍結本地語言模型。只有當兩個事實都可以在密封語法下由外部閘門推導時，計劃才會被發布。當符合條件時，會向黃金標準用戶請求一個標準答案。該協議在基準構建之前固定的標準下進行了一次評估，針對144個由孤立代理上下文編寫的任務，這些上下文無法訪問閘門、語法或實驗計劃。建立了三個貢獻。首先，候選生成和發布決策是分開測量的。在22個路由的無法回答的任務中，有21個製作的準備計劃被提交，所有計劃都被拒絕。相同的83個發布在沒有模型調用的情況下被重現。其次，在83個發布中未觀察到虛假發布。在獨立且同分佈假設下，獲得了0.0354的一側95% Clopper-Pearson上限，低於密封的5%閾值。然而，在基準之外的146個發布中，隨後記錄了一次虛假發布。第三，對不正確用戶答案的保護進行了特徵描述。在96個可回答任務中，有13個任務的兩個事實是從原始文本中綁定的。在剩餘的任務中，431對配對中有169次發布了不正確的答案，包括涉及坐標排除的失敗。未測試可部署的提問政策，因為資格是根據答案鍵確定的。閘門敏感性和真實用戶行為未被測量。

docs.title: Minimally Invasive Steering of Language Models
docs.text:
2609.30218v1 by Taha Entesari, Jingyu Zhang, Daniel Khashabi, Mahyar Fazlyab

Pre-logit steering adapts a frozen language model to a test-time reward by adding vectors to its final hidden states. Unregularized reward optimization can substantially alter the output distribution and degrade generation quality. We propose Minimally Invasive Steering Vector Optimization (MISVO), which penalizes interventions using the local KL geometry of the induced token distribution. The resulting Fisher quadratic measures distributional sensitivity and admits an analytic gradient computed through matrix--vector products with the frozen language-model head. We derive an exact decomposition of the sequence-level KL gradient into an analytic Fisher term and a suffix score-function term. For a fixed generation horizon, we show that the suffix term is second order in the steering magnitude and that three Fisher surrogates agree with the full KL gradient to first order. MISVO uses the frozen-reference surrogate to optimize position-specific interventions without updating model parameters. Across preference and code-generation tasks on models with approximately 1B--14B parameters, MISVO achieves the highest mean reward in six of seven model--task settings, with diversity and coherence scores close to those of Best-of-N.

摘要：預先邏輯引導將凍結的語言模型調整為測試時的獎勵，通過向其最終隱藏狀態添加向量來實現。未正則化的獎勵優化可能會顯著改變輸出分佈並降低生成質量。我們提出了最小侵入性引導向量優化（MISVO），該方法使用所產生的標記分佈的局部KL幾何來懲罰干預。所得到的Fisher二次型度量分佈靈敏度，並允許通過與凍結語言模型頭的矩陣-向量乘積計算解析梯度。我們推導出序列級KL梯度的精確分解，分為解析Fisher項和後綴分數函數項。對於固定的生成範圍，我們顯示後綴項在引導幅度中為二階，且三個Fisher替代品在一階上與完整的KL梯度一致。MISVO使用凍結參考替代品來優化特定位置的干預，而無需更新模型參數。在約1B-14B參數的模型上進行偏好和代碼生成任務時，MISVO在七個模型-任務設置中的六個中達到了最高的平均獎勵，且多樣性和一致性分數接近Best-of-N的水平。

docs.title: Instrumental Monitor Evasion Emerges Under Ordinary Task Pressure
docs.text:
2609.30217v1 by David Schmotz, Derck Prinzhorn, Luca Beurer-Kellner, Anselm Paulus, Ameya Prabhu, Maksym Andriushchenko

A central concern in AI safety is that agents may treat oversight as an obstacle when it conflicts with completing their goals. We study instrumental evasion, the propensity of LLM agents to circumvent runtime monitoring as a means of completing ordinary tasks. We introduce EvasionBench, a benchmark of 50 diverse task-policy pairs in which completing the task requires an operation prohibited by a runtime monitor. Agents know that their tool calls are monitored and are prompted to continue working when they pause. Across our evaluations, best-of-3 evasion attempt rates reach up to 98% and success rates up to 88%, with substantial variance across models. Claude Fable 5.1 succeeds less often, but frequently makes creative attempts to circumvent the monitor. Evasion generally increases with test-time compute, with higher evasion rates at greater reasoning effort and token use. Traces show that agents encode prohibited commands, decompose operations across tool calls, and retry until relevant context leaves the monitor's history. We also find that GPT-6 Astra's low evasion rate comes with overrefusal, as it frequently abandons otherwise solvable tasks under a denial-of-service prompt injection. Our findings show that ordinary task pressure can lead to adaptive attempts to evade runtime monitors without an explicit adversarial objective. Effective oversight must therefore remain robust against repeated attempts, as the persistence that helps agents solve difficult tasks can also drive them to circumvent their guardrails.

摘要：一個關於人工智慧安全的核心問題是，當監督與完成目標發生衝突時，代理可能會將監督視為障礙。我們研究工具性逃避，即大型語言模型（LLM）代理繞過運行時監控以完成普通任務的傾向。我們引入了EvasionBench，這是一個包含50對多樣化任務-政策的基準，其中完成任務需要進行運行時監控禁止的操作。代理知道他們的工具調用受到監控，並在暫停時被提示繼續工作。在我們的評估中，最佳的三次逃避嘗試率高達98%，成功率高達88%，且模型之間存在顯著的變異性。Claude Fable 5.1的成功率較低，但經常會創造性地嘗試繞過監控。逃避行為通常隨著測試時計算能力的增加而增加，並且在更大的推理努力和標記使用下，逃避率更高。痕跡顯示代理編碼了被禁止的命令，將操作分解到工具調用中，並重試直到相關上下文離開監控的歷史。我們還發現，GPT-6 Astra的低逃避率伴隨著過度拒絕，因為它經常在拒絕服務的提示注入下放棄本可以解決的任務。我們的研究結果顯示，普通任務的壓力可以導致適應性嘗試逃避運行時監控，而不需要明確的對抗目標。因此，有效的監督必須對重複的嘗試保持穩健，因為幫助代理解決困難任務的堅持也可能驅使他們繞過防護措施。

docs.title: Underwater C3-JEPA: An Object-Centric Cross-View World Model for ROV Salvage
docs.text:
2609.30214v1 by Yuncong Yang, Jinlong Li, Yulong Xue, Feng Wu, Chunwen Zhang, Lei Qiao, Xuyang Wang
