摘要：強化學習已成為大型語言模型（LLM）後訓練的核心組成部分，但令牌級的信用缺乏普遍接受的數學定義，使其與常用訓練信號之間的關係不明確。我們制定了三個規則條件，即完整性、前綴一致性和中立性，並證明它們唯一地決定了令牌級信用。這一特徵提供了一個統一的基礎，用於解釋現有算法中的現象，並指導改進的演員-評論家訓練程序的發展。從這個角度看，On-Policy Distillation（OPD）中的理想教師充當隱式評論家，產生與令牌級信用引起的預期策略梯度成比例的結果。儘管反應級的REINFORCE Leave-One-Out（RLOO）信號的粒度較粗，但它們與令牌級信用的預期策略梯度貢獻相匹配。我們進一步在有界結果獎勵下建立了近似信用稀疏性，並展示了在廣義優勢估計（GAE）中，中介評論家的誤差如何變得可與基礎信用相媲美。這些動機促成了政策對齊評論家訓練（PACT），該方法採用了演員-然後-評論家的更新順序，對評論家訓練應用重要性抽樣修正，並更好地將評論家與更新的策略對齊。在代理數學推理中，PACT在四個基準上達到了72.87%的平均準確率，分別超過GRPO和PPO 8.80和13.16個百分點。在SWE-bench Verified上，PACT達到了67.4%的通過率，分別超過PPO、GRPO和SAO 2.4、2.0和3.8個百分點。

docs.title: xWhyL: Causal Interactive Learning
docs.text:
2609.26037v1 by Nicholas Tagliapietra, Florian Peter Busch, Moritz Willig, Matej Zečević, Lavdim Halilaj, Juergen Luettin, Kristian Kersting

Explanations are central to causal reasoning, and cognitive science has long established that the human drive to explain is itself a mechanism for learning about causality. Despite this, learning from those abductive signals is largely ignored in artificial intelligence. While explainable AI (XAI) increasingly draws on causal models to generate explanations, the converse direction about what explanations can do for causality remains largely unexplored. To fill this gap, we propose xWhyL, a formal framework connecting causality and XAI by learning causal models from explanations. We develop a mathematical theory that translates explanations into a learning signal complementary to observational data, and demonstrate how it enables overcoming the limits of observational causal discovery. As explanations can be derived from incorrect beliefs and clash with data, a tension we call the Causal Tug-of-War, we prove conditions under which our framework rejects misspecified explanations rather than absorbing them. Our practical instantiation, Causal Interactive Learning (CIL), shows how expert explanations can efficiently support causal discovery and distinguish correct from incorrect explanations.

摘要：解釋是因果推理的核心，認知科學早已確立人類解釋的驅動力本身就是學習因果關係的機制。儘管如此，人工智慧在這些推理信號中學習的部分卻大多被忽視。雖然可解釋的人工智慧（XAI）越來越多地依賴因果模型來生成解釋，但關於解釋對因果關係的影響的反向方向仍然大多未被探索。為了填補這一空白，我們提出了xWhyL，一個通過從解釋中學習因果模型來連接因果關係和XAI的正式框架。我們發展了一個數學理論，將解釋轉化為一種補充觀察數據的學習信號，並展示了它如何使得克服觀察因果發現的限制成為可能。由於解釋可能源自錯誤的信念並與數據相衝突，我們稱之為因果拔河的緊張局勢，我們證明了在什麼條件下我們的框架會拒絕錯誤的解釋，而不是吸收它們。我們的實踐實現——因果互動學習（CIL）展示了專家解釋如何有效地支持因果發現並區分正確與錯誤的解釋。

docs.title: Compiling Sufficient Governance Context from Declared Losses and Reachable States: Exact Observation-Contract Synthesis with Cardinality and Cost Objectives
docs.text:
2609.26016v1 by Gaston Besanson

We call the object this paper derives and certifies a minimal sufficient governance context: given a finite reachable-state model, a deterministic declared verdict, and candidate observable attributes, we compute sufficient observation sets, distinguish attributes that are individually indispensable from contracts that are jointly sufficient, and select among sufficient contracts under a cardinality or declared-cost objective. An observation contract is a set of candidate attributes whose values determine the declared verdict on every reachable state; an authority contract is one selected under an objective and bound to a gate schema. We synthesize every inclusion-minimal sufficient contract where exhaustive enumeration is affordable, and a minimum-cardinality or minimum-cost contract by SAT/MaxSAT encoding otherwise, checking sufficiency directly. On a constructed code/cloud domain, the individually-indispensable core is not sufficient as an observation contract and two distinct reducts exist; a preregistered cost model separates them exactly. On a second, larger, constructed domain, the same pattern recurs, but that domain's cost model does not separate the alternatives: a fully explained cost tie, reported as found. We measure discernibility-family scaling where exhaustive enumeration is confirmed infeasible within a registered timeout, while SAT/MaxSAT synthesis solves in well under a second; MaxSAT showed no measured cardinality advantage over plain SAT. AuthorityBench compares four baselines across three domains; the declared-only baseline is not exactly sufficient on any. Every selected contract is checked for sufficiency, with a counterexample on failure and a check summary, not a portable certificate, on success -- the compiler-focused scope of a two-scope table; an independently specified end-to-end case study is registered follow-up work, not claimed here.

摘要：我們稱這篇論文所推導和證明的對象為最小充分治理背景：給定一個有限可達狀態模型、一個確定性聲明的判決，以及候選可觀察屬性，我們計算充分觀察集，區分個別不可或缺的屬性與共同充分的合約，並在基數或聲明成本目標下選擇充分合約。觀察合約是一組候選屬性，其值決定每個可達狀態上的聲明判決；權威合約是在一個目標下選擇並綁定於一個閘門架構的合約。我們合成每個包含最小的充分合約，當全面列舉是可負擔的情況下，否則通過SAT/MaxSAT編碼合成最小基數或最小成本合約，並直接檢查充分性。在一個構建的代碼/雲域中，個別不可或缺的核心作為觀察合約並不充分，且存在兩個不同的簡約；一個預註冊的成本模型恰好將它們分開。在第二個更大構建的域中，相同的模式重現，但該域的成本模型並未分開這些選擇：完全解釋的成本平局，如實報告。我們測量可辨識性家族的擴展性，其中全面列舉在註冊的超時內被確認為不可行，而SAT/MaxSAT合成在不到一秒內解決；MaxSAT在測量的基數上未顯示出相對於普通SAT的優勢。AuthorityBench在三個域中比較四個基準；僅聲明基準在任何情況下都不完全充分。每個選定的合約都檢查其充分性，失敗時提供反例，成功時提供檢查摘要，而不是可攜帶的證書——一個以編譯器為中心的兩範疇表的範圍；一個獨立指定的端到端案例研究被註冊為後續工作，並未在此聲明。

docs.title: Skytopia: Monocular Drone Navigation with Action-Conditioned Latent World Models
docs.text:
2609.26007v1 by Yuhang Zhang, Rangya Zhang, Yujing Shang, Zhuoyuan Yu, Weiying Wang, Steven Yang, Qingsong Yan, Chao Yan, Mir Feroskhan

Monocular drone navigation requires reaching a goal in an unseen environment from a single forward-facing camera, which offers few cues for depth and scale. World models address this by modelling how observations evolve under actions, but they are built to be executed: the prediction is produced at deployment and fed back into action generation at every control step. We argue that what a policy needs from a world model is not the prediction but the representation required to produce it: in flight the executed action explains almost all of the change between observations, so prediction reduces to reprojecting a static scene under a known displacement. We therefore introduce skytopia, a policy built on an action-conditioned latent world model, and the 3D Gaussian Splatting platform on which it is trained. A forward objective predicts the representation of the next observation from the intended motion, and an inverse objective recovers that motion from the predicted transition. Because the prediction never reaches action generation, the predictor is discarded and one policy serves point-goal, image-goal, and goal-free navigation. Simulation experiments show that skytopia outperforms every baseline under all three specifications, attaining 57.8%, 66.0%, and 49.0% success rate, while discarding the predictor removes 59.4% of the inference cost. The same policy is subsequently deployed on a physical drone without fine-tuning and reaches goals in indoor, open outdoor, and woodland environments.

摘要：單目無人機導航需要從單個前向攝像頭在未見環境中達到目標，這提供了很少的深度和尺度線索。世界模型通過建模觀察在行動下如何演變來解決這個問題，但它們是為了執行而構建的：預測在部署時產生，並在每個控制步驟中反饋到行動生成中。我們認為，政策從世界模型中需要的不是預測，而是產生它所需的表示：在飛行中，執行的行動幾乎解釋了觀察之間的所有變化，因此預測簡化為在已知位移下重新投影靜態場景。因此，我們引入了skytopia，一個基於行動條件潛在世界模型的政策，以及其訓練所用的3D高斯點雲平台。一個前向目標從預期運動中預測下一個觀察的表示，而一個反向目標則從預測的轉換中恢復該運動。由於預測從未達到行動生成，預測器被丟棄，並且一個政策服務於點目標、圖像目標和無目標導航。模擬實驗顯示，skytopia在所有三個規範下均超越了每個基準，成功率分別達到57.8%、66.0%和49.0%，而丟棄預測器則減少了59.4%的推理成本。同一政策隨後在物理無人機上部署，無需微調，並在室內、開放戶外和林地環境中達到目標。

docs.title: CausalLoss-Fin: Attributing Financial-Agent Loss to Decisions and Infrastructure Faults
docs.text:
2609.25960v1 by Abhishek Sharma

When an agent handling a payment exception loses money, the agent-step attribution methods this paper compares against will name one of its actions. They will do so even when a settlement message was dropped and the agent never had a chance: they intervene on agent actions and do not expose infrastructure faults as intervenable variables, so every dollar they explain is charged to a decision. We take a benchmark whose fault process is explicit and replayable, decompose each episode's realised delivery schedule into named, individually repairable messages, and intervene on both the agent's choices and the infrastructure's. A telescoping identity splits any policy's loss exactly three ways: an infrastructure effect, a policy differential against the best implementable policy, and a reference-policy residual. Two of the three can be negative, so none is a share; Shapley then divides the first into signed allocations over individual messages. One result is structural and needs no corpus: an agent-only baseline identifies no infrastructure cause, because its model contains no variable that could name one. What 545 planted episodes across 3 policies measure is the size of that consequence. It misfiles 100% of infrastructure episodes and charges $114,383.40 to the agent. Repairing what it names recovers 0.0% of the available loss; repairing a minimal sufficient set recovers 100.0%. Scoring messages one at a time is not merely imprecise: 27.8% (95% CI: 23.3--32.3%) of episodes do not decompose additively. We evaluate deterministic programmatic policies rather than language-model agents, which is what makes replay exact and which limits external validity to stochastic agents. The prevalence figures are properties of this generator, not field rates.

摘要：當處理支付異常的代理人損失金錢時，本論文比較的代理步驟歸因方法將會指名其某一行動。即使在結算消息被丟棄且代理人從未有機會的情況下，它們仍會這樣做：它們干預代理行動，並且不將基礎設施故障視為可干預變量，因此它們解釋的每一美元都歸因於一個決策。我們採取一個故障過程明確且可重播的基準，將每個實現的交付時間表分解為命名的、可單獨修復的消息，並對代理的選擇和基礎設施進行干預。一個縮放身份將任何政策的損失精確地分為三個部分：基礎設施效應、相對於最佳可實施政策的政策差異，以及參考政策的殘差。三者中有兩個可以是負數，因此沒有一個是份額；Shapley 然後將第一部分劃分為對個別消息的簽名分配。一個結果是結構性的，並且不需要語料庫：僅代理的基準無法識別任何基礎設施原因，因為其模型中不包含可以命名的變量。545 個在 3 種政策下植入的實例測量的是這一後果的大小。它錯誤歸檔 100% 的基礎設施實例，並向代理人收取 $114,383.40。修復其所命名的內容回收 0.0% 的可用損失；修復一個最小充分集回收 100.0%。逐一評分消息不僅僅是不精確的：27.8%（95% CI：23.3--32.3%）的實例無法加法分解。我們評估確定性程序政策而非語言模型代理，這使得重播變得精確，並限制外部有效性於隨機代理。這些流行率數據是這個生成器的特性，而不是現場比率。

docs.title: Prediction Is Not Detection: Evaluating Pre-Recognition Claims in Longitudinal Clinical AI
docs.text:
2609.25852v1 by Jing Yang, Long R. Jiao, Xiujun Cai, Zongjiu Zhang

Clinically useful early detection requires validated pre-recognition lead time. Yet event-based evaluations of longitudinal clinical AI can treat recognition-mediated care-process signals as shortcuts and recognition-dependent endpoints as reference standards, inflating apparent performance and lead time while undermining cross-center transport. Such results may serve prognosis without establishing detection before recognition. We define an interval-censored pre-recognition transition, an independent as-of reference standard, and a prespecified recognition proxy to make the claim testable.

摘要：臨床上有用的早期檢測需要經過驗證的預認識提前時間。然而，基於事件的長期臨床人工智慧評估可以將認識介導的護理過程信號視為捷徑，並將依賴認識的終點視為參考標準，這樣會膨脹表面性能和提前時間，同時削弱跨中心的轉運。這樣的結果可能有助於預後，但並未在認識之前建立檢測。我們定義了一個區間右截斷的預認識轉變，一個獨立的即時參考標準，以及一個預先指定的認識代理，以使該主張可測試。

docs.title: MorphoSHAP: Rethinking the Unit of Attribution in Explanation for Deep Visual Models
docs.text:
2609.25815v1 by Anirudh Prabhakaran, Alexandre Rocchi, Gianni Franchi

Visual attribution methods typically explain predictions using pixels, superpixels, or regular patches. These representations can localize important regions, but provide limited information about their structure. We introduce MorphoSHAP, a model-agnostic post-hoc method that instead uses morphological shapes as the players of a Shapley attribution game. Using the Tree of Shapes, each shape is described by its scale, geometry, and signed contribution, providing explanations of where the evidence lies, what type of structure carries it, and how strongly it affects the prediction. This shared morphological vocabulary enables spatial, textual, and global class-level explanations beyond image-specific heatmaps. To the best of our knowledge, MorphoSHAP is the first SHAP-based image attribution framework to combine these different forms of explanation. Across five diverse datasets and three architectures, MorphoSHAP achieves strong insertion/deletion performance and outperforms competing attribution methods on several benchmarks. Finally, a user study shows that MorphoSHAP provides explanations that are easy to use and are preferred over standard attribution baselines.

摘要：視覺歸因方法通常使用像素、超像素或常規區塊來解釋預測。這些表示可以定位重要區域，但對其結構提供的資訊有限。我們介紹了 MorphoSHAP，一種與模型無關的事後方法，該方法使用形態學形狀作為 Shapley 歸因遊戲的參與者。利用形狀樹，每個形狀都由其尺度、幾何形狀和簽名貢獻來描述，提供了證據所在的位置、承載它的結構類型以及它對預測影響的強度的解釋。這種共享的形態學詞彙使得超越圖像特定熱圖的空間、文本和全局類別級解釋成為可能。據我們所知，MorphoSHAP 是第一個基於 SHAP 的圖像歸因框架，結合了這些不同形式的解釋。在五個多樣的數據集和三種架構中，MorphoSHAP 實現了強大的插入/刪除性能，並在幾個基準測試中超越了競爭的歸因方法。最後，一項用戶研究顯示，MorphoSHAP 提供的解釋易於使用，並且比標準歸因基準更受偏愛。

docs.title: LingLan: An Advancing Traditional Chinese Medicine Diagnosis LLM with Multimodal Data
docs.text:
2609.25715v1 by Zheng Chen, Zhicheng Du, Haoxuan Li, Yingshan Liang, Peiwu Qin

Though artificial intelligence (AI) increasingly transforms modern medicine, its integration into Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) has been relatively slow, primarily due to TCM's reliance on holistic, subjective diagnostic methods---namely Inspection, Auscultation and Olfaction, Inquiry, and Palpation(I-AOI-P)---which are difficult to align with quantitative, standardized medical systems. In this work, we introduce a Unification Framework for Multimodal Data (UFMD), which automatically processes tongue and pulse images into structured, clinically standard descriptions, integrating multi-source diagnostic information into a unified digital record of I-AOI-P process. Building on this structured data, we create LingLan-14B, a TCM-specific large language model fine-tuned via supervised learning to emulate the diagnostic logic and workflow of I-AOI-P process. Experimental results show that our method significantly enhances diagnostic accuracy, achieving a relative improvement of 103.5% over the baseline (62.72% vs. 30.82%) and reaching an F1-score of up to 82%.

摘要：儘管人工智慧（AI）日益改變現代醫學，但其在傳統中醫（TCM）中的整合相對緩慢，主要是因為中醫依賴於整體的、主觀的診斷方法——即觀察、聽診與嗅診、詢問和觸診（I-AOI-P）——這些方法難以與定量、標準化的醫療系統對齊。在這項工作中，我們介紹了一個多模態數據統一框架（UFMD），該框架自動將舌頭和脈搏圖像處理成結構化的臨床標準描述，將多來源的診斷信息整合到I-AOI-P過程的統一數字記錄中。在這些結構化數據的基礎上，我們創建了LingLan-14B，這是一個針對中醫的特定大型語言模型，通過監督學習進行微調，以模擬I-AOI-P過程的診斷邏輯和工作流程。實驗結果顯示，我們的方法顯著提高了診斷準確性，相較於基準提高了103.5%（62.72% vs. 30.82%），F1-score達到82%。

docs.title: Interpretable AI plus Handheld, Portable Retinal Photographs: A Low-Cost Glaucoma Screening Solution for West Africa
docs.text:
2609.25697v1 by Charis Y. N. Chiang, Tarela Sarimiye, Adeyinka Ashaye, Martin Buist, Michael A. Hauser, Olusola Olawoye, Michaël J. A. Girard

Purpose: To develop and evaluate an interpretable artificial intelligence (AI) framework for glaucoma screening from low-cost portable, handheld retinal fundus photographs in a West African population and to compare its performance with clinical tabletop fundus imaging. Methods: We used data from a community-based study of 681 participants (1,362 eyes) in Nigeria, comprising 414 glaucoma, 478 glaucoma suspect, and 470 non-glaucoma eyes. Fundus photographs were acquired using the low-cost handheld, portable Volk Viva retinal camera and the Canon CR-2-AF tabletop camera. We fine-tuned component models separately to each device to perform vessel segmentation, cup and disc boundary segmentation, and feature extraction to detect optic nerve head features. A final classification model combined these components to classify scans as glaucoma, glaucoma suspect or non-glaucoma. Feature-weight analysis and Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping were used for interpretation. Results: The models performed well on both Volk Viva and Canon CR-2-AF images: Vessel segmentation: 0.98 Dice Coefficient (DC) (Volk) and 0.94 DC (Canon); Cup and disc segmentation: 0.95 DC (Volk) and 0.96 DC (Canon); Optic nerve head feature detection: area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUCs) of 0.83$\pm$0.03 (Volk) and 0.87$\pm$0.04 (Canon); Classification model: AUCs of 0.85$\pm$0.01 (Volk) and 0.93$\pm$0.01 (Canon). Reports for each image, present model decision confidence scores and decision-rationale visualizations to support clinical interpretation. Conclusions: Volk Viva results were reasonably comparable to Canon CR-2-AF in the component models and not far behind in classification. This shows that interpretable AI combined with low-cost, portable imaging may enhance community-level glaucoma screening, especially in settings with limited specialist access and resources.

摘要：目的：開發和評估一個可解釋的人工智慧（AI）框架，用於從低成本的便攜式手持視網膜眼底照片中進行青光眼篩查，針對西非地區的人群，並將其性能與臨床桌面眼底成像進行比較。方法：我們使用了來自尼日利亞681名參與者（1,362隻眼睛）的社區基礎研究數據，包括414隻青光眼、478隻青光眼可疑眼和470隻非青光眼眼睛。眼底照片是使用低成本的手持便攜式Volk Viva視網膜相機和Canon CR-2-AF桌面相機獲取的。我們分別對每個設備的組件模型進行微調，以執行血管分割、杯盤邊界分割和特徵提取，以檢測視神經頭特徵。最終分類模型將這些組件結合起來，將掃描結果分類為青光眼、青光眼可疑或非青光眼。特徵權重分析和梯度加權類別激活映射被用於解釋。結果：這些模型在Volk Viva和Canon CR-2-AF影像上表現良好：血管分割：0.98 Dice Coefficient (DC)（Volk）和0.94 DC（Canon）；杯盤分割：0.95 DC（Volk）和0.96 DC（Canon）；視神經頭特徵檢測：受試者工作特徵曲線下面積（AUCs）為0.83$\pm$0.03（Volk）和0.87$\pm$0.04（Canon）；分類模型：AUCs為0.85$\pm$0.01（Volk）和0.93$\pm$0.01（Canon）。每張影像的報告中，呈現模型決策信心分數和決策理由可視化，以支持臨床解釋。結論：Volk Viva的結果在組件模型中與Canon CR-2-AF相當可比，且在分類上也不遜色。這表明，可解釋的AI結合低成本的便攜式成像可能會增強社區層級的青光眼篩查，特別是在專家訪問和資源有限的環境中。

docs.title: ShowTellArena: Evaluating Business Workflow Understanding from Demonstrations
docs.text:
2609.25467v1 by David Garg, Ritobrata Sarkar, Ehsan Azarnasab, Siddhartha Borah

We often teach a colleague by showing the work and explaining the decisions as we go. How can we check what an agent understood from the same lesson? We introduce ShowTellArena, a benchmark protocol and public dataset for comprehension after narrated business demonstrations. The v1.0 release contains 50 business workflow tasks, with recordings, screenshots, narration, fixture seeds, and 502 questions. Tasks span finance, hiring, procurement, customer decisions, inventory, and logistics. The protocol holds the business scenario and quiz fixed while allowing each product to capture the lesson through its own teaching interface. Questions test operational rules, boundaries, exceptions, and errors in proposed automations. We analyze 218 selected pilot attempts across 39 workflow cases, including 28 cases attempted by all three evaluated systems. These exploratory results expose both answer errors and failures to complete the teaching experience. We describe the release's verification gaps and the pilot's uneven coverage, exclusions, and grading provenance. The contribution is an inspectable dataset and assessment workflow that others can extend; the selected pilot is not a controlled product ranking.

摘要：我們經常通過展示工作並在過程中解釋決策來教導同事。我們如何檢查代理從同一課程中理解了什麼？我們介紹了ShowTellArena，一個基準協議和公共數據集，用於在敘述商業演示後的理解測試。v1.0版本包含50個商業工作流程任務，包含錄音、截圖、敘述、固定種子和502個問題。任務涵蓋財務、招聘、採購、客戶決策、庫存和物流。該協議保持商業場景和測驗不變，同時允許每個產品通過自己的教學界面捕捉課程。問題測試提議自動化中的操作規則、邊界、例外和錯誤。我們分析了39個工作流程案例中218個選定的試點嘗試，包括所有三個評估系統都嘗試的28個案例。這些探索性結果揭示了答案錯誤和未能完成教學體驗的情況。我們描述了版本的驗證差距以及試點的不均勻覆蓋、排除和評分來源。這一貢獻是一個可檢查的數據集和評估工作流程，其他人可以擴展；所選的試點不是一個受控的產品排名。

docs.title: Passes Alone, Fails Together: Benchmarking Semantic Coordination in Parallel LLM-Agent Development
docs.text:
2609.25396v1 by Haocheng Xia, Eugene Wu, Yongjoo Park

Parallel coding agents can produce patches that work alone but fail when merged. This happens when one agent changes an interface or rule that another agent still relies on. We study these failures with stale, a benchmark for semantic coordination. Our evaluation runs the same tests on each patch alone and on their combination, counting only failures introduced by combining the patches. We use three tiers: synthetic tasks with controlled interface changes, pairs of merged pull requests, and constructed tasks that use real Django helpers. Among 834 runs on 417 mined Django pairs, only one showed interference after correcting the grading procedure. On constructed tasks using 12 Django helpers, interference occurred in 97% of runs. A message describing the completed concurrent change recovered 82% of runs. Reviewed pull requests may contain few unresolved parallel changes, even when agents fail on controlled tasks using real code. The constructed failure rates do not estimate how often these problems occur in practice.

摘要：平行編碼代理可以產生獨立運作但合併後失敗的補丁。當一個代理改變了另一個代理仍然依賴的介面或規則時，就會發生這種情況。我們使用 stale 這個語義協調的基準來研究這些失敗。我們的評估對每個補丁單獨和它們的組合進行相同的測試，只計算由合併補丁引入的失敗。我們使用三個層級：具有控制介面變更的合成任務、合併的拉取請求對，以及使用真實 Django 幫助器的構建任務。在對 417 個挖掘的 Django 對進行的 834 次運行中，只有一次在修正評分程序後顯示出干擾。在使用 12 個 Django 幫助器的構建任務中，97% 的運行出現了干擾。一條描述已完成的並行變更的消息恢復了 82% 的運行。即使在使用真實代碼的控制任務中，審查的拉取請求也可能包含少量未解決的平行變更。構建的失敗率並不能估計這些問題在實踐中發生的頻率。

docs.title: From Decorative to Load-Bearing: Task Difficulty Shapes the Causal Role of Chain-of-Thought
docs.text:
2609.25366v1 by Renee Jia, Di Mu

Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is only meaningful if written reasoning causally constrains the answer. We introduce continuation-based causal testing, an ablation-patch intervention that perturbs one reasoning step, truncates the chain, and forces the model to continue from the corrupted prefix. It measures how load-bearing a CoT is for the final answer, a behavioral notion distinct from mechanistic faithfulness. Across Gemma-2-9B-IT, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B on GSM8K, MMLU, and BIG-Bench Hard, CoT load-bearingness tracks model-relative task difficulty: on easy tasks models silently bypass their own reasoning; on hard tasks they follow corrupted steps and propagate errors. A matched 2x2 analysis shows task difficulty dominates perturbation type: error propagation rises 16x from GSM8K to BBH multistep arithmetic, and a variance partition over 28,584 continuations attributes 98.8% of explained deviance to task difficulty versus 0.8% to perturbation type. Reasoning-specific RL suppresses error propagation and compresses the gradient. A four-variant judge-sensitivity analysis and blind two-annotator study (n=500) show the error-propagation vs. non-propagation label is invariant to judge prompt, with perfect inter-annotator agreement (Cohen's kappa = 1.00). This gradient creates a structural problem for CoT-based oversight and AI safety monitoring: where the trace is easy to read it carries little signal, and where it matters errors propagate before a monitor can intervene. Linear probes on hidden states separate silent bypass, self-correction, and error propagation, but additive activation steering provides limited causal control, flipping only about 25% of error-propagation cases at best. Behavioral mode is readable but not reliably controllable.

摘要：Chain-of-thought (CoT) 監控只有在書面推理對答案有因果約束時才有意義。我們引入基於延續的因果測試，一種切除干預，擾動一個推理步驟，截斷鏈條，並強迫模型從損壞的前綴繼續。它衡量 CoT 對最終答案的承載能力，這是一種與機械忠實性不同的行為概念。在 Gemma-2-9B-IT、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 和 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 在 GSM8K、MMLU 和 BIG-Bench Hard 上的實驗中，CoT 的承載能力與模型相對的任務難度相關：在簡單任務上，模型靜默地繞過自己的推理；在困難任務上，它們遵循損壞的步驟並傳播錯誤。一項匹配的 2x2 分析顯示任務難度主導了擾動類型：從 GSM8K 到 BBH 多步算術，錯誤傳播上升了 16 倍，對 28,584 次延續的方差分解將 98.8% 的解釋偏差歸因於任務難度，而 0.8% 歸因於擾動類型。針對推理的強化學習抑制了錯誤傳播並壓縮了梯度。一項四變量的評審敏感性分析和盲目的雙標註者研究（n=500）顯示，錯誤傳播與非傳播標籤對評審提示不變，且標註者之間的協議完美（Cohen's kappa = 1.00）。這一梯度為基於 CoT 的監督和 AI 安全監控創造了一個結構性問題：當痕跡容易閱讀時，它攜帶的信號很少，而在重要的地方，錯誤在監控者介入之前就已經傳播。對隱藏狀態的線性探測區分了靜默繞過、自我修正和錯誤傳播，但加性激活引導提供的因果控制有限，最多僅能翻轉約 25% 的錯誤傳播案例。行為模式可讀但不可靠可控。

docs.title: Exactness at Inference: A Representational Criterion for Out-of-Distribution Generalization
docs.text:
2609.24942v1 by Filipe Marinho Rocha, Inês Dutra, Vítor Santos Costa, Luís Paulo Reis

A model generalizes outside its training distribution only when it computes a representation structurally equivalent to the generating mechanism, not an approximation fitted to it. Such equivalence is necessary for exactness in and out of distribution, and extrapolation is governed by this exactness at inference, whatever its realization. Tensor Logic shows this: a zero-temperature contraction is equivalent to discrete logic, deducing in place with no artefact extracted, its tensors Boolean, its embeddings orthonormal, only its arithmetic continuous. Lacking infinite recursion it reaches Datalog, not Prolog, and though exact over closed domains it needs external memory to bind a novel entity. The criterion needs neither a discrete representation nor an extracted expression, and constrains inference, not training: an exact marginal in $[0,1]$ passes, a Neural Network thresholded to a hard label does not. Logic Tensor Networks fail it, while differentiable ILP and Tensor Logic at $T=0$ pass. Piecewise-affine extrapolation divergence and an inability to bind novel entities are two faces of a shortfall in exact representability. For hybrid architectures, a propagation rule follows: the output inherits the bounds of every fitted estimator on its path, explaining which axes fail in equivariant models and the ARC-AGI induction/transduction split. Only an exact hypothesis class certifies what the training data leave underdetermined: on a law-derived partition it finds the $56.3\%$ of distant queries that are answerable, which ensembles meet with false confidence and distance metrics rank backwards. Common inductive biases, from symmetries to memory, reach exactness only because humans inject them, an argument for inducing exact representations rather than fitting surrogates whose residuals, even at the arithmetic floor in training, diverge outside the data and compound under composition.

摘要：模型只有在計算出與生成機制結構上等價的表示時，才能在其訓練分佈之外進行泛化，而不是對其進行擬合的近似。這種等價性對於分佈內外的精確性是必要的，而外推則受此精確性在推理中的支配，無論其實現為何。張量邏輯顯示了這一點：零溫度收縮等價於離散邏輯，無需提取任何工件即可在當地推導，其張量為布爾型，其嵌入為正交正規，只有其算術為連續的。缺乏無限遞歸，它達到的是Datalog，而不是Prolog，儘管在封閉域上是精確的，但它需要外部記憶來綁定新實體。該標準既不需要離散表示，也不需要提取表達，並限制推理，而不是訓練：在$[0,1]$中的精確邊際通過，而閾值為硬標籤的神經網絡則不通過。邏輯張量網絡未能滿足該標準，而可微分的ILP和在$T=0$的張量邏輯則通過。分段仿射外推的發散和無法綁定新實體是精確可表示性不足的兩個方面。對於混合架構，傳播規則遵循：輸出繼承其路徑上每個擬合估計器的界限，解釋哪些軸在等變模型中失敗以及ARC-AGI的歸納/轉導分裂。只有精確的假設類才能證明訓練數據留下的未確定性：在基於法律的劃分上，它找到了$56.3\%$的可回答遠程查詢，而這些集合以虛假的信心相遇，距離度量則向後排名。常見的歸納偏見，從對稱性到記憶，之所以達到精確性，僅僅是因為人類注入了它們，這是一個支持誘導精確表示的論點，而不是擬合殘差的替代品，這些替代品即使在訓練中的算術底線上，也會在數據之外發散並在組合下加劇。

docs.title: Et Tu, Brute? Economic Misalignment in Personal AI Agents
docs.text:
2609.24927v1 by Aman Priyanshu, Supriti Vijay, Brian Jabarian, Niloofar Mireshghallah

Personal AI agents make recommendations and take actions on people's behalf in high-stakes economic contexts, e.g., buying a flight, choosing health insurance, or selecting a graduate program. The agent is given access to the user's personal context, e.g., their email inbox and a structured profile of personal attributes, with the intention of making an optimal, personalized decision for the user. We show that by simply providing this personal context, the agent steers recommendations based on inferred wealth, without being explicitly instructed to do so. In a suite of 325K experiments on 13 agents across three types of economic decisions (flights, health insurance, and graduate programs), we find that 8 models systematically choose more expensive options for wealthier users when requests are identical. This steering continues even when it directly goes against the user's stated objective: when explicitly instructed to find the cheapest option, some agents still act on the wealth profile they have inferred. It also occurs when wealth is inferred from ambient data, such as emails unrelated to the task. And it persists under privacy controls that block specific attributes: blocking financial attributes largely removes the disparity, but blocking other attributes leaves it unchanged and can increase it by up to 40% for insurance, as agents rely on the remaining signals to infer wealth. Larger and more capable models are no better; Claude Opus 4.8 shows the largest effect. We term this misalignment "adversarial delegation", in which the very conditions that make a personal AI agent useful - access to personal information - enable it to act against the user's interests.

摘要：個人 AI 代理在高風險的經濟情境中代表人們做出建議和行動，例如購買航班、選擇健康保險或選擇研究生課程。該代理獲得用戶的個人背景資訊，例如他們的電子郵件收件箱和結構化的個人屬性檔案，旨在為用戶做出最佳的個性化決策。我們顯示，僅僅提供這些個人背景資訊，代理就能根據推斷出的財富來引導建議，而不需要明確指示這樣做。在對 13 個代理進行的 325K 實驗中，涵蓋三種類型的經濟決策（航班、健康保險和研究生課程），我們發現 8 個模型在請求相同的情況下，系統性地為較富裕的用戶選擇更昂貴的選項。這種引導即使在直接違反用戶明確目標的情況下仍然持續存在：當明確指示尋找最便宜的選項時，一些代理仍然根據他們推斷出的財富檔案行動。當財富是從與任務無關的環境數據（例如電子郵件）推斷時，這種情況也會發生。而且在阻止特定屬性的隱私控制下也會持續存在：阻止財務屬性在很大程度上消除了差異，但阻止其他屬性則保持不變，並且對於保險，可能會增加高達 40% 的差異，因為代理依賴剩餘的信號來推斷財富。更大且更強大的模型並沒有更好；Claude Opus 4.8 顯示出最大的影響。我們將這種不對齊稱為「對抗性委託」，在這種情況下，使個人 AI 代理有用的條件——訪問個人信息——使其能夠反對用戶的利益行動。

docs.title: From Pattern Recognizers to Personalized Companions: A Survey of Large Language Models in Mental Health
docs.text:
2609.25186v1 by He Hu, Yucheng Zhou, Qianning Wang, Yingjian Zou, Chiyuan Ma, Juzheng Si, Jianzhuang Liu, Zitong Yu, Laizhong Cui, Fei Ma, Qi Tian

The rising global prevalence of mental health conditions, together with longstanding barriers in traditional healthcare, such as limited resources, high cost, stigma, and privacy concerns, has created an urgent need for accessible and scalable support. Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as a transformative technology with strong potential to democratize mental health support through advanced natural language understanding and generation. However, the rapidly expanding, fragmented body of work in this area lacks a coherent evolutionary narrative, making it difficult to contextualize current progress and identify future directions. This survey addresses this gap by organizing and analyzing the literature around a central thesis: the role of LLMs in mental health is evolving through three distinct, increasingly sophisticated phases. We trace this trajectory from Phase I, in which LLMs act primarily as passive Information Tools and Pattern Recognizers for assessment; through Phase II, where they function as Empathetic Conversationalists for in-the-moment, stateless interactions; to the current frontier, Phase III, which seeks Longitudinal, Personalized Companions implemented as stateful cognitive agents. To support this framework, we systematically review core technologies, agent architectures (Profile, Memory, Reasoning, and Planning), and the critical infrastructure of datasets and benchmarks, highlighting how their evolution underpins this developmental path. Viewing the field through this developmental lens, we provide a comprehensive synthesis of existing work, an insightful narrative of its trajectory, and a clear roadmap for future innovation in responsible, effective, and human-centered AI for mental healthcare. A curated collection of the resources reviewed in this survey is available at our project repository: https://github.com/Emo-gml/Awesome-Mental-Health-LLMs.

摘要：全球心理健康狀況的上升流行率，加上傳統醫療中長期存在的障礙，如資源有限、高成本、污名化和隱私問題，創造了對可獲得和可擴展支持的迫切需求。大型語言模型（LLMs）已經成為一種變革性技術，具有通過先進的自然語言理解和生成來民主化心理健康支持的強大潛力。然而，這一領域快速擴展且支離破碎的研究體系缺乏一致的演變敘事，這使得難以將當前的進展置於上下文中並確定未來的方向。本調查通過圍繞一個中心論題組織和分析文獻，填補了這一空白：LLMs在心理健康中的角色正通過三個明確且日益精緻的階段演變。我們追溯這一軌跡，從第一階段，在這一階段中，LLMs主要作為被動的信息工具和模式識別器進行評估；到第二階段，它們作為同理心的對話者進行即時的無狀態互動；再到當前的前沿，第三階段，尋求作為有狀態的認知代理實現的縱向個性化伴侶。為了支持這一框架，我們系統性地回顧了核心技術、代理架構（配置、記憶、推理和規劃）以及數據集和基準的關鍵基礎設施，突顯了它們的演變如何支撐這一發展路徑。通過這一發展視角來看待該領域，我們提供了現有工作的全面綜合、其軌跡的深刻敘事，以及未來在負責任、有效和以人為中心的心理健康護理AI中的創新清晰路線圖。本調查中回顧的資源的策劃集合可在我們的項目庫中獲得：https://github.com/Emo-gml/Awesome-Mental-Health-LLMs。

docs.title: Decoding Guardrails: XAI-Guided Perturbation Analysis of Prompt Injection Detection
docs.text:
2609.24801v1 by Fernando Outeda, Gustavo Betarte, Juan Diego Campo, Fiorella Cravero

Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in production systems, raising concerns about their exposure to adversarial manipulation through prompt injection and jailbreak attacks. Classifier-based guardrails, such as Prompt Guard 2, are widely used as a first line of defense against such attacks, but their internal decision logic is largely opaque to both defenders and attackers. This paper presents an exploratory case study that applies explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) techniques to analyze how Prompt Guard 2 distinguishes malicious from benign prompts. We conduct four experiments to probe this question empirically. Guided by Vanilla Gradient and SHAP attributions, we find that Prompt Guard 2's decisions rely on the cumulative contribution of many tokens rather than a few dominant ones, yet saliency-guided synonym substitution and sentence-level paraphrasing can flip its predictions while altering only a moderate fraction of the text, in some cases yielding a successful jailbreak against the underlying LLM. A dataset-scale saliency analysis further shows that undetected injection prompts systematically lack the lexical markers the classifier relies on. We discuss the implications of these findings for the design and evaluation of classifier-based guardrails, and argue that explanation methods intended to support transparency can simultaneously lower the cost of constructing successful adversarial bypasses.

摘要：大型語言模型（LLMs）越來越多地應用於生產系統中，這引發了對它們在提示注入和越獄攻擊中遭受對抗性操控的擔憂。基於分類器的防護措施，如 Prompt Guard 2，被廣泛用作對抗這類攻擊的第一道防線，但其內部決策邏輯對於防禦者和攻擊者來說都在很大程度上是不透明的。本文提出了一個探索性案例研究，應用可解釋的人工智慧（XAI）技術來分析 Prompt Guard 2 如何區分惡意提示和良性提示。我們進行了四個實驗來實證探討這個問題。在 Vanilla Gradient 和 SHAP 重要性指標的指導下，我們發現 Prompt Guard 2 的決策依賴於許多標記的累積貢獻，而不是少數主導的標記，然而，基於重要性引導的同義詞替換和句子級別的改寫可以在僅改變文本的一小部分的情況下顛覆其預測，在某些情況下成功實現對基礎 LLM 的越獄。數據集規模的顯著性分析進一步顯示，未被檢測的注入提示系統性地缺乏分類器所依賴的詞彙標記。我們討論了這些發現對基於分類器的防護措施設計和評估的影響，並認為旨在支持透明度的解釋方法可以同時降低構建成功對抗性繞過的成本。

docs.title: DeceptionAnalyser: A Web-Based AI Tool for Performing Structured Deception Analysis with Argumentation Schemes and LLMs
docs.text:
2609.24369v1 by Stefan Sarkadi, Xabier Garmendia, Jack Mumford, Trevor Bench-Capon

Deception plays a central role in Intelligence operations, yet it remains difficult to analyse systematically without expert knowledge of reasoning patterns and cognitive manipulation. In computational argumentation, for instance, no scheme-level ground-truth corpora currently exist to support statistical validation. In this paper, we address this by introducing a set of ten argument schemes designed to model distinct forms of deception, each accompanied by structured premises and critical questions. In doing so, we introduce the first dedicated library of argumentation schemes specifically designed for deception analysis, providing a structured foundation for systematically modelling and analysing deception in narrative text. We then present \textit{DeceptionAnalyser}, a browser-based tool that implements these schemes through a two-stage methodology combining LLM-based premise extraction with critical-question-driven evaluation. Our aim is to provide a conceptual and methodological foundation for analysing deceptive reasoning in narrative text. This is precisely what we address in this paper by demonstrating how structured argumentation theory and AI-assisted analysis can support transparent, explainable assessments of potential deception. Because the schemes are designed to flag claims for scrutiny rather than to output a deception verdict, we do not benchmark classification accuracy; instead, we assess the \emph{reliability} of the methodology by measuring the consistency of the tool's premise and conclusion assessments across ten contemporary large language models and repeated runs. We find that scheme detection is highly stable for clear-cut deception and degrades gracefully, in interpretable ways, on more ambiguous intelligence-style narratives.

摘要：欺騙在情報行動中扮演著核心角色，然而在沒有專業的推理模式和認知操控知識的情況下，系統性分析仍然困難。以計算論證為例，目前並不存在任何方案級別的真實語料庫來支持統計驗證。在本文中，我們通過引入一組十個論證方案來解決這一問題，這些方案旨在模擬不同形式的欺騙，每個方案都附有結構化的前提和關鍵問題。這樣做的同時，我們推出了首個專門為欺騙分析設計的論證方案庫，為系統性建模和分析敘事文本中的欺騙提供了結構化的基礎。接著，我們介紹了 \textit{DeceptionAnalyser}，這是一個基於瀏覽器的工具，通過結合基於大型語言模型的前提提取和關鍵問題驅動的評估的兩階段方法實現這些方案。我們的目標是為分析敘事文本中的欺騙推理提供概念和方法論基礎。正是通過展示結構化論證理論和AI輔助分析如何支持潛在欺騙的透明、可解釋評估，我們在本文中解決了這一問題。由於這些方案旨在標記需要審查的主張，而不是輸出欺騙判決，因此我們不對分類準確性進行基準測試；相反，我們通過測量工具在十個當代大型語言模型和重複運行中的前提和結論評估的一致性來評估方法論的\emph{可靠性}。我們發現，對於明確的欺騙，方案檢測的穩定性非常高，而在更模糊的情報風格敘事中，則以可解釋的方式優雅地降級。

docs.title: Temporal Generalization and Explanation Stability of Control Flow Graph Neural Networks for Malware Detection
docs.text:
2609.24280v1 by Md. Asif Sajeed, Md. Nazrul Islam Mondal, Md Ashraful Hossen Akash

Malware detection is a critical task in cybersecurity, and graph neural networks over control flow graphs have shown promising results for it. However, detectors are usually evaluated on a random split of a corpus collected over a single period, which cannot show how well a model generalizes to later samples. This study addresses that limitation with a strict temporal split: every model is trained on one period and scored once on a later one. Two corpora of control flow graphs, each node carrying 37 features, were extracted statically from 1,989 Windows portable executables: 459 graphs from 2024-2025 for training and 223 from 2026 for evaluation. Twelve variants and a flat-feature control were trained on the earlier corpus. The choice of message-passing operator changes robustness to the shift significantly, and every pairwise gap that survives correction separates an aggregating architecture from one built around a learned attentional readout. The ranking also reverses: the flat control, which sees node features but no topology, is the best in-distribution model and among the worst across the boundary, so a conventional benchmark would have rejected message passing. Neither recalibration nor ensembling substitutes for the operator choice. Attributions do not shift, but explanation validity is architecture-specific, and the most accurate operator on the later corpus is the hardest to explain. An architecture derived from the finding matches the best searched operator without search. The shift affects both malware and benign classes alike, so these are results about robustness to distribution shift, not malware evolution.

摘要：惡意軟體檢測是網路安全中的一項關鍵任務，而基於控制流圖的圖神經網路在這方面顯示出了良好的結果。然而，檢測器通常是在一個單一時期收集的語料庫的隨機劃分上進行評估，這無法顯示模型對後續樣本的泛化能力。本研究通過嚴格的時間劃分來解決這一限制：每個模型在一個時期內訓練，並在後續時期進行一次評分。從1,989個Windows可攜式執行檔中靜態提取了兩個控制流圖語料庫，每個節點攜帶37個特徵：2024-2025年的459個圖用於訓練，2026年的223個圖用於評估。在早期語料庫上訓練了十二個變體和一個平面特徵控制。消息傳遞運算符的選擇顯著改變了對變化的穩健性，並且每一對經過修正的差距將聚合架構與基於學習的注意力讀取架構分開。排名也發生了逆轉：平面控制雖然能看到節點特徵但無法看到拓撲，是最佳的內部分佈模型，但在邊界上卻是最差的，因此傳統基準會拒絕消息傳遞。無論是重新校準還是集成都無法替代運算符的選擇。歸因不會改變，但解釋的有效性是特定於架構的，而在後期語料庫上最準確的運算符是最難以解釋的。從該發現衍生的架構與最佳搜索運算符匹配，無需搜索。這一變化同樣影響惡意軟體和良性類別，因此這些結果關於對分佈變化的穩健性，而非惡意軟體的演變。

docs.title: ACLArena: Agent Continue Learning in Multi-stage Post-training
docs.text:
2609.23989v1 by Haixin Wang, Xiaoxuan Wang, Junkai Zhang, Han Zhang, Renliang Sun, Alexander K Taylor, Yidan Shi, Haoran Deng, Chenguang Wang, Jason Cong, Yizhou Sun, Wei Wang

Building general-purpose agents for industrial deployment requires integrating multiple capabilities, each typically acquired at a distinct stage of training. Yet there is currently no well-established recipe for Agent Continual Learning (ACL), with little understanding of the trade-offs among existing integration paradigms. To address this gap, we introduce ACLArena, a framework for comprehensively studying, analyzing, and evaluating ACL. We first build a sequential training pipeline and conduct an in-depth analysis that explains the mechanisms of forgetting and generalization from two complementary perspectives, the model level and the token level. Guided by these analyses, we systematically compare multi-teacher on-policy distillation, self-distilled fine-tuning, and model merging to assess their ability to recover previously learned capabilities while preserving newly acquired ones. Through extensive experiments, we develop a detailed understanding of how capabilities transfer across stages. Finally, we propose a new ACL recipe that combines offline replay over high-quality trajectories with a routed network of multiple LoRA experts each specialized via RL, substantially improving the agent's ability to learn across multiple domains. Comprehensive experiments on four reasoning and agentic tasks, evaluated under both in-domain and out-of-domain settings, demonstrate the value of our analysis and the effectiveness of our approach.

摘要：建立用於工業部署的通用代理需要整合多種能力，而這些能力通常是在訓練的不同階段獲得的。然而，目前尚無成熟的代理持續學習（ACL）方案，對於現有整合範式之間的權衡也缺乏了解。為了解決這一空白，我們引入了ACLArena，一個用於全面研究、分析和評估ACL的框架。我們首先建立了一個順序訓練管道，並進行深入分析，從模型層面和標記層面兩個互補的角度解釋遺忘和泛化的機制。在這些分析的指導下，我們系統地比較了多教師在政策蒸餾、自我蒸餾微調和模型合併，以評估它們在保持新獲得能力的同時恢復先前學習能力的能力。通過大量實驗，我們詳細了解了能力如何在不同階段之間轉移。最後，我們提出了一種新的ACL方案，結合了對高質量軌跡的離線重播和通過強化學習專門化的多個LoRA專家的路由網絡，顯著提高了代理在多個領域學習的能力。在四個推理和代理任務上進行的全面實驗，在域內和域外設置下進行評估，展示了我們分析的價值和我們方法的有效性。

docs.title: UniK: Universal Knowledge Perception for Digital and Physical AI
docs.text:
2609.23971v1 by Nirmit Desai, Kunal Sawarkar, Aditya Mahakali, Dongkon Lee, Kevin Park, Eric Song

Two transformative classes of AI systems are reshaping how organizations operate: \textit{digital AI}, which reasons over enterprise knowledge to power chatbots and agent workflows; and \textit{physical AI}, which learns to control robots and autonomous systems from video, gameplay, and sensor telemetry. Both face the same foundational bottleneck: raw knowledge at scale, spanning heterogeneous modalities, locked in private corpora that existing AI infrastructure cannot access reliably or efficiently. We propose \textit{Universal Knowledge Perception (UniK)} as a common platform for both classes, covering the full knowledge lifecycle (ingestion, enrichment, indexing, retrieval, and continuous evaluation) across modalities from rich text and video to molecular data and sensor telemetry. We present UniK, built on Polymath Retrieval (multi-index fusion over automatically enriched indices) with no task-specific fine-tuning. Across five digital AI domains (medical literature, open-domain QA, chemistry, legal video proceedings, and government open data) UniK combined with an open-source 70-billion-parameter model consistently matches or outperforms frontier proprietary LLMs that are orders of magnitude larger: 76\% RAG accuracy on government data versus 47\% for GPT-5; 77.9\% on medical QA without fine-tuning; topping all open-source chemistry pipelines. We show that the same infrastructure directly addresses the data curation, indexing, and retrieval challenges facing physical AI world model training, where the knowledge problem is harder but structurally identical.

摘要：兩種變革性的人工智慧系統正在重塑組織的運作方式：\textit{數位人工智慧}，它利用企業知識來驅動聊天機器人和代理工作流程；以及\textit{實體人工智慧}，它從視頻、遊戲和傳感器遙測中學習控制機器人和自主系統。這兩者面臨著相同的基礎瓶頸：大規模的原始知識，跨越異質的模態，鎖定在現有人工智慧基礎設施無法可靠或高效訪問的私有語料庫中。我們提出\textit{通用知識感知（UniK）}作為這兩類系統的共同平台，涵蓋整個知識生命周期（攝取、豐富、索引、檢索和持續評估），跨越從豐富文本和視頻到分子數據和傳感器遙測的模態。我們展示了UniK，基於多數據索引融合的Polymath Retrieval，且不需要特定任務的微調。在五個數位人工智慧領域（醫學文獻、開放領域問答、化學、法律視頻程序和政府開放數據）中，UniK結合一個開源的700億參數模型，始終能夠匹配或超越規模大數量級的前沿專有大型語言模型：政府數據的76\% RAG準確率對比GPT-5的47\%；在醫學問答中達到77.9\%的準確率，且無需微調；在所有開源化學管道中名列前茅。我們展示了相同的基礎設施能直接解決實體人工智慧世界模型訓練中面臨的數據策展、索引和檢索挑戰，儘管知識問題更為困難，但結構上是相同的。

docs.title: Explainable Recommendations at Scale: LLM Rationales for YouTube Music Artist Discovery
docs.text:
2609.23877v1 by Xiao Liu, Yanwei Song, Srivaths Ranganathan, Yuan Chen, Zheyun Feng, Parker Steenburgh, Jochen Klingenhoefer, Nathan Lasche, Gergo Varady, Tim Steele

Modern music streaming platforms face a persistent tradeoff: exploiting familiar content versus driving the exploration of novel items. While users frequently desire discovery, they hesitate to select unknown artists over proven favorites. Providing transparent, natural language rationales that explain why an unexplored item is recommended lowers this barrier. However, while Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at this nuanced explainability, their real-time deployment is severely bottlenecked by prohibitive inference costs and computational overhead. In this paper, we present an industry case study of a decoupled recommendation architecture that successfully scales exploration without compromising latency. Our system isolates LLM inference asynchronously offline, pre-computing personalized candidate pools of undiscovered artists alongside tailored rationales. Large-scale online A/B experiments validate our design. We demonstrate that combining LLM-backed recommendations with these explanatory rationales significantly reduces the trust barrier for new content, yielding statistically significant improvements in both user exploration and overall engagement on the discovery surfaces.

摘要：現代音樂串流平台面臨著一個持續的權衡：利用熟悉的內容與推動探索新項目之間的平衡。雖然用戶經常渴望發現新事物，但他們卻猶豫不決，選擇未知的藝術家而非已知的喜愛者。提供透明的自然語言理由，解釋為何推薦未探索的項目，可以降低這一障礙。然而，儘管大型語言模型（LLMs）在這種細緻的可解釋性方面表現出色，但其實時部署卻受到高昂推理成本和計算開銷的嚴重瓶頸。在本文中，我們呈現了一個行業案例研究，展示了一種解耦的推薦架構，成功地在不妥協延遲的情況下擴展探索。我們的系統異步離線隔離LLM推理，預先計算個性化的未發現藝術家候選池及其量身定制的理由。大規模的在線A/B實驗驗證了我們的設計。我們展示了結合LLM支持的推薦與這些解釋性理由顯著降低了對新內容的信任障礙，並在用戶探索和整體參與度方面在發現界面上取得了統計上顯著的改善。

docs.title: What Makes a Terminal-Bench Task Hard? Separating Genuine Hardness from Fake-Hardness on an Adjudicated Agentic Corpus
docs.text:
2609.26826v1 by Edward Lue Chee Lip, Boden Moraski, Tim Knappe, Lang Xiong, Sarvesh Gharat, Antonio Mari, Ivan Bercovich

Frontier benchmarks need tasks that current models cannot solve. But a task that no model solves is not automatically a hard task. The same zero pass rate can come from a real capability gap, but it can also come from missing context, a broken reference solution, infrastructure failure, or a verifier that can be bypassed. In this paper, we study this issue using a frozen Terminal-Bench 3 / Frontier-Bench 0.1 production record with 1,081 pull requests, 639 scored tasks, 28,801 trials, and $105,933 in logged agent spend. We ask what an all-fail task actually certifies. For the 125 tasks with no honest pass, we combine task artifacts, reference-solution runs, empty-solution controls, adversarial trials, trajectories, telemetry, and review records, and apply an ordered validity screen. Only 78 of the 125 tasks survive as certified-unsolved candidates. The remaining tasks include 14 with broken oracles, 8 dominated by infrastructure failures, 4 that are only passable through verifier bypasses, and 21 whose solvability is not certified by the available evidence. Thus, lack of saturation and genuine difficulty are not the same thing. The certified-unsolved label is also narrow: it means that the authored route passed, infrastructure did not dominate, no strict bypass was observed, and all evaluated agents failed. It does not prove intrinsic hardness, verifier completeness, or failure at the intended capability. We further analyze rejected submissions and passing tasks to show that pass rate alone cannot explain why a task is difficult. Overall, our results suggest that frontier benchmarks should report the evidence behind their all-fail tasks before using them as capability claims.

摘要：前沿基準需要當前模型無法解決的任務。但一個沒有模型解決的任務並不自動意味著這是一個困難的任務。相同的零通過率可能來自真正的能力差距，但也可能來自缺乏上下文、破損的參考解決方案、基礎設施故障，或可以被繞過的驗證器。在本文中，我們使用一個凍結的 Terminal-Bench 3 / Frontier-Bench 0.1 生產記錄進行研究，該記錄包含 1,081 個拉取請求、639 個得分任務、28,801 次試驗，和 $105,933 的記錄代理支出。我們詢問一個全失敗任務實際上認證了什麼。對於 125 個沒有誠實通過的任務，我們結合任務文檔、參考解決方案執行、空解決方案控制、對抗性試驗、軌跡、遙測和審查記錄，並應用有序有效性篩選。只有 125 個任務中的 78 個作為認證未解決候選者存活下來。剩餘的任務包括 14 個具有破損預言機、8 個被基礎設施故障主導、4 個僅能通過驗證器繞過而通過的，以及 21 個其可解性未被現有證據認證的。因此，缺乏飽和度和真正的困難並不是同一回事。認證未解決標籤也很狹窄：這意味著所創建的路徑通過，基礎設施沒有主導，沒有觀察到嚴格的繞過，並且所有評估的代理均失敗。這並不能證明內在的困難性、驗證器的完整性，或在預期能力上的失敗。我們進一步分析被拒絕的提交和通過的任務，以顯示通過率本身無法解釋為什麼一個任務是困難的。總體而言，我們的結果表明，前沿基準應在將其全失敗任務用作能力聲明之前報告其背後的證據。

docs.title: Predicting Out-of-Distribution Generalization of Neural Operators via Observable Spectral Error Decomposition
docs.text:
2609.23529v1 by Hang-Cheng Dong, Pengcheng Cheng

Neural operators have emerged as powerful surrogates for solving partial differential equations (PDEs), yet their reliability under distribution shift remains a critical barrier to deployment. Existing approaches to out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization in operator learning are largely empirical and black-box: they report aggregate error metrics without explaining why errors arise or when they will grow. We propose a structure-preserving framework that makes OOD generalization predictable and auditable. Our key idea is to parameterize the learned solution operator as a spectral filter $h_θ(λ)$ acting on the eigenvalues of the underlying elliptic operator, implemented via Chebyshev polynomial expansions and trained with a weak-form objective. This parameterization admits an exact decomposition of the energy-norm error into two observable components: a model-dependent spectral approximation term and a distribution-dependent spectral weighting term induced by the input. From this decomposition we derive three diagnostics: a conservative in-band supremum $\vareps_{\mathrm{sup}}$, a global RMS proxy $\vareps_{\mathrm{rms}}$, and a sample-dependent effective metric $\vareps_{\mathrm{eff}}(f)$. These diagnostics can be computed without access to ground-truth solutions. Through four controlled experiments, we show that $\vareps_{\mathrm{eff}}(f)|f|$ consistently predicts energy error under in-distribution, in-band spectral shift, out-of-band tail, and compound shifts, whereas global metrics can be systematically misleading. Our framework shifts OOD assessment of neural operators from black-box benchmarking to operator-structure diagnostics, providing a practical route to auditable scientific machine learning.

摘要：神經運算子已成為解決偏微分方程（PDEs）的強大替代方案，但其在分佈轉移下的可靠性仍然是部署的一個關鍵障礙。現有的運算子學習中對於分佈外（OOD）泛化的研究主要是經驗性的，且為黑箱模型：它們報告總體錯誤指標，但未解釋錯誤產生的原因或何時會增長。我們提出了一個保持結構的框架，使得OOD泛化變得可預測且可審計。我們的關鍵思想是將學習到的解運算子參數化為作用於基礎橢圓運算子的特徵值的頻譜濾波器 $h_θ(λ)$，通過切比雪夫多項式展開實現，並使用弱形式目標進行訓練。這種參數化允許將能量範數誤差精確分解為兩個可觀察的組件：一個依賴於模型的頻譜近似項和一個由輸入引起的依賴於分佈的頻譜加權項。從這個分解中，我們推導出三個診斷指標：保守的帶內上界 $\vareps_{\mathrm{sup}}$、全局均方根代理 $\vareps_{\mathrm{rms}}$，以及依賴於樣本的有效度量 $\vareps_{\mathrm{eff}}(f)$。這些診斷指標可以在不接觸真實解的情況下計算。通過四個控制實驗，我們顯示 $\vareps_{\mathrm{eff}}(f)|f|$ 在帶內、帶內頻譜轉移、帶外尾部和復合轉移下持續預測能量誤差，而全局指標則可能系統性地誤導。我們的框架將神經運算子的OOD評估從黑箱基準轉變為運算子結構診斷，提供了一條可審計的科學機器學習的實用途徑。

docs.title: Signal2Symbol: Neuro-Symbolic Temporal Reasoning for Explainable Physiological Time-Series Anomaly Detection
docs.text:
2609.26820v1 by Naser Mansour, Sidahmed Benabderrahmane, Ameer Rahwan

Physiological time series such as electrocardiograms (ECG) and electroencephalograms (EEG) exhibit complex temporal structure, substantial acquisition variability, and a strong need for transparent decision-making. Although deep models can achieve high detection performance, they often provide limited insight into why a segment is anomalous, how local anomalies relate over time, and whether a detection belongs to a broader recurring pattern. We propose Signal2Symbol, a neuro-symbolic framework for explainable biosignal anomaly detection. The method first converts ECG/EEG signals into symbolic sequences using either a learned VQ-VAE (Vector Quantized Variational Autoencoder) codebook or a SAX (Symbolic Aggregate approXimation) baseline. It then constructs bigram enriched token-window transactions and scores anomalies through rare itemset evidence derived from minimal rare itemset mining. Detected anomalous windows are merged into intervals and related using Allen interval algebra, enabling composite temporal explanations such as escalation chains, artifact overlap, and cross-channel synchrony. Finally, we introduce a rare temporal concept lattice based on Formal Concept Analysis (FCA), which groups anomalous intervals by shared rare symbolic evidence, Allen temporal relations, channel context, and robustness attributes. The resulting Galois lattice compresses many local detections into interpretable families of temporal-symbolic anomalies. We evaluate on three public benchmarks: MIT-BIH Arrhythmia (beat-level ECG), PTB-XL (record-level ECG), and the Bonn EEG dataset (segment-level EEG). We stress-test robustness under additive noise and baseline-wander perturbations. The results highlight the value of neuro-symbolic tokenization for temporal anomaly analysis and show that Allen/FCA reasoning provides compact, interpretable summaries of local detections.

摘要：生理時間序列如心電圖（ECG）和腦電圖（EEG）展現出複雜的時間結構、顯著的獲取變異性，以及對透明決策的強烈需求。儘管深度模型能夠達到高檢測性能，但它們通常對於為何某一段落是異常的、局部異常如何隨時間相關，以及檢測是否屬於更廣泛的重複模式，提供的見解有限。我們提出了Signal2Symbol，一種用於可解釋生物信號異常檢測的神經符號框架。該方法首先使用學習到的VQ-VAE（向量量化變分自編碼器）代碼本或SAX（符號聚合近似）基準，將ECG/EEG信號轉換為符號序列。然後，它構建了二元豐富的標記窗口交易，並通過從最小稀有項集挖掘中衍生的稀有項集證據對異常進行打分。檢測到的異常窗口被合併為區間，並使用艾倫區間代數進行關聯，從而實現複合時間解釋，如升級鏈、工件重疊和跨通道同步。最後，我們基於形式概念分析（FCA）引入了一個稀有時間概念格，該概念格根據共享的稀有符號證據、艾倫時間關係、通道上下文和穩健性屬性對異常區間進行分組。最終生成的伽羅瓦格壓縮了許多局部檢測，形成可解釋的時間-符號異常家族。我們在三個公共基準上進行評估：MIT-BIH心律不整（按拍心電圖）、PTB-XL（按記錄心電圖）和波恩EEG數據集（按段腦電圖）。我們在加性噪音和基線漂移擾動下進行了壓力測試。結果突顯了神經符號標記化在時間異常分析中的價值，並顯示艾倫/FCA推理提供了局部檢測的緊湊、可解釋的摘要。

docs.title: TicTacBench: Benchmarking Timing Closure Capabilities of Coding Agents
docs.text:
2609.23363v1 by Bowei Wang, Zhigang Fang, Zhijie Yang, Renzhi Chen, Shanshan Li, Lei Wang

Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have led to the emergence of coding agents capable of performing complex engineering tasks, including register-transfer level (RTL) design and optimization. Existing RTL benchmarks mainly evaluate functional correctness and performance, power, and area (PPA) of the generated RTL designs, leaving agents' ability for \emph{timing closure} under-evaluated. We propose TicTacBench, a benchmark specifically designed to evaluate coding agents' capabilities for RTL-level timing closure under post-place-and-route (post-PnR) evaluation. TicTacBench contains 30 diverse tasks, each provided with a suboptimal RTL design, realistic timing constraints, functional equivalence verification, and timing reports. With over 300 runs of coding agents driven by 8 frontier LLMs, we find that even the best agent can only close 53.3\% of tasks with 7.18\% area-delay product (ADP) degradation and 8.83\% energy-delay-squared product (EDDP) improvement on average. We identify common failure categories that explain why agents fail to close timing. Then we propose TicTacSkill, a new method that guides agents to follow standard timing-closure procedures and improves the Timing Closure Rate by 9\%. These results suggest that while coding agents have made significant progress in RTL design, their timing-closure capability still has substantial room for improvement.

摘要：最近在大型語言模型（LLMs）方面的進展導致了編碼代理的出現，這些代理能夠執行複雜的工程任務，包括寄存器傳輸級（RTL）設計和優化。現有的RTL基準主要評估生成的RTL設計的功能正確性和性能、功耗及面積（PPA），而對代理在\emph{時序收斂}方面的能力評估不足。我們提出了TicTacBench，一個專門設計用於評估編碼代理在後佈局和路由（post-PnR）評估下的RTL級時序收斂能力的基準。TicTacBench包含30個多樣化的任務，每個任務都提供了一個次優的RTL設計、現實的時序約束、功能等價驗證和時序報告。通過對8個前沿LLM驅動的編碼代理進行超過300次的運行，我們發現即使是最好的代理也只能完成53.3\%的任務，平均面積延遲乘積（ADP）下降7.18\%，能量延遲平方乘積（EDDP）改善8.83\%。我們識別出常見的失敗類別，解釋了為什麼代理無法完成時序收斂。然後我們提出了TicTacSkill，一種新方法，指導代理遵循標準的時序收斂程序，並將時序收斂率提高了9\%。這些結果表明，儘管編碼代理在RTL設計方面取得了顯著進展，但它們的時序收斂能力仍有很大的改進空間。

docs.title: Why Ghost Outputs Teach: A Kernel-Based Understanding of Subliminal Learning
docs.text:
2609.23260v1 by Zhe Li, Bicheng Ying, Chaosheng Dong, Haibo Yang

Subliminal Learning (SL) is a recently identified phenomenon in which a student model acquires downstream task capabilities by matching seemingly unrelated auxiliary outputs from a teacher, despite never observing task labels, task-specific outputs, or the original training data. While recent studies have identified where subliminal signals may reside, the optimization mechanism underlying this phenomenon remains poorly understood. In this work, we provide a mechanistic understanding of SL through the lens of learning dynamics. Specifically, we derive a chained cross-task kernel that explicitly links ghost-output supervision to changes in task predictions through shared backbone representations. Our unified analytical framework provides a rigorous mathematical explanation for three central empirical puzzles in SL: (i) under shared initialization, the transfer operator forms a strictly Positive Semi-Definite (PSD) structure, guaranteeing that ghost-output optimization aligns the student with the teacher's true task objective without explicit label exposure; (ii) the ghost-output dimensionality acts as an explicit rank bottleneck governing the transfer of task-relevant features; and (iii) synthetic, high-entropy inputs function as broadband probes that maximize cross-task kernel overlap, explaining why random noise consistently outperforms structured data for subliminal transfer. Experiments on the canonical ghost-output setting validate all three theoretical predictions, providing the first learning-dynamics-based theoretical explanation of how ghost-output supervision gives rise to subliminal learning.

摘要：潛意識學習（SL）是一種最近被識別的現象，在這種現象中，學生模型通過匹配來自教師的看似無關的輔助輸出來獲得下游任務能力，儘管從未觀察到任務標籤、任務特定輸出或原始訓練數據。雖然最近的研究已經識別出潛意識信號可能存在的地方，但這一現象背後的優化機制仍然不甚了解。在這項工作中，我們通過學習動態的視角提供了對SL的機械理解。具體而言，我們推導出一個鏈式跨任務核，明確將鬼輸出監督與通過共享骨幹表示的任務預測變化聯繫起來。我們的統一分析框架為SL中的三個核心實證難題提供了嚴謹的數學解釋：（i）在共享初始化下，轉移算子形成了一個嚴格的正半定（PSD）結構，保證鬼輸出優化使學生與教師的真實任務目標一致，而無需明確的標籤曝光；（ii）鬼輸出的維度充當了顯式的秩瓶頸，控制著任務相關特徵的轉移；以及（iii）合成的高熵輸入作為寬頻探針，最大化跨任務核的重疊，解釋了為什麼隨機噪聲在潛意識轉移中始終優於結構化數據。在經典的鬼輸出設置上的實驗驗證了這三個理論預測，提供了第一個基於學習動態的理論解釋，說明鬼輸出監督如何導致潛意識學習。

docs.title: Triggers and Diagnostics for LLM-Based Interpretability Failures in Active Inference Agents
docs.text:
2609.23215v1 by Param Raval, Rohit Shenoy, Archana Vaidheeswaran

LLM explainers are increasingly attached to autonomous agents as runtime oversight, with operators reading a generated account of the agent's beliefs and actions rather than its internal state. We audit the account itself, pairing an Active Inference (AIF) agent that tracks German grid demand and adjusts generation with an LLM explainer on three backends (GPT-4o, Claude-3-Opus, Gemini), and probing the pair with three black-box triggers. Corrupting the observation stream by 600 MW per step moves the agent's posterior by 490 MW, roughly 0.9% of grid capacity. None of the 30 explanations produced during the injection flag anything under a stated rubric, and each narrates the corrupted belief fluently. On timesteps where the agent takes an objectively wrong action, all three explainers produce a sycophantic rationalization 80-95% of the time (n = 20 per backend). Attacker-controlled text in the observation metadata field steers the explainer, with susceptibility differing by provider and data exfiltration succeeding on all three. We propose mitigations for each failure but do not evaluate them. In every failure we observed, the explanation was fluent and wrong. Moreover, nothing in the explainer architecture checks whether an explanation is true before an operator acts on it. Testing the explainer therefore belongs in any audit of an agentic deployment.

摘要：LLM 解釋器越來越多地與自主代理結合，作為運行時監督，操作員閱讀生成的代理信念和行動的報告，而不是其內部狀態。我們審計該報告，將一個跟蹤德國電網需求並調整發電的主動推理 (AIF) 代理與三個後端的 LLM 解釋器（GPT-4o、Claude-3-Opus、Gemini）配對，並用三個黑箱觸發器對這對進行探測。每一步將觀察流的數據損壞 600 MW，使代理的後驗變化 490 MW，大約是電網容量的 0.9%。在注入過程中產生的 30 個解釋中，沒有任何一個在聲明的標準下標示出任何問題，每個解釋都流利地敘述了被損壞的信念。在代理採取客觀錯誤行動的時間步上，所有三個解釋器在 80-95% 的時間內產生了阿諛奉承的合理化（n = 每個後端 20 次）。觀察元數據字段中的攻擊者控制文本引導了解釋器，並且不同提供者的易受攻擊性不同，數據外洩在三者中均成功。我們為每個失敗提出了緩解措施，但未對其進行評估。在我們觀察到的每一個失敗中，解釋都是流利且錯誤的。此外，解釋器架構中沒有任何檢查解釋是否真實的機制，操作員在採取行動之前並不會檢查解釋的真實性。因此，測試解釋器應該是任何代理部署審計的一部分。

docs.title: Whitening Inverts the Hierarchy: What the Norm of a Whitened Embedding Measures
docs.text:
2609.23117v1 by Mohammed Ahnouch, Lotfi Elaachak

Whitening a foundation-model embedding and using its squared norm as a training-free likelihood surrogate is motivated by the observation that whitened coordinates often appear approximately standard normal. We show that this observation follows from the projection central limit theorem and therefore does not imply a Gaussian joint distribution. Across multiple encoders and three training objectives, we find systematic over-dispersion of the whitened radius relative to the Gaussian reference, including against distributional clones with identical mean and covariance. We further show that the commonly reported agreement between empirical and theoretical norm statistics is an algebraic consequence of in-sample whitening and does not constitute evidence for Gaussianity. We identify the mechanism behind this behavior: whitening reverses the encoder's spectral hierarchy, shifting the contribution to the squared norm toward near-degenerate directions that encode predominantly noise. In these directions, the dominant variability is governed by a single input-dependent scale. We estimate this scale from two moments and use it to predict, without additional free parameters, the cross-dependence between disjoint spectral halves. These results indicate that the squared whitened norm is better interpreted as a Mahalanobis measure of semantic atypicality than as a log-likelihood. This interpretation explains both its practical effectiveness and its calibration failures: the statistic can rank and detect atypical samples consistently with nonparametric density estimates and across encoders trained with different objectives, while Gaussian tail thresholds can be inaccurate by orders of magnitude. etc.

摘要：將基礎模型的嵌入進行白化，並使用其平方範數作為無訓練的似然替代，這一做法的動機源於觀察到白化坐標通常近似標準正態分佈。我們顯示這一觀察是從投影中心極限定理推導而來，因此並不意味著高斯聯合分佈。在多個編碼器和三個訓練目標下，我們發現白化半徑相對於高斯參考存在系統性過度離散，包括與均值和協方差相同的分佈克隆相比。我們進一步顯示，常報告的經驗和理論範數統計的一致性是樣本內白化的代數結果，並不構成高斯性的證據。我們確定了這一行為背後的機制：白化逆轉了編碼器的光譜層次，將平方範數的貢獻轉移到主要編碼噪聲的近退化方向。在這些方向上，主導變異性由單一的輸入依賴尺度所控制。我們從兩個矩估計這個尺度，並利用它在不增加額外自由參數的情況下預測不相交光譜半部之間的交叉依賴。這些結果表明，平方白化範數更應被解釋為語義非典型性的馬哈拉諾比斯度量，而不是對數似然。這一解釋解釋了其實際有效性及其校準失敗：該統計量可以一致地對非典型樣本進行排名和檢測，與非參數密度估計以及使用不同目標訓練的編碼器相符，而高斯尾閾值可能會有數量級的誤差。等。

docs.title: FireWorldBench: Benchmarking Complex Physical World Intelligence through Coupled-Field Fire Dynamics
docs.text:
2609.23064v1 by Qiang Chen, Hao Guo, Huatai Zhu, Tairan Huang, Yichao Cao, Hongyan Xu, Keke Huang, Haifeng Li, Yi Chen, Xiu Su

Understanding the physical world requires more than object recognition, scene description, and short-term visual prediction, as real-world physical systems involve multiple continuous fields, latent causal mechanisms, partial observations, and intervention-sensitive dynamics. We propose FireWorldBench, a benchmark for evaluating complex physical world intelligence in multimodal large language models and agents through coupled-field fire dynamics. Fire provides a canonical stress-test environment, where multiple interacting physical fields jointly shape observable states and temporal dynamics. FireWorldBench is organized along two complementary axes, a physical capability axis and a fire scenario task axis, jointly covering physical-state understanding, temporal dynamics, causal mechanisms, and intervention reasoning. The benchmark comprises 520 fire-world entries, including 494 controlled simulation worlds and 26 real-world-aligned event groups, spanning 47 scene archetypes across 7 environment families. These entries combine structured textual observations, multiple 2D physical-field visualizations, and 3D event-level scene modeling, yielding 9,074 text-image interleaved question-answer pairs across choice-based and open-ended report-generation formats. FireWorldBench evaluates whether models can infer latent physical states, explain underlying mechanisms, forecast coupled-field evolution, and assess intervention consequences from multimodal partial observations, providing a challenging testbed for complex physical world intelligence.

摘要：理解物理世界需要的不僅僅是物體識別、場景描述和短期視覺預測，因為現實世界的物理系統涉及多個連續場、潛在的因果機制、部分觀察和對干預敏感的動態。我們提出了FireWorldBench，一個用於通過耦合場火災動力學評估多模態大型語言模型和代理的複雜物理世界智能的基準。火災提供了一個典型的壓力測試環境，在這裡多個相互作用的物理場共同塑造可觀察的狀態和時間動態。FireWorldBench在兩個互補的軸上組織，一個是物理能力軸，另一個是火災場景任務軸，聯合涵蓋物理狀態理解、時間動態、因果機制和干預推理。該基準包含520個火災世界條目，包括494個受控模擬世界和26個與現實世界對應的事件組，涵蓋7個環境家族中的47個場景原型。這些條目結合了結構化的文本觀察、多個2D物理場可視化和3D事件級場景建模，產生了9,074個文本-圖像交錯的問答對，涵蓋基於選擇的和開放式報告生成格式。FireWorldBench評估模型是否能夠推斷潛在的物理狀態、解釋潛在的機制、預測耦合場的演變，並從多模態部分觀察中評估干預後果，為複雜的物理世界智能提供了一個具有挑戰性的測試平台。

docs.title: An Accurate and Interpretable Hyper Graph Neural Network for GBM Survival Prediction
docs.text:
2609.25088v1 by Mushahid Intesum

Survival prediction for glioblastoma multiforme (GBM) demands models that are both accurate and interpretable, yet existing approaches treat these objectives as com- peting, where performant models sacrifice transparency, while interpretable models accept degraded predictive power. We argue that this trade-off is not inherent. Graph neural net- works offer a structural foundation for extracting interpretable, explainable representations without compromising discriminative ability. Furthermore, current methods typically rely on a single imaging modality, underutilizing the complementary information available across multi-modal MRI and clinical metadata. We propose a multi-modal framework that inte- grates three components to address both objectives simultaneously: (1) a sheaf hypergraph neural network that captures higher-order relationships among tissue patches through direc- tional, asymmetric message passing; (2) a concept bottleneck layer that compresses learned representations into clinically grounded concepts, enforcing ante-hoc interpretability; and (3) an extension sufficiency test (EST) regularizer that penalizes unfaithful explanations during training, ensuring that model explanations genuinely reflect the internal decision process. Clinical and genomic features are incorporated through gated fusion, preserving the dominant prognostic signal of molecular markers while retaining concept-level traceabil- ity. Evaluated on 593 patients from the UPenn-GBM dataset under 5-fold cross-validation, our framework achieves a concordance index of 0.643 with the lowest fold-level variance among all compared models (std = 0.015). To our knowledge, this is the first work to unify sheaf hypergraph convolution, concept bottleneck supervision, and EST regularization for interpretable survival prediction from brain MRI

摘要：生存預測對於多形性膠質母細胞瘤（GBM）需要準確且可解釋的模型，然而現有的方法將這些目標視為競爭關係，其中性能優越的模型犧牲了透明度，而可解釋的模型則接受了預測能力的下降。我們認為這種權衡並非固有的。圖神經網絡提供了一個結構基礎，可以提取可解釋、可解釋的表示，而不妨礙區分能力。此外，當前的方法通常依賴於單一的成像模式，未能充分利用多模態MRI和臨床元數據中可用的互補信息。我們提出了一個多模態框架，整合三個組件以同時解決這兩個目標：（1）一個束超圖神經網絡，通過方向性、不對稱的消息傳遞捕捉組織片段之間的高階關係；（2）一個概念瓶頸層，將學習到的表示壓縮為臨床基礎的概念，強化事前可解釋性；以及（3）一個擴展充分性測試（EST）正則化器，在訓練過程中懲罰不忠實的解釋，確保模型的解釋真實反映內部決策過程。臨床和基因組特徵通過門控融合納入，保留了分子標記的主導預後信號，同時保持概念級的可追溯性。在UPenn-GBM數據集上對593名患者進行5折交叉驗證，我們的框架達到了0.643的協調指數，並在所有比較模型中具有最低的折層變異性（標準差=0.015）。據我們所知，這是第一個將束超圖卷積、概念瓶頸監督和EST正則化統一應用於可解釋的腦MRI生存預測的工作。

docs.title: From Research Frontier to Laboratory Bench: Design of a Four-Tier Experimental Teaching System for Multimodal Medical Image Intelligent Diagnosis
docs.text:
2609.22790v1 by Dongjing Shan, Yamei Luo, Jin Li, Yong Luo

Undergraduate programmes in intelligent medical engineering are expanding, yet laboratory curricula lag behind the multimodal, long-tailed, and distributionally shifting realities of clinical AI. This design paper presents an advanced experimental teaching system that translates an ongoing multimodal deep learning research project on endometrial carcinoma into a structured undergraduate lab sequence. We identify three educational gaps (modality, authenticity, and deployment) and derive four pedagogical principles from constructive alignment, experiential learning, the research teaching nexus, and the CDIO framework. The curriculum comprises four progressive tiers plus an engineering layer, with 32 laboratory units over 64 contact hours, delivered via a custom virtual clinical workstation using de-identified multi-institutional data. Each tier maps to a specific technical bottleneck, prerequisite coursework, and criterion-referenced deliverables. Data governance, safety, and assessment protocols are specified. Learning outcome data will be collected across two implementation cycles.

摘要：本科智能醫療工程課程正在擴展，但實驗室課程卻落後於臨床AI的多模態、長尾和分佈性變化的現實。這篇設計論文提出了一個先進的實驗教學系統，將一個關於子宮內膜癌的持續多模態深度學習研究項目轉化為一個結構化的本科實驗室序列。我們確定了三個教育差距（模態、真實性和部署），並從建設性對齊、體驗式學習、研究教學聯繫和CDIO框架中推導出四個教學原則。課程包括四個漸進層次加上一個工程層，擁有32個實驗單元，總共64小時的接觸時間，通過使用去識別的多機構數據的自定義虛擬臨床工作站進行授課。每個層次對應於一個特定的技術瓶頸、先修課程和基準參考成果。數據治理、安全性和評估協議已被明確規定。學習成果數據將在兩個實施週期中收集。

docs.title: MATE: Policy-Aware Security Auditing for Mobile Agents via Synthesis-Driven Trajectory Learning
docs.text:
2609.22724v1 by Changyue Jiang, Jiayi Wang, Xin Wen, Jiarun Dai, Geng Hong, Xudong Pan

Mobile agents powered by foundation models now automate complex, multi-step workflows on real devices, but their trajectories can violate app-specific security policies. Existing trajectory-level defenses rely on LLM prompting or rigid rules, and thus fail to support fine-grained, natural-language policies that generalize across apps and tasks. In this work, we introduce MATE, a lightweight, policy-conditioned auditor that encodes both agent trajectories and natural-language security policies to determine whether a trajectory violates a given policy and to explain why. Treating policies as editable text rather than fixed model parameters allows MATE to handle user-defined and evolving requirements without retraining. To construct MATE, we build a knowledge base by extracting app descriptions, workflows, and policies from hundreds of popular mobile apps worldwide, and synthesizing over 140K semantically realistic, policy-conditioned trajectories with a multi-stage pipeline. We further release MATEBench, a trajectory-level auditing benchmark with two synthetic subsets and one real-world subset of manually collected trajectories. Models trained with our synthesis-driven trajectory learning achieve over 95% accuracy on MATEBench, retain strong performance on external safety benchmarks, and audit trajectories from Zhipu's AutoGLM and Alibaba's Mobile-Agent on real devices with over 95% accuracy, outperforming prior methods by over 20%. MATE shows that practical, fine-grained security auditing for heterogeneous mobile agents is both feasible and effective.

摘要：行動代理由基礎模型驅動，現在能夠在真實設備上自動化複雜的多步驟工作流程，但它們的軌跡可能會違反應用特定的安全政策。現有的軌跡級別防禦依賴於大型語言模型提示或僵硬的規則，因此無法支持跨應用和任務的細粒度自然語言政策。在這項工作中，我們介紹了MATE，一個輕量級的政策條件審計工具，它編碼了代理的軌跡和自然語言安全政策，以確定軌跡是否違反了給定的政策並解釋原因。將政策視為可編輯的文本而非固定的模型參數，使MATE能夠處理用戶定義和不斷演變的需求，而無需重新訓練。為了構建MATE，我們通過從全球數百個流行的移動應用中提取應用描述、工作流程和政策，並使用多階段管道合成超過14萬條語義上現實的政策條件軌跡來建立知識庫。我們進一步發布了MATEBench，一個具有兩個合成子集和一個手動收集的真實世界子集的軌跡級審計基準。使用我們的合成驅動軌跡學習訓練的模型在MATEBench上達到超過95%的準確率，並在外部安全基準上保持強勁的表現，能夠在真實設備上對Zhipu的AutoGLM和阿里巴巴的Mobile-Agent的軌跡進行審計，準確率超過95%，比以前的方法提高了超過20%。MATE顯示出對異構移動代理進行實用的細粒度安全審計既可行又有效。

docs.title: GaitVista: Reliability-Aware AI Measurement toward Accessible Longitudinal Gait Assessment
docs.text:
2609.22619v1 by Nethmi Jayasinghe, Mihir Parashar, Amit Ranjan Trivedi

Tracking recovery of walking function requires detecting meaningful gait change across rehabilitation sessions, yet objective 3D measurement remains confined to specialized motion-capture laboratories. Small camera sets and body-worn inertial sensors broaden access, but reliability varies across joints and time, allowing sensing failures to masquerade as patient change. We present \textsc{GaitVista}, a reliability-aware measurement layer whose lightweight gate assigns joint- and frame-specific visual contributions using camera coverage, local visual quality, cross-modal disagreement, and root-motion continuity, and exposes them for inspection. Across seven clean and degraded sensing conditions on TotalCapture, \textsc{GaitVista} reduces average full-body and lower-body error by \textbf{27.7\%} and \textbf{27.8\%}, attains the lowest worst-condition error among fusion methods, and reduces the gap to a joint-frame oracle from $2.76$--$5.33$~cm for condition-blind baselines to $1.11$~cm. On MoVi with image-derived keypoints, it is the only deployable fusion method to improve over both unimodal streams, reducing marker-supported error by \textbf{6.4\%} relative to the strongest learned fusion baseline. On TotalCapture, it improves bilateral knee-flexion waveform accuracy by \textbf{18.9\%}. Raw inertial measurements from five TotalCapture participants show location- and time-varying magnetic disturbance, supporting the design's reliability premise. Both benchmarks contain neurologically healthy participants in controlled settings and retain participant-specific IMU calibration; we therefore report progress toward accessible gait assessment, not validated clinical deployment.

摘要：追蹤步態功能的恢復需要在康復會議中檢測到有意義的步態變化，但客觀的3D測量仍然限於專門的運動捕捉實驗室。小型攝影機組和身體佩戴的慣性傳感器擴大了可及性，但可靠性在關節和時間上有所不同，這使得感測失敗可能偽裝成患者的變化。我們提出了\textsc{GaitVista}，這是一個關注可靠性的測量層，其輕量級的閘道根據攝影機覆蓋範圍、局部視覺質量、跨模態不一致性和根運動連續性分配關節和幀特定的視覺貢獻，並將其暴露以供檢查。在TotalCapture的七種乾淨和劣化的感測條件下，\textsc{GaitVista}將全身和下身的平均誤差分別降低了\textbf{27.7\%}和\textbf{27.8\%}，在融合方法中達到最低的最差條件誤差，並將與關節幀預言者的差距從$2.76$--$5.33$~cm降低到$1.11$~cm。在MoVi中，使用圖像衍生的關鍵點，它是唯一一種可部署的融合方法，能夠在兩個單模態流上都有所改善，相對於最強的學習融合基線，將標記支持的誤差降低了\textbf{6.4\%}。在TotalCapture上，它將雙側膝關節屈曲波形的準確性提高了\textbf{18.9\%}。來自五位TotalCapture參與者的原始慣性測量顯示出位置和時間變化的磁擾動，支持設計的可靠性前提。這兩個基準均包含在受控環境中神經上健康的參與者，並保留參與者特定的IMU校準；因此，我們報告了朝向可及步態評估的進展，而不是經過驗證的臨床部署。

docs.title: Benchmarking the Explanatory Quality of Open-Weight Vision-Language Models in Face Recognition
docs.text:
2609.21879v1 by Laurent Colbois, Sébastien Marcel

Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have recently been proposed as promising tools for face recognition, as they can produce natural language explanations alongside similarity scores. This capability is considered appealing for face comparisons in forensic contexts, which require decisions to be transparent and auditable. However, existing evaluations of VLMs for that use case focus mostly on recognition accuracy, while the validity of generated explanations remains unquantified. In this work, we introduce a benchmarking framework for VLM-based face recognition that treats explanation quality as a core evaluation axis. We propose two criteria that explanations should satisfy: relevance, i.e., reliance on identity-stable facial features; and faithfulness, i.e., alignment with the visible image content without hallucinated features. We jointly develop a methodology enabling the quantification of relevance and faithfulness of evaluated models, based on constraining model outputs to a structured explanation format that supports automated querying and auditing. Using this framework, we benchmark several families of open-weight VLMs, jointly evaluating face verification accuracy and explanation quality. Our results highlight remaining shortcomings of produced explanations, and emphasize the need for such explanation quality metrics to get a complete picture of model performance. The proposed benchmark and open-source evaluation harness provide a foundation for proper benchmarking and future fine-tuning of explainable face recognition systems.

摘要：視覺-語言模型（VLMs）最近被提出作為面部識別的有前景工具，因為它們可以生成自然語言解釋以及相似性分數。這種能力在法醫環境中的面部比較中被認為是吸引人的，因為這些環境需要透明且可審計的決策。 然而，現有的VLM評估主要集中在識別準確性上，而生成解釋的有效性仍未量化。在這項工作中，我們引入了一個基於VLM的面部識別基準框架，將解釋質量視為核心評估軸。我們提出了兩個解釋應滿足的標準：相關性，即依賴身份穩定的面部特徵；以及忠實性，即與可見圖像內容的一致性，而不包含幻覺特徵。我們共同開發了一種方法論，使得能夠量化所評估模型的相關性和忠實性，這是基於將模型輸出限制為支持自動查詢和審計的結構化解釋格式。利用這個框架，我們基準測試了幾個開放權重的VLM家族，並共同評估了面部驗證準確性和解釋質量。我們的結果突顯了生成解釋的剩餘缺陷，並強調了這種解釋質量指標的必要性，以獲得模型性能的完整圖景。所提出的基準和開源評估工具為正確的基準測試和未來可解釋面部識別系統的微調提供了基礎。

docs.title: An Agentic Just-in-Time Adaptive Intervention System for Personalized Sleep Support: Proof-of-Concept Study with N of 1 Data
docs.text:
2609.21805v1 by Nick Rezaee, Chelsea Boccagno

Background: Just-in-time adaptive interventions (JITAIs) can use behavioral data to adapt support to changing contexts, but many rely on predefined rules and manual configuration. Objective: We developed a proof-of-concept sleep JITAI using an AI agent to review personal data, evaluate reminders, adapt interventions, and record decisions for human review. Methods: Running in Home Assistant on a configurable schedule, the agent follows a reusable skill file to review 30 days of sleep and behavioral data, including physical activity, smartphone use, and bedtime routines, to identify patterns and create or update automated reminders. Results: Initial runs demonstrated technical feasibility, successfully completing data review and intervention decisions while limiting reminders to three per day and saving decision records. Conclusions: Agentic AI may enable flexible, adaptive sleep JITAIs. The architecture supports future comparison with fixed or rulebased interventions, requires human oversight, and could extend to other health behaviors.

摘要：背景：即時適應干預（JITAIs）可以利用行為數據來根據變化的情境調整支持，但許多仍依賴預定義的規則和手動配置。 目標：我們開發了一個概念驗證的睡眠 JITAI，使用 AI 代理來審查個人數據、評估提醒、調整干預並記錄決策以供人類審查。 方法：該代理在 Home Assistant 中以可配置的時間表運行，遵循可重用的技能文件，審查 30 天的睡眠和行為數據，包括身體活動、智能手機使用和就寢例行，以識別模式並創建或更新自動提醒。 結果：初步運行顯示技術可行性，成功完成數據審查和干預決策，同時將提醒限制為每天三次並保存決策記錄。 結論：代理式 AI 可能使靈活的、自適應的睡眠 JITAIs 成為可能。該架構支持未來與固定或基於規則的干預進行比較，需人類監督，並可擴展到其他健康行為。

docs.title: Consistent Relexicalization of Clinical Documents using Graph-Based Approach
docs.text:
2609.21387v1 by Dipankar Das, Atri Mandal, Sandeep Singh, Tushar Shandhilya

Relexicalization is a pivotal technique in clinical NLP, as it facilitates robust masking of sensitive information while synthesizing datasets that retain high-fidelity, real-world characteristics. However, preserving structural integrity, relational coherence, and temporal consistency during transformation remains a significant challenge. Existing approaches frequently rely on independent entity replacement, which results in clinical inconsistencies across longitudinal records. This reduces the value of such relexicalized datasets for downstream scientific analysis. To address these limitations, we introduce G-RELIC (Graph Based Contextual Relexicalization with Improved Consistency) which combines the power of LLMs with graphs. G-RELIC implements a graph-based mapping mechanism which optimizes for one-to-one correspondence between original and surrogate entities. It also introduces a deterministic temporal repositioning algorithm to preserve temporal consistency. Empirical evaluations on diverse, real-world clinical datasets validate that G-RELIC significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. G-RELIC yields a 30.4 percentage point improvement in relational integrity (62.1% to 92.5%) and 45.9 percentage point improvement in temporal coherence (46% to 91.9%) without compromising on the recognized privacy benchmarks for clinical datasets. This maximizes the analytical utility of relexicalized datasets while minimizing re-identification risk.

摘要：再詞彙化是臨床自然語言處理中的一項關鍵技術，因為它促進了敏感信息的穩健遮蔽，同時合成保留高保真度、真實世界特徵的數據集。然而，在轉換過程中保持結構完整性、關聯一致性和時間一致性仍然是一個重大挑戰。現有的方法通常依賴於獨立實體替換，這導致了縱向記錄中的臨床不一致性。這降低了此類再詞彙化數據集在下游科學分析中的價值。為了解決這些限制，我們介紹了 G-RELIC（基於圖的上下文再詞彙化與改進一致性），它結合了大型語言模型和圖的力量。G-RELIC 實現了一種基於圖的映射機制，優化了原始實體和替代實體之間的一對一對應。它還引入了一種確定性的時間重新定位算法，以保持時間一致性。在多樣化的真實臨床數據集上的實證評估證實，G-RELIC 顯著超越了最先進的基準。G-RELIC 在關聯完整性上提高了 30.4 個百分點（從 62.1% 到 92.5%），在時間一致性上提高了 45.9 個百分點（從 46% 到 91.9%），而不妥協於臨床數據集的隱私基準。這最大化了再詞彙化數據集的分析效用，同時最小化了重新識別的風險。

docs.title: Ability-Residual Decoupled Modeling for Affective Cognitive Diagnosis
docs.text:
2609.21214v1 by Boyuan Zhao, Meng Ye

Cognitive diagnosis infers students' concept mastery from response logs. However, students' responses are not determined by mastery alone: non-cognitive factors such as emotion, engagement, and fatigue can also affect performance. Affective cognitive diagnosis therefore extends conventional cognitive diagnosis by incorporating affective states. Existing methods often assume that the cognitive diagnosis backbone has already explained ability, item, and concept effects, so the remaining errors can be attributed mainly to affect. We argue that this assumption can be insufficient in real educational data: item calibration bias, systematic concept bias, personalized student-concept deviations, and latent student-item matching can form stable cognitive residuals. Without an explicit modeling pathway, these residuals may leak into affective representations, producing affect contamination. To address this problem, we propose an ability-residual decoupled framework for affective cognitive diagnosis. The model first captures unmodeled cognitive residuals through student, item, concept, student-concept, and low-rank student-item components, and then uses an affective module to modulate guess/slip effects. A Q-matrix-constrained concept residual attention mechanism adaptively aggregates only item-relevant concept residuals. Experiments on ASSIST2017, ASSIST2012, ASSIST2009, and Junyi with six cognitive diagnosis backbones show response-prediction gains across the reported comparisons and generally improved affect alignment when affect labels are available. Ablation studies, leakage probes, principal component analysis visualization, long-tail analysis, and case studies further indicate that ability residuals absorb stable cognitive bias, reduce cognitive contamination in the affective branch, and enhance the robustness and predictive accuracy of cognitive diagnosis models.
