摘要：認知診斷從反應日誌推斷學生的概念掌握情況。然後，學生的反應不僅僅由掌握程度決定：非認知因素如情緒、參與度和疲勞也會影響表現。因此，情感認知診斷通過納入情感狀態來擴展傳統的認知診斷。現有的方法通常假設認知診斷的基礎已經解釋了能力、項目和概念的影響，因此剩餘的誤差主要可以歸因於情感。我們認為這一假設在真實的教育數據中可能不夠充分：項目標定偏差、系統性概念偏差、個性化的學生-概念偏差以及潛在的學生-項目匹配可能形成穩定的認知殘差。若沒有明確的建模途徑，這些殘差可能會滲透到情感表徵中，產生情感污染。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了一個能力-殘差解耦框架，用於情感認知診斷。該模型首先通過學生、項目、概念、學生-概念和低秩學生-項目組件捕捉未建模的認知殘差，然後使用情感模塊來調節猜測/滑動效應。一個受Q矩陣約束的概念殘差注意機制自適應地聚合僅與項目相關的概念殘差。在ASSIST2017、ASSIST2012、ASSIST2009和Junyi上進行的實驗顯示，在報告的比較中，反應預測的增益，以及在情感標籤可用時，情感對齊的普遍改善。消融研究、泄漏探測、主成分分析可視化、長尾分析和案例研究進一步表明，能力殘差吸收了穩定的認知偏差，減少了情感分支中的認知污染，並增強了認知診斷模型的穩健性和預測準確性。

docs.title: Clinician-Grounded Quality Assurance for AI-Assisted Psychiatric Intake
docs.text:
2609.21149v1 by King Shi, Amanda Li, Jonathan Ivey, Synthia Qia Wang, Guan Gui, Hyunseo Kim, Peter Zandi, Jason Straub, Jacob Taylor, Ananya Joshi

Before patients can use AI-assisted psychiatric intake systems, health systems need practical ways to routinely evaluate these tools against their clinical standards for quality assurance. Because clinicians may use different intake styles, evaluation for this task must (1) support comparison across interviewing approaches, (2) minimize clinician burden, and (3) measure clinically relevant performance for health systems deploying these technologies. We present a clinician-grounded evaluation platform built around a memory-augmented patient simulator for open-ended AI interviewing, InterviewPlayground. We created interactive patients using InterviewPlayground with our expert-authored vignettes, constructed a simulated intake platform for the interviews, and designed evaluation modalities relevant to intake. In a pilot of 6 clinicians in a 25-minute assessment compared to a GPT-based LLM intake interviewer, the LLM recovered more of the clinically relevant items embedded in the patient vignettes (88.0% vs. 38.9%), but made more clinical inferences not based on the interview (56.8% vs. 27.8%), and characterized identified safety concerns less often (33.3% vs. 66.7%), setting the stage for deployed quality assurance for this task.

摘要：在患者能夠使用 AI 輔助的精神科接診系統之前，醫療系統需要實用的方法來定期評估這些工具是否符合其臨床標準以進行質量保證。因為臨床醫生可能使用不同的接診風格，因此這項任務的評估必須 (1) 支持不同訪談方法之間的比較，(2) 減少臨床醫生的負擔，並且 (3) 測量對於部署這些技術的醫療系統而言臨床相關的表現。我們提出了一個以臨床醫生為基礎的評估平台，圍繞著一個增強記憶的患者模擬器，用於開放式的 AI 訪談，名為 InterviewPlayground。我們使用 InterviewPlayground 創建了互動式患者，並利用我們專家的小品故事，構建了一個模擬接診平台以進行訪談，並設計了與接診相關的評估方式。在對 6 位臨床醫生進行的 25 分鐘評估的試點中，與基於 GPT 的 LLM 接診訪談者相比，LLM 從患者小品故事中恢復了更多臨床相關項目 (88.0% 對 38.9%)，但做出了更多不基於訪談的臨床推斷 (56.8% 對 27.8%)，並且識別安全問題的頻率較低 (33.3% 對 66.7%)，為這項任務的質量保證部署奠定了基礎。

docs.title: Trustworthy FinAInce: Unpacking How AI-Mediated Financial Advice is Judged
docs.text:
2609.20989v2 by Aryan Ramchandra Kapadia, Eshwar Chandrasekharan, Koustuv Saha

As generative AI is increasingly used as a source of personal financial guidance, understanding how people appraise such advice is important for supporting appropriate reliance. We conducted a randomized vignette experiment with 285 U.S. adults across eight financial decisions, independently varying three advice styles---AI, expert, and online community---and displayed source labels while holding the underlying recommendation consistent. Advice style most strongly shaped message and safety appraisals, Expert labels selectively increased perceived source knowledge, and decision context primarily shaped risk and safety appraisals. These appraisals were associated with downstream judgments, with models explaining 69.2% of overall quality, 75.9% of trust, and 82.9% of intended reliance. Expert-style advice also remained most preferred when shown without source labels. Our findings have implications for understanding financial advice evaluation, distinguishing the roles of advice style and source labels, and designing financial AI that supports grounded evaluation rather than simply maximizing trust.

摘要：隨著生成式人工智慧越來越多地被用作個人財務指導的來源，了解人們如何評價這些建議對於支持適當的依賴至關重要。我們對285名美國成年人進行了一項隨機小品實驗，涵蓋八個財務決策，獨立變化三種建議風格——AI、專家和在線社區——並在保持基本建議一致的同時顯示來源標籤。建議風格最強烈地影響了信息和安全評估，專家標籤選擇性地提高了感知的來源知識，而決策背景主要影響風險和安全評估。這些評估與後續判斷相關，模型解釋了69.2%的整體質量、75.9%的信任和82.9%的預期依賴。專家風格的建議在未顯示來源標籤的情況下仍然是最受偏好的。我們的研究結果對理解財務建議評估、區分建議風格和來源標籤的角色，以及設計支持基於事實的評估而非僅僅是最大化信任的財務AI具有重要意義。

docs.title: ERCPMP-Gx: Endoscopic Image and Video Dataset for Morphological, Histopathological, and Genomic Characterization of Colorectal Polyposis
docs.text:
2609.20815v1 by Zahra Ghaffari, Massih Bahar, Mojgan Forootan, Ali Darvishi, Hamidreza Bolhasani

Hereditary polyposis syndromes can be precursor lesions to colorectal cancer and are associated with a broad spectrum of extracolonic tumors. Early identification and accurate classification of these syndromes are essential for timely diagnosis, individualized patient management, and targeted surveillance strategies for affected families. However, public endoscopic datasets are largely organized around the individual sporadic polyp, and none links the polyposis phenotype to histopathology and germline findings at the patient level. Here, we present ERCPMP-Gx, an endoscopic, histopathological, and genomic dataset developed to support the application of artificial intelligence (AI) in the recognition, characterization, and classification of colorectal polyposis. Most procedures were performed using the Olympus EVIS X1 system with white-light endoscopy (WLE), narrow-band imaging (NBI), magnifying NBI (M-NBI), and NBI with near focus modes, yielding 160 images and accompanying video clips. Approximately eighty percent of cases represent clinically and/or genetically confirmed hereditary polyposis syndromes (PG), including familial adenomatous polyposis (FAP), Peutz-Jeghers syndrome (PJS), juvenile polyposis syndrome (JPS), and ganglioneuroma syndrome (GNS), while the remaining twenty percent comprise non-hereditary polyps and polyp-mimicking lesions with overlapping morphological features (Non-PG), included to support differential classification. Each released record is linked, where available, to standardized endoscopic annotations, representative histopathology, and clinically reported germline findings, forming an AI-ready, patient-level annotation framework. The dataset is publicly accessible at Mendeley (https://doi.org/10.17632/nzyfc544bx.2). For the latest updates and further information, readers are referred to the DataBioX website: https://databiox.com.

摘要：遺傳性息肉症候群可能是結腸直腸癌的前驅病變，並與廣泛的腸外腫瘤相關聯。及早識別和準確分類這些症候群對於及時診斷、個性化病人管理以及針對受影響家庭的監測策略至關重要。然後，公共內視鏡數據集主要圍繞個別散發性息肉組織，而沒有將息肉症表型與患者層級的組織病理學和種系發現聯繫起來。在此，我們呈現ERCPMP-Gx，一個內視鏡、組織病理學和基因組數據集，旨在支持人工智慧（AI）在結腸直腸息肉的識別、特徵描述和分類中的應用。大多數程序使用奧林巴斯EVIS X1系統進行，配備白光內視鏡（WLE）、窄帶成像（NBI）、放大NBI（M-NBI）和近焦模式的NBI，產生160張圖像和伴隨的視頻片段。大約百分之八十的病例代表臨床和/或基因確認的遺傳性息肉症候群（PG），包括家族性腺瘤性息肉症（FAP）、Peutz-Jeghers症候群（PJS）、青少年息肉症候群（JPS）和神經節瘤症候群（GNS），而剩餘的百分之二十則包括非遺傳性息肉和具有重疊形態特徵的息肉模擬病變（Non-PG），以支持差異分類。每個發布的記錄都與標準化的內視鏡註釋、代表性的組織病理學和臨床報告的種系發現相連接，形成一個適合AI的患者層級註釋框架。該數據集可在Mendeley上公開訪問（https://doi.org/10.17632/nzyfc544bx.2）。有關最新更新和進一步信息，讀者可參考DataBioX網站：https://databiox.com。

docs.title: An Empirical Study of Harness Design for Coding Agents
docs.text:
2609.20804v1 by Run-Ze Fan, Zihao Zhang, Simin Ma, Yebowen Hu, Shouju Wang, Kaiqiang Song, Fei Liu, Hamed Zamani, Xiaoyang Wang

Coding harnesses shape how autonomous coding agents translate model capabilities into long-horizon software-engineering performance, yet existing work typically evaluates harnesses as monolithic systems, leaving the effectiveness of individual components unclear. To enable component-level comparisons, we study this question with a lightweight coding harness whose execution loop is fixed while three components are varied: planning, action space, and context management. Across four models evaluated on SWE-Bench Verified and Terminal-Bench 2.1, we evaluate 176 matched settings spanning five context-management strategies, four context-window budgets, and targeted ablations of planning and action space. We find that: (1) Context management becomes increasingly valuable as the context-window budget tightens, with most of its benefit coming from preventing context-overflow failures. (2) Staging rule-based elision before LLM-based summarization provides the strongest overall efficiency among the context-management strategies, whereas making elided content recoverable adds machinery that models rarely use and yields no accuracy gain. (3) Planning shifts from an accuracy scaffold for weaker models to a cost saver for stronger models, with little change in accuracy. (4) Predefined tools improve performance for models with weaker bash proficiency, whereas bash-capable models can operate effectively with a bash-only interface and achieve substantially lower cost, especially on command-line-centric tasks. Trajectory-level analysis explains these effects: context management extends execution trajectories without substantially altering agent behavior, planning changes where trajectories stop, and the action space changes the granularity at which code is written. These findings inform model- and budget-aware harness design and provide a modular framework for evaluating future harness components.

摘要：編碼工具的設計影響自主編碼代理如何將模型能力轉化為長期軟體工程表現，但現有的研究通常將編碼工具評估為整體系統，這使得單個組件的有效性不明確。為了實現組件級的比較，我們研究這個問題，使用一個輕量級的編碼工具，其執行循環是固定的，而三個組件則有所變化：規劃、行動空間和上下文管理。在對SWE-Bench Verified和Terminal-Bench 2.1評估的四個模型中，我們評估了176個匹配的設置，涵蓋五種上下文管理策略、四種上下文窗口預算，以及針對規劃和行動空間的針對性刪減。我們發現：（1）隨著上下文窗口預算的收緊，上下文管理變得越來越有價值，其大部分好處來自於防止上下文溢出失敗。（2）在LLM基礎的摘要之前進行階段性基於規則的省略，在上下文管理策略中提供了最強的整體效率，而使省略內容可恢復則增加了模型很少使用的機械，並且沒有帶來準確性的提升。（3）規劃從較弱模型的準確性支架轉變為較強模型的成本節省者，準確性變化不大。（4）預定義的工具提高了對於bash熟練度較弱模型的性能，而具備bash能力的模型則可以有效地使用僅限bash的介面運作，並在以命令行為中心的任務中實現顯著降低的成本。軌跡級分析解釋了這些效果：上下文管理延長了執行軌跡而不顯著改變代理行為，規劃改變了軌跡停止的地方，而行動空間改變了編碼的粒度。這些發現為模型和預算意識的編碼工具設計提供了指導，並為評估未來的編碼工具組件提供了模組化框架。

docs.title: A Qualitative Model for Reasoning about Path and Support
docs.text:
2609.20349v1 by Abhishek Jaiswal, Zoe Falomir

Spatial reasoning abilities correlate strongly with performance in STEM fields. Games offer a compelling medium for training these critical skills in developing children who have a natural proclivity for play. However, to facilitate human-like tutoring and player guidance, these games require an AI agent capable of making commonsense inferences from spatial events. Qualitative reasoning (QR) models appear to be a suitable framework for these application domains. As these models reason in symbolic representations, they can seamlessly translate game states into interpretable feedback for human-like player guidance. This paper introduces a hybrid qualitative model designed for Camelot Jr., a block-puzzle game that requires constructing multi-level bridges to connect two avatars stationed on separate towers. The game poses a challenge for the player, who must make platforms stable, plan their path, and ensure they use all the provided blocks. To handle the precise physics required by the domain, we integrate a mathematical center-of-mass stability logic to guide our qualitative solver. Our work facilitates spatial skill training in Camelot Jr. and contributes to the development of human-centric, explainable game-playing agents.

摘要：空間推理能力與STEM領域的表現有著強烈的相關性。遊戲提供了一個引人入勝的媒介，用於培養這些關鍵技能，以幫助那些天生喜愛遊玩的孩子。然而，為了促進類人輔導和玩家指導，這些遊戲需要一個能夠從空間事件中做出常識推斷的AI代理。質性推理（QR）模型似乎是這些應用領域的合適框架。由於這些模型以符號表示進行推理，它們可以無縫地將遊戲狀態轉換為可解釋的反饋，以便進行類人玩家指導。本文介紹了一個為Camelot Jr.設計的混合質性模型，這是一個需要構建多層橋樑以連接駐紮在不同塔樓上的兩個化身的積木拼圖遊戲。這款遊戲對玩家提出了挑戰，玩家必須使平台穩定、規劃路徑，並確保使用所有提供的積木。為了處理該領域所需的精確物理，我們整合了一個數學質心穩定邏輯來指導我們的質性求解器。我們的工作促進了Camelot Jr.中的空間技能訓練，並有助於開發以人為中心的可解釋遊戲代理。

docs.title: NeuSOGA3D: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Explainable 3D Geometric Reconstruction
docs.text:
2609.20323v2 by Qingde Li, Qingqi Hong, Zihan Li, Jie Tian

Three-dimensional reconstruction from unorganized point clouds remains a challenging problem in computer vision, geometric modeling, and computer-aided design. While neural implicit methods achieve impressive reconstruction accuracy, geometry is typically encoded in latent representations that limit interpretability and reuse within engineering workflows. We present NeuSOGA3D (Neuro-Symbolic Observation-Guided Geometric Abstraction in 3D), a hybrid framework that combines learned perceptual priors inherited from NeuSOGA with explicit symbolic geometric reasoning. The method projects point clouds onto principal orthographic planes, constructs symbolic implicit spline representations from the resulting observations, and fuses them through shape-preserving constructive solid geometry operations to generate a coarse visual hull. Additional geometric detail is recovered through cross-sectional decomposition and volumetric reconstruction using Partial Shape-Preserving Splines. Unlike conventional neural implicit approaches, NeuSOGA3D progressively transforms observations into explicit symbolic entities, including control polygons, implicit spline fields, cross-sections, and volumetric lofts. Experiments on all forty categories of the ModelNet40 benchmark demonstrate the ability of the framework to recover structurally meaningful and CAD-compatible geometric representations from diverse point-cloud observations. The results highlight the potential of combining learned perception with symbolic geometric reasoning for explainable geometric intelligence.

摘要：三維重建來自無組織點雲仍然是計算機視覺、幾何建模和計算機輔助設計中的一個挑戰性問題。雖然神經隱式方法實現了令人印象深刻的重建精度，但幾何通常以潛在表示的形式編碼，這限制了其在工程工作流程中的可解釋性和重用性。 我們提出了NeuSOGA3D（神經符號觀察引導的三維幾何抽象），這是一個混合框架，結合了來自NeuSOGA的學習感知先驗和明確的符號幾何推理。該方法將點雲投影到主正交平面上，從生成的觀察中構建符號隱式樣條表示，並通過保持形狀的構造實體幾何操作將它們融合以生成粗略的視覺外殼。 通過橫截面分解和使用部分形狀保持樣條的體積重建，恢復額外的幾何細節。與傳統的神經隱式方法不同，NeuSOGA3D逐步將觀察轉換為明確的符號實體，包括控制多邊形、隱式樣條場、橫截面和體積升高。 在ModelNet40基準的四十個類別上進行的實驗展示了該框架從多樣的點雲觀察中恢復結構上有意義且與CAD兼容的幾何表示的能力。結果突顯了將學習感知與符號幾何推理相結合以實現可解釋幾何智能的潛力。

docs.title: Bridging Modalities on the Cortex: Surface-based MRI to PET Translation with a Diffusion Bridge
docs.text:
2609.20147v1 by Yitong Li, Alexandra Samoylova, Fabian Bongratz, Timo Grimmer, Dennis M. Hedderich, Igor Yakushev, Christian Wachinger

Cortical hypometabolism measured by Fluorodeoxyglucose Positron Emission Tomography (FDG-PET) is a highly sensitive biomarker for dementia diagnosis. However, high costs, radiation exposure, and limited accessibility constrain its clinical utility. While cross-modal synthesis from Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) offers a promising alternative, existing volumetric generation methods do not explicitly account for the highly folded cortical geometry, where disease-related patterns predominantly reside. To address this, we introduce a novel surface-based diffusion bridge framework DB-SUiT for MRI-to-PET translation that operates natively on the cortical manifold. A conditional Spherical U-shaped vision Transformer (SUiT) is specifically designed to model the intricate cross-modal relationships while preserving surface topology. It combines spherical convolutional encoders for multi-scale surface feature extraction with bottleneck Transformers to capture long-range spatial dependencies, while incorporating demographic and subcortical conditions to refine the synthesis. Evaluated on two datasets, including subjects with different dementia types, DB-SUiT demonstrates high-fidelity synthesis that substantially outperforms other baselines. In automated dementia classification, synthesized PET surfaces improve performance over MRI by 14.2% and PET volumes by 11.3%, approaching the performance of real PET surfaces. In a blinded reader study, synthetic PET achieved 85.5% diagnostic accuracy, compared with 75.8% for MRI and 95.2% for real PET. This further demonstrates cross-cohort and cross-pathology generalization, as the model was evaluated without retraining on an external cohort that included a dementia subtype not represented during training. Our code is available at https://github.com/ai-med/DB-SUiT.

摘要：皮質低代謝量由氟脫氧葡萄糖正子發射斷層掃描（FDG-PET）測量，是一個對於癡呆診斷的高度敏感生物標記。然而，高昂的成本、輻射暴露和有限的可及性限制了其臨床實用性。雖然來自磁共振成像（MRI）的跨模態合成提供了一個有前景的替代方案，但現有的體積生成方法並未明確考慮高度摺疊的皮質幾何結構，而疾病相關模式主要存在於此。為了解決這個問題，我們引入了一種新穎的基於表面的擴散橋接框架DB-SUiT，用於MRI到PET的轉換，該框架在皮質流形上原生運行。一個條件性的球形U型視覺Transformer（SUiT）專門設計用來建模複雜的跨模態關係，同時保留表面拓撲。它結合了球形卷積編碼器以進行多尺度表面特徵提取，並使用瓶頸Transformer來捕捉長距離空間依賴性，同時納入人口統計和皮層下條件以精煉合成。在兩個數據集上進行評估，包括不同癡呆類型的受試者，DB-SUiT顯示出高保真度的合成，顯著超越其他基準。在自動癡呆分類中，合成的PET表面相比MRI提高了14.2%的性能，PET體積提高了11.3%，接近真實PET表面的性能。在一項盲讀者研究中，合成的PET達到了85.5%的診斷準確率，而MRI為75.8%，真實PET為95.2%。這進一步展示了跨隊列和跨病理的泛化，因為該模型在未經重新訓練的外部隊列上進行評估，該隊列包括在訓練期間未代表的癡呆亞型。我們的代碼可在https://github.com/ai-med/DB-SUiT獲得。

docs.title: PAANI : On Device Visual Evidence Fusion and Explainable Guidance for River Robot Simulation
docs.text:
2609.22353v1 by Savio Cardoz, Santhiya Rajan

Mobile river monitoring robots must interpret obstacles and water boundaries that geographic waypoints alone cannot describe. On resource constrained platforms, converting imperfect visual predictions into timely and inspectable guidance is a distinct challenge. An object label or steering command does not explain which evidence supports a decision or when that evidence is unreliable. We present PAANI, an on-device perception to guidance architecture that combines a project trained YOLO11n detector and a custom MobileNetV3 Small semantic segmenter with timestamp aligned evidence fusion on Arduino UNO Q. Bounded tracking supplies object persistence, while an explicit corridor policy combines surface labels, accepted detections, urgency and mask uncertainty. Each final advisory exposes its contributing evidence and policy reasons. ROS 2 interfaces connect the local AI pipeline to a separate Gazebo vessel, localization and control testbed. Training uses 10,000 WaterScenes images for four-class detection and 1,127 MaSTr1325 images for segmentation, including 198 segmentation validation images. The selected FP32 ONNX models occupy 14.817 MB. Detector checkpoint test mAP at 0.5 IoU is 0.7388, while the separately evaluated rectangular ONNX export achieves validation mAP at 0.5 IoU of 0.7367. Segmentation ONNX validation mIoU is 0.9750. A five-minute UNO Q recording produced median and 95th percentile pipeline latencies of 467.8 ms and 580.3 ms at a configured 0.5 Hz cadence. The evaluation also identifies black input misclassification and a sampling rate mismatch that prevents the diagnostic apparent motion estimator from collecting sufficient evidence. These results support an inspectable and reusable edge robotics foundation while clearly distinguishing model accuracy and on-board execution from validated on-water collision avoidance.

摘要：移動河流監測機器人必須解釋障礙物和水邊界，而僅靠地理路徑點無法描述這些。在資源受限的平台上，將不完美的視覺預測轉換為及時且可檢查的指導是一項獨特的挑戰。一個物體標籤或轉向命令並不能解釋哪些證據支持決策或何時該證據不可靠。我們提出了PAANI，一種將經過項目訓練的YOLO11n檢測器和自定義的MobileNetV3 Small語義分割器與Arduino UNO Q上的時間戳對齊證據融合相結合的設備內感知到指導架構。有界追蹤提供物體持續性，而顯式走廊策略則結合了表面標籤、接受的檢測、緊急性和掩碼不確定性。每個最終建議都揭示其貢獻證據和政策原因。ROS 2接口將本地AI管道連接到一個單獨的Gazebo船隻、定位和控制測試平台。訓練使用了10,000張WaterScenes圖像進行四類檢測，以及1,127張MaSTr1325圖像進行分割，包括198張分割驗證圖像。所選的FP32 ONNX模型佔用14.817 MB。檢測器檢查點測試的mAP在0.5 IoU下為0.7388，而單獨評估的矩形ONNX導出在0.5 IoU下達到驗證mAP為0.7367。分割ONNX驗證的mIoU為0.9750。五分鐘的UNO Q錄音產生了中位數和95百分位數的管道延遲，分別為467.8毫秒和580.3毫秒，配置為0.5 Hz的頻率。評估還識別出黑色輸入誤分類和取樣率不匹配，這阻止了診斷明顯運動估計器收集足夠的證據。這些結果支持可檢查和可重用的邊緣機器人基礎，同時清楚地區分模型準確性和板載執行與經過驗證的水上碰撞避免。

docs.title: Reproducibility is not construct validity: LLM measurement of institutionally situated communication
docs.text:
2609.19866v1 by Veronika Batzdorfer, Carlo Romano Marcello Alessandro Santagiustina

High annotation reproducibility does not necessarily imply that an LLM-inferred measure captures the construct it is intended to measure. We test this distinction using a dataset from the European Commission's AI Act consultation, linking structured survey responses to free-text consultation submissions from the same stakeholders. LLM annotations of consultation submissions are highly reproducible (intraclass correlations > 0.99), yet show limited convergence with survey-reported measures of the nominal construct they were intended to approximate. Divergence between survey-and LLM-inferred text-based measures varies systematically across stakeholder groups: business associations express greater concern about AI risks in text-based consultations than in survey responses ({g} = +1.0), whereas public authorities and several nonbusiness groups show smaller or negative divergences. Divergences between scores suggest positive spatial autocorrelation across European countries (Moran's I = 0.347, p = 0.036), indicating that stakeholders from neighboring countries tend toward more similar text-based stances towards AI safety concerns. Despite divergence, survey-reported concerns remain strongly associated with support for explainability across all divergence levels. These results demonstrate that LLM annotation reproducibility can coexist with poor construct correspondence and motivate validation procedures that distinguish reproducibility, construct validity, and communication context variation when LLMs are used as measurement instruments.

摘要：高註解可重複性並不一定意味著 LLM 推斷的量度捕捉了其所意圖測量的構念。我們使用來自歐洲委員會 AI 法案諮詢的數據集來測試這一區別，將結構化的調查回應與來自相同利益相關者的自由文本諮詢提交相連結。LLM 對諮詢提交的註解具有高度的可重複性（組內相關係數 > 0.99），但與調查報告的名義構念量度之間的收斂性有限。調查與 LLM 推斷的基於文本的量度之間的差異在利益相關者群體中系統性地變化：商業協會在基於文本的諮詢中對 AI 風險表達的關注程度高於調查回應（{g} = +1.0），而公共當局和幾個非商業團體則顯示出較小或負的差異。分數之間的差異表明歐洲國家之間存在正的空間自相關（Moran's I = 0.347, p = 0.036），這表明來自鄰近國家的利益相關者在對 AI 安全問題的基於文本的立場上傾向於更相似。儘管存在差異，調查報告的關注仍然與各種差異水平的可解釋性支持強烈相關。這些結果表明，LLM 註解的可重複性可以與構念對應的不足共存，並促使驗證程序的進行，以區分可重複性、構念效度和溝通背景變異，當 LLM 被用作測量工具時。

docs.title: Large Language Model Agents for Evidence Based Genetic Disease Severity Classification
docs.text:
2609.19569v2 by Tohid Ghasemnejad, Ahmadreza Argha, Mark Grosser, John Wang, Min Yang, Thantrira Porntaveetus, Tony Roscioli, Nigel H. Lovell, Mahmoud Aarabi, Hamid Alinejad-Rokny

Disease severity classification for genetic conditions is subjective and labor-intensive, creating bottlenecks in genomic screening, where commercial panels vary widely in size and overlap. We developed an autonomous AI agent integrating Reasoning and Acting (ReAct) with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to classify 10,211 Human Phenotype Ontology terms. It uses American College of Medical Genetics (ACMG)-endorsed severity guidelines and American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (ACOG) quality-of-life criteria to retrieve PubMed literature, generate interpretable reasoning chains, and independently verify claims. At the phenotype level, using expert-curated cohorts, the agent achieved 93.55% accuracy (MCC 0.9237) with 82.6% to 91.4% of claims supported by direct evidence or valid inferences. Gene-level severity was aggregated across 8,738 pairs, identifying 3,283 autosomal recessive pairs with severe or profound presentations. External validation showed 95.2% concordance with Mackenzie's Mission gene list. This system enables standardized panel design by providing reliable, automated classification supported by direct evidence.

摘要：疾病嚴重程度的分類對於遺傳條件來說是主觀且勞動密集的，這在基因組篩查中造成了瓶頸，因為商業面板的大小和重疊程度差異很大。我們開發了一個自主的 AI 代理，將推理和行動 (ReAct) 與檢索增強生成 (RAG) 整合，以對 10,211 個人類表型本體術語進行分類。它使用美國醫學遺傳學會 (ACMG) 認可的嚴重程度指導方針和美國婦產科醫學會 (ACOG) 的生活質量標準來檢索 PubMed 文獻，生成可解釋的推理鏈，並獨立驗證主張。在表型層面上，使用專家策劃的隊列，該代理達到了 93.55% 的準確率 (MCC 0.9237)，其中 82.6% 至 91.4% 的主張得到了直接證據或有效推論的支持。基因層面的嚴重程度在 8,738 對中進行了匯總，識別出 3,283 個具有嚴重或深度表現的常染色體隱性對。外部驗證顯示與 Mackenzie's Mission 基因名單的符合率為 95.2%。該系統通過提供可靠的、基於直接證據的自動化分類，實現了標準化面板設計。

docs.title: A Multi-Modal Generative Model for Tomato Disease Leaves Understanding
docs.text:
2609.19555v1 by Khang Nguyen Quoc, Minh-Phuoc Tran, Gia-Han Truong, Luyl-Da Quach

Artificial intelligence for plant disease analysis has advanced from task-specific classifiers to multi-modal models capable of jointly interpreting visual and textual information. However, practical deployment in precision agriculture remains limited because most existing approaches treat disease understanding as isolated prediction tasks, failing to capture the complementary relationships among symptom recognition, severity assessment, and question-driven diagnostic reasoning. In tomato pathology, accurate interpretation of diseased leaves requires more than label prediction; it demands integrating visual symptoms with semantic context to support a comprehensive and explainable understanding. Here, we present SOLAR, a multimodal generative model that understands tomato disease spanning six question-answering tasks. SOLAR learns to align visual features with task-aware language representations by Fusion Expert module based on mixture-of-expert, enabling it to generate contextually relevant answers across diverse diagnostic tasks. By formulating tomato disease analysis as a generative Visual Question Answering (VQA) task, SOLAR provides a flexible framework that supports multi-task inference within a single model while improving performance and cross-task knowledge sharing. We evaluate SOLAR on $41,677$ images, including $216,209$ Question-Answering (QA) pairs to understand tomato leaf disease under both closed and open-ended QA settings. Experimental results show that SOLAR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art vision-only, vision-language, and task-specific models across all tasks, demonstrating superior accuracy, robustness, and multimodal reasoning. These findings highlight the potential of generative multimodal modeling as an effective direction for understanding of plant disease. The code for this study is available at https://github.com/EnalisUs/SOLAR.

摘要：人工智慧在植物疾病分析方面已經從特定任務的分類器發展到能夠共同解釋視覺和文本信息的多模態模型。然而，實際在精準農業中的應用仍然有限，因為大多數現有的方法將疾病理解視為孤立的預測任務，未能捕捉到症狀識別、嚴重程度評估和問題驅動的診斷推理之間的互補關係。在番茄病理學中，準確解釋病變葉片需要的不僅僅是標籤預測；它要求將視覺症狀與語義上下文整合，以支持全面且可解釋的理解。在這裡，我們介紹SOLAR，一個多模態生成模型，能夠理解涵蓋六個問答任務的番茄疾病。SOLAR通過基於專家混合的融合專家模塊學習將視覺特徵與任務感知的語言表示對齊，使其能夠在各種診斷任務中生成上下文相關的答案。通過將番茄疾病分析表述為生成的視覺問答（VQA）任務，SOLAR提供了一個靈活的框架，支持在單一模型中進行多任務推理，同時提高性能和跨任務知識共享。我們在$41,677$張圖像上評估SOLAR，包括$216,209$個問答（QA）對，以了解在封閉和開放式QA設置下的番茄葉病。實驗結果顯示，SOLAR在所有任務中始終超越最先進的僅視覺、視覺-語言和特定任務模型，展現出卓越的準確性、穩健性和多模態推理能力。這些發現突顯了生成多模態建模作為理解植物疾病的有效方向的潛力。本研究的代碼可在 https://github.com/EnalisUs/SOLAR 獲得。

docs.title: Predict Before You Deploy: Offline Prediction of Quantization-Induced Task Degradation for World Action Models
docs.text:
2609.19441v1 by Jiuyi Xu, Jinjia Guo, Meida Chen, Jing Du, Yangming Shi

World action models (WAMs) rely on video-generation backbones, requiring substantial memory and compute for deployment. Post-training quantization reduces memory and can accelerate inference, but bit width, grouping, and quantizer choice define a large configuration space. Identifying configurations that preserve task performance through exhaustive closed-loop evaluation is costly. We propose PreDE (Predict Before You Deploy), a policy-calibrated framework for predicting quantization-induced task degradation from offline action deviations. Using closed-loop outcomes from a small development set, PreDE calibrates two thresholds and accepts, rejects, or defers new configurations using a fixed observation log. Under a within-setting label-ordering hypothesis, the rule issues decisions where all thresholds consistent with the development labels agree. Across five WAMs and four benchmark settings, quantization produces configuration-dependent task losses that cannot be explained by bit width alone or a shared deviation threshold. Across 28 held-out configurations from two policies, PreDE issued 21 decisions before observing closed-loop outcomes (75% coverage), all matching the observed acceptable or degraded labels. Deferred candidates included both acceptable outcomes and a 33-percentage-point loss. In 450 Franka Research 3 trials across two independently fine-tuned policies, all configurations assigned to high-deviation groups before testing showed significant degradation, while low-deviation comparisons showed no statistically significant degradation. On the real robot, W4A4 achieved a 1.37x action-query speedup and approximately 44% lower peak memory. These results support policy-specific behavioral calibration for quantization configuration selection while identifying candidates that require closed-loop evaluation. The code is available at https://github.com/jiuyixu25/PreDE.

摘要：世界行動模型（WAMs）依賴於視頻生成骨幹，這需要大量的內存和計算資源來進行部署。訓練後量化可以減少內存並加速推理，但位寬、分組和量化器的選擇定義了一個龐大的配置空間。通過徹底的閉環評估來識別保留任務性能的配置是成本高昂的。我們提出了PreDE（預測後再部署），這是一個政策校準框架，用於從離線行動偏差中預測量化引起的任務退化。利用來自小型開發集的閉環結果，PreDE校準了兩個閾值，並使用固定的觀察日誌接受、拒絕或延遲新的配置。在一個內部設定的標籤排序假設下，該規則在所有與開發標籤一致的閾值同意的情況下發出決策。在五個WAMs和四個基準設定中，量化產生的任務損失依賴於配置，這不能僅通過位寬或共享偏差閾值來解釋。在來自兩個政策的28個保留配置中，PreDE在觀察到閉環結果之前發出了21個決策（75% 覆蓋率），所有決策均與觀察到的可接受或退化標籤相匹配。延遲的候選者包括可接受的結果和33個百分點的損失。在450次Franka Research 3的試驗中，所有在測試前被分配到高偏差組的配置顯示出顯著的退化，而低偏差的比較則未顯示出統計上顯著的退化。在真實機器人上，W4A4實現了1.37倍的行動查詢加速和約44%的峰值內存降低。這些結果支持針對量化配置選擇的政策特定行為校準，同時識別需要閉環評估的候選者。代碼可在 https://github.com/jiuyixu25/PreDE 獲得。

docs.title: Can Vision-Language Models Judge Olympic Diving? From Reasoning to Scores in Zero-Shot Action Quality Assessment
docs.text:
2609.19354v1 by Henry O. Velesaca, David Freire-Obregon, Luigi Miranda, Abel Reyes-Angulo

Automated action quality assessment (AQA) in Olympic sports remains a challenging task due to the complexity of human motion and the subjectivity inherent in expert judging. This work evaluates the capability of open-source Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to perform zero-shot action quality assessment on Olympic diving videos using the AQA-7 benchmark dataset. In this regard, a regression-based framework is pro-posed to leverage both the semantic reasoning and phase-level sub-scores generated by the VLMs, combining TF-IDF vectorization, dimensionality reduction, and ensemble learning to predict final competition scores. Experimental results show that standalone VLMs achieve moderate Spearman correlations below 0.32, while the proposed ensemble regression framework substantially improves performance in the reported evaluation, reaching a Spearman correlation of 0.67 with a four-model configuration. Textual reasoning features con-sistently outperformed raw numerical sub-scores, highlighting the richness of VLM-generated explanations for action quality analysis. These findings suggest that VLMs hold strong potential as assistive tools for explainable and semi-automated sports performance evaluation. The code is publicly available on GitHub https://github.com/hvelesaca/olympic diving judge vlm

摘要：自動化動作質量評估（AQA）在奧林匹克運動中仍然是一項具有挑戰性的任務，這是由於人類動作的複雜性和專家評判中固有的主觀性。這項工作評估了開源視覺-語言模型（VLMs）在使用 AQA-7 基準數據集對奧林匹克跳水視頻進行零樣本動作質量評估的能力。在這方面，提出了一種基於回歸的框架，以利用 VLMs 生成的語義推理和階段級子分數，結合 TF-IDF 向量化、降維和集成學習來預測最終比賽分數。實驗結果顯示，獨立的 VLMs 在斯皮爾曼相關性上達到0.32以下的中等水平，而所提出的集成回歸框架在報告的評估中顯著提高了性能，達到0.67的斯皮爾曼相關性，使用四個模型的配置。文本推理特徵始終優於原始數字子分數，突顯了 VLM 生成的解釋在動作質量分析中的豐富性。這些發現表明，VLMs 作為可解釋和半自動化體育表現評估的輔助工具具有強大的潛力。代碼已在 GitHub 上公開，網址為 https://github.com/hvelesaca/olympic diving judge vlm

docs.title: Prepared Or Unprepared? Evaluating Healthcare Workforce Readiness for Clinical Adoption of Artificial Intelligence in Nigeria
docs.text:
2609.19096v1 by Abbas M. Rabiu, Abdulrazaq A. Zubair, Um-mulkhairi Ibrahim, Tolulope Olusuyi, Shaheeda Farouq, Safwan M. Dafi, Adaobi C. Emegoakor, Yewande Gbadamosi, Maruf Adewole

Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly integrated into healthcare systems worldwide, yet its successful clinical adoption depends critically on workforce readiness, particularly in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) where infrastructural and training gaps persist. This cross-sectional study evaluated awareness, attitudes, preparedness, and barriers to AI adoption among 761 healthcare professionals across multiple disciplines and practice settings in Nigeria. Data were collected between December 2025 and March 2026 using a structured, validated questionnaire. Overall awareness of AI in healthcare was high (92.6%); however, objective knowledge and self-reported preparedness remained limited, with 40.9% reporting low or very low knowledge and only 63.0% feeling adequately prepared. Willingness to adopt AI was high: 92.5% expressed interest in training, and 78.7% supported inclusion of AI education in undergraduate curricula. Key barriers included lack of training (84.7%), poor infrastructure (71.1%), high cost of AI tools (61.0%), fear of job displacement (60.6%), ethical concerns (52.9%), and data privacy concerns (52.7%). Significant differences in preparedness were observed across geopolitical zones (chi-square (5) = 24.28, p < 0.001), and awareness differed across professional groups (chi-square (6) = 68.38, p < 0.001). Attitudes toward AI differed significantly across professional groups (F = 3.32, p = 0.003), with professionals who felt prepared demonstrating more positive attitudes (mean = 3.74) compared to those who did not (mean = 3.46). These findings reveal a critical disconnect between high awareness and actual readiness, underscoring the need for targeted training, infrastructure investment, and clear implementation frameworks to bridge the gap between AI technological potential and clinical reality in resource-constrained settings.

摘要：人工智慧（AI）正日益融入全球的醫療系統，但其成功的臨床採用在很大程度上依賴於人力資源的準備程度，特別是在基礎設施和培訓存在缺口的低收入和中等收入國家（LMICs）。本橫斷面研究評估了761名來自尼日利亞多個學科和實踐環境的醫療專業人員對AI的認識、態度、準備情況和採用障礙。數據於2025年12月至2026年3月期間通過結構化的經驗驗證問卷收集。醫療領域對AI的整體認識很高（92.6%）；然而，客觀知識和自我報告的準備程度仍然有限，40.9%的人報告知識低或非常低，只有63.0%的人感到準備充分。對於採用AI的意願很高：92.5%的人表達了對培訓的興趣，78.7%的人支持在本科課程中納入AI教育。主要障礙包括缺乏培訓（84.7%）、基礎設施差（71.1%）、AI工具的高成本（61.0%）、對工作取代的恐懼（60.6%）、倫理問題（52.9%）和數據隱私問題（52.7%）。在地緣政治區域之間觀察到準備程度的顯著差異（卡方檢驗（5）= 24.28，p < 0.001），而不同專業群體之間的認識也有所不同（卡方檢驗（6）= 68.38，p < 0.001）。對AI的態度在不同專業群體之間顯著不同（F = 3.32，p = 0.003），感到準備充分的專業人員表現出更積極的態度（平均 = 3.74），相比之下，感到不充分的專業人員的平均值為3.46。這些發現揭示了高認識與實際準備之間的關鍵脫節，強調了需要針對性的培訓、基礎設施投資和明確的實施框架，以縮小AI技術潛力與資源有限環境中的臨床現實之間的差距。

docs.title: Reporting Practice Matters: The Impact of Reference Choice on Chest X-ray Report Evaluation
docs.text:
2609.19093v1 by Daniel P. Jeong, Charles Q. Li, Hossein Hosseiny, Nitya M. Bhalla, Fatma Uyar Morency, Pradeep Ravikumar, Zachary C. Lipton, Michael Oberst

Radiologists follow heterogeneous reporting practices. Two radiologists examining the same image and identifying the same clinical findings might nevertheless compose superficially distinct reports, varying in terminology, shorthand, formatting, and level of detail. These variations in reporting norms represent an under-appreciated obstacle in efforts to evaluate AI-based radiology report generation (RRG) models, where machine-generated reports are typically assessed based on their concordance with human-generated references. In this paper, we quantify the sensitivity of established evaluation metrics to variations in reporting practices, revealing impacts large enough to alter the rankings of models. We introduce a radiologist-informed taxonomy of variations in radiology reporting practice and a method (ReRef) that rewrites reference reports along the axes of our taxonomy while preserving clinical interpretation. For instance, when comparing the performance of nine RRG models on MIMIC-CXR using RadCliQ-v1, condensing the discussion of normal findings in the reference reports causes Libra to drop from first to second place while CheXOne rises from third to first. Our results suggest that many current metrics fail to decouple clinical interpretation from conformity to reporting practices and that choosing the ``right'' references that accurately reflect the desired reporting practices can be important in practice. To support future research, we release MIMIC-CXR-Ext-ReRef, a radiologist-validated dataset of 120 (original, alternative) reference report pairs derived from MIMIC-CXR.

摘要：放射科醫生遵循異質的報告實踐。兩位放射科醫生檢查同一影像並識別相同的臨床發現，然而他們可能仍然撰寫表面上不同的報告，這些報告在術語、簡寫、格式和細節程度上有所不同。這些報告規範的變異代表了一個被低估的障礙，對於評估基於人工智慧的放射報告生成（RRG）模型的努力來說，機器生成的報告通常是根據其與人類生成的參考報告的一致性來評估的。在本文中，我們量化了既定評估指標對報告實踐變異的敏感性，揭示出足以改變模型排名的影響。我們引入了一個基於放射科醫生的放射報告實踐變異分類法以及一種方法（ReRef），該方法在我們的分類法軸上重寫參考報告，同時保留臨床解釋。例如，當使用RadCliQ-v1比較九個RRG模型在MIMIC-CXR上的表現時，對參考報告中正常發現的討論進行簡化，導致Libra從第一名降至第二名，而CheXOne則從第三名上升至第一名。我們的結果表明，許多當前的指標未能將臨床解釋與報告實踐的遵循分開，並且選擇準確反映所需報告實踐的“正確”參考在實踐中可能是重要的。為了支持未來的研究，我們發布了MIMIC-CXR-Ext-ReRef，這是一個經過放射科醫生驗證的數據集，包含120對（原始、替代）參考報告對，來源於MIMIC-CXR。

docs.title: Probabilistic Linear Explanations
docs.text:
2609.19077v1 by Frederic Koriche, Jean-Marie Lagniez, Chi Tran

Formal explainability provides mathematically grounded justifications for individual predictions. However, abductive explanations often exceed human cognitive limits by involving too many features, while probabilistic relaxations have remained largely limited to categorical classification. We present a unified framework for probabilistic explainability based on sparse, anchored linear models, applicable to both binary classification and continuous regression. By mapping instances to the Boolean hypercube, our linear explanations strictly generalize subset-based approaches: they capture both the magnitude and direction of feature contributions while enforcing a prescribed sparsity budget $k$. We show that minimizing the relevance error for such explanations is \ClassNPPP-hard when the underlying model is a neural network, and we relate this intractable objective to a tractable surrogate---the fidelity error. For a parameterized family of local distributions, the relevance error of any $k$-sparse explanation is bounded by its fidelity error up to a multiplicative factor that remains small locally. We address the resulting empirical problem using two complementary approaches: a Mixed Integer Programming (MIP) formulation that yields provably optimal empirical solutions while maintaining polynomial sample complexity, and a polynomial-time Iterative Hard Thresholding (IHT) algorithm with provable approximation guarantees. Empirical evaluations show that, unlike state-of-the-art baselines such as LIME and MAPLE, our explanations satisfy both the anchoring and sparsity constraints by construction, while consistently achieving lower relevance error.

摘要：正式的可解釋性提供了對個別預測的數學基礎的合理解釋。然而，溯因解釋往往超出了人類的認知極限，因為涉及的特徵過多，而概率放寬在很大程度上仍然僅限於類別分類。我們提出了一個基於稀疏、錨定線性模型的概率可解釋性統一框架，適用於二元分類和連續回歸。通過將實例映射到布爾超立方體，我們的線性解釋嚴格地概括了基於子集的方法：它們捕捉了特徵貢獻的大小和方向，同時強制執行預定的稀疏預算 $k$。我們展示了當基礎模型為神經網絡時，最小化此類解釋的相關性誤差是 \ClassNPPP-困難的，並將這一難以處理的目標與一個可處理的替代目標——保真誤差相關聯。對於一個參數化的局部分佈族，任何 $k$-稀疏解釋的相關性誤差都被其保真誤差所限制，且乘數因子在局部保持較小。我們使用兩種互補的方法來解決這一實證問題：一種混合整數規劃（MIP）公式，能夠產生可證明的最佳實證解決方案，同時保持多項式樣本複雜度；另一種是具有可證明近似保證的多項式時間迭代硬閾值（IHT）算法。實證評估顯示，與 LIME 和 MAPLE 等最先進的基準不同，我們的解釋在構造上滿足錨定和稀疏約束，同時始終實現較低的相關性誤差。

docs.title: Double descent is the principle of least action
docs.text:
2609.19076v2 by Congzhou M Sha

The test error of a model plotted against its number of parameters $d$ falls, peaks when the model can just fit the training data, and falls again, exhibiting the double descent phenomenon. We explain the phenomenon with statistical mechanics. The training trajectory of a stochastic gradient-based method is a particle wandering over the energy landscape of the training loss at an induced temperature $T$, and a run that has equilibrated visits every parameter vector of a given training loss equally often, the fundamental postulate of statistical mechanics, with probability given by the Boltzmann distribution. Because training starts at an initial point and has only finite time to diffuse, it carries an effective weight decay, which makes every parameter a quadratic degree of freedom. The equipartition theorem then distributes the energy among the $d$ degrees of freedom in shares of $T/2$, so at a fixed training loss adding parameters lowers the temperature and drives the Boltzmann distribution toward the stationary path. Finally, adding parameters can only lower the $L^2$ norm of the stationary path, so a solution sampled at fixed loss is less likely to be large with increasing $d$, effectively increasing weight regularization.

摘要：模型的測試錯誤與其參數數量 $d$ 的關係圖呈現下降趨勢，當模型剛好能擬合訓練數據時達到峰值，然後再次下降，顯示出雙重下降現象。 我們用統計力學來解釋這一現象。 基於隨機梯度的方法的訓練軌跡就像是一個粒子在訓練損失的能量景觀上隨機遊走，溫度為 $T$，而一個已經達到平衡的運行會以相等的頻率訪問給定訓練損失的每個參數向量，這是統計力學的基本假設，概率由玻爾茲曼分佈給出。 因為訓練是從一個初始點開始的，並且只有有限的時間進行擴散，它攜帶了一個有效的權重衰減，這使得每個參數成為一個二次自由度。 然後，等分配定理將能量在 $d$ 個自由度之間分配，每個自由度的能量為 $T/2$，因此在固定的訓練損失下，增加參數會降低溫度並驅動玻爾茲曼分佈朝向穩定路徑。 最後，增加參數只能降低穩定路徑的 $L^2$ 範數，因此在固定損失下抽樣的解隨著 $d$ 的增加而不太可能變得很大，有效地增加了權重正則化。

docs.title: RLLBC-Lib: An Educational Code Library for Reinforcement Learning and Learning-Based Control
docs.text:
2609.19074v1 by Bernd Frauenknecht, Emma Cramer, Artur Eisele, Paul Kruse, Lukas Kesper, Jonas Hertrampf, Ramil Sabirov, Jyotirmaya Patra, Johannes Berger, Paul Brunzema, Friedrich Solowjow, Sebastian Trimpe

Reinforcement learning (RL) is an exciting concept as well as a remarkable success story worth sharing. However, RL builds on rather complex interactions between different objects that play out over several cycles. Such dynamics are often best explained with an easily accessible implementation. We present RLLBC-Lib, a carefully crafted code library with the goal of lowering the entry barrier for students and other learners of RL in the context of learning-based control. At its heart, RLLBC-Lib comprises a comprehensive library of tabular RL approaches to enforce a clear understanding of the theoretical foundations. A deep RL library follows the same design principles, underscoring the parallels between simple tabular and state-of-the-art deep RL approaches. Additionally, RLLBC-Lib provides a collection of implementations illustrating core RL principles and contrasting RL to other learning-based control approaches. Finally, RLLBC-Lib provides an ideal basis for creating programming assignments with automated grading.

摘要：強化學習（RL）是一個令人興奮的概念，也是值得分享的卓越成功故事。然而，RL 建立在不同物件之間相當複雜的互動之上，這些互動在幾個循環中展開。這種動態通常最好用一個易於訪問的實現來解釋。我們介紹 RLLBC-Lib，這是一個精心設計的代碼庫，旨在降低學生和其他 RL 學習者在基於學習的控制上下的入門門檻。在其核心，RLLBC-Lib 包含一個全面的表格 RL 方法庫，以強化對理論基礎的清晰理解。深度 RL 庫遵循相同的設計原則，強調簡單表格方法和最先進的深度 RL 方法之間的相似性。此外，RLLBC-Lib 提供了一系列實現，說明核心 RL 原則並將 RL 與其他基於學習的控制方法進行對比。最後，RLLBC-Lib 提供了一個理想的基礎，用於創建具有自動評分的編程作業。

docs.title: Decodable but Misrouted: Sparse Features Uncover a Readout Gap in Vision-Language Models for Harmful Meme Detection
docs.text:
2609.18860v1 by Girish A. Koushik, Diptesh Kanojia, Helen Treharne

When a large vision-language model misclassifies a harmful meme, the failure may reflect missing internal evidence or an inability to route represented evidence to its output. We distinguish these cases in Gemma-3 and Qwen3.5 using sparse autoencoders, role-conditioned probes, causal interventions, and recovery experiments across six harmful content benchmarks, with additional Spanish and Hindi-English code-mixed evaluations. Sparse readouts outperform native prediction on all six primary binary tasks: Qwen averages $0.740$ versus $0.432$ native macro-F1, while residual reconstruction reaches $0.486$, whereas Gemma improves from $0.532$ to $0.714$. These differences reflect supervised accessibility rather than a pre-existing, native decision rule, and the most influential token role depends on the task. Under the evaluated score scales, Qwen silent-feature ablation is $24-63$ times more probe-sensitive, whereas routed-feature patching on literal yes/no tasks is $16-140$ times more output-sensitive. Calibration-only routing recovers $93.3$% of the mean gap, and probe-distilled LoRA improves native predictions, although shared multi-task adaptation causes negative transfer. A case study of Gemma-3-12B on Facebook Hateful Memes finds a distributed rank-32 image-prompt interaction, reaching $0.756$ versus $0.685$ native macro-F1. Robustness controls show that the signal extends beyond English, is not explained solely by accompanying OCR, and depends on paired visual evidence. Thus, routing, rather than representation alone, is a recurring bottleneck in harmful meme classification.

摘要：當一個大型的視覺-語言模型錯誤分類一個有害的迷因時，這種失誤可能反映出缺失的內部證據或無法將所表示的證據傳遞到其輸出。我們在 Gemma-3 和 Qwen3.5 中區分這些情況，使用稀疏自編碼器、角色條件探針、因果干預和在六個有害內容基準上的恢復實驗，並進行額外的西班牙語和印地語-英語混合評估。稀疏讀出在所有六個主要二元任務上超越了本地預測：Qwen 的平均值為 $0.740$，而本地宏-F1 為 $0.432$，同時殘差重建達到 $0.486$，而 Gemma 從 $0.532$ 提升至 $0.714$。這些差異反映了監督可及性，而非預先存在的本地決策規則，並且最具影響力的標記角色取決於任務。在評估的分數範疇下，Qwen 的靜默特徵消融對探針的敏感度是 $24-63$ 倍，而在字面是/否任務上的路由特徵修補則對輸出的敏感度是 $16-140$ 倍。僅進行校準的路由恢復了 $93.3$% 的平均差距，探針提煉的 LoRA 改進了本地預測，儘管共享的多任務適應會導致負轉移。對 Gemma-3-12B 在 Facebook Hateful Memes 上的案例研究發現了一個分佈的排名-32 圖像提示交互，達到 $0.756$ 對比 $0.685$ 的本地宏-F1。穩健性控制顯示信號超越英語，不僅僅由伴隨的 OCR 解釋，並且依賴於配對的視覺證據。因此，路由而非僅僅是表示，是有害迷因分類中的一個反覆瓶頸。

docs.title: Dimensionality reduction for AI based hyperspectral image classification based on XAI
docs.text:
2609.22333v1 by Vladimir Zeljković, Branka Stojanović, Harald Ganster, Aleksandar Nešković

This research addresses the challenge of limited material recycling in wood recycling processes by leveraging artificial intelligence (AI)-based dimensionality reduction. Our study explores the application of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) in multi-channel hyperspectral imaging (HSI), extending beyond RGB channels to over 200 spectral channels. Dimensionality reduction within this context involves streamlining the feature space for AI system training and inference. Focusing on explainable AI (XAI) methods, this paper contributes to a broader research initiative, presenting a solution framework that enhances the sustainability and efficiency of wood recycling processes.

摘要：這項研究通過利用基於人工智慧（AI）的降維技術，解決了木材回收過程中材料回收有限的挑戰。我們的研究探討了卷積神經網絡（CNN）在多通道高光譜成像（HSI）中的應用，超越了RGB通道，達到200多個光譜通道。在這個背景下，降維涉及簡化特徵空間，以便於AI系統的訓練和推理。本論文專注於可解釋的人工智慧（XAI）方法，為更廣泛的研究計畫做出貢獻，提出了一個解決方案框架，提升了木材回收過程的可持續性和效率。

docs.title: Version- and Scope-Aware Question Answering over Normative Documents: A Deployed System and an End-to-End Evaluation at Production Scale
docs.text:
2609.18769v1 by Liuyin Wang, Shuaipeng Jin, Jiwei Shi, Jensen Hsu

Correctly answering a question grounded in normative documents often depends on information outside any single passage: whether the retrieved document is the version currently in force; whether it applies to the jurisdiction, subject (such as an institution or applicant), and date at issue; and whether each normative claim can be traced to its supporting source text. Hosted retrieval services have substantially lowered the engineering cost of building an initial system over such corpora, making "upload the documents and ask" a common default. We evaluate this default on approximately 73,000 candidate normative documents supplied to a production deployment. The evaluation uses a stratified sample of 200 questions from our published benchmark, with a gold source document for every question; the released sampling rule reads no system outputs or scores. We compare the hosted service with a governed system that resolves version and scope through explicit rules before generation. The governed system scored 97.7 overall, while the hosted service scored 88.1, a gap of 9.6 points computed from unrounded means. The question set, the answer text evaluated for both systems, the scores, and the scripts used to reproduce the reported benchmark statistics are public. The governed configuration has operated as a commercial product since January 2026 and serves 1,126 registered users; named customer organizations include Zhipu AI and Lecheng Health. By mid-April 2026, it had reached roughly 100,000 calls per workday.

摘要：正確回答基於規範文件的問題往往依賴於任何單一段落之外的信息：檢索到的文件是否是目前有效的版本；它是否適用於相關的管轄區、主題（例如機構或申請者）和相關日期；以及每個規範主張是否可以追溯到其支持的源文本。托管檢索服務大幅降低了在這些語料庫上建立初始系統的工程成本，使得「上傳文件並詢問」成為常見的默認選擇。我們對大約73,000份供應給生產部署的候選規範文件評估了這一默認選擇。評估使用了我們已發表基準中的200個問題的分層樣本，對於每個問題都有一份金源文件；發布的抽樣規則不讀取任何系統輸出或分數。我們將托管服務與一個通過明確規則在生成之前解決版本和範圍的管理系統進行比較。管理系統的總分為97.7，而托管服務的分數為88.1，兩者之間的差距為9.6分，計算基於未四捨五入的平均值。問題集、對兩個系統評估的答案文本、分數以及用於重現報告基準統計的腳本都是公開的。自2026年1月以來，管理配置已作為商業產品運行，服務1,126名註冊用戶；命名的客戶組織包括智譜AI和樂成健康。到2026年4月中旬，它的工作日呼叫量已達到約100,000次。

docs.title: PAPC: Platform Mediation for Privacy-Propagation Externalities in AI-Mediated Workflows
docs.text:
2609.19226v1 by Tao Huang, Guosen Wu, Chen Hou, Guolong Zheng

AI-mediated platforms coordinate work through LLM agents acting for different principals. In these workflows, privacy loss can be created before a final answer appears: a memory write, shared-workspace update, inter-agent message, or tool event may impose downstream exposure cost on another principal. We model this failure mode as a privacy-propagation externality, where the cost of a raw disclosure depends on topology and fanout as well as content. We present PAPC, a platform-mediated mechanism that intercepts information-moving events before they update shared state or external channels. PAPC combines policy, provenance, topology/fanout, privilege, and content signals to allow an event, release a policy-safe abstraction, quarantine raw content, block a transition, or narrow onward rights. The model explains why final-output control misses intermediate exposure costs and why high-fanout objects amplify propagation. Across retrieval-memory and multi-agent workflow benchmarks, PAPC preserves deterministic task completion and eliminates measured exact raw-value and external raw-value exposure. The results position event-level mediation as a platform-governance primitive for agent-mediated online work.

摘要：AI介導的平台透過為不同委託人行事的LLM代理協調工作。在這些工作流程中，隱私損失可能在最終答案出現之前就已產生：記憶寫入、共享工作區更新、代理之間的消息或工具事件可能對另一個委託人施加下游暴露成本。我們將這種失敗模式建模為隱私傳播外部性，其中原始披露的成本取決於拓撲和傳播程度以及內容。我們提出了PAPC，一種平台介導的機制，能在信息移動事件更新共享狀態或外部通道之前攔截這些事件。PAPC結合政策、來源、拓撲/傳播程度、特權和內容信號，以允許一個事件、釋放一個政策安全的抽象、隔離原始內容、阻止轉換或縮小後續權利。該模型解釋了為什麼最終輸出控制忽略了中間暴露成本，以及為什麼高傳播對象會放大傳播。在檢索記憶和多代理工作流程基準中，PAPC保持確定性的任務完成，並消除了測量的精確原始值和外部原始值的暴露。這些結果將事件級別的調解定位為代理介導的在線工作的平臺治理原語。

docs.title: Generalist-Specialist Mixture-of-Experts for Rare Pathology Detection in Multimodal Imaging
docs.text:
2609.18688v1 by Johannes Kaiser, Florian Braunmiller, Daniel Rückert, Georgios Kaissis

AI models for multimodal medical imaging must balance modality-specific specialization with cross-modal shared representations, a trade-off that pure Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures currently fail to satisfy. Expert-based routing improves in-domain learning but may sacrifice cross-modal signals, which appear particularly important for rare (low-prevalence) pathologies in our experiments. To resolve this, we introduce Generalist-Specialist-MoE (GS-MoE), a two-branch (MoE) architecture that couples a cross-modal generalist model with distinct modality-specific specialists (experts) via domain-constrained feature fusion. On RadImageNet (1.35M images, 165 pathologies, three modalities), GS-MoE recovers detection of six low-prevalence pathologies on which every baseline scores F1 $=$ 0, with per-class gains up to +0.60 F1. It attains this while even slightly exceeding dense and specialist-only MoE aggregate baselines (MCC 0.770), while using ${\sim}53\%$ fewer active parameters at inference than the strongest investigated dense model.

摘要：AI 模型在多模態醫學影像中必須在特定模態的專業化與跨模態的共享表徵之間取得平衡，這是一個純粹的專家混合（MoE）架構目前無法滿足的權衡。基於專家的路由改善了領域內的學習，但可能會犧牲跨模態信號，而這在我們的實驗中對於罕見（低流行率）病理顯得尤其重要。為了解決這個問題，我們引入了通才-專家-MoE（GS-MoE），這是一種雙分支（MoE）架構，通過領域約束的特徵融合將跨模態的通才模型與不同的模態專家（專家）相結合。在 RadImageNet（1.35M 圖像，165 種病理，三種模態）上，GS-MoE 恢復了六種低流行率病理的檢測，這些病理在每個基準上得分 F1 $=$ 0，並且每類的增益高達 +0.60 F1。它在這一過程中甚至略微超越了密集和專家專用 MoE 的總體基準（MCC 0.770），同時在推理時使用的主動參數比調查過的最強密集模型少了 ${\sim}53\%$。

docs.title: PACT: Can Enterprise AI Assistants Be Trusted Under Pressure?
docs.text:
2609.18605v1 by Mika Okamoto, Ansel Kaplan Erol

As corporate AI adoption continues to grow, enterprise-grade LLM agents are being deployed into sensitive contexts such as hiring, healthcare, and finance. In these contexts, compliance with rules specified in an agent's system context is a first-order legal concern. Currently, no evaluation framework systematically measures which LLM models tend to violate compliance rules, especially under pressure from a persistent user, a hurried manager, or circumstances where violation is convenient or attractive. We introduce PACT (Pressure-Applied Compliance Testing), a benchmark for rule-following under pressure in AI agents assisting employees in daily tasks across twelve regulated enterprise domains and forty-eight scenarios, each set in a realistic multi-turn conversation. Each benchmark item pairs a standing rule against a rule-violating shortcut, and applies a battery of pressures across different wordings and system-prompt modes. We construct PACT component by component under strict LLM-as-judge auditing to ensure samples are unambiguous, ungameable, and realistic enough to avoid eliciting evaluation-aware behavior. We use PACT to profile LLM compliance across six complementary metrics that create a holistic picture of an AI assistant's robustness under pressure and throughout multi-turn conversations, its transparency, and ability to correctly discern where a rule applies. We aggregate this profile into PACTScore, a reliability-weighted compliance rate over all items and modes. Our results across 22 common LLM models spanning multiple providers and sizes show substantial variability in compliance across models and metric dimensions. Even the strongest assistants mis-apply a rule on 6 to 10% of items, and ordinary user pressure raises the violation rate by 65% on average. PACT highlights compliance risks in LLM assistants, motivating guardrails and careful model selection.

摘要：隨著企業對人工智慧的採用持續增長，企業級的LLM代理正在被部署到如招聘、醫療保健和金融等敏感領域。在這些情境中，遵守代理系統上下文中規定的規則是一項首要的法律關注。目前，尚無評估框架系統性地衡量哪些LLM模型傾向於違反合規規則，特別是在持續用戶、匆忙的經理或違規方便或吸引的情況下。我們介紹了PACT（壓力應用合規測試），這是一個基準，用於評估在壓力下遵循規則的AI代理，協助員工在十二個受監管的企業領域和四十八個場景中進行日常任務，每個場景都設置在現實的多輪對話中。每個基準項目將一項現行規則與一個違規的捷徑進行配對，並在不同的措辭和系統提示模式下施加一系列壓力。我們在嚴格的LLM作為評判的審計下逐步構建PACT，以確保樣本明確、不易被操控且足夠真實，以避免引發評估意識行為。我們使用PACT來分析LLM在六個互補指標上的合規性，這些指標共同描繪了AI助手在壓力下及整個多輪對話中的穩健性、透明度以及正確辨別規則適用範圍的能力。我們將這一分析整合為PACTScore，這是一個對所有項目和模式的可靠性加權合規率。我們在22個涵蓋多個提供商和規模的常見LLM模型中的結果顯示，模型和指標維度之間的合規性存在顯著變異性。即使是最強大的助手在6%到10%的項目上也會錯誤應用規則，而普通用戶的壓力平均會使違規率提高65%。PACT突顯了LLM助手中的合規風險，促使建立防護措施和謹慎的模型選擇。

docs.title: TRIPROBE: Probing Task Separability Beyond Classification for XAI
docs.text:
2609.18525v1 by Amirhossein Sadough, Freek Hens, Aleksa Bokšan, Mohammad Mahdi Dehshibi, Mahyar Shahsavari

Modern evaluation of learning pipelines often reduces to downstream accuracy, leaving open the question of why tasks succeed or fail. TriProbe addresses this gap with a multi-level probing framework for explainable diagnosis of task separability. Rather than treating models as black boxes, TriProbe traces how separability evolves across inputs, learned features, and final classifiers. It decomposes multi-task problems into binary subtasks and applies three complementary probes: a Foundational Probe on input spaces, a Latent Probe on feature representations, and a Final Probe on classifier outputs. Using Maximum Fisher's Discriminant Ratio as a principled separability metric, TriProbe identifies bottlenecks and affected task pairs. Experiments on the Roshambo sEMG benchmark show how TriProbe reveals hidden breakdowns, guiding data collection, validation, and architecture design.

摘要：現代對學習流程的評估通常簡化為下游準確性，留下了為何任務成功或失敗的問題。TriProbe 通過一個多層次的探測框架來解決這一空白，以便對任務可分性進行可解釋的診斷。TriProbe 並不將模型視為黑箱，而是追蹤可分性如何在輸入、學習特徵和最終分類器之間演變。它將多任務問題分解為二元子任務，並應用三個互補的探測器：對輸入空間的基礎探測器、對特徵表示的潛在探測器，以及對分類器輸出的最終探測器。使用最大費舍爾判別比作為原則性的可分性度量，TriProbe 確定瓶頸和受影響的任務對。在 Roshambo sEMG 基準上的實驗顯示 TriProbe 如何揭示隱藏的故障，指導數據收集、驗證和架構設計。

docs.title: Visual Compliance via Executable Safety Rule Entailment
docs.text:
2609.18328v1 by Jisoo Kim, TaeYoon Kwack, Jinwoo Jang, Honguk Woo

Recent advances in LLMs and VLMs have enabled safety systems to reason beyond simple risk patterns toward more contextual and semantic safety concerns. However, as risk patterns continue to evolve and safety rules become more complex, existing training-based end-to-end safeguards face persistent challenges in adaptability and explainable reasoning over complex safety rules. To address these challenges, we propose GuardEn (Guarding by Safety Rule Entailment), an executable safeguard framework that decomposes safety policies into atomic propositions through Safety-Rule Compilation, modeling their composition as executable code. At test time, Scene-Grounded Execution instantiates these atomic propositions with contextual visual information derived from scene graphs, enabling rule-grounded and interpretable safety reasoning. Experiments on SafetyVisionBench demonstrate the effectiveness of programmable safeguard for complex visual safety assessment, achieving an average improvement of 9.8 F1 points over the strongest baseline.

摘要：最近在大型語言模型（LLMs）和視覺語言模型（VLMs）方面的進展，使得安全系統能夠超越簡單的風險模式，朝向更具情境性和語義性的安全關注。然而，隨著風險模式的不斷演變和安全規則的日益複雜，現有基於訓練的端到端安全防護面臨著在適應性和對複雜安全規則的可解釋推理方面的持續挑戰。為了解決這些挑戰，我們提出了GuardEn（通過安全規則推導進行保護），這是一個可執行的安全防護框架，通過安全規則編譯將安全政策分解為原子命題，並將其組合建模為可執行代碼。在測試時，場景基礎執行使用來自場景圖的上下文視覺信息實例化這些原子命題，實現基於規則的可解釋安全推理。在SafetyVisionBench上的實驗證明了可編程安全防護在複雜視覺安全評估中的有效性，平均提高了9.8個F1點，相較於最強基準。

docs.title: Knowledge-Graph Based Augmentation versus Retrieval Augmented Generation for Cultural-Related Question Answering
docs.text:
2609.18317v2 by Pablo Poulenard, Yannis Karmim, Valentin Barrière

Large language models (LLMs) suffer from a long-tail deficit: culturally specific facts, particularly those concerning underrepresented regions such as Latin America, appear too rarely in pretraining corpora to be reliably memorized. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) addresses this by grounding generation in external text, but structured alternatives such as Knowledge Graphs (KGs) offer tighter control over what enters the context, along with potential gains in explainability and updatability. We benchmark Graph-RAG against standard RAG on LatamQA, a culturally grounded multiple-choice dataset spanning eight thematic categories. The graphs are built end-to-end from Wikipedia articles with KGGen, a recent open-domain extractor, without manual curation in our main setting. G-Retriever is competitive with RAG and reduces the error of the base LLM by 72\% with a standard KG and 78\% with a benchmark-aware variant, the gap to RAG narrowing further as the graph is oriented toward task-relevant content. The trained projection transfers zero-shot to Portuguese without target-language fine-tuning, indicating multilingual reach.

摘要：大型語言模型（LLMs）面臨長尾缺失的問題：文化特定的事實，特別是那些涉及拉丁美洲等代表性不足地區的事實，在預訓練語料庫中出現得過於稀少，無法可靠地被記住。檢索增強生成（RAG）通過將生成基於外部文本來解決這一問題，但結構化的替代方案如知識圖譜（KGs）則提供了對進入上下文的內容更緊密的控制，並可能在可解釋性和可更新性方面帶來收益。我們在LatamQA上對Graph-RAG進行基準測試，這是一個涵蓋八個主題類別的文化基礎多選題數據集。這些圖是從維基百科文章中端到端構建的，使用KGGen這個最近的開放領域提取器，並且在我們的主要設置中沒有手動策劃。G-Retriever在與RAG的競爭中表現出色，並將基礎LLM的錯誤率降低了72\%（使用標準KG）和78\%（使用基準感知變體），隨著圖的內容朝向任務相關內容，與RAG的差距進一步縮小。訓練後的投影在沒有目標語言微調的情況下可以零樣本轉移到葡萄牙語，顯示出多語言的覆蓋範圍。

docs.title: A Study of the Reliability of Agentic AI-Generated Programs
docs.text:
2609.18298v2 by Ayesha Shafique, Barton P. MIller, Elisa R. Heymann

Agentic-AI based software development offers the promise of faster completion of the software, greater programmer efficiency, and more reliable code. The question is how can we verify these claims in an objective way? In this project, we attempted to answer this question based on three practices. First, we applied a typical best-practices agentic AI workflow for software development. Second, our target programs were ten well-known, release-quality human-written Linux utility programs so that we could compare the AI-generated code against a concrete ground truth. Third, we based our measure of reliability on a widely used testing technique, fuzz random testing. For this testing, we used both classic black box, generational testing and more modern coverage guided (gray box, mutational) testing using AFL++. We found that the AI-generated versions of the utility programs were typically as reliable - often more reliable - than the latest human-generated versions of these programs. While the AI-generated versions did have some failures, they were less common than the code from the standard repositories. Interestingly, the AI-generated code was less likely to have failures such as memory errors (such as buffer overflows) but more likely to have hangs such as infinite loops. In addition, we verified that generating robust and reliable software using agentic AI requires careful practice and human supervision. The quality of the code is highly dependent on the prompts and skills used, and how the human directing the process responds. We also demonstrated that using agentic AI workflow for software development (with its prompts and skills) can become a specification of the code that leads to cost-effective sustainability of the software.

摘要：代理式人工智慧（Agentic-AI）基礎的軟體開發承諾能更快完成軟體、提高程式設計師效率，並產出更可靠的程式碼。問題是，我們如何以客觀的方式驗證這些聲明？在這個專案中，我們試圖根據三個實踐來回答這個問題。首先，我們應用了典型的最佳實踐代理式人工智慧工作流程來進行軟體開發。其次，我們的目標程式是十個知名的、發布品質的人類撰寫的 Linux 工具程式，以便將 AI 生成的程式碼與具體的真實情況進行比較。第三，我們的可靠性測量基於一種廣泛使用的測試技術，即模糊隨機測試。對於這項測試，我們使用了經典的黑箱生成測試以及更現代的覆蓋引導（灰箱、變異）測試，使用 AFL++。我們發現，這些工具程式的 AI 生成版本通常與最新的人類生成版本一樣可靠——往往更可靠。雖然 AI 生成的版本確實有一些失敗，但這些失敗的頻率低於標準庫中的程式碼。有趣的是，AI 生成的程式碼不太可能出現記憶體錯誤（例如緩衝區溢出），但更可能出現無限迴圈等掛起情況。此外，我們驗證了使用代理式人工智慧生成穩健可靠的軟體需要謹慎的實踐和人類監督。程式碼的質量在很大程度上取決於所使用的提示和技能，以及指導過程的人類如何反應。我們還展示了使用代理式人工智慧工作流程進行軟體開發（連同其提示和技能）可以成為程式碼的規範，從而實現軟體的成本效益可持續性。

docs.title: Building Trust in Artificial Intelligence: A Necessity for Railway Applications
docs.text:
2609.18278v1 by Lefebvre Renard Clément, Lébé Vincent, Da Silva Ribeiro Pereira Ricardo, Sundell Johan, Jaoul Arnaud Saiah Kenza, Mijatovíc Nenad

Artificial Intelligence (AI) is currently only applied to non-safety critical applications due to the strict standards and regulations for railway industries. We propose to review the three main fields necessary to increase trust in data science and AI algorithms and reach compliance: robustness, Operational Design Domain (ODD), and explainability. Robustness is the ability of an AI system to maintain its level of performance under any circumstances (ISO24029). ODDs allow the explicit definition of operating conditions under which a system is intended to operate, according to the recently published DIN DKE SPEC 99004. Explainability is the property of an AI system to express important factors influencing the AI system results in a way that humans can understand. Those 3 domains of research are already well investigated by nonrailway actors, with algorithms and methods ready to use for railway applications. A system view is necessary to ensure all trustworthy requirements interact continuously in a safe MLOps environment thereby fostering acceptance from regulators, operators and the public. Beyond safeguarding safety-critical applications, we aim to show that fostering deep trust in AI, as now required by regulatory frameworks worldwide, will unlock its full potential and transform the pace of adoption across mission-critical domains.

摘要：人工智慧（AI）目前僅應用於非安全關鍵的應用，因為鐵路行業有嚴格的標準和法規。我們提議回顧三個主要領域，以增加對數據科學和AI算法的信任並達到合規性：穩健性、操作設計範疇（ODD）和可解釋性。穩健性是指AI系統在任何情況下保持其性能水平的能力（ISO24029）。根據最近發布的DIN DKE SPEC 99004，ODD允許明確定義系統預期運行的操作條件。可解釋性是指AI系統以人類能理解的方式表達影響AI系統結果的重要因素的特性。這三個研究領域已被非鐵路參與者充分研究，並有算法和方法可供鐵路應用使用。系統觀點是必要的，以確保所有值得信賴的要求在安全的MLOps環境中持續互動，從而促進監管機構、運營商和公眾的接受。除了保護安全關鍵應用外，我們的目標是顯示，促進對AI的深度信任，如今全球監管框架所要求的，將釋放其全部潛力並改變在任務關鍵領域的採用速度。

docs.title: A Lightweight CNN Integrated Compact Convolutional Transformer for Multi-Scale Feature Learning and reducing computational complexity for breast cancer mammography image detection and classification
docs.text:
2609.18212v1 by Md Taimur Ahad, Ainuddin Ahmed

Over the years, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have demonstrated strong capability in cancer detection and classification using medical images. However, CNN-based models often struggle to capture long-range contextual dependencies. In such scenarios, integrating Compact Convolutional Transformer (CCT) architectures after the CCT layer allows CNN-extracted features to reshape into compact patch tokens using a CCT tokenizer, followed by the addition of positional embeddings to preserve spatial structure. Using 5-fold cross-validation, the model was tested on 3 sets of breast cancer mammography. With only 250,435 parameters, the model achieved 99%-100% accuracy across 3 datasets, indicating robust generalization. Explainable AI (XAI) was integrated into the model to explain the breast cancer classification process to enhance clinical trust. The results indicate that the proposed framework is suitable for computer-aided diagnosis systems, particularly in resource-constrained clinical environments. The novelty of the proposed CNN-integrated CCT overcomes the limitation of CNN's gradient degradation in the last layers by integrating convolutional tokenization with transformer-based learning. Lighter than ViT, which is effective in capturing long-range dependencies, the model has also proven efficient in breast cancer classification by capturing long-range dependencies among breast tissue regions.

摘要：多年來，卷積神經網絡（CNN）在使用醫學影像進行癌症檢測和分類方面展現了強大的能力。然而，基於CNN的模型往往難以捕捉長距離的上下文依賴性。在這種情況下，在CCT層之後整合緊湊卷積Transformer（CCT）架構，允許CNN提取的特徵通過CCT標記器重塑為緊湊的補丁標記，隨後添加位置嵌入以保留空間結構。使用5折交叉驗證，該模型在3組乳腺癌乳房X光檢查上進行測試。僅有250,435個參數，該模型在3個數據集上達到了99%-100%的準確率，顯示出強大的泛化能力。可解釋的人工智慧（XAI）被整合進模型中，以解釋乳腺癌分類過程，增強臨床信任。結果表明，所提出的框架適合用於計算機輔助診斷系統，特別是在資源受限的臨床環境中。所提出的CNN整合CCT的新穎性克服了CNN在最後幾層中的梯度退化限制，通過將卷積標記化與基於Transformer的學習相結合。該模型比ViT更輕巧，ViT在捕捉長距離依賴性方面有效，並且在乳腺癌分類中也證明了其效率，能夠捕捉乳腺組織區域之間的長距離依賴性。

docs.title: Rethinking How We Evaluate Methodological Progress in Health AI
docs.text:
2609.18134v2 by Florent Pollet, Matthew McDermott

Methodological progress in artificial intelligence (AI) for electronic health records (EHRs) depends on our ability to determine which algorithms work better, and under which conditions. However, such progress is thought to be hindered by difficulties in reproducibility and in defining clinically meaningful evaluation tasks. We empirically study these barriers by re-implementing 12 historical and recent algorithms within a shared evaluation framework and evaluating them on two clinical datasets, MIMIC-IV and NWICU. We compare two complementary task families: expert-authored clinically meaningful tasks and generated tasks defined from randomly sampled event codes and prediction horizons. We ask whether relative algorithms comparisons transfer across task families and datasets, whether residual task heterogeneity contains useful methodological structure, and what a controlled comparison reveals about progress over the last decade. We find that aggregate pairwise comparisons transfer strongly across evaluation settings, including from randomly generated tasks to clinically meaningful tasks and across datasets. At the same time, clinically meaningful tasks exhibit greater task-method interaction, providing preliminary evidence that task properties can help explain when particular modeling choices are advantageous. Finally, newer algorithms do not consistently outperform earlier approaches: gradient-boosted trees remain highly competitive when paired with a modern, wide and sparse representation of the EHR. Together, these results suggest that useful methodological knowledge may require less task engineering than commonly assumed, while highlighting the importance of understanding the structured heterogeneity that remains across tasks and methods.

摘要：方法論在人工智慧 (AI) 於電子健康紀錄 (EHRs) 的進展取決於我們判斷哪些演算法表現更佳以及在何種條件下。然而，這樣的進展被認為受到可重複性和定義臨床上有意義的評估任務的困難所阻礙。我們透過在共享評估框架內重新實現 12 種歷史和近期的演算法，並在兩個臨床數據集 MIMIC-IV 和 NWICU 上進行評估，實證研究這些障礙。我們比較兩個互補的任務類別：專家編寫的臨床有意義任務和從隨機抽樣事件代碼和預測視野定義的生成任務。我們詢問相對的演算法比較是否能在任務類別和數據集之間轉移，殘餘任務異質性是否包含有用的方法論結構，以及受控比較對過去十年的進展揭示了什麼。我們發現，總體成對比較在評估環境之間強烈轉移，包括從隨機生成的任務到臨床有意義的任務以及跨數據集。同時，臨床有意義的任務顯示出更大的任務-方法互動，提供初步證據表明任務特性可以幫助解釋何時特定的建模選擇是有利的。最後，較新的演算法並不總是優於早期的方法：梯度提升樹在與現代的、寬且稀疏的 EHR 表示配對時仍然具有高度競爭力。綜合這些結果表明，有用的方法論知識可能需要的任務工程少於普遍假設，同時強調理解任務和方法之間仍然存在的結構性異質性的重要性。

docs.title: Measuring AI Leadership: Development and Validation of a Multidimensional Measure for AI-Native Organizations
docs.text:
2609.17965v1 by Mustafa Akben, Leslie Coyne

AI is changing what leaders must judge, explain, learn, and coordinate, yet existing measures do not capture these behaviors at the level needed to study leadership in AI-enabled work. We develop the AI Leadership Battery, which organizes 36 behaviorally specific subdimensions into 11 theory-specified content families. Following established scale-development procedures, the research used deductive item generation; content validation of definitional correspondence and definitional distinctiveness; exploratory factor analysis and item reduction; confirmatory factor analysis in independent samples; and tests of internal consistency reliability, convergent validity, discriminant validity, and criterion-related and incremental validity. Across the development and validation studies, the analyses provided evidence for the Battery's content, multidimensional structure, reliability, and distinction from selected orbiting constructs. The Battery also contributed additional information beyond orbiting constructs across organizational growth, decision speed, customer/stakeholder response capability, AI-enabled team performance, AI-enabled work experience, AI security and risk management, and AI adoption and integration. The resulting measure provides researchers with a behavioral framework for examining how leaders in AI-enabled work regulate judgment, learning, adaptation, transparency, and accountability.

摘要：AI 正在改變領導者必須判斷、解釋、學習和協調的內容，但現有的衡量標準並未捕捉到這些行為，無法在研究 AI 驅動的工作中的領導力時達到所需的水平。我們開發了 AI 領導力電池，它將 36 個行為特定的子維度組織成 11 個理論指定的內容家族。根據既定的量表開發程序，研究使用了演繹性項目生成；對定義對應性和定義區別性的內容驗證；探索性因素分析和項目縮減；在獨立樣本中的驗證性因素分析；以及內部一致性可靠性、收斂效度、區別效度和標準相關及增量效度的測試。在開發和驗證研究中，分析提供了對電池內容、多維結構、可靠性以及與選定的相關構念之間的區別的證據。該電池還提供了超越相關構念的額外信息，涵蓋組織增長、決策速度、客戶/利益相關者反應能力、AI 驅動的團隊表現、AI 驅動的工作經驗、AI 安全和風險管理，以及 AI 採用和整合。最終的測量為研究人員提供了一個行為框架，以檢視 AI 驅動工作中的領導者如何調節判斷、學習、適應、透明度和問責制。

docs.title: AI and Human Approaches to Mathematical Problem Solving
docs.text:
2609.17779v1 by Yang Ding

AI systems have begun to report solutions, disproofs, and substantive advances on long-standing mathematical problems, raising questions about whether they approach research in the same way as mathematicians. This study compares public AI research accounts with the human literature on 11 such problems. The human corpus contains 58 papers that directly addressed the same mathematical targets later reported by AI sources as resolved, disproved, or substantially advanced; 31 within-problem comparisons were constructed from these materials. Six validated text-based measures capture problem resolution, method articulation, uncertainty and boundary specification, successor-question generation, generality, and cross-disciplinary integration. AI accounts place greater emphasis on resolving the focal problem and connecting ideas across fields. Human papers devote significantly more attention to explaining methods, specifying assumptions and limitations, and identifying questions for subsequent research. No precise difference is detected in generality. The estimated directions remain unchanged when each mathematical problem is removed in turn. The findings reveal two distinct research profiles: AI accounts concentrate on closing and recombining problems, whereas mathematical papers more extensively document the procedures, limits, and research opportunities through which results become cumulative knowledge. Evaluating research AI therefore requires attention to the organization of inquiry, not only whether a target is solved.

摘要：AI 系統已開始報告解決方案、反駁和在長期存在的數學問題上取得的實質性進展，這引發了關於它們是否以與數學家相同的方式進行研究的問題。這項研究將公共 AI 研究報告與人類文獻中 11 個此類問題進行比較。人類文獻包含 58 篇直接針對 AI 來源後來報告為已解決、被反駁或實質性進展的相同數學目標的論文；這些材料構建了 31 個問題內比較。六個經驗驗證的文本基準捕捉了問題解決、方法闡述、不確定性和邊界規範、後繼問題生成、普遍性和跨學科整合。AI 報告更強調解決焦點問題和跨領域連結思想。人類論文則顯著更多地關注解釋方法、指定假設和限制，以及識別後續研究的問題。普遍性方面未檢測到明確差異。當每個數學問題依次移除時，估計的方向保持不變。研究結果揭示了兩種不同的研究輪廓：AI 報告專注於關閉和重新組合問題，而數學論文則更廣泛地記錄了通過哪些程序、限制和研究機會使結果成為累積知識。評估研究 AI 因此需要關注探究的組織，而不僅僅是目標是否被解決。

docs.title: Information Set Emulation: Causal Certificates for AI Derived EHR Features
docs.text:
2609.17777v1 by Takes Fujita, Nobutaka Hattori

AI and large language models can recover clinically meaningful features from electronic health records (EHRs), but predictive usefulness does not establish admissibility for causal inference. We introduce information set emulation: an AI typed lift attaches source evidence, clinical and recording times, decision-time availability, representation version, proposed causal roles, and unresolved ambiguity to extracted features under a locked target trial. Causal certificates record auditable evidence for those roles. Features with unresolved downstream roles are routed to compatible reporting or separate analyses. Typed evidence defines an observational fiber of causal worlds consistent with the observed law. The locked scalar estimand maps this fiber to a compatible image whose squared Chebyshev radius equals the residual minimax mean squared error when the image is nonempty and compact. This classical identity provides a target-specific measure of information ambiguity. The contribution is its integration with a joint EHR observation map and an auditable certificate architecture. Under explicit exchangeability, positivity, and nuisance-consistency conditions, we give identification and cross-fitted augmented inverse probability weighted estimation, distinguishing empirical and population targets. An EHR compression-drift identity separates the roles of frame presence, treatment assignment, and outcome observation. Artificial simulations and a common-law finite-world example illustrate estimation failures and information-radius reduction. Synthetic Phase 0 notes demonstrate audit diagnostics; a separate role-specific analysis spread illustrates routing and is not an exact fiber radius. All experiments are synthetic. The framework specifies when reconstructed information can support a point claim and when compatible reporting is required.

摘要：AI 和大型語言模型可以從電子健康記錄 (EHRs) 中恢復臨床有意義的特徵，但預測的有用性並不建立因果推斷的可接受性。 我們引入信息集模擬：一種 AI 類型的提升將來源證據、臨床和記錄時間、決策時間的可用性、表示版本、提議的因果角色和未解決的模糊性附加到鎖定目標試驗下提取的特徵。 因果證書記錄這些角色的可審計證據。 具有未解決下游角色的特徵被路由到兼容的報告或單獨分析。 類型證據定義了一種觀察性因果世界的纖維，與觀察到的法則一致。 鎖定的標量估計量將這個纖維映射到一個兼容的圖像，其平方切比雪夫半徑等於當圖像非空且緊湊時的殘差最小最大均方誤差。 這一經典身份提供了一種特定於目標的信息模糊性測量。 其貢獻在於與聯合 EHR 觀察圖和可審計證書架構的整合。 在明確的可交換性、正性和干擾一致性條件下，我們給出了識別和交叉擬合的增強逆概率加權估計，區分經驗和人口目標。 EHR 壓縮漂移身份分離了框架存在、治療分配和結果觀察的角色。 人工模擬和一個普通法有限世界的例子說明了估計失敗和信息半徑的減少。 合成的第 0 階段記錄展示了審計診斷；一個單獨的角色特定分析擴展展示了路由，並不是一個精確的纖維半徑。 所有實驗都是合成的。 該框架指定了何時重建的信息可以支持一個點聲明以及何時需要兼容的報告。

docs.title: Evolution of US Oral Political Language
docs.text:
2609.17755v1 by Jacques Savoy

The analysis of US political language is usually based on the written form (e.g. presidential addresses) or posts broadcasted on various social networks. Oral production, however, which is even more frequent, can better reveal the style and mode of thinking of the speaker. This study covers this mode of linguistic communication by considering 19 candidates from the presidential elections between 1960 to 2024. Our main research objectives are to disclose the main trends hidden in those presidential debates. Do we observe a clear simplification of the US political language over time? Does Trump have poor language compared to the other candidates? Do unusual stylistic features occur only with a single, specific president? Moreover, can we detect a pattern explaining the success or failure of some nominees? Over time, this study demonstrates a significant reduction in political language complexity, a decrease of the mean sentence length, and a noteworthy decline of complex terms. Moreover, the emotional tone increases over the decades, while logical and rational thinking tends to lessen.

摘要：美國政治語言的分析通常基於書面形式（例如總統演說）或在各種社交網絡上廣播的帖子。然而，口語表達更為頻繁，能更好地揭示講者的風格和思維模式。本研究通過考慮1960年至2024年之間的19位候選人來涵蓋這種語言交流模式。我們的主要研究目標是揭示那些總統辯論中隱藏的主要趨勢。我們是否觀察到美國政治語言隨時間的明顯簡化？特朗普的語言是否比其他候選人差？不尋常的風格特徵是否僅出現在某位特定的總統身上？此外，我們能否檢測到解釋某些提名人成功或失敗的模式？隨著時間的推移，本研究顯示政治語言的複雜性顯著降低，平均句子長度減少，複雜術語的顯著下降。此外，情感語調在幾十年中增加，而邏輯和理性思維則趨向減少。

docs.title: Det-LIME: Detector-Aware, Multi-Instance Local Interpretable Model-Agnostic Explanations for Automated Marine Mammal Detection
docs.text:
2609.17479v1 by Jiayi Zhou, David W. Johnston, Brinnae Bent

Despite the rapid uptake of black-box object detectors in marine mammal research and monitoring, explainability techniques are rarely integrated into conservation workflows. Furthermore, most classification-oriented explainability tools are ill-suited to detection tasks involving imagery of social organisms or those with colonial life histories, as they ignore multiple detections within a scene and produce single-instance outputs that blur evidence across individuals. These methods also generate low-resolution, often biologically irrelevant visuals, limiting their utility for debugging, targeted data augmentation, and refined data collection. We proposed Det-LIME, a detector-aware, multi-instance adaptation of Local Interpretable Model-Agnostic Explanations (LIME) that produced instance-specific, box-aligned explanations by combining per-detection weighting, a proximity kernel that emphasizes regions near each box, and Intersection-over-Union-based matching to track the same instance across perturbations. We evaluated Det-LIME on aerial drone imagery for harbor seal detection, with an additional seabird case study to assess generality, and compared it with vanilla LIME, Stabilized LIME, Deterministic LIME, and gradient-based attribution methods. Using the Attribution Ratio and Max Saliency Hit Rate metrics, we showed that Det-LIME consistently improved multi-instance attribution. In practice, these higher-resolution, instance-aware explanations provide insight into model outputs and support post-processing, debugging, and actionable improvements in modeling and data collection or augmentation.

摘要：儘管黑箱物體檢測器在海洋哺乳動物研究和監測中的快速應用，解釋技術卻很少融入保育工作流程中。此外，大多數以分類為導向的解釋工具不適合涉及社會生物或具有群居生活史的檢測任務，因為它們忽略了場景中的多重檢測，並產生模糊個體證據的單一實例輸出。這些方法還生成低解析度、通常生物學上無關的視覺效果，限制了它們在調試、針對性數據增強和精細數據收集中的實用性。我們提出了Det-LIME，這是一種檢測器感知的多實例適應性本地可解釋模型無關解釋（LIME），通過結合每次檢測的加權、強調每個框附近區域的接近核，以及基於交集-聯合的匹配來跟踪相同的實例，產生特定於實例的、框對齊的解釋。我們在用於港口海豹檢測的無人機航拍影像上評估了Det-LIME，並進行了額外的海鳥案例研究以評估其普遍性，並將其與原始LIME、穩定LIME、確定性LIME和基於梯度的歸因方法進行比較。使用歸因比率和最大顯著性命中率指標，我們顯示Det-LIME在多實例歸因方面持續改善。在實踐中，這些更高解析度、實例感知的解釋提供了對模型輸出的洞察，並支持後處理、調試以及在建模和數據收集或增強中的可行改進。

docs.title: CareMirror: Bringing Caregiver Wellbeing into the Dementia Care Ecosystem
docs.text:
2609.17434v1 by Jiayue Melissa Shi, Ethan Nguyen, Drishti Goel, Upasana Natarajan, Shashwat Srivatsa, Daniel S. Brown, Violeta J. Rodríguez, Dong Whi Yoo, Ravi Karkar, Koustuv Saha

Family caregivers of people living with dementia shoulder emotional and practical responsibilities, yet their own wellbeing often remains peripheral to dementia care. We built CareMirror, an envisioned caregiver wellbeing ecosystem with interconnected caregiver- and clinician-facing interfaces for longitudinal reflection, personalized support, and caregiver-controlled sharing with clinical care. We conducted semi-structured interviews with 14 caregivers, using CareMirror as a design probe to examine how they perceived this ecosystem and what expectations, concerns, and boundaries emerged around clinical connection. Caregivers valued attention to their wellbeing, longitudinal awareness, context-sensitive support, and clinical visibility when it could lead to meaningful follow-up. However, repeated reflection could become burdensome or emotionally difficult, automatic clinical sharing could inhibit candid disclosure, and participants wanted control over what information entered clinical care. They also expected AI to support reflection and communication without replacing caregiver voice or clinician judgment. We contribute design considerations for proactive, clinically connected caregiver wellbeing support.

摘要：家庭照顧者在照顧患有癡呆症的人時，承擔著情感和實際的責任，但他們自己的福祉往往在癡呆症護理中處於邊緣地位。我們建立了CareMirror，一個設想中的照顧者福祉生態系統，擁有互聯的面向照顧者和臨床醫生的界面，用於長期反思、個性化支持和照顧者控制的臨床共享。我們對14位照顧者進行了半結構化訪談，使用CareMirror作為設計探針，檢視他們對這個生態系統的看法，以及圍繞臨床聯繫出現的期望、擔憂和界限。照顧者重視對他們福祉的關注、長期的認知、情境敏感的支持，以及在能夠導致有意義的後續跟進時的臨床可見性。然而，重複的反思可能會變得繁重或情感上困難，自動的臨床共享可能會抑制坦誠的披露，參與者希望能控制進入臨床護理的信息。他們還期望人工智慧能支持反思和溝通，而不取代照顧者的聲音或臨床醫生的判斷。我們提供了主動、臨床連結的照顧者福祉支持的設計考量。

docs.title: Finding Common Mistakes In Modelling With Mathematical Formalisms Using LLMs
docs.text:
2609.17111v1 by Lilian Killich, Marko Schmellenkamp, Fabian Vehlken, Thomas Zeume

Modelling with mathematical formalisms like logical formulas, mathematical equations, or regular expressions is an important yet challenging task for students of computer science and other STEM disciplines.
