Across seven clean and degraded sensing conditions on TotalCapture, \textsc{GaitVista} reduces average full-body and lower-body error by \textbf{27.7\%} and \textbf{27.8\%}, attains the lowest worst-condition error among fusion methods, and reduces the gap to a joint-frame oracle from $2.76$--$5.33$~cm for condition-blind baselines to $1.11$~cm. On MoVi with image-derived keypoints, it is the only deployable fusion method to improve over both unimodal streams, reducing marker-supported error by \textbf{6.4\%} relative to the strongest learned fusion baseline. On TotalCapture, it improves bilateral knee-flexion waveform accuracy by \textbf{18.9\%}. Raw inertial measurements from five TotalCapture participants show location- and time-varying magnetic disturbance, supporting the design's reliability premise. Both benchmarks contain neurologically healthy participants in controlled settings and retain participant-specific IMU calibration; we therefore report progress toward accessible gait assessment, not validated clinical deployment.

摘要：追蹤步態功能的恢復需要在康復會議中檢測到有意義的步態變化，但客觀的3D測量仍然限於專門的運動捕捉實驗室。小型攝影機組和身體佩戴的慣性傳感器擴大了可及性，但可靠性在關節和時間上有所不同，這使得感測失敗可能偽裝成患者的變化。我們提出了\textsc{GaitVista}，這是一個關注可靠性的測量層，其輕量級的閘道根據攝影機覆蓋範圍、局部視覺質量、跨模態不一致性和根運動連續性分配關節和幀特定的視覺貢獻，並將其暴露以供檢查。在TotalCapture的七種乾淨和劣化的感測條件下，\textsc{GaitVista}將全身和下身的平均誤差分別降低了\textbf{27.7\%}和\textbf{27.8\%}，在融合方法中達到最低的最差條件誤差，並將與關節幀預言者的差距從$2.76$--$5.33$~cm降低到$1.11$~cm。在MoVi中，使用圖像衍生的關鍵點，它是唯一一種可部署的融合方法，能夠在兩個單模態流上都有所改善，相對於最強的學習融合基線，將標記支持的誤差降低了\textbf{6.4\%}。在TotalCapture上，它將雙側膝關節屈曲波形的準確性提高了\textbf{18.9\%}。來自五位TotalCapture參與者的原始慣性測量顯示出位置和時間變化的磁擾動，支持設計的可靠性前提。這兩個基準均包含在受控環境中神經上健康的參與者，並保留參與者特定的IMU校準；因此，我們報告了朝向可及步態評估的進展，而不是經過驗證的臨床部署。

docs.title: Toward Personalized Sleep Guidance from Wearable Data Using Language Models
docs.text:
2609.22463v1 by Yusheng Tan, Running Zhao, Sofia Angel, Ninghui Hao, Ash Arian, Nikita N. Dulin, Jay Lin, Ou Zhu, Faiza Shaik, Xinxing Yang, Bonnie W. Leung, Katie Roster, Arlene Ruiz de Luzuriaga, Kenneth Lee, Alejandra Lastra, Habibul Ahsan, Guihong Wan

Sleep monitoring using wearable data has shown promise for personal health, yet large language model (LLM)-based summarization and question answering remain insufficient for personalized sleep guidance. Training specialized models, however, often requires costly expert annotation. Moreover, privacy and accessibility concerns motivate lightweight, local deployment for end users. We present a two-stage framework to address these challenges. Specifically, in Stage~1, a multi-agent LLM pipeline reasons structured sleep guidance from unannotated wearable records, enabling scalable dataset construction. Stage~2 distills guidance reasoning trajectories into small language models (SLMs) through supervised fine-tuning and integrates a training-free Best-of-$N$ selection strategy to enhance inference. Experimental results demonstrate our method outperforms commercial general and medical LLMs and open-source models. Human evaluation further supports the quality of the generated guidance and the feasibility of personalized sleep guidance with SLMs.

摘要：使用可穿戴數據進行睡眠監測在個人健康方面顯示出希望，然而基於大型語言模型（LLM）的摘要和問答仍然不足以提供個性化的睡眠指導。訓練專門的模型通常需要昂貴的專家標註。此外，隱私和可及性問題促使輕量級、本地化的端用戶部署。我們提出了一個兩階段框架來解決這些挑戰。具體而言，在第一階段，多代理LLM管道從未標註的可穿戴記錄中推理結構化的睡眠指導，從而實現可擴展的數據集構建。第二階段通過有監督的微調將指導推理軌跡提煉成小型語言模型（SLMs），並整合無需訓練的最佳$N$選擇策略以增強推理。實驗結果顯示我們的方法優於商業通用和醫療LLM以及開源模型。人類評估進一步支持生成指導的質量以及使用SLMs進行個性化睡眠指導的可行性。

docs.title: An Agentic Just-in-Time Adaptive Intervention System for Personalized Sleep Support: Proof-of-Concept Study with N of 1 Data
docs.text:
2609.21805v1 by Nick Rezaee, Chelsea Boccagno

Background: Just-in-time adaptive interventions (JITAIs) can use behavioral data to adapt support to changing contexts, but many rely on predefined rules and manual configuration. Objective: We developed a proof-of-concept sleep JITAI using an AI agent to review personal data, evaluate reminders, adapt interventions, and record decisions for human review. Methods: Running in Home Assistant on a configurable schedule, the agent follows a reusable skill file to review 30 days of sleep and behavioral data, including physical activity, smartphone use, and bedtime routines, to identify patterns and create or update automated reminders. Results: Initial runs demonstrated technical feasibility, successfully completing data review and intervention decisions while limiting reminders to three per day and saving decision records. Conclusions: Agentic AI may enable flexible, adaptive sleep JITAIs. The architecture supports future comparison with fixed or rulebased interventions, requires human oversight, and could extend to other health behaviors.

摘要：背景：即時適應干預（JITAIs）可以利用行為數據來根據變化的情境調整支持，但許多仍依賴預定義的規則和手動配置。 目標：我們開發了一個概念驗證的睡眠 JITAI，使用 AI 代理來審查個人數據、評估提醒、調整干預並記錄決策以供人類審查。 方法：該代理在 Home Assistant 中以可配置的時間表運行，遵循可重用的技能文件，審查 30 天的睡眠和行為數據，包括身體活動、智能手機使用和就寢例行，以識別模式並創建或更新自動提醒。 結果：初步運行顯示技術可行性，成功完成數據審查和干預決策，同時將提醒限制為每天三次並保存決策記錄。 結論：代理式 AI 可能使靈活的、自適應的睡眠 JITAIs 成為可能。該架構支持未來與固定或基於規則的干預進行比較，需人類監督，並可擴展到其他健康行為。

docs.title: ECG Mirage: Revealing and Mitigating the Underutilisation of ECGs in Vision-Language Models for Clinical Prediction
docs.text:
2609.21755v1 by Jinning Liang, Mingcheng Zhu, Tingting Zhu

Emergency department (ED) decision-making relies on heterogeneous clinical information, including patient history, vital signs, laboratory results, and electrocardiograms (ECGs). Vision--language models (VLMs) can jointly process these modalities, but strong predictive performance does not necessarily imply meaningful use of the correct patient's ECG. We term this failure mode ECG Mirage: apparent multimodal capability without useful dependence on patient-specific ECG information. We distinguish two forms: ECG neglect, where ECGs provide little predictive benefit, and ECG confusion, where matched ECGs outperform no-image inputs but not mismatched ECGs. To evaluate these behaviours, we compare predictions obtained with matched ECGs, outcome-discordant mismatched ECGs, and no-image inputs while holding the clinical text and prediction targets fixed. Across four VLMs on MDS-ED, matched ECGs provide no consistent advantage for either ICU admission or clinical deterioration prediction. We then train four restricted visual prompts using supervised learning followed by conditional direct preference optimisation, while keeping the VLM backbone frozen. The resulting models achieve balanced accuracies of 70.6% for ICU admission and 67.5% for deterioration and increase the matched-versus-mismatched performance gap to approximately 16.5 and 5.5 percentage points, respectively. Overall, our study identifies ECG Mirage in multimodal clinical prediction and introduces visual prompt tuning as an efficient mitigation strategy.

摘要：急診部門（ED）的決策依賴於異質的臨床信息，包括病史、生命體徵、實驗室結果和心電圖（ECG）。視覺-語言模型（VLMs）可以共同處理這些模態，但強大的預測性能並不一定意味著正確使用患者的ECG。我們將這種失敗模式稱為ECG幻影：表面上的多模態能力卻沒有對患者特定ECG信息的有用依賴。我們區分兩種形式：ECG忽視，ECG提供的預測效益很小；以及ECG混淆，匹配的ECG在預測上優於無圖像輸入，但不如不匹配的ECG。為了評估這些行為，我們比較了使用匹配ECG、結果不一致的不匹配ECG和無圖像輸入所獲得的預測，同時保持臨床文本和預測目標不變。在四個VLMs的MDS-ED上，匹配的ECG對於ICU入院或臨床惡化預測並未提供一致的優勢。然後，我們使用監督學習訓練四個限制性視覺提示，隨後進行條件直接偏好優化，同時保持VLM主幹不變。最終模型在ICU入院的平衡準確率達到70.6%，在惡化的準確率為67.5%，並將匹配與不匹配的性能差距分別增大至約16.5和5.5個百分點。總體而言，我們的研究在多模態臨床預測中識別了ECG幻影，並引入視覺提示調整作為一種有效的緩解策略。

docs.title: Consistent Relexicalization of Clinical Documents using Graph-Based Approach
docs.text:
2609.21387v1 by Dipankar Das, Atri Mandal, Sandeep Singh, Tushar Shandhilya

Relexicalization is a pivotal technique in clinical NLP, as it facilitates robust masking of sensitive information while synthesizing datasets that retain high-fidelity, real-world characteristics. However, preserving structural integrity, relational coherence, and temporal consistency during transformation remains a significant challenge. Existing approaches frequently rely on independent entity replacement, which results in clinical inconsistencies across longitudinal records. This reduces the value of such relexicalized datasets for downstream scientific analysis. To address these limitations, we introduce G-RELIC (Graph Based Contextual Relexicalization with Improved Consistency) which combines the power of LLMs with graphs. G-RELIC implements a graph-based mapping mechanism which optimizes for one-to-one correspondence between original and surrogate entities. It also introduces a deterministic temporal repositioning algorithm to preserve temporal consistency. Empirical evaluations on diverse, real-world clinical datasets validate that G-RELIC significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. G-RELIC yields a 30.4 percentage point improvement in relational integrity (62.1% to 92.5%) and 45.9 percentage point improvement in temporal coherence (46% to 91.9%) without compromising on the recognized privacy benchmarks for clinical datasets. This maximizes the analytical utility of relexicalized datasets while minimizing re-identification risk.

摘要：再詞彙化是臨床自然語言處理中的一項關鍵技術，因為它促進了敏感信息的穩健遮蔽，同時合成保留高保真度、真實世界特徵的數據集。然而，在轉換過程中保持結構完整性、關聯一致性和時間一致性仍然是一個重大挑戰。現有的方法通常依賴於獨立實體替換，這導致了縱向記錄中的臨床不一致性。這降低了此類再詞彙化數據集在下游科學分析中的價值。為了解決這些限制，我們介紹了 G-RELIC（基於圖的上下文再詞彙化與改進一致性），它結合了大型語言模型和圖的力量。G-RELIC 實現了一種基於圖的映射機制，優化了原始實體和替代實體之間的一對一對應。它還引入了一種確定性的時間重新定位算法，以保持時間一致性。在多樣化的真實臨床數據集上的實證評估證實，G-RELIC 顯著超越了最先進的基準。G-RELIC 在關聯完整性上提高了 30.4 個百分點（從 62.1% 到 92.5%），在時間一致性上提高了 45.9 個百分點（從 46% 到 91.9%），而不妥協於臨床數據集的隱私基準。這最大化了再詞彙化數據集的分析效用，同時最小化了重新識別的風險。

docs.title: Clinician-Grounded Quality Assurance for AI-Assisted Psychiatric Intake
docs.text:
2609.21149v1 by King Shi, Amanda Li, Jonathan Ivey, Synthia Qia Wang, Guan Gui, Hyunseo Kim, Peter Zandi, Jason Straub, Jacob Taylor, Ananya Joshi

Before patients can use AI-assisted psychiatric intake systems, health systems need practical ways to routinely evaluate these tools against their clinical standards for quality assurance. Because clinicians may use different intake styles, evaluation for this task must (1) support comparison across interviewing approaches, (2) minimize clinician burden, and (3) measure clinically relevant performance for health systems deploying these technologies. We present a clinician-grounded evaluation platform built around a memory-augmented patient simulator for open-ended AI interviewing, InterviewPlayground. We created interactive patients using InterviewPlayground with our expert-authored vignettes, constructed a simulated intake platform for the interviews, and designed evaluation modalities relevant to intake. In a pilot of 6 clinicians in a 25-minute assessment compared to a GPT-based LLM intake interviewer, the LLM recovered more of the clinically relevant items embedded in the patient vignettes (88.0% vs. 38.9%), but made more clinical inferences not based on the interview (56.8% vs. 27.8%), and characterized identified safety concerns less often (33.3% vs. 66.7%), setting the stage for deployed quality assurance for this task.

摘要：在患者能夠使用 AI 輔助的精神科接診系統之前，醫療系統需要實用的方法來定期評估這些工具是否符合其臨床標準以進行質量保證。因為臨床醫生可能使用不同的接診風格，因此這項任務的評估必須 (1) 支持不同訪談方法之間的比較，(2) 減少臨床醫生的負擔，並且 (3) 測量對於部署這些技術的醫療系統而言臨床相關的表現。我們提出了一個以臨床醫生為基礎的評估平台，圍繞著一個增強記憶的患者模擬器，用於開放式的 AI 訪談，名為 InterviewPlayground。我們使用 InterviewPlayground 創建了互動式患者，並利用我們專家的小品故事，構建了一個模擬接診平台以進行訪談，並設計了與接診相關的評估方式。在對 6 位臨床醫生進行的 25 分鐘評估的試點中，與基於 GPT 的 LLM 接診訪談者相比，LLM 從患者小品故事中恢復了更多臨床相關項目 (88.0% 對 38.9%)，但做出了更多不基於訪談的臨床推斷 (56.8% 對 27.8%)，並且識別安全問題的頻率較低 (33.3% 對 66.7%)，為這項任務的質量保證部署奠定了基礎。

docs.title: Aligning with Lived Experience: Heterogeneous Benefits of Fine Tuning in Mental Health Support Generation
docs.text:
2609.21075v1 by Mohit Chandra, Nabin Kim, Eli Min, Aamogh Sawant, Tanmay Sutar, Munmun De Choudhury

As access to professional mental healthcare remains limited, many individuals turn to online platforms such as Reddit to seek peer support situated within human lived experience. However, a significant portion of such queries go unanswered, presenting an opportunity for using Large Language Models (LLMs) to fill this gap. While LLMs have demonstrated strong performance on clinical benchmarks, their ability to generate lived-experience informed and community-aligned peer support is underexplored. Addressing this gap, we introduce the COmmunity-centered Peer Engaged Support (COPES) dataset and a three-axis evaluation framework to assess LLM alignment with community perspectives to mental health support seeking queries. Evaluating zero-shot and post-trained (SFT and DPO) models, we show that post-training on COPES significantly improves Strategy Alignment (>50% for general-purpose models) and alignment in Emotion & Tone. However, we also observe that such improvements are heterogeneous and alignment improvements vary significantly across subreddits and requested coping strategies. Furthermore, post-training induces distributional shifts, heavily favoring problem-focused recommendations while suppressing emotion-focused strategies. Together, this work shows that while curating community-driven data improves the alignment of LLM responses, model performance remains disparate across distinct sub-communities and specific mental health needs.

摘要：由於專業心理健康護理的獲取仍然有限，許多人轉向像 Reddit 這樣的在線平台尋求基於人類生活經驗的同儕支持。然而，這類查詢中有相當一部分未得到回覆，這為使用大型語言模型（LLMs）填補這一空白提供了機會。雖然 LLMs 在臨床基準上表現出色，但它們生成基於生活經驗且與社區一致的同儕支持的能力仍未得到充分探索。為了解決這一空白，我們介紹了以社區為中心的同儕參與支持（COPES）數據集以及一個三軸評估框架，以評估 LLM 與社區對心理健康支持尋求查詢的觀點的一致性。通過評估零樣本和後訓練（SFT 和 DPO）模型，我們顯示在 COPES 上的後訓練顯著提高了策略一致性（對於通用模型超過 50%）以及情感和語調的一致性。然而，我們也觀察到這些改進是異質的，且一致性改進在不同子版塊和請求的應對策略之間差異顯著。此外，後訓練會引起分佈變化，強烈偏向於問題導向的建議，同時抑制情感導向的策略。綜合來看，這項工作顯示，雖然策劃社區驅動的數據改善了 LLM 回應的一致性，但模型性能在不同子社區和特定心理健康需求之間仍然存在差異。

docs.title: ERCPMP-Gx: Endoscopic Image and Video Dataset for Morphological, Histopathological, and Genomic Characterization of Colorectal Polyposis
docs.text:
2609.20815v1 by Zahra Ghaffari, Massih Bahar, Mojgan Forootan, Ali Darvishi, Hamidreza Bolhasani

Hereditary polyposis syndromes can be precursor lesions to colorectal cancer and are associated with a broad spectrum of extracolonic tumors. Early identification and accurate classification of these syndromes are essential for timely diagnosis, individualized patient management, and targeted surveillance strategies for affected families. However, public endoscopic datasets are largely organized around the individual sporadic polyp, and none links the polyposis phenotype to histopathology and germline findings at the patient level. Here, we present ERCPMP-Gx, an endoscopic, histopathological, and genomic dataset developed to support the application of artificial intelligence (AI) in the recognition, characterization, and classification of colorectal polyposis. Most procedures were performed using the Olympus EVIS X1 system with white-light endoscopy (WLE), narrow-band imaging (NBI), magnifying NBI (M-NBI), and NBI with near focus modes, yielding 160 images and accompanying video clips. Approximately eighty percent of cases represent clinically and/or genetically confirmed hereditary polyposis syndromes (PG), including familial adenomatous polyposis (FAP), Peutz-Jeghers syndrome (PJS), juvenile polyposis syndrome (JPS), and ganglioneuroma syndrome (GNS), while the remaining twenty percent comprise non-hereditary polyps and polyp-mimicking lesions with overlapping morphological features (Non-PG), included to support differential classification. Each released record is linked, where available, to standardized endoscopic annotations, representative histopathology, and clinically reported germline findings, forming an AI-ready, patient-level annotation framework. The dataset is publicly accessible at Mendeley (https://doi.org/10.17632/nzyfc544bx.2). For the latest updates and further information, readers are referred to the DataBioX website: https://databiox.com.

摘要：遺傳性息肉症候群可能是結腸直腸癌的前驅病變，並與廣泛的腸外腫瘤相關聯。及早識別和準確分類這些症候群對於及時診斷、個性化病人管理以及針對受影響家庭的監測策略至關重要。然後，公共內視鏡數據集主要圍繞個別散發性息肉組織，而沒有將息肉症表型與患者層級的組織病理學和種系發現聯繫起來。在此，我們呈現ERCPMP-Gx，一個內視鏡、組織病理學和基因組數據集，旨在支持人工智慧（AI）在結腸直腸息肉的識別、特徵描述和分類中的應用。大多數程序使用奧林巴斯EVIS X1系統進行，配備白光內視鏡（WLE）、窄帶成像（NBI）、放大NBI（M-NBI）和近焦模式的NBI，產生160張圖像和伴隨的視頻片段。大約百分之八十的病例代表臨床和/或基因確認的遺傳性息肉症候群（PG），包括家族性腺瘤性息肉症（FAP）、Peutz-Jeghers症候群（PJS）、青少年息肉症候群（JPS）和神經節瘤症候群（GNS），而剩餘的百分之二十則包括非遺傳性息肉和具有重疊形態特徵的息肉模擬病變（Non-PG），以支持差異分類。每個發布的記錄都與標準化的內視鏡註釋、代表性的組織病理學和臨床報告的種系發現相連接，形成一個適合AI的患者層級註釋框架。該數據集可在Mendeley上公開訪問（https://doi.org/10.17632/nzyfc544bx.2）。有關最新更新和進一步信息，讀者可參考DataBioX網站：https://databiox.com。

docs.title: When Do Language-Grounded Explanations Help? A Graph-Bottleneck for Farm Monitoring Interpretable Sheep Facial Pain
docs.text:
2609.20427v1 by Alam Noor, Miguel Guti'errez Gait'an

Automated pain recognition from facial expression could make continuous welfare assessment practical in sheep, but adoption depends on trust: a stockperson cannot act on a score that arrives without justification. We ground a model in the Sheep Pain Facial Expression Scale (SPFES) by letting each detected facial region attend over text embeddings of the clinical descriptors and then test whether the resulting explanations mean anything. They do not. Ablating an entire descriptor changes the predicted logit by about $10^{-4}$, and the most-attended cue agrees with the predicted pain level in only $32.6\%$ of regions, although the attention maps, the learned gate, and the generated text all proposed otherwise. We therefore remove the appearance bypass with a concept bottleneck whose classifier reads only SPFES concept scores, supervised by per-region state annotations that image-level pipelines discard. This costs $0.05$--$0.10$ in Cohen's $κ$ but yields concepts that are demonstrably learned: minority pain-indicating states are recovered at $3.5$--$8.3\times$ their base rates, and the ear and eye severity orderings emerge without severity supervision. Removing the supervision alone leaves $κ$ unchanged while concept accuracy falls to $0.109$, showing that architectural necessity does not imply semantic validity. We also show that pooled concept accuracy is misleading under clinical imbalance and provide a cross-validated, protocol-matched benchmark of seven methods on this dataset.

摘要：自動化的面部表情疼痛識別可以使羊隻的持續福利評估變得可行，但其採用取決於信任：一名牧場工作人員無法根據沒有理由的分數採取行動。我們基於羊隻疼痛面部表情量表（SPFES）建立了一個模型，讓每個檢測到的面部區域關注臨床描述符的文本嵌入，然後測試所產生的解釋是否有意義。結果並沒有。去除整個描述符會使預測的對數變化約為 $10^{-4}$，而最受關注的提示與預測的疼痛水平在僅 $32.6\%$ 的區域中一致，儘管注意力圖、學習的門控和生成的文本都提出了相反的觀點。因此，我們去除了外觀旁路，使用了一個概念瓶頸，其分類器僅讀取 SPFES 概念分數，並由每個區域的狀態註釋進行監督，這些註釋在圖像級管道中被丟棄。這使得 Cohen 的 $κ$ 降低了 $0.05$--$0.10$，但產生的概念是明顯學習到的：少數疼痛指示狀態的恢復率為其基準率的 $3.5$--$8.3\times$，而耳朵和眼睛的嚴重程度排序在沒有嚴重程度監督的情況下出現。僅去除監督使得 $κ$ 不變，而概念準確率降至 $0.109$，顯示出架構必要性並不意味著語義有效性。我們還顯示，在臨床不平衡的情況下，合併的概念準確率具有誤導性，並提供了在此數據集上七種方法的交叉驗證、協議匹配基準。

docs.title: Bridging Modalities on the Cortex: Surface-based MRI to PET Translation with a Diffusion Bridge
docs.text:
2609.20147v1 by Yitong Li, Alexandra Samoylova, Fabian Bongratz, Timo Grimmer, Dennis M. Hedderich, Igor Yakushev, Christian Wachinger

Cortical hypometabolism measured by Fluorodeoxyglucose Positron Emission Tomography (FDG-PET) is a highly sensitive biomarker for dementia diagnosis. However, high costs, radiation exposure, and limited accessibility constrain its clinical utility. While cross-modal synthesis from Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) offers a promising alternative, existing volumetric generation methods do not explicitly account for the highly folded cortical geometry, where disease-related patterns predominantly reside. To address this, we introduce a novel surface-based diffusion bridge framework DB-SUiT for MRI-to-PET translation that operates natively on the cortical manifold. A conditional Spherical U-shaped vision Transformer (SUiT) is specifically designed to model the intricate cross-modal relationships while preserving surface topology. It combines spherical convolutional encoders for multi-scale surface feature extraction with bottleneck Transformers to capture long-range spatial dependencies, while incorporating demographic and subcortical conditions to refine the synthesis. Evaluated on two datasets, including subjects with different dementia types, DB-SUiT demonstrates high-fidelity synthesis that substantially outperforms other baselines. In automated dementia classification, synthesized PET surfaces improve performance over MRI by 14.2% and PET volumes by 11.3%, approaching the performance of real PET surfaces. In a blinded reader study, synthetic PET achieved 85.5% diagnostic accuracy, compared with 75.8% for MRI and 95.2% for real PET. This further demonstrates cross-cohort and cross-pathology generalization, as the model was evaluated without retraining on an external cohort that included a dementia subtype not represented during training. Our code is available at https://github.com/ai-med/DB-SUiT.

摘要：皮質低代謝量由氟脫氧葡萄糖正子發射斷層掃描（FDG-PET）測量，是一個對於癡呆診斷的高度敏感生物標記。然而，高昂的成本、輻射暴露和有限的可及性限制了其臨床實用性。雖然來自磁共振成像（MRI）的跨模態合成提供了一個有前景的替代方案，但現有的體積生成方法並未明確考慮高度摺疊的皮質幾何結構，而疾病相關模式主要存在於此。為了解決這個問題，我們引入了一種新穎的基於表面的擴散橋接框架DB-SUiT，用於MRI到PET的轉換，該框架在皮質流形上原生運行。一個條件性的球形U型視覺Transformer（SUiT）專門設計用來建模複雜的跨模態關係，同時保留表面拓撲。它結合了球形卷積編碼器以進行多尺度表面特徵提取，並使用瓶頸Transformer來捕捉長距離空間依賴性，同時納入人口統計和皮層下條件以精煉合成。在兩個數據集上進行評估，包括不同癡呆類型的受試者，DB-SUiT顯示出高保真度的合成，顯著超越其他基準。在自動癡呆分類中，合成的PET表面相比MRI提高了14.2%的性能，PET體積提高了11.3%，接近真實PET表面的性能。在一項盲讀者研究中，合成的PET達到了85.5%的診斷準確率，而MRI為75.8%，真實PET為95.2%。這進一步展示了跨隊列和跨病理的泛化，因為該模型在未經重新訓練的外部隊列上進行評估，該隊列包括在訓練期間未代表的癡呆亞型。我們的代碼可在https://github.com/ai-med/DB-SUiT獲得。

docs.title: FCA-Guided Counterfactual Explanations for Multi-Modal Breast Cancer Diagnosis: A Framework Achieving Perfect Validity with Emergent Sparsity
docs.text:
2609.20067v1 by Abdullahi Isa, Souley Boukari, Muhammad Aliyu

Deep learning models for multi-modal breast cancer diagnosis achieve high predictive accuracy but remain clinically unacceptable without actionable, counterfactual explanations. Attribution-based methods (LIME, SHAP) are categorically inapplicable to this purpose, as they generate no alternative instances and thus cannot be evaluated on counterfactual quality metrics. This investigation provides empirical evidence that FCA-Guided Counterfactual (FCA-CF) framework that uses a Formal Concept Analysis (FCA) concept lattice as a hard structural constraint on counterfactual search, operating over a multi-modal TCGA-BRCA dataset. We benchmark against four genuine counterfactual methods: Wachter-style CF, DiCE, FACE, and NICE, evaluated on 60 benign-predicted TCGA-BRCA instances. The FCA-CF framework achieves Validity = 1.0000 (100% of counterfactuals successfully flip the prediction), Sparsity = 2.37 features changed (best among all valid methods), and Proximity = 0.900 (normalised L2-based, matching NICE as joint best). The classifier achieves Accuracy = 0.980, F1 = 0.976, ROC-AUC = 0.9947. Ablation analysis confirms that the FCA lattice constraint is the primary sparsity driver (removing it increases sparsity by +40%, p < 0.001, Cohen's d = 0.78), while Phase C greedy refinement accounts for the largest individual contribution (+113% sparsity increase when disabled, p < 0.001, d = 5.01). FCA-guided counterfactual generation achieves a clinically important Pareto-dominant outcome; it is simultaneously the sparsest and among the most proximate of all valid methods, with perfect validity. The emergent sparsity property arising from lattice topology rather than numerical penalty terms constitutes a structurally novel contribution to the counterfactual explanation literature.

摘要：深度學習模型在多模態乳腺癌診斷中達到了高預測準確率，但在沒有可行的反事實解釋的情況下仍然無法臨床接受。基於歸因的方法（LIME、SHAP）在這個目的上是根本不適用的，因為它們不生成替代實例，因此無法在反事實質量指標上進行評估。本研究提供了實證證據，表明FCA引導的反事實（FCA-CF）框架使用形式概念分析（FCA）概念格作為反事實搜索的硬結構約束，並在多模態TCGA-BRCA數據集上運行。我們與四種真實的反事實方法進行基準測試：Wachter風格CF、DiCE、FACE和NICE，並在60個良性預測的TCGA-BRCA實例上進行評估。FCA-CF框架達到了有效性= 1.0000（100%的反事實成功翻轉預測），稀疏性= 2.37個變更特徵（在所有有效方法中最佳），以及接近度= 0.900（基於標準化L2，與NICE並列最佳）。分類器達到了準確率= 0.980，F1= 0.976，ROC-AUC= 0.9947。消融分析確認FCA格約束是主要的稀疏性驅動因素（移除它會使稀疏性增加40%以上，p < 0.001，Cohen's d = 0.78），而C階段的貪婪細化則佔據了最大的個別貢獻（禁用時稀疏性增加113%，p < 0.001，d = 5.01）。FCA引導的反事實生成實現了一個臨床重要的Pareto優勢結果；它同時是所有有效方法中最稀疏的，並且接近度最高，具有完美的有效性。來自格拓撲而非數值懲罰項的稀疏性新特性構成了對反事實解釋文獻的結構性新貢獻。

docs.title: ClashBench: Conflicts Leading Agents to Seize and Harm
docs.text:
2609.19892v1 by Yuejin Xie, Yu Li, Dadi Guo, Qingyu Liu, Yuqian Fu, Yanwei Fu, Yujiu Yang, Xia Hu, Dongrui Liu

As agent systems become more widely used, multiple agent sessions increasingly run alongside pre-existing user tasks in the same environment, sharing resources with limited capacity or mutually exclusive states. This creates a safety risk: when granted sufficient privileges, an agent may resolve a resource conflict by terminating or otherwise disrupting an existing task rather than reporting it. In this work, we identify and formalize this failure mode, which we term destructive resource preemption: obtaining the resources required for a requested task by terminating, overwriting, evicting, or degrading an incumbent task. To systematically study this risk, we introduce ClashBench, an executable benchmark comprising 268 validated conflict cases across 55 resource types, and evaluate 17 models through Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode. We observe destructive preemption in 44.5% of trajectories, where the agent completes the requested task while causing the incumbent task to fail its health check. We also show that prompt-based safeguards are insufficient: an instruction to avoid affecting existing tasks reduces but does not eliminate preemption, while an instruction explicitly authorizing the agent to stop local processes increases it. More concerningly, in 31.9% of successful destructive-preemption cases, the final response mentions neither the resource conflict nor the action taken to resolve it, raising concerns about possible concealment. These findings establish destructive resource preemption as a broad safety risk in privileged agent systems and motivate stronger privilege controls, task isolation, and conflict-aware safeguards.

摘要：隨著代理系統的廣泛使用，多個代理會話越來越多地與現有用戶任務在同一環境中並行運行，共享有限容量或互斥狀態的資源。這造成了安全風險：當獲得足夠的權限時，代理可能通過終止或以其他方式干擾現有任務來解決資源衝突，而不是報告它。在這項工作中，我們識別並正式化了這一失敗模式，我們稱之為破壞性資源搶佔：通過終止、覆蓋、驅逐或降級現有任務來獲取所需資源以執行請求的任務。為了系統地研究這一風險，我們引入了 ClashBench，一個可執行的基準測試，包含 268 個經過驗證的衝突案例，涵蓋 55 種資源類型，並通過 Codex、Claude Code 和 OpenCode 評估 17 種模型。我們觀察到在 44.5% 的軌跡中出現了破壞性搶佔，代理在完成請求的任務的同時導致現有任務未能通過健康檢查。我們還表明，基於提示的安全措施不足：避免影響現有任務的指令減少了但並未消除搶佔，而明確授權代理停止本地過程的指令則增加了搶佔的發生。更令人擔憂的是，在 31.9% 的成功破壞性搶佔案例中，最終回應既未提及資源衝突，也未提及為解決該衝突所採取的行動，這引發了對可能隱瞞的擔憂。這些發現確立了破壞性資源搶佔作為特權代理系統中的一個廣泛安全風險，並促使加強特權控制、任務隔離和衝突意識的安全措施。

docs.title: Integrating knowledge from case reports: a medical ontology based multimodal information system with structured summary
docs.text:
2609.19775v1 by Shuyu Guo, Lan Huang, Yichen Liu, Hanbin Ma, Tian Bai

Published medical case reports serve as a crucial medical information carrier, documenting discoveries in rare diseases, diagnostic methods, and innovative treatments. Despite the wealth of clinical knowledge in millions of case reports in the public medicine literature database (PubMed), accessing relevant information efficiently is hindered by the limitations of traditional keyword-based retrieval tools on unstructured and diverse case reports. To address the above issues, we introduce a comprehensive multimodal information system for case reports integrating structured clinical summaries of patients including medical images and biomedical named entities from 52949 open-access case reports published from 2000 to 2021. The multimodal essential information is organized in a well-structured medical ontology. Also, a powerful interface for searching and browsing case reports is designed to assist junior clinicians in retrieving cases effectively and improving the identification and diagnosis of rare diseases.

摘要：已發表的醫療案例報告作為重要的醫療資訊載體，記錄了罕見疾病、診斷方法和創新治療的發現。儘管公共醫學文獻資料庫（PubMed）中有數百萬份案例報告的豐富臨床知識，但由於傳統基於關鍵字的檢索工具在非結構化和多樣化的案例報告上的限制，獲取相關資訊的效率受到阻礙。為了解決上述問題，我們介紹了一個綜合性的多模態資訊系統，該系統整合了從2000年到2021年發表的52949份開放獲取案例報告中的患者結構化臨床摘要，包括醫療影像和生物醫學命名實體。多模態的基本資訊被組織在一個結構良好的醫學本體中。此外，還設計了一個強大的介面，用於搜尋和瀏覽案例報告，以幫助初級臨床醫師有效檢索案例，並改善對罕見疾病的識別和診斷。

docs.title: LearnActCoder: Role-Aware Error Memory for Adaptive Clinical Coding Agents
docs.text:
2609.19721v1 by Meysam Ghaffari, Bhaskar Sen, Nasim Sabetpour, Nina Fatehi, Animesh Agarwal, Carlos Morato

Clinical coding agents repeatedly encounter the same failure modes, including unsupported codes, missed documented conditions, specificity errors, and procedure-coding convention mismatches. We introduce Learn-Then-Act, an inference-time adaptation framework that converts errors from a small labeled LEARN batch into a structured Mistake Knowledge Database (MistakeKDB). False-negative lessons are routed to a recall-oriented Coder, while false-positive lessons are routed to a precision-oriented Judge. We instantiate the framework in LearnActCoder, a Coder-Judge clinical coding pipeline with lookup-table grounding where available. On 150 matched MIMIC-III notes, structured MistakeKDB improves CPT F1 by 5.9 percentage points, while raw-example and reflection-style memories remain near the no-memory baseline; the ICD-9 improvement is not significant. On a matched MIMIC-IV cohort, memory shifts ICD-10 coding toward higher precision at a recall cost, leaving F1 statistically unchanged. Applying the same memory to 1,000 held-out MIMIC-III notes maintains a stable ICD operating point, providing scale/stability evidence. Overall, the results are consistent with structured, feedback-derived error memory being useful for adapting clinical coding behavior across cases without weight updates or changes to the underlying workflow. Absolute CPT/HCPCS performance remains low, and the system is evaluated retrospectively rather than in clinical deployment.

摘要：臨床編碼代理人反覆遇到相同的失敗模式，包括不支援的代碼、遺漏的文檔條件、特異性錯誤和程序編碼慣例不匹配。我們介紹了 Learn-Then-Act，一種推理時適應框架，它將來自小型標記 LEARN 批次的錯誤轉換為結構化的錯誤知識數據庫 (MistakeKDB)。假陰性教訓被路由到以召回為導向的編碼器，而假陽性教訓則被路由到以精確度為導向的評判者。我們在 LearnActCoder 中實現了該框架，這是一個具有查找表基礎的編碼器-評判者臨床編碼管道。對於 150 份匹配的 MIMIC-III 記錄，結構化的 MistakeKDB 將 CPT F1 提高了 5.9 個百分點，而原始示例和反思風格的記憶保持在接近無記憶基線；ICD-9 的改進則不顯著。在匹配的 MIMIC-IV 群體中，記憶將 ICD-10 編碼推向更高的精確度，但以召回為代價，F1 統計上保持不變。將相同的記憶應用於 1,000 份保留的 MIMIC-III 記錄保持了穩定的 ICD 操作點，提供了規模/穩定性的證據。總體而言，結果與結構化的、基於反饋的錯誤記憶在跨案例適應臨床編碼行為方面的有效性一致，而無需權重更新或對基礎工作流程的變更。絕對的 CPT/HCPCS 表現仍然較低，該系統是回顧性評估，而非在臨床部署中進行評估。

docs.title: CliniCIRCA: A Modular LLM Framework for Constructing Longitudinal Mental Health Patient Journeys from Raw EHR Narratives
docs.text:
2609.19585v1 by Aiwei Ivy Zhang, Nimra Ishfaq, Mohit Chandra, Santiago Alvarez Lesmes, Adam Coscia, Khatiya Chelidze Moon, Xiaohan Ding, Munmun De Choudhury

In mental health care, reasoning over patient journeys is a key task for clinicians. Yet these journeys, encompassing a longitudinal progression of biological, psychological, and social events, are often spread across disparate unstructured text narratives, making temporal recovery challenging. We present CliniCIRCA, a multi-stage LLM framework for Calendar-anchored, Imprecision-aware Reconstruction of Clinical Annals. To our knowledge, CliniCIRCA is the first to temporally classify clinical events across unstructured discharge summaries without event-level timestamps. From 14,882 MIMIC-III mental health admissions, we first construct a benchmark of 52 discharge summaries on which CliniCIRCA produces 15,891 temporally tagged events. After correcting 629 errors based on a clinician-in-the-loop evaluation, we produce verified gold-standard labels. Finally, the corrected timelines drive a temporally grounded summarization stage that compresses each source 1.52 times into a date-grouped chronological record. We then scale the framework to generate 1,000 silver-standard timelines and evaluate them as training data. Compared with zero- and few-shot prompting, instruction tuning generally improves five open-weight models on event extraction, temporal tagging, and summarization across silver and clinician-verified evaluations.

摘要：在心理健康護理中，對病人旅程的推理是臨床醫生的一項關鍵任務。然而，這些旅程涵蓋了生物、心理和社會事件的長期進展，通常分散在不同的非結構化文本敘事中，使得時間恢復變得具有挑戰性。我們提出了CliniCIRCA，一個多階段的LLM框架，用於基於日曆的、考慮不精確性的臨床年鑑重建。據我們所知，CliniCIRCA是第一個在沒有事件級時間戳的情況下，對非結構化出院摘要中的臨床事件進行時間分類的系統。從14,882例MIMIC-III心理健康住院病例中，我們首先構建了一個基準，包含52份出院摘要，CliniCIRCA在此基準上生成了15,891個時間標記事件。在根據臨床醫生參與評估修正629個錯誤後，我們生成了經過驗證的黃金標準標籤。最後，修正後的時間線驅動了一個時間基礎的總結階段，將每個來源壓縮1.52倍，形成按日期分組的時間記錄。然後，我們擴展該框架以生成1,000個銀標準時間線並將其作為訓練數據進行評估。與零樣本和少樣本提示相比，指令調整通常改善了五個開放權重模型在事件提取、時間標記和總結方面的表現，無論是在銀標準還是臨床醫生驗證的評估中。

docs.title: Large Language Model Agents for Evidence Based Genetic Disease Severity Classification
docs.text:
2609.19569v2 by Tohid Ghasemnejad, Ahmadreza Argha, Mark Grosser, John Wang, Min Yang, Thantrira Porntaveetus, Tony Roscioli, Nigel H. Lovell, Mahmoud Aarabi, Hamid Alinejad-Rokny

Disease severity classification for genetic conditions is subjective and labor-intensive, creating bottlenecks in genomic screening, where commercial panels vary widely in size and overlap. We developed an autonomous AI agent integrating Reasoning and Acting (ReAct) with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to classify 10,211 Human Phenotype Ontology terms. It uses American College of Medical Genetics (ACMG)-endorsed severity guidelines and American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (ACOG) quality-of-life criteria to retrieve PubMed literature, generate interpretable reasoning chains, and independently verify claims. At the phenotype level, using expert-curated cohorts, the agent achieved 93.55% accuracy (MCC 0.9237) with 82.6% to 91.4% of claims supported by direct evidence or valid inferences. Gene-level severity was aggregated across 8,738 pairs, identifying 3,283 autosomal recessive pairs with severe or profound presentations. External validation showed 95.2% concordance with Mackenzie's Mission gene list. This system enables standardized panel design by providing reliable, automated classification supported by direct evidence.

摘要：疾病嚴重程度的分類對於遺傳條件來說是主觀且勞動密集的，這在基因組篩查中造成了瓶頸，因為商業面板的大小和重疊程度差異很大。我們開發了一個自主的 AI 代理，將推理和行動 (ReAct) 與檢索增強生成 (RAG) 整合，以對 10,211 個人類表型本體術語進行分類。它使用美國醫學遺傳學會 (ACMG) 認可的嚴重程度指導方針和美國婦產科醫學會 (ACOG) 的生活質量標準來檢索 PubMed 文獻，生成可解釋的推理鏈，並獨立驗證主張。在表型層面上，使用專家策劃的隊列，該代理達到了 93.55% 的準確率 (MCC 0.9237)，其中 82.6% 至 91.4% 的主張得到了直接證據或有效推論的支持。基因層面的嚴重程度在 8,738 對中進行了匯總，識別出 3,283 個具有嚴重或深度表現的常染色體隱性對。外部驗證顯示與 Mackenzie's Mission 基因名單的符合率為 95.2%。該系統通過提供可靠的、基於直接證據的自動化分類，實現了標準化面板設計。

docs.title: Physics-Informed Hemodynamic Modeling for Data-Free Prediction and Sparse-Data Assimilation
docs.text:
2609.19290v1 by Xi Chen, Jianchuan Yang, Hongde Li, Guangxin He, Qiuyu Ye, Qiang Luo, Mao Chen, Wenqi Hu

Clinical decision-making for coronary intervention relies mainly on angiography and fractional flow reserve (FFR). However, angiography is two-dimensional and lacks depth information for 3D lesion characterization, while FFR provides only a single functional index, offering limited hemodynamic insight. Among existing methods, numerical analysis is computationally expensive, whereas learning-based approaches require extensive supervision and often lack physical consistency. To address these limitations, we propose physics-informed hemodynamic modeling, an integrated deep learning framework for 3D coronary blood flow analysis from dual-view angiography. First, an attention-enhanced CNN reconstructs coronary geometry from angiography. The resulting point clouds are then mapped to a reference domain and Fourier-encoded for joint representation. A decoupled network separately predicts velocity and pressure fields, with embedded physical priors enabling efficient transfer across physiological conditions. Across 32 clinical patients evaluated under four flow conditions, the trans-stenotic pressure-drop mean absolute percentage error was 2.02%, while the velocity and pressure relative-L2 errors were 0.054 and 0.023, respectively. Validation against hospital-measured FFR further achieved 93.8% diagnostic accuracy (30/32; exact 95% CI, 79.2%-99.2%). The framework also supports illustrative revascularization comparisons and sparse-data assimilation, with the full angiography-to-hemodynamics pipeline completed within 20 minutes per patient.

摘要：臨床決策制定對於冠狀介入主要依賴於血管造影和分數流量儲備（FFR）。然而，血管造影是二維的，缺乏三維病變特徵化的深度信息，而FFR僅提供單一的功能指標，提供的血流動力學見解有限。在現有方法中，數值分析計算成本高昂，而基於學習的方法需要大量監督，且通常缺乏物理一致性。為了應對這些限制，我們提出了物理知識驅動的血流動力學建模，這是一個集成的深度學習框架，用於從雙視角血管造影進行三維冠狀血流分析。首先，增強注意力的CNN從血管造影中重建冠狀幾何。隨後，生成的點雲被映射到參考域並進行傅里葉編碼以實現聯合表示。一個解耦網絡分別預測速度和壓力場，嵌入的物理先驗使得在生理條件之間的有效轉移成為可能。在32名在四種流動條件下評估的臨床患者中，經狹窄壓降的平均絕對百分比誤差為2.02%，而速度和壓力的相對L2誤差分別為0.054和0.023。與醫院測量的FFR進行驗證進一步達到了93.8%的診斷準確率（30/32；精確95% CI，79.2%-99.2%）。該框架還支持說明性的再血管化比較和稀疏數據同化，整個血管造影到血流動力學的流程在每位患者身上完成的時間不超過20分鐘。

docs.title: Prepared Or Unprepared? Evaluating Healthcare Workforce Readiness for Clinical Adoption of Artificial Intelligence in Nigeria
docs.text:
2609.19096v1 by Abbas M. Rabiu, Abdulrazaq A. Zubair, Um-mulkhairi Ibrahim, Tolulope Olusuyi, Shaheeda Farouq, Safwan M. Dafi, Adaobi C. Emegoakor, Yewande Gbadamosi, Maruf Adewole

Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly integrated into healthcare systems worldwide, yet its successful clinical adoption depends critically on workforce readiness, particularly in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) where infrastructural and training gaps persist. This cross-sectional study evaluated awareness, attitudes, preparedness, and barriers to AI adoption among 761 healthcare professionals across multiple disciplines and practice settings in Nigeria. Data were collected between December 2025 and March 2026 using a structured, validated questionnaire. Overall awareness of AI in healthcare was high (92.6%); however, objective knowledge and self-reported preparedness remained limited, with 40.9% reporting low or very low knowledge and only 63.0% feeling adequately prepared. Willingness to adopt AI was high: 92.5% expressed interest in training, and 78.7% supported inclusion of AI education in undergraduate curricula. Key barriers included lack of training (84.7%), poor infrastructure (71.1%), high cost of AI tools (61.0%), fear of job displacement (60.6%), ethical concerns (52.9%), and data privacy concerns (52.7%). Significant differences in preparedness were observed across geopolitical zones (chi-square (5) = 24.28, p < 0.001), and awareness differed across professional groups (chi-square (6) = 68.38, p < 0.001). Attitudes toward AI differed significantly across professional groups (F = 3.32, p = 0.003), with professionals who felt prepared demonstrating more positive attitudes (mean = 3.74) compared to those who did not (mean = 3.46). These findings reveal a critical disconnect between high awareness and actual readiness, underscoring the need for targeted training, infrastructure investment, and clear implementation frameworks to bridge the gap between AI technological potential and clinical reality in resource-constrained settings.

摘要：人工智慧（AI）正日益融入全球的醫療系統，但其成功的臨床採用在很大程度上依賴於人力資源的準備程度，特別是在基礎設施和培訓存在缺口的低收入和中等收入國家（LMICs）。本橫斷面研究評估了761名來自尼日利亞多個學科和實踐環境的醫療專業人員對AI的認識、態度、準備情況和採用障礙。數據於2025年12月至2026年3月期間通過結構化的經驗驗證問卷收集。醫療領域對AI的整體認識很高（92.6%）；然而，客觀知識和自我報告的準備程度仍然有限，40.9%的人報告知識低或非常低，只有63.0%的人感到準備充分。對於採用AI的意願很高：92.5%的人表達了對培訓的興趣，78.7%的人支持在本科課程中納入AI教育。主要障礙包括缺乏培訓（84.7%）、基礎設施差（71.1%）、AI工具的高成本（61.0%）、對工作取代的恐懼（60.6%）、倫理問題（52.9%）和數據隱私問題（52.7%）。在地緣政治區域之間觀察到準備程度的顯著差異（卡方檢驗（5）= 24.28，p < 0.001），而不同專業群體之間的認識也有所不同（卡方檢驗（6）= 68.38，p < 0.001）。對AI的態度在不同專業群體之間顯著不同（F = 3.32，p = 0.003），感到準備充分的專業人員表現出更積極的態度（平均 = 3.74），相比之下，感到不充分的專業人員的平均值為3.46。這些發現揭示了高認識與實際準備之間的關鍵脫節，強調了需要針對性的培訓、基礎設施投資和明確的實施框架，以縮小AI技術潛力與資源有限環境中的臨床現實之間的差距。

docs.title: Reporting Practice Matters: The Impact of Reference Choice on Chest X-ray Report Evaluation
docs.text:
2609.19093v1 by Daniel P. Jeong, Charles Q. Li, Hossein Hosseiny, Nitya M. Bhalla, Fatma Uyar Morency, Pradeep Ravikumar, Zachary C. Lipton, Michael Oberst

Radiologists follow heterogeneous reporting practices. Two radiologists examining the same image and identifying the same clinical findings might nevertheless compose superficially distinct reports, varying in terminology, shorthand, formatting, and level of detail. These variations in reporting norms represent an under-appreciated obstacle in efforts to evaluate AI-based radiology report generation (RRG) models, where machine-generated reports are typically assessed based on their concordance with human-generated references. In this paper, we quantify the sensitivity of established evaluation metrics to variations in reporting practices, revealing impacts large enough to alter the rankings of models. We introduce a radiologist-informed taxonomy of variations in radiology reporting practice and a method (ReRef) that rewrites reference reports along the axes of our taxonomy while preserving clinical interpretation. For instance, when comparing the performance of nine RRG models on MIMIC-CXR using RadCliQ-v1, condensing the discussion of normal findings in the reference reports causes Libra to drop from first to second place while CheXOne rises from third to first. Our results suggest that many current metrics fail to decouple clinical interpretation from conformity to reporting practices and that choosing the ``right'' references that accurately reflect the desired reporting practices can be important in practice. To support future research, we release MIMIC-CXR-Ext-ReRef, a radiologist-validated dataset of 120 (original, alternative) reference report pairs derived from MIMIC-CXR.

摘要：放射科醫生遵循異質的報告實踐。兩位放射科醫生檢查同一影像並識別相同的臨床發現，然而他們可能仍然撰寫表面上不同的報告，這些報告在術語、簡寫、格式和細節程度上有所不同。這些報告規範的變異代表了一個被低估的障礙，對於評估基於人工智慧的放射報告生成（RRG）模型的努力來說，機器生成的報告通常是根據其與人類生成的參考報告的一致性來評估的。在本文中，我們量化了既定評估指標對報告實踐變異的敏感性，揭示出足以改變模型排名的影響。我們引入了一個基於放射科醫生的放射報告實踐變異分類法以及一種方法（ReRef），該方法在我們的分類法軸上重寫參考報告，同時保留臨床解釋。例如，當使用RadCliQ-v1比較九個RRG模型在MIMIC-CXR上的表現時，對參考報告中正常發現的討論進行簡化，導致Libra從第一名降至第二名，而CheXOne則從第三名上升至第一名。我們的結果表明，許多當前的指標未能將臨床解釋與報告實踐的遵循分開，並且選擇準確反映所需報告實踐的“正確”參考在實踐中可能是重要的。為了支持未來的研究，我們發布了MIMIC-CXR-Ext-ReRef，這是一個經過放射科醫生驗證的數據集，包含120對（原始、替代）參考報告對，來源於MIMIC-CXR。

docs.title: The AR Fairness Metamodel: A Structured Framework for Fairness Measures
docs.text:
2609.19234v1 by Julian Alfredo Mendez, Timotheus Kampik

This paper presents the AR fairness metamodel, a framework designed to represent, analyze, and compare different fairness scenarios. The metamodel considers key elements, such as agents, resources, and their attributes, and enables the systematic definition and comparison of various fairness measures. We provide examples involving both discrete and continuous measures, including equality, equity, group fairness, individual fairness, the Gini index, the Theil index, Jain's fairness index, and a detailed fairness measure for Australia's Child Care Subsidy. We also explore relationships among group fairness, individual fairness, and envy-freeness, supported by formal proofs. At the conceptual modeling level, our approach builds on the Tiles framework, which offers modular components that can be connected to capture diverse fairness definitions. The goal is to make AR-based fairness definitions practical and adaptable across contexts, providing a clear way to define, compare, and evaluate them. An implementation of the Tiles framework is available as an open-source tool, and can support fairness modeling and evaluation across a wide range of applications.

摘要：這篇論文提出了AR公平性元模型，一個旨在表示、分析和比較不同公平情境的框架。該元模型考慮了關鍵元素，如代理、資源及其屬性，並使得各種公平性度量的系統定義和比較成為可能。我們提供了涉及離散和連續度量的例子，包括平等、公平、群體公平、個體公平、基尼指數、泰爾指數、賈因公平指數，以及澳大利亞兒童保育補貼的詳細公平性度量。我們還探討了群體公平、個體公平和無嫉妒性之間的關係，並提供了形式證明作為支持。在概念建模層面，我們的方法基於Tiles框架，該框架提供了模組化組件，可以連接以捕捉多樣的公平性定義。目標是使基於AR的公平性定義在各種情境中實用且可適應，提供一種明確的方式來定義、比較和評估它們。Tiles框架的實現作為開源工具可用，並能支持廣泛應用中的公平性建模和評估。

docs.title: Version- and Scope-Aware Question Answering over Normative Documents: A Deployed System and an End-to-End Evaluation at Production Scale
docs.text:
2609.18769v1 by Liuyin Wang, Shuaipeng Jin, Jiwei Shi, Jensen Hsu

Correctly answering a question grounded in normative documents often depends on information outside any single passage: whether the retrieved document is the version currently in force; whether it applies to the jurisdiction, subject (such as an institution or applicant), and date at issue; and whether each normative claim can be traced to its supporting source text. Hosted retrieval services have substantially lowered the engineering cost of building an initial system over such corpora, making "upload the documents and ask" a common default. We evaluate this default on approximately 73,000 candidate normative documents supplied to a production deployment. The evaluation uses a stratified sample of 200 questions from our published benchmark, with a gold source document for every question; the released sampling rule reads no system outputs or scores. We compare the hosted service with a governed system that resolves version and scope through explicit rules before generation. The governed system scored 97.7 overall, while the hosted service scored 88.1, a gap of 9.6 points computed from unrounded means. The question set, the answer text evaluated for both systems, the scores, and the scripts used to reproduce the reported benchmark statistics are public. The governed configuration has operated as a commercial product since January 2026 and serves 1,126 registered users; named customer organizations include Zhipu AI and Lecheng Health. By mid-April 2026, it had reached roughly 100,000 calls per workday.

摘要：正確回答基於規範文件的問題往往依賴於任何單一段落之外的信息：檢索到的文件是否是目前有效的版本；它是否適用於相關的管轄區、主題（例如機構或申請者）和相關日期；以及每個規範主張是否可以追溯到其支持的源文本。托管檢索服務大幅降低了在這些語料庫上建立初始系統的工程成本，使得「上傳文件並詢問」成為常見的默認選擇。我們對大約73,000份供應給生產部署的候選規範文件評估了這一默認選擇。評估使用了我們已發表基準中的200個問題的分層樣本，對於每個問題都有一份金源文件；發布的抽樣規則不讀取任何系統輸出或分數。我們將托管服務與一個通過明確規則在生成之前解決版本和範圍的管理系統進行比較。管理系統的總分為97.7，而托管服務的分數為88.1，兩者之間的差距為9.6分，計算基於未四捨五入的平均值。問題集、對兩個系統評估的答案文本、分數以及用於重現報告基準統計的腳本都是公開的。自2026年1月以來，管理配置已作為商業產品運行，服務1,126名註冊用戶；命名的客戶組織包括智譜AI和樂成健康。到2026年4月中旬，它的工作日呼叫量已達到約100,000次。

docs.title: Generalist-Specialist Mixture-of-Experts for Rare Pathology Detection in Multimodal Imaging
docs.text:
2609.18688v1 by Johannes Kaiser, Florian Braunmiller, Daniel Rückert, Georgios Kaissis

AI models for multimodal medical imaging must balance modality-specific specialization with cross-modal shared representations, a trade-off that pure Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures currently fail to satisfy. Expert-based routing improves in-domain learning but may sacrifice cross-modal signals, which appear particularly important for rare (low-prevalence) pathologies in our experiments. To resolve this, we introduce Generalist-Specialist-MoE (GS-MoE), a two-branch (MoE) architecture that couples a cross-modal generalist model with distinct modality-specific specialists (experts) via domain-constrained feature fusion. On RadImageNet (1.35M images, 165 pathologies, three modalities), GS-MoE recovers detection of six low-prevalence pathologies on which every baseline scores F1 $=$ 0, with per-class gains up to +0.60 F1. It attains this while even slightly exceeding dense and specialist-only MoE aggregate baselines (MCC 0.770), while using ${\sim}53\%$ fewer active parameters at inference than the strongest investigated dense model.

摘要：AI 模型在多模態醫學影像中必須在特定模態的專業化與跨模態的共享表徵之間取得平衡，這是一個純粹的專家混合（MoE）架構目前無法滿足的權衡。基於專家的路由改善了領域內的學習，但可能會犧牲跨模態信號，而這在我們的實驗中對於罕見（低流行率）病理顯得尤其重要。為了解決這個問題，我們引入了通才-專家-MoE（GS-MoE），這是一種雙分支（MoE）架構，通過領域約束的特徵融合將跨模態的通才模型與不同的模態專家（專家）相結合。在 RadImageNet（1.35M 圖像，165 種病理，三種模態）上，GS-MoE 恢復了六種低流行率病理的檢測，這些病理在每個基準上得分 F1 $=$ 0，並且每類的增益高達 +0.60 F1。它在這一過程中甚至略微超越了密集和專家專用 MoE 的總體基準（MCC 0.770），同時在推理時使用的主動參數比調查過的最強密集模型少了 ${\sim}53\%$。

docs.title: PACT: Can Enterprise AI Assistants Be Trusted Under Pressure?
docs.text:
2609.18605v1 by Mika Okamoto, Ansel Kaplan Erol

As corporate AI adoption continues to grow, enterprise-grade LLM agents are being deployed into sensitive contexts such as hiring, healthcare, and finance. In these contexts, compliance with rules specified in an agent's system context is a first-order legal concern. Currently, no evaluation framework systematically measures which LLM models tend to violate compliance rules, especially under pressure from a persistent user, a hurried manager, or circumstances where violation is convenient or attractive. We introduce PACT (Pressure-Applied Compliance Testing), a benchmark for rule-following under pressure in AI agents assisting employees in daily tasks across twelve regulated enterprise domains and forty-eight scenarios, each set in a realistic multi-turn conversation. Each benchmark item pairs a standing rule against a rule-violating shortcut, and applies a battery of pressures across different wordings and system-prompt modes. We construct PACT component by component under strict LLM-as-judge auditing to ensure samples are unambiguous, ungameable, and realistic enough to avoid eliciting evaluation-aware behavior. We use PACT to profile LLM compliance across six complementary metrics that create a holistic picture of an AI assistant's robustness under pressure and throughout multi-turn conversations, its transparency, and ability to correctly discern where a rule applies. We aggregate this profile into PACTScore, a reliability-weighted compliance rate over all items and modes. Our results across 22 common LLM models spanning multiple providers and sizes show substantial variability in compliance across models and metric dimensions. Even the strongest assistants mis-apply a rule on 6 to 10% of items, and ordinary user pressure raises the violation rate by 65% on average. PACT highlights compliance risks in LLM assistants, motivating guardrails and careful model selection.

摘要：隨著企業對人工智慧的採用持續增長，企業級的LLM代理正在被部署到如招聘、醫療保健和金融等敏感領域。在這些情境中，遵守代理系統上下文中規定的規則是一項首要的法律關注。目前，尚無評估框架系統性地衡量哪些LLM模型傾向於違反合規規則，特別是在持續用戶、匆忙的經理或違規方便或吸引的情況下。我們介紹了PACT（壓力應用合規測試），這是一個基準，用於評估在壓力下遵循規則的AI代理，協助員工在十二個受監管的企業領域和四十八個場景中進行日常任務，每個場景都設置在現實的多輪對話中。每個基準項目將一項現行規則與一個違規的捷徑進行配對，並在不同的措辭和系統提示模式下施加一系列壓力。我們在嚴格的LLM作為評判的審計下逐步構建PACT，以確保樣本明確、不易被操控且足夠真實，以避免引發評估意識行為。我們使用PACT來分析LLM在六個互補指標上的合規性，這些指標共同描繪了AI助手在壓力下及整個多輪對話中的穩健性、透明度以及正確辨別規則適用範圍的能力。我們將這一分析整合為PACTScore，這是一個對所有項目和模式的可靠性加權合規率。我們在22個涵蓋多個提供商和規模的常見LLM模型中的結果顯示，模型和指標維度之間的合規性存在顯著變異性。即使是最強大的助手在6%到10%的項目上也會錯誤應用規則，而普通用戶的壓力平均會使違規率提高65%。PACT突顯了LLM助手中的合規風險，促使建立防護措施和謹慎的模型選擇。

docs.title: HPOQuest: A Rare-Disease Diagnostic Agent Using Active Phenotype Acquisition
docs.text:
2609.18431v1 by Kamilia Zaripova, Nassir Navab, Azade Farshad, Annalisa Marsico

More than 300 million people worldwide are affected by one of over 7,000 known rare diseases, yet diagnosis remains difficult because patients initially present with incomplete and heterogeneous phenotypes. We present HPOQuest, a training-free framework for sequential phenotype acquisition in rare-disease diagnosis. Starting from a small set of observed patient phenotypes, HPOQuest maintains a probabilistic disease ranking and iteratively selects informative follow-up questions to support clinicians during patient assessment. Confirmed phenotypes update the disease ranking, while all responses update the candidate question set. Across four benchmark cohorts, HPOQuest substantially improves diagnosis from sparse initial phenotypes, with gains of up to 30% points at Recall@1 and 45% points at Recall@5. These results demonstrate that sequential phenotype acquisition can substantially improve rare-disease diagnosis from limited initial clinical evidence.

摘要：全球有超過3億人受到7000多種已知罕見疾病的影響，但由於患者最初呈現不完整和異質的表型，診斷仍然困難。我們提出了HPOQuest，一個無需訓練的框架，用於在罕見疾病診斷中進行序列表型獲取。HPOQuest從一小組觀察到的患者表型開始，維持一個概率疾病排名，並迭代選擇有資訊的後續問題，以支持臨床醫生在患者評估過程中的工作。確認的表型會更新疾病排名，而所有的回答則會更新候選問題集。在四個基準隊列中，HPOQuest顯著改善了從稀疏初始表型的診斷，Recall@1的提升高達30個百分點，Recall@5的提升高達45個百分點。這些結果顯示，序列表型獲取可以顯著改善基於有限初始臨床證據的罕見疾病診斷。

docs.title: TERN: A Delta-rule Memory with a Seasonal Reference and Online Adaptation for Epidemic Forecasting
docs.text:
2609.18407v2 by Shunya Nagashima, Yuta Funayama

Weekly influenza surveillance counts guide vaccine distribution and public-health alerts, yet they are hard to forecast. Each region offers only a few seasons, waves shift in timing and height every year, and information that helps while a wave grows misleads after its peak, whereas last season's shape stays informative for a year. Existing epidemic graph models and general forecasters read a short fixed window and treat all past information alike, so they neither exploit earlier seasons nor discard stale associations when the epidemic phase changes. To address these limitations, we propose TERN, a forecaster built around a delta-rule fast-weight memory that decays channel-wise and erases along a learned address under gates driven by local epidemic-phase features, combined with an explicit seasonal reference and online adaptation. On three Cola-GNN influenza benchmarks, TERN outperformed epidemic graph models and general forecasters, matched or exceeded seasonal references, and a controlled comparison confirmed the contribution of the memory itself.

摘要：每週的流感監測數據指導疫苗分配和公共衛生警報，但預測這些數據卻很困難。每個地區只有幾個季節，波峰的時間和高度每年都會變化，而在波峰增長期間有用的信息在其達到頂峰後卻會誤導，然而上個季節的形狀在一年內仍然具有參考價值。現有的流行病圖模型和一般預測者僅閱讀固定的短期窗口，並將所有過去的信息視為相同，因此它們既不利用早期的季節，也不在流行病階段變化時丟棄過時的關聯。為了解決這些限制，我們提出了TERN，一種基於快速加權記憶的預測器，該記憶根據通道逐漸衰減，並在由當地流行病階段特徵驅動的閘門下沿著學習的地址進行擦除，結合明確的季節參考和在線適應。在三個Cola-GNN流感基準上，TERN超越了流行病圖模型和一般預測者，達到了或超過了季節參考，並且受控比較確認了記憶本身的貢獻。

docs.title: A Non-Linear Neuron Based Detection of Isolated Pixels in Binary and Grayscale Images using Contrast Sensitive Receptive Fields
docs.text:
2609.18399v1 by Nassir Mohammad

Identifying isolated points is important in image processing applications such as medical imaging, astronomy and quality control management. Other domains, such as cybersecurity, also present challenges that can be framed as image processing problems. One example of particular interest is the identification of anomalous single nodes in spatially organised networks where groups of nodes in different regions share similar feature values. This task can involve both binary and more complex grayscale images. However, existing methods face limitations: template matching is infeasible for grayscale images, while 2nd order derivative based methods are highly sensitive to noise and require user-specified thresholds. To overcome these issues, a novel method is proposed for detecting meaningful single-pixel deviations in images. This approach modifies and extends a neuron model, originally designed for anomaly detection, to operate on spatially diameter limited receptive fields that incorporate excitatory and inhibitory regions. The result is a method that is free from user-specified thresholds and parameters, and can be applied to both binary and grayscale images, providing an effective, robust and efficient solution.

摘要：識別孤立點在醫學影像、天文學和質量控制管理等影像處理應用中是非常重要的。其他領域，如網路安全，也提出了可以被視為影像處理問題的挑戰。特別感興趣的一個例子是識別在空間組織網路中異常的單一節點，在這些網路中，不同區域的節點群體共享相似的特徵值。這項任務可以涉及二進制和更複雜的灰階影像。然而，現有的方法面臨著限制：模板匹配對灰階影像來說是不可行的，而基於二階導數的方法對噪音非常敏感，並且需要用戶指定的閾值。為了克服這些問題，提出了一種新方法來檢測影像中的有意義的單像素偏差。這種方法修改並擴展了一個最初設計用於異常檢測的神經元模型，使其能夠在包含興奮性和抑制性區域的空間直徑有限的感受野上運作。最終的結果是一種不需要用戶指定閾值和參數的方法，並且可以應用於二進制和灰階影像，提供了一種有效、穩健且高效的解決方案。

docs.title: A Study of the Reliability of Agentic AI-Generated Programs
docs.text:
2609.18298v2 by Ayesha Shafique, Barton P. MIller, Elisa R. Heymann

Agentic-AI based software development offers the promise of faster completion of the software, greater programmer efficiency, and more reliable code. The question is how can we verify these claims in an objective way? In this project, we attempted to answer this question based on three practices. First, we applied a typical best-practices agentic AI workflow for software development. Second, our target programs were ten well-known, release-quality human-written Linux utility programs so that we could compare the AI-generated code against a concrete ground truth. Third, we based our measure of reliability on a widely used testing technique, fuzz random testing. For this testing, we used both classic black box, generational testing and more modern coverage guided (gray box, mutational) testing using AFL++. We found that the AI-generated versions of the utility programs were typically as reliable - often more reliable - than the latest human-generated versions of these programs. While the AI-generated versions did have some failures, they were less common than the code from the standard repositories. Interestingly, the AI-generated code was less likely to have failures such as memory errors (such as buffer overflows) but more likely to have hangs such as infinite loops. In addition, we verified that generating robust and reliable software using agentic AI requires careful practice and human supervision. The quality of the code is highly dependent on the prompts and skills used, and how the human directing the process responds. We also demonstrated that using agentic AI workflow for software development (with its prompts and skills) can become a specification of the code that leads to cost-effective sustainability of the software.

摘要：代理式人工智慧（Agentic-AI）基礎的軟體開發承諾能更快完成軟體、提高程式設計師效率，並產出更可靠的程式碼。問題是，我們如何以客觀的方式驗證這些聲明？在這個專案中，我們試圖根據三個實踐來回答這個問題。首先，我們應用了典型的最佳實踐代理式人工智慧工作流程來進行軟體開發。其次，我們的目標程式是十個知名的、發布品質的人類撰寫的 Linux 工具程式，以便將 AI 生成的程式碼與具體的真實情況進行比較。第三，我們的可靠性測量基於一種廣泛使用的測試技術，即模糊隨機測試。對於這項測試，我們使用了經典的黑箱生成測試以及更現代的覆蓋引導（灰箱、變異）測試，使用 AFL++。我們發現，這些工具程式的 AI 生成版本通常與最新的人類生成版本一樣可靠——往往更可靠。雖然 AI 生成的版本確實有一些失敗，但這些失敗的頻率低於標準庫中的程式碼。有趣的是，AI 生成的程式碼不太可能出現記憶體錯誤（例如緩衝區溢出），但更可能出現無限迴圈等掛起情況。此外，我們驗證了使用代理式人工智慧生成穩健可靠的軟體需要謹慎的實踐和人類監督。程式碼的質量在很大程度上取決於所使用的提示和技能，以及指導過程的人類如何反應。我們還展示了使用代理式人工智慧工作流程進行軟體開發（連同其提示和技能）可以成為程式碼的規範，從而實現軟體的成本效益可持續性。

docs.title: A Lightweight CNN Integrated Compact Convolutional Transformer for Multi-Scale Feature Learning and reducing computational complexity for breast cancer mammography image detection and classification
docs.text:
2609.18212v1 by Md Taimur Ahad, Ainuddin Ahmed

Over the years, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have demonstrated strong capability in cancer detection and classification using medical images. However, CNN-based models often struggle to capture long-range contextual dependencies. In such scenarios, integrating Compact Convolutional Transformer (CCT) architectures after the CCT layer allows CNN-extracted features to reshape into compact patch tokens using a CCT tokenizer, followed by the addition of positional embeddings to preserve spatial structure. Using 5-fold cross-validation, the model was tested on 3 sets of breast cancer mammography. With only 250,435 parameters, the model achieved 99%-100% accuracy across 3 datasets, indicating robust generalization. Explainable AI (XAI) was integrated into the model to explain the breast cancer classification process to enhance clinical trust. The results indicate that the proposed framework is suitable for computer-aided diagnosis systems, particularly in resource-constrained clinical environments. The novelty of the proposed CNN-integrated CCT overcomes the limitation of CNN's gradient degradation in the last layers by integrating convolutional tokenization with transformer-based learning. Lighter than ViT, which is effective in capturing long-range dependencies, the model has also proven efficient in breast cancer classification by capturing long-range dependencies among breast tissue regions.

摘要：多年來，卷積神經網絡（CNN）在使用醫學影像進行癌症檢測和分類方面展現了強大的能力。然而，基於CNN的模型往往難以捕捉長距離的上下文依賴性。在這種情況下，在CCT層之後整合緊湊卷積Transformer（CCT）架構，允許CNN提取的特徵通過CCT標記器重塑為緊湊的補丁標記，隨後添加位置嵌入以保留空間結構。使用5折交叉驗證，該模型在3組乳腺癌乳房X光檢查上進行測試。僅有250,435個參數，該模型在3個數據集上達到了99%-100%的準確率，顯示出強大的泛化能力。可解釋的人工智慧（XAI）被整合進模型中，以解釋乳腺癌分類過程，增強臨床信任。結果表明，所提出的框架適合用於計算機輔助診斷系統，特別是在資源受限的臨床環境中。所提出的CNN整合CCT的新穎性克服了CNN在最後幾層中的梯度退化限制，通過將卷積標記化與基於Transformer的學習相結合。該模型比ViT更輕巧，ViT在捕捉長距離依賴性方面有效，並且在乳腺癌分類中也證明了其效率，能夠捕捉乳腺組織區域之間的長距離依賴性。

docs.title: Rethinking How We Evaluate Methodological Progress in Health AI
docs.text:
2609.18134v2 by Florent Pollet, Matthew McDermott

Methodological progress in artificial intelligence (AI) for electronic health records (EHRs) depends on our ability to determine which algorithms work better, and under which conditions. However, such progress is thought to be hindered by difficulties in reproducibility and in defining clinically meaningful evaluation tasks. We empirically study these barriers by re-implementing 12 historical and recent algorithms within a shared evaluation framework and evaluating them on two clinical datasets, MIMIC-IV and NWICU. We compare two complementary task families: expert-authored clinically meaningful tasks and generated tasks defined from randomly sampled event codes and prediction horizons. We ask whether relative algorithms comparisons transfer across task families and datasets, whether residual task heterogeneity contains useful methodological structure, and what a controlled comparison reveals about progress over the last decade. We find that aggregate pairwise comparisons transfer strongly across evaluation settings, including from randomly generated tasks to clinically meaningful tasks and across datasets. At the same time, clinically meaningful tasks exhibit greater task-method interaction, providing preliminary evidence that task properties can help explain when particular modeling choices are advantageous. Finally, newer algorithms do not consistently outperform earlier approaches: gradient-boosted trees remain highly competitive when paired with a modern, wide and sparse representation of the EHR. Together, these results suggest that useful methodological knowledge may require less task engineering than commonly assumed, while highlighting the importance of understanding the structured heterogeneity that remains across tasks and methods.

摘要：方法論在人工智慧 (AI) 於電子健康紀錄 (EHRs) 的進展取決於我們判斷哪些演算法表現更佳以及在何種條件下。然而，這樣的進展被認為受到可重複性和定義臨床上有意義的評估任務的困難所阻礙。我們透過在共享評估框架內重新實現 12 種歷史和近期的演算法，並在兩個臨床數據集 MIMIC-IV 和 NWICU 上進行評估，實證研究這些障礙。我們比較兩個互補的任務類別：專家編寫的臨床有意義任務和從隨機抽樣事件代碼和預測視野定義的生成任務。我們詢問相對的演算法比較是否能在任務類別和數據集之間轉移，殘餘任務異質性是否包含有用的方法論結構，以及受控比較對過去十年的進展揭示了什麼。我們發現，總體成對比較在評估環境之間強烈轉移，包括從隨機生成的任務到臨床有意義的任務以及跨數據集。同時，臨床有意義的任務顯示出更大的任務-方法互動，提供初步證據表明任務特性可以幫助解釋何時特定的建模選擇是有利的。最後，較新的演算法並不總是優於早期的方法：梯度提升樹在與現代的、寬且稀疏的 EHR 表示配對時仍然具有高度競爭力。綜合這些結果表明，有用的方法論知識可能需要的任務工程少於普遍假設，同時強調理解任務和方法之間仍然存在的結構性異質性的重要性。

docs.title: SNOMED CT Concept Recommendation from Masked Clinical Context
docs.text:
2609.17855v1 by Ali Noori

Standardizing clinical language to SNOMED CT supports interoperability, analytics, and reusable phenotyping, but concept recommendation remains difficult when relevant concepts are rare or absent from training data. We present a masked-concept recommendation benchmark using the SNOMED CT Entity Linking Challenge v1.2.1 data derived from MIMIC-IV-Note. The dataset contains 75,491 annotations across 272 discharge summaries, with 204 notes used for training and 68 for historical testing. For each unique note-concept pair, the target mention is masked from a local clinical context and the system ranks SNOMED CT concepts observed during training. We compare a popularity baseline, sparse TF-IDF concept prototypes, dense latent semantic analysis embeddings, sparse-dense fusion, retrieved-note evidence, and a retrieval-augmented hybrid. Sparse TF-IDF performs best, achieving Recall@1 of 14.81%, Recall@10 of 33.43%, MRR of 0.2114, and nDCG@10 of 0.2297. Retrieval augmentation does not improve this baseline, with Recall@10 of 31.99% and MRR of 0.1937. Performance is strongly affected by concept frequency: Recall@10 is 7.74% for concepts appearing in only one or two training notes versus 43.90% for concepts appearing in more than ten. In addition, 9.66% of test note-concept pairs contain concepts unseen during training. These findings show that local lexical context and terminology coverage are major determinants of recommendation quality in low-resource settings and provide a reproducible baseline for future ontology-grounded and biomedical-encoder retrieval systems.

摘要：標準化臨床語言為 SNOMED CT 支援互操作性、分析和可重用的表型，但當相關概念在訓練數據中稀少或缺失時，概念推薦仍然困難。我們提出了一個使用 SNOMED CT 實體連結挑戰 v1.2.1 數據的遮蔽概念推薦基準，該數據源自 MIMIC-IV-Note。該數據集包含 75,491 個標註，涵蓋 272 份出院摘要，其中 204 份用於訓練，68 份用於歷史測試。對於每個獨特的筆記-概念對，目標提及從當地臨床背景中遮蔽，系統對訓練期間觀察到的 SNOMED CT 概念進行排名。我們比較了人氣基準、稀疏 TF-IDF 概念原型、密集潛在語義分析嵌入、稀疏-密集融合、檢索筆記證據和檢索增強混合模型。稀疏 TF-IDF 表現最佳，達到 Recall@1 14.81%、Recall@10 33.43%、MRR 0.2114 和 nDCG@10 0.2297。檢索增強並未改善這一基準，Recall@10 為 31.99% 和 MRR 0.1937。性能受概念頻率的強烈影響：對於僅出現在一或兩份訓練筆記中的概念，Recall@10 為 7.74%，而對於出現在十份以上的概念，則為 43.90%。此外，9.66% 的測試筆記-概念對包含在訓練期間未見過的概念。這些發現表明，當地詞彙上下文和術語覆蓋範圍是低資源環境中推薦質量的主要決定因素，並為未來基於本體和生物醫學編碼器的檢索系統提供了一個可重複的基準。

docs.title: Information Set Emulation: Causal Certificates for AI Derived EHR Features
docs.text:
2609.17777v1 by Takes Fujita, Nobutaka Hattori

AI and large language models can recover clinically meaningful features from electronic health records (EHRs), but predictive usefulness does not establish admissibility for causal inference. We introduce information set emulation: an AI typed lift attaches source evidence, clinical and recording times, decision-time availability, representation version, proposed causal roles, and unresolved ambiguity to extracted features under a locked target trial. Causal certificates record auditable evidence for those roles. Features with unresolved downstream roles are routed to compatible reporting or separate analyses. Typed evidence defines an observational fiber of causal worlds consistent with the observed law. The locked scalar estimand maps this fiber to a compatible image whose squared Chebyshev radius equals the residual minimax mean squared error when the image is nonempty and compact. This classical identity provides a target-specific measure of information ambiguity. The contribution is its integration with a joint EHR observation map and an auditable certificate architecture. Under explicit exchangeability, positivity, and nuisance-consistency conditions, we give identification and cross-fitted augmented inverse probability weighted estimation, distinguishing empirical and population targets. An EHR compression-drift identity separates the roles of frame presence, treatment assignment, and outcome observation. Artificial simulations and a common-law finite-world example illustrate estimation failures and information-radius reduction. Synthetic Phase 0 notes demonstrate audit diagnostics; a separate role-specific analysis spread illustrates routing and is not an exact fiber radius. All experiments are synthetic. The framework specifies when reconstructed information can support a point claim and when compatible reporting is required.

摘要：AI 和大型語言模型可以從電子健康記錄 (EHRs) 中恢復臨床有意義的特徵，但預測的有用性並不建立因果推斷的可接受性。 我們引入信息集模擬：一種 AI 類型的提升將來源證據、臨床和記錄時間、決策時間的可用性、表示版本、提議的因果角色和未解決的模糊性附加到鎖定目標試驗下提取的特徵。 因果證書記錄這些角色的可審計證據。 具有未解決下游角色的特徵被路由到兼容的報告或單獨分析。 類型證據定義了一種觀察性因果世界的纖維，與觀察到的法則一致。 鎖定的標量估計量將這個纖維映射到一個兼容的圖像，其平方切比雪夫半徑等於當圖像非空且緊湊時的殘差最小最大均方誤差。 這一經典身份提供了一種特定於目標的信息模糊性測量。 其貢獻在於與聯合 EHR 觀察圖和可審計證書架構的整合。 在明確的可交換性、正性和干擾一致性條件下，我們給出了識別和交叉擬合的增強逆概率加權估計，區分經驗和人口目標。 EHR 壓縮漂移身份分離了框架存在、治療分配和結果觀察的角色。 人工模擬和一個普通法有限世界的例子說明了估計失敗和信息半徑的減少。 合成的第 0 階段記錄展示了審計診斷；一個單獨的角色特定分析擴展展示了路由，並不是一個精確的纖維半徑。 所有實驗都是合成的。 該框架指定了何時重建的信息可以支持一個點聲明以及何時需要兼容的報告。

docs.title: CareMirror: Bringing Caregiver Wellbeing into the Dementia Care Ecosystem
docs.text:
2609.17434v1 by Jiayue Melissa Shi, Ethan Nguyen, Drishti Goel, Upasana Natarajan, Shashwat Srivatsa, Daniel S. Brown, Violeta J. Rodríguez, Dong Whi Yoo, Ravi Karkar, Koustuv Saha

Family caregivers of people living with dementia shoulder emotional and practical responsibilities, yet their own wellbeing often remains peripheral to dementia care. We built CareMirror, an envisioned caregiver wellbeing ecosystem with interconnected caregiver- and clinician-facing interfaces for longitudinal reflection, personalized support, and caregiver-controlled sharing with clinical care. We conducted semi-structured interviews with 14 caregivers, using CareMirror as a design probe to examine how they perceived this ecosystem and what expectations, concerns, and boundaries emerged around clinical connection. Caregivers valued attention to their wellbeing, longitudinal awareness, context-sensitive support, and clinical visibility when it could lead to meaningful follow-up. However, repeated reflection could become burdensome or emotionally difficult, automatic clinical sharing could inhibit candid disclosure, and participants wanted control over what information entered clinical care. They also expected AI to support reflection and communication without replacing caregiver voice or clinician judgment. We contribute design considerations for proactive, clinically connected caregiver wellbeing support.

摘要：家庭照顧者在照顧患有癡呆症的人時，承擔著情感和實際的責任，但他們自己的福祉往往在癡呆症護理中處於邊緣地位。我們建立了CareMirror，一個設想中的照顧者福祉生態系統，擁有互聯的面向照顧者和臨床醫生的界面，用於長期反思、個性化支持和照顧者控制的臨床共享。我們對14位照顧者進行了半結構化訪談，使用CareMirror作為設計探針，檢視他們對這個生態系統的看法，以及圍繞臨床聯繫出現的期望、擔憂和界限。照顧者重視對他們福祉的關注、長期的認知、情境敏感的支持，以及在能夠導致有意義的後續跟進時的臨床可見性。然而，重複的反思可能會變得繁重或情感上困難，自動的臨床共享可能會抑制坦誠的披露，參與者希望能控制進入臨床護理的信息。他們還期望人工智慧能支持反思和溝通，而不取代照顧者的聲音或臨床醫生的判斷。我們提供了主動、臨床連結的照顧者福祉支持的設計考量。
